title: Quantum Product Architect
description:
At NVIDIA, we're solving the world's most demanding problems with our unique approach to accelerated computing. Quantum computing is one of the transformative technologies we are bringing to life — and the US national laboratories and federal research community are key hubs for much of that work. NVIDIA's quantum platform, spanning CUDA-Q, cuQuantum, CUDA-Q QEC, and NVQLink, is already central to how researchers simulate quantum systems, develop error-corrected architectures, and connect QPUs to GPU supercomputing.

We're looking for a passionate quantum computing expert to lead developer relations across this community. In this role you will define strategic collaborations, drive adoption of NVIDIA's quantum SDKs across federal research programs and serve as the technical bridge between mission scientists and NVIDIA's product and engineering teams. You'll do this by getting into the ecosystem — running workshops at user facilities, presenting at conferences, building reference implementations, and cultivating a network of collaborators across the federal quantum landscape. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!

What you'll be doing:

  • Serve as the senior technical and strategic interface to a focused set of NVIDIA’s most important QPU-builder partners.

  • Develop a detailed understanding of each partner’s architecture, technical roadmap, product strategy, and system requirements. Use these insights to shape NVIDIA’s computing, networking, and quantum software roadmaps.

  • Create and drive multi-year joint roadmaps that integrate partner QPUs with NVIDIA GPUs, networking, systems, and software, including CUDA-Q, CUDA-Q QEC, cuQuantum, and NVQLink.

  • Move partner engagements from piecemeal integrations toward co-designed, productizable QPU-GPU systems and reference architectures that NVIDIA and its partners can take to market.

  • Lead cross-functional work across NVIDIA product, engineering, systems, networking, developer relations, and business development teams to turn joint roadmaps into clear technical plans and deliverables.

  • Conduct technical workshops, hackathons, and hands-on training sessions at national labs, user facilities, and federal research venues. Represent NVIDIA at scientific and technical conferences such as SC, APS Global Physics Summit, and IEEE Quantum Week.

  • Engage senior technical leaders, including division directors, principal investigators, chief scientists, and program managers. Collaborate to address architectural challenges such as QPU-GPU integration, real-time control, decoding latency, and the transition to fault tolerance.

What we need to see:

  • Master's degree in physics, computer science, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, chemistry, or a related field, or equivalent experience. PhD preferred.

  • 14+ years of experience in quantum information science, with 5+ years in the quantum computing industry or at a national laboratory or similar research institution.

  • Demonstrated technical expertise across quantum algorithms, quantum error correction, or quantum hardware and control systems, with the ability to maintain a credible conversation with a principal investigator.

  • Hands-on background in scientific computing, high-performance computing, or GPU-accelerated software development.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including public speaking to technical audiences.

  • Willingness to travel frequently (approximately 40%) to national laboratories, federal sites, and conferences across the United States.

  • This position requires U.S. citizenship and a security clearance. An active TS/SCI or DOE Q clearance is strongly preferred.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Prior experience working at or with a DOE national laboratory, an NQIS Research Center, or other federal institution — particularly hands-on time at a leading computing facility.

  • Familiarity with federal research funding, procurement, and collaboration mechanisms, and with how lab program offices set technical direction.

  • Prior developer relations, technical evangelism, or solutions architecture experience in a research-facing role.

  • Experience with quantum control stacks, QPU calibration, or real-time systems.

We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our best-in-class engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous person with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!

title: NA Customs Compliance Lead
description:
Welcome to Gordon Food Service! We are excited that you are thinking about opportunities with us, and we have an amazing story to share. See below for a quick glance of who we are and the impact you could have on the food service industry. There's a seat at our table for you...

Position Summary:


The NA Customs Compliance Lead is responsible for the administration and analysis of functions associated with the importation of goods by Gordon Food Service (Limson). Key responsibility is performing preliminary review and risk assessment of all items offered for import, as well as management of post entry verification programs. The position will also oversee the Company’s strict adherence to a set of formal policies and procedures designed to ensure compliance with all applicable rules and regulations.

What you will do:

  • Provide preliminary assessment and approval of all new items offered for import by Gordon Food Service (Limson).

  • Identify items and areas of high compliance risk; consult and advise leadership for potential exposure.

  • Manage shared tariff bases of classifications, tariff rates, TT, origin, and other import data elements.

  • Maintain an internal reference library to assist decisions about tariff classification, valuation, preferential claims.

  • Maintain and promote the use of a manual of customs compliance policies and procedures.

  • Manage post entry verification programs, and oversee individual and blanket corrections of customs records.

  • Apply and maintain an SOP governing the working relationship with Canadian customs brokers.

  • Track accuracy of customs entries, as well as billing of brokerage, duty, and OGD fees.

  • Serve as the liaison between AP, Cost, Finance, and customs compliance teams.

  • Support customs compliance projects such as CBSA compliance verifications, and refund claims.

  • Interpret new customs policies and regulations in order to establish new processes and procedures needed to ensure the Company meets its compliance responsibilities.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

When you will work:

  • Monday through Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm.

  • Hybrid Work Schedule: 4 days in office, 1 day from home.

What you'll bring to the table:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Management or related field required.

  • CCS or CTCS certification strongly preferred.

  • Minimum of four years experience in analytical customs compliance environment with customs brokers or companies with large import/export operations. In lieu of the specified education and experience requirements, a proven capability to perform the essential functions of the job, as demonstrated by an equivalent combination of education, training and/or relevant work experience may be considered.

  • In-depth understanding of tariff classification principles (GIR).

  • In-depth understanding of customs valuation methods and application of FTA specific rules of origin.

  • Ability to maintain and analyze large tariff bases of foreign vendors and imported items.

  • Knowledge and experience in filing individual and blanket corrections.

  • Knowledge of the various PGA’s and OGD’s within North America.

  • Experience with imports regulated by CFIA and GAC (primarily TRQ subject goods).

  • Must have excellent written, verbal, organizational and communication skills as well as problem-solving capabilities.

  • Excellent time management and organizational skills with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Results oriented with strong determination to succeed.

  • Positive attitude with a commitment to learning and desire for personal and professional growth.

BE PART OF AN AMAZING CULTURE WHERE WHAT MATTERS TO YOU, MATTERS TO US!

Gordon Food Service values our customers and understands that their success is largely dependent upon their workforce. To demonstrate our commitment to our partnership, we will require any candidate who works for a Gordon Food Service customer to provide a letter of support from their management if they are selected for the interview process.

title: Engineering Director, VxWorks
description:
ABOUT WIND RIVER

Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability.

Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. The company’s software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers. We’ve achieved recent 5G milestones including the world’s first successful 5G data session with Verizon and building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone.

The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a “Top Workplace” for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where the lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer-focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging, come join us and help advance the future software defined world.


YOUR ROLE

As an Engineering Director – VxWorks, you will lead a global engineering organization responsible for the development, delivery, evolution, and quality of the VxWorks real-time operating system and adjacent safety-certified products serving Aerospace, Defense, Government, Industrial, and other mission-critical markets.

You will be accountable for product delivery, technology strategy, organizational effectiveness, and execution against business commitments. Working closely with Product Management, Services, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership, you will ensure VxWorks continues to deliver industry-leading reliability, safety, security, and performance while supporting long-term growth objectives.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and develop an organization of 75+ software engineers and engineering managers across multiple geographic locations.

  • Own execution and delivery of the VxWorks product roadmap, including safety-certified and security-focused capabilities.

  • Define and drive the long-term technical strategy and investment priorities for the VxWorks platform and related technologies.

  • Align engineering resources, organizational capacity, and development investments with product strategy, customer commitments, and revenue objectives.

  • Establish and monitor engineering performance metrics, driving continuous improvement in quality, productivity, delivery predictability, and customer satisfaction.

  • Provide executive-level visibility into program status, business impact, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.

  • Identify and proactively manage technical, schedule, product, and certification risks.

  • Champion a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

  • Ensure successful delivery of mission-critical and safety-critical software that meets the highest standards of reliability, performance, safety, and security.

  • Lead participation in safety, security, compliance, and certification audits and regulatory reviews.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable standards and frameworks, including DO-178C, ISO 26262, IEC 61508, and customer cybersecurity requirements.

  • Provide technical leadership in embedded systems, RTOS, virtualization, and system software architecture.

  • Drive adoption of modern engineering practices, including DevSecOps, automation, CI/CD, AI agentic workflows, and secure software development.

  • Partner with Product Management to translate market opportunities, customer requirements, and business objectives into executable roadmaps and engineering plans.

  • Collaborate with Services teams to enable customer-specific solutions while preserving platform scalability, maintainability, and certification objectives.

  • Support strategic customer engagements, executive briefings, customer escalations, and key account growth initiatives.

  • Develop organizational capability through talent acquisition, coaching, leadership development, and succession planning.

HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE

Success in this role requires exceptional leadership, technical depth, operational rigor, and the ability to align engineering execution with business outcomes.

Experience

  • BTech/BE/MTech/ME Educational Background

  • 12+ years of experience in embedded systems, platform software, operating systems, or related engineering disciplines.

  • 7+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience, including responsibility for managers and multi-team organizations.

  • Demonstrated success delivering safety-critical, mission-critical, or revenue-critical software products at scale.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience leading large-scale engineering organizations delivering embedded software, operating systems, platform software, or safety-critical products.

  • Demonstrated success managing managers and scaling organizations to support strategic and revenue-critical business objectives.

  • Deep understanding of embedded systems, real-time operating systems, virtualization technologies, and system-level software architecture.

  • Experience defining technology strategy and driving multi-year platform evolution in partnership with product and business leaders.

  • Demonstrated experience with safety certification frameworks such as DO-178C, ISO 26262, IEC 61508, or equivalent standards.

  • Experience delivering software products in secure, highly regulated, or mission-critical environments.

  • Strong knowledge of modern software engineering practices, including DevSecOps, CI/CD, automation, AI agentic workflows, and secure development lifecycle processes.

  • Hands-on software development experience with C and C++.

  • Proven ability to balance technical priorities, customer commitments, product strategy, and business outcomes.

  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and customer engagement skills.

  • Experience collaborating effectively across Engineering, Product Management, Services, Sales, and Customer Success organizations.

  • Experience leading globally distributed teams and fostering high-performance engineering cultures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with cybersecurity compliance frameworks such as NIST SP 800-171, NIST 800-53, or equivalent standards.

  • Experience delivering certified software platforms for Aerospace & Defense, Industrial, Automotive, Medical, or other regulated industries.

  • Experience supporting strategic customer relationships, major account pursuits, or executive-level customer engagements.

WHY JOIN US?
In a world increasingly driven by software innovation, Wind River is pioneering the technologies that accelerate the digital transformation of our customers with a new generation of mission‑critical AI systems—built for an AI‑first world with the most exacting safety, security, performance, and reliability standards. Our success depends on our ability to innovate with velocity and deliver solutions that help customers solve their toughest challenges.

Wind River is a global leader in mission‑critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, we have been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that demand the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability. We support customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries as they build the next generation of intelligent machines.

Wind River’s technology has supported historic achievements—from NASA’s Artemis I and the James Webb Space Telescope to multiple Mars rovers, as well as the world’s first successful 5G data session with Verizon and one of the largest Open RAN networks with Vodafone.
With industry recognition for innovation, leadership, and workplace excellence—including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a “Top Workplace” for ten straight years—Wind River offers a culture built on growth mindset, customer focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging.

· Named Top Workplace for the 10th year in a row
· Wind River’s strong commitment to DEIB

title: Exercise Physiologist
description:

Join Australia's Leading Provider of Occupational Health & General Medical Services

Backed by the world-leading Sonic Healthcare network, Sonic HealthPlus partners with businesses to provide a range of onsite and in-clinic occupational and corporate healthcare services. Sonic HealthPlus is committed to fostering a supportive, inclusive and collaborative workplace where our people thrive. Whether you're wanting to advance your career, develop new skills or looking to make a meaningful difference in your communities, you’ll be empowered to grow and succeed with us.

We offer competitive remuneration, ongoing professional development and flexible working opportunities where possible, all within a supportive team culture built on integrity, excellence and care.

About the Role

We're seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Exercise Physiologist or Exercise Scientist to join our allied health team at our Brisbane CBD Clinic on a full-time basis.

Reporting directly to the Practice Manager, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality occupational health services, including fitness-for-work assessments, musculoskeletal screenings and functional testing. There will also be opportunities to provide onsite health, wellness and injury prevention services to our corporate clients.

Whether you're an experienced clinician or a recent graduate, this is an excellent opportunity to develop your career in occupational health.   • Providing onsite occupational health services at client workplaces as required.

  • Excellent interpersonal and organisational skills.

Desirable

  • Experience delivering workplace health promotion, wellness or injury prevention programs.

title: Senior Psychometrist Brain and Body Donation Program
location: Banner Research (10515 W Sante Fe Dr)
description:
Primary City/State:

Sun City, Arizona

Department Name:

Neuropsychology-Rsrch

Work Shift:

Day

Job Category:

Clinical Care

The Research Institute Brain and Body Donation Program – Sun City serves all aspects of the Institute’s mission – to make a difference to patients with age-related disorders through cutting-edge research, clinical care, prevention, and education. The Neuropsychology team includes neuropsychologists, psychometrists, research assistants, post-doctoral fellows, and psychology graduate students. Our team is dedicated to precision and accuracy in administration of neuropsychological measures, compassionate care for our patients and research participants, and collaborative innovation of best practices.

The Senior Psychometrist administers and scores complex cognitive and neuropsychological tests. Assessments take place in diverse contexts, including government- and industry-sponsored research and clinical trials, local and national research consortiums, community-based cognitive screenings, and outpatient clinical evaluations. The psychometrists work closely with the neuropsychologists and under their supervision. Neuropsychologists are always there to help, support, and educate. Research opportunities are available for someone who is planning to study further in graduate school or medical school.

As a member of our team, you will also be engaged in our robust training program, which teaches the next generation of neuropsychologists (graduate students and post-doctoral fellows). The Neuropsychology Center is also called upon for sharing our expertise in cognitive assessment with colleagues across various departments.

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8am to 4:30pm

Location: Banner Research 10515 W Santa Fe Dr Sun City, AZ

Banner Alzheimer's Institute (BAI) was established in 2006 as Banner Health's first Center of Excellence. Banner Sun Health Research Institute (BSHRI) was founded in 1986. Our team is uniquely, passionately, and strategically committed to ending Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative disorders without losing another generation, advancing oncology research to improve cancer prevention and treatment outcomes, and providing an unparalleled model of care for families facing these devastating diseases. Banner Research is committed to improving people's lives through comprehensive patient care and advances that capitalize on the best biomedical research. We intend to make a transformational difference in Alzheimer's disease, other neurodegenerative disorders, and oncology research and care.

POSITION SUMMARY
This position administers complex, global clinical assessments as well as cognitive and neuropsychological assessments. All employees are responsible for (1) supporting the Company’s goals and mission, (2) for following all Company policies and procedures, (3) for providing quality customer service, and (4) for following safety standards in performing all aspects of the functions below, reporting/removing unsafe equipment and attending safety education sessions.

CORE FUNCTIONS
1. Administers global clinical assessments using semi-structured and unstructured interviews. This position attends training for specific clinical trial and/or research protocols and administers the interviews in accordance with protocols to ensure validity.

2. Scores evaluations and provides required observational summary as relevant. For certain evaluations, enters test data into computer database ensuring accuracy and entry in a timely manner.

3. Attends training provided by research sponsors to understand study protocols, administration and scoring procedures. Conducts interviews with a high level of attention to detail and with strict adherence to study protocols and procedures in order to provide valid test results.

4. May assist in the training of cognitive psychometrists and interns in the proper administration and scoring of instruments, along with the varied nuances of testing including behavioral observations, effort and validity of assessment, and rapport-building with patient/participant.

5. This position is responsible to assess clinical severity of research participants. Confers with supervisor, site neuropsychologist, and/or study investigator for unusual or complex cases. This person will need to function independently and be able to provide a clinical assessment / judgment of severity without guidance from other team members and without access to medical records. This position serves the clinical trials department and pharma sponsors and their CROs.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Master’s Degree in psychology, behavioral health or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Certification from Washington University for Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR) scale required upon hire or must be obtained within the first 90 days of employment.

Requires two years of clinical and cognitive assessment experience or related education experience. Requires excellent clinical judgment and communication skills (both verbal and written). Requires ability to establish rapport with clinical with varying degrees of impairment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

Located on the dynamic CU Anschutz Medical Campus—adjacent to the Fitzsimons Innovation Community and nationally recognized partners including University of Colorado Hospital and Children’s Hospital Colorado—the School of Dental Medicine offers a unique environment where discovery, innovation, and patient care converge.

This is an extraordinary opportunity for an accomplished leader to build on a strong foundation, inspire faculty, staff, and students, foster strategic partnerships, advance fundraising and community engagement efforts, and drive the next era of growth and impact for one of the region’s premier dental schools.

If you are passionate about advancing academic excellence, leading innovation, and improving oral health outcomes for future generations, we invite you to apply.

- Provide visionary leadership and strategic direction that advances the School of Dental Medicine’s mission, aligns with campus and system priorities, and strengthens its national reputation in education, research, clinical care, and community engagement.

- Lead and continuously enhance academic programs, ensuring educational excellence, innovation, student success, accreditation compliance, and interprofessional collaboration.

- Promote interdisciplinary collaboration across CU Anschutz and its partners to advance integrated education, research, clinical care, and innovation.

- Maintain effective governance, accreditation, compliance, risk management, and accountability practices that support institutional excellence and continuous improvement.

To view more details on this role, review the job prospectus.

Why Join Us\:

The University of Colorado School of Dental Medicine stands at the forefront of dental education, clinical innovation, research, and community impact. As part of the nationally renowned CU Anschutz, the school offers an extraordinary environment where interdisciplinary collaboration, scientific discovery, and patient-centered care converge. With a strong foundation of academic excellence, a commitment to advancing oral health, and strategic partnerships across healthcare, research, and industry, the School of Dental Medicine is uniquely positioned for continued growth and influence.

CACI is searching for an Intermediate Information System Security Officer to support the FEMA Office of the Chief Information Security Officer (OCISO) in Washington, D.C. As an Intermediate ISSO, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the security and compliance of FEMA's information systems. You will work in a dynamic environment, collaborating with Lead ISSOs, IT system owners, stakeholders, and cybersecurity professionals to implement and maintain robust security controls. Your efforts will directly contribute to safeguarding FEMA's mission-critical systems and data. The Intermediate ISSO will be responsible for technical cybersecurity efforts in coordination with Lead ISSOs, providing direct support to the Compliance Branch Lead. Serving as a point of contact for technical cybersecurity matters related to quantifying technical risk, the Intermediate ISSO will execute Risk Management Framework activities for ATO decisions, ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability of FEMA Information Systems, and implement security controls throughout the system lifecycle. This position requires maintaining a security posture in compliance with FISMA, DHS 4300 Series, NIST, and DHS and Component Directives.


Responsibilities:

The Intermediate ISSO will execute Risk Management Framework activities for ATO decisions and ensure systems meet compliance requirements while ensuring confidentiality, integrity, and availability of FEMA Information Systems through proper security control implementation. This position requires implementing security controls and conducting system assessments to identify vulnerabilities and gaps, as well as developing and maintaining System Security Plans, Configuration Management Plans, and Contingency Plans. The Intermediate ISSO will conduct Security Impact Analyses and test configuration changes pre- and post-deployment, support continuous monitoring of IT systems, and develop and track POA&Ms for identified vulnerabilities. Responsibilities include developing security requirement traceability matrices and managing hardware and software inventory lists, supporting cloud security initiatives, and participating in Change Advisory Board (CAB) reviews. The position involves conducting technical vulnerability assessments, providing audit support documentation, and responding to cybersecurity data calls with timely information to leadership. Critical deliverables include preparing Security Test Plans 90 days prior to testing and Security Test Reports within 15 days after testing, generating POA&Ms within 0 to 15 days after vulnerability identification, and updating System Security Plans, Configuration Management Plans, and Contingency Plans annually or when changes occur. The Intermediate ISSO will conduct Security Impact Analysis Reports within 5 business days after change notification, analyze Risk Assessment Reports and FISMA Scorecard Analysis on a daily basis, and produce Weekly Activity Reports and Monthly Program Reports. This position requires following the Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) Guide when developing, updating, or reviewing required security artifacts and tracking and suggesting technologies, processes, and practices designed to protect networks, devices, programs, and data from malicious attack, damage, or unauthorized access.

- Minimum 7 years of experience in information security

title: Senior Engineer - NextGen OS V&V Test
description:
ABOUT WIND RIVER

Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability.

Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. The company’s software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers. We’ve achieved recent 5G milestones including the world’s first successful 5G data session with Verizon and building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone.

The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a “Top Workplace” for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where the lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer-focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging, come join us and help advance the future software defined world.

We are seeking a skilled Validation and Testing Developer to join our team in developing the next generation Real-Time Operating System (RTOS).

As a Senior Engineer for verification and validation testing, you will contribute to researching and evaluating tools and framework, as well as designing and implementing the test framework used for both certified and non-certified software components. You will also be contributing to designing and implementing system testing and V&V test development.

In your daily job you will:

  • Work with technical leads to evaluate next-generation validation and verification tools best suited for certification objectives (all Design Assurance Levels) for DO-178C and other standards

  • Assess tool qualification requirements per Software Tool Qualification Considerations

  • Working with architects and tech leads to develop a scalable and maintainable test framework for the next generation embedded OS to support both certified (DO-178C) and non-certified testing workflows, such as requirements-based testing, structural coverage analysis, and traceability

  • Implement automation capabilities for continuous integration and continuous regression testing

  • Participate in developing system-level tests to validate RTOS functionality, performance, and timing behavior

  • Create and execute verification and validation (V&V) test cases traceable to system and software requirements

  • Collaborate with systems and software engineers to ensure complete requirements coverage

  • Take initiative to improve the RTOS product and processes

  • Collaborate and engage effectively with global software engineering teams.

  • Work in an Agile Scrum Teams and follow Agile processes

Key skills and competencies for succeeding in this role are:

  • BTech / MTech degree (Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or equivalent technical degree).

  • 5+ years of experience in software testing, verification, or validation

  • Good understanding of RTOS concepts (scheduling, concurrency, determinism, resource management)

  • Experience with DO-178C (or DO-178B) software lifecycle and verification objectives is a plus

  • Familiarity with DO-330 tool qualification processes is a plus

  • Proficiency in test automation and framework development (e.g., Python, C, C++)

  • Experience with requirements-based testing and traceability is a plus

  • Experience with static analysis, model-based testing, or formal methods is a plus

  • Knowledge of structural coverage tools and techniques (MC/DC, branch, statement) is a plus

  • Experience with commercial or open-source RTOS platforms (e.g., VxWorks, RTEMS, Zephyr, FreeRTOS) is a plus

  • Familiarity with verification tools such as VectorCAST, LDRA, Parasoft, Rapita, or equivalent is a plus

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines

  • Experience with firmware bring up and boot up is a plus

In a world increasingly driven by software innovation, Wind River is pioneering the technologies that accelerate the digital transformation of our customers with a new generation of mission‑critical AI systems—built for an AI‑first world with the most exacting safety, security, performance, and reliability standards. Our success depends on our ability to innovate with velocity and deliver solutions that help customers solve their toughest challenges.

With industry recognition for innovation, leadership, and workplace excellence—including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a “Top Workplace” for ten straight years—Wind River offers a culture built on growth mindset, customer focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging.

  • Document findings, communicate technical results, and continuously improve validation methodologies, automation environments, and engineering processes

  • Ability to read, debug, and reason about C/C++ code (Rust or Go a plus)
  • Strong scripting and automation experience using Python, Bash, and/or Ansible
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems: concurrency, consistency models, fault tolerance, and large-scale system performance under stress
  • Ability to drive technical alignment across teams, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and make high-quality architectural decisions at speed
  • Advance AI-driven approaches to test automation: intelligent scenario generation, LLM-augmented root-cause analysis, and autonomous validation pipelines

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with large-scale clusters or distributed systems

title: REFS Specialist
description:
Job Description Summary

The REFS Specialist provides subject-matter expertise and end-to-end operational ownership across assigned Real Estate & Facility Services activities. The role translates business and site needs into reliable, compliant, cost-effective service solutions; applies data and professional judgement to identify risks and improvement opportunities; and drives actions through internal stakeholders and external service partners. The position acts as a trusted point of contact for assigned REFS domains and supports a safe, efficient, sustainable, and high-quality workplace environment.

Role Scope and Specialist Expectations
• Own assigned REFS processes and service outcomes within delegated authority, rather than limiting the role to administrative coordination.
• Apply specialist knowledge of REFS standards, local requirements, service contracts, operational risks, and site priorities.
• Analyze performance data, trends, incidents, customer feedback, and cost drivers; convert findings into practical recommendations and action plans.
• Provide expert guidance to stakeholders and service partners, escalating material risks, compliance gaps, and decisions requiring management attention.
• Lead defined improvement initiatives and workstreams from assessment through implementation, benefit tracking, and sustainable handover.
• Maintain effective governance, documentation, controls, and reporting for assigned services.


Job Description

Major Accountabilities

Service Ownership and Operational Excellence

  • Act as the specialist owner and primary point of contact for assigned REFS service areas, which may include cleaning, food and coffee services, facility maintenance, occupational health services, physical workplace, security, and employee transportation.
  • Define, monitor, and challenge service performance against agreed SLAs, KPIs, quality expectations, and site requirements.
  • Investigate recurring service issues, identify root causes, agree corrective actions, and verify effectiveness.
  • Develop and maintain service standards, operating routines, inspection mechanisms, escalation paths, and performance dashboards.
  • Drive customer-focused improvements while balancing compliance, service continuity, cost, quality, and employee experience.

Contractor and Supplier Performance Management

  • Provide day-to-day governance of subcontractors and service partners within assigned scope.
  • Monitor supplier performance, staffing, training, documentation, service quality, and adherence to contractual and site requirements.
  • Lead or facilitate service reviews, document decisions and actions, and follow through to closure.
  • Identify performance gaps and support recovery plans, change requests, commercial discussions, and issue escalation in collaboration with Procurement and REFS leadership.
  • Ensure contractor activities are planned and executed with appropriate operational, quality, HSE, and business continuity controls.

Cost, Procurement, and Resource Optimization

  • Identify, evaluate, implement, and report cost-saving and productivity opportunities without compromising compliance or service quality.
  • Perform spend and consumption analysis, prepare business cases, and track realized benefits against approved targets.
  • Provide accurate specifications, operational data, service volumes, and technical input for sourcing and procurement activities.
  • Support purchase orders, approvals, invoice validation, budget tracking, forecasting, and financial reconciliations within assigned scope.
  • Recommend demand-management, process, contract, or specification improvements based on evidence and stakeholder needs.

Projects, Change, and Continuous Improvement

  • Lead or support REFS projects and improvement initiatives, including scope definition, risk and opportunity assessment, stakeholder alignment, implementation planning, and progress reporting.
  • Apply structured problem-solving and continuous improvement methods to remove waste, simplify processes, improve controls, and strengthen service stability.
  • Assess operational readiness and support implementation of new or changed services, systems, layouts, equipment, and supplier arrangements.
  • Ensure project actions, risks, dependencies, decisions, and benefits are documented and actively managed.

Quality, Compliance, Audit, HSE, and BCM

  • Maintain audit and self-inspection readiness for assigned services and ensure required evidence is accurate, current, and retrievable.
  • Support inspections and audits as the REFS subject-matter contact; explain processes, provide documentation, and coordinate timely follow-up actions.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable Novartis requirements, Data Integrity expectations, local legal obligations, Quality standards, HSE procedures, and BCM requirements.
  • Inspect and monitor supplier HSE systems and site implementation; report, investigate, and follow up HSE incidents and unsafe conditions within assigned scope.
  • Monitor statutory and employer-related documentation requirements and escalate identified gaps promptly.
  • Provide professional guidance on non-compliance and support proportionate corrective or disciplinary processes in collaboration with the accountable functions.

Stakeholder Management, Governance, and Capability Building

  • Build trusted relationships with site functions, leadership teams, employees, Procurement, Quality, HSE, P&O, Finance, and external partners.
  • Organize and facilitate governance, operational, and project meetings; provide concise analyses, decisions required, risks, and action tracking.
  • Assess training and capability needs for assigned services; coordinate implementation and verify completion and effectiveness where applicable.
  • Communicate service changes, risks, performance, and improvement outcomes clearly to relevant audiences.
  • Share expertise, standardize good practices, and contribute to REFS knowledge management and succession readiness.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Achieve high customer satisfaction levels across key service areas in line with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs), including:
    • Cleaning Services
    • Food and Coffee Services
    • Facility Maintenance
    • Occupational Health Services
    • Physical Working Environment
    • Security Services

  • Achieve and maintain all defined operational and service-related KPIs.

Professional Competencies

  • Communication
  • Negotiation

Ideal Background

Education

title: Drilling Operator
description:
Are you ready to support safe, efficient drilling operations?

Are you able to operate mechanical and hydraulic drilling equipment in demanding environments?

Partner with the best

Drilling operations at Baker Hughes rely on highly skilled operators who support safe and flawless execution on the rig floor. Drilling operators work directly with the drilling team, handling essential mechanical tools, tubulars, and equipment used to build wellbore structure and maintain drilling continuity.

Fuel your passion

As a Drilling Operator, you will be working at the center of rig operations, supporting drilling crews with tubular handling and mechanical operations fundamental to safe well construction. You will be operating drilling‑floor tools, assisting in running casing and tubing, inspecting equipment, and supporting the driller and floorhands with the tasks required to keep drilling progressing efficiently.

As a Drilling Operator, you will be responsible for:

  • Operating drilling and tubular‑handling equipment on the rig floor—including elevators, slips, spiders, mechanical tools, and hydraulic/pneumatic devices used during pipe handling and well construction.

  • Assisting with running and pulling tubulars (casing, drill pipe, and tubing), supporting safe alignment, stabbing, latching, and connection integrity during drilling operations.

  • Inspecting tools and equipment before, during, and after drilling activities to ensure operational readiness and identify potential failures or hazards.

  • Communicating effectively with the driller, rig floor operators, and supervisors to coordinate safe movement of tubulars, tools, and equipment.

  • Following all drilling and client safety requirements, attending rig safety meetings, and maintaining constant awareness of hazards on the rig floor.

  • Supporting general rig‑floor duties such as assisting with rig‑up/rig‑down, basic equipment troubleshooting, and completing operational documentation.

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have general knowledge of the oil and gas industry, preferably with direct exposure to drilling or tubular‑handling operations.

  • Have strong mechanical aptitude and the ability to safely operate and understand mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic tools used on drilling rigs.

  • Have the ability to work well and communicate effectively with drilling crews, supervisors, and subcontracted personnel in high‑pressure environments.

  • Have a two‑year technical degree (preferred) or equivalent technical training combined with field experience.

  • Have previous industry experience and product‑line exposure (drilling, TRS, rig operations), with the ability to follow procedures and maintain safety compliance.

title: Senior System Software Engineer - Halos Core and Robotics Platform
description:
We are looking for a talented Senior System Software Engineer to help build NVIDIA Halos, our full-stack safety platform for physical AI: autonomous vehicles, humanoids, industrial robots, and intelligent machines that sense, decide, and act in the real world. This role sits at the intersection of embedded systems, rich operating systems, safety, security, virtualization, and accelerated computing. If you have a good understanding of System Software development on Real Time OS (RTOS), ARM architecture, Virtualization, strong C and/or Ada/SPARK programming skills, and experience with formal methods, we want to hear from you! We are a leading artificial intelligence computing company and are paving the way with innovations in gaming, visualization, supercomputing, and autonomous vehicle and robotics safety platforms.

NVIDIA gives automakers, tier-1 suppliers, automotive research institutions, and startups the power and flexibility to develop and deploy breakthrough artificial intelligence systems for autonomous vehicles. Our unified computing architecture makes it possible to train deep neural networks in the data center on the NVIDIA DGX™, and then seamlessly run them on NVIDIA's Halos platform inside the vehicle. Leading vehicle manufacturers, tier 1 suppliers, mapping and simulation companies, software and sensor providers, and startups around the world are developing on the NVIDIA Halos® platform to deliver the best solutions for the new world of mobility. As a System Software Engineer, you will get an opportunity to work on high-performance NVIDIA edge AI platforms running complex mixed-criticality software stacks across QNX, Linux, hypervisors, safety partitions, accelerators, and real-time AI workloads, and work alongside industry experts in diverse teams and projects.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Design, develop and debug system software for NVIDIA Halos OS across QNX, Linux, and hypervisor-based environments.

  • Design and develop BSP, boot, driver, device-management, diagnostics, and platform software for NVIDIA SoCs and edge AI platforms.

  • Design & develop I/O Virtualization solutions for mixed-criticality systems

  • Develop safe and secure software compliant with ISO 26262 and ISO 21434 standards.

  • Bring up and optimize next-generation NVIDIA platforms, working closely with ASIC, firmware, OS, safety, security, and platform teams.

  • Use Formal Methods to architect and develop high integrity software

  • Use GenAI and AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate debugging, test development, code review, documentation, requirements analysis, and workflow automation.

  • Design debugging, tracing, logging, and performance-analysis solutions that improve developer experience

  • Handle complex issues requiring interactions between components partitioned across the large software stack

  • Mentor junior engineers

What we need to see:

  • Bachelors/Masters or equivalent experience in Computer Science

  • 5+ years of experience in System Software architecture and development for real time embedded systems

  • Strong understanding of computer architecture and operating system fundamentals

  • Experience in designing and developing solutions for complex system problems.

  • Strong C and/or Ada/SPARK programming and debugging skills

  • Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools for coding, debugging, testing, documentation, or workflow automation.

  • Hands-on experience with debugging tools, performance analysis and system analyzer tools

  • A dedicated, team and results oriented, self-motivated contributor with excellent analytical and interpersonal skills

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • In-depth knowledge of embedded systems and real time operating systems, like QNX and RT Linux skills

  • Good understanding of ARM architecture and low level software development for ARM v8 based SOCs

  • Prior hands-on experience in Ada/SPARK programming (including specification and formal verification) and TLA+ formal verification modeling

  • Experience performing architectural safety analysis (FMEA/DFA) and security analysis (Threat modeling)

  • Background in software development in compliance to ISO 26262 standard

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family

title: Sr. HR Programs Specialist
description:
Company Overview

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

Job Description/Preferred Qualifications

Job Description Summary
Partner primarily with HR stakeholders to identify and address organizational and people-process challenges. Analyze organizational structures, responsibilities, workforce data, and work processes to develop practical recommendations and deliver assigned improvement initiatives. Own analysis, project execution, and follow-through within an agreed scope, while aligning priorities and decisions with the relevant HR owners.

Build an understanding of business operations through collaboration with HR partners and participation in business-facing projects. Engage managers and operational stakeholders as needed to gather input, validate findings, and support implementation, in coordination with the relevant HR partner. This hands-on individual contributor role emphasizes analytical thinking, sound judgment, and delivery; training is one possible intervention, not the default solution.

Key Responsibilities

HR Stakeholder Partnership & Organizational Analysis

  • Work with HR partners and functional specialists to understand priorities, gather employee and manager input, and define the problem to be addressed.
  • Develop knowledge of business workflows, operating requirements, and the people implications of business decisions through assigned projects.
  • Analyze organizational structures, responsibilities, reporting relationships, and cross-functional handoffs within assigned projects.
  • Identify unclear ownership, duplication, and process gaps; validate findings with the relevant HR owner and operational stakeholders.
  • Develop practical options with supporting evidence, resource implications, risks, and proposed success measures.
  • Review recommendations with HR stakeholders and secure required approvals before implementation.

Change Management & Process Improvement

  • Independently manage assigned HR improvement projects or defined workstreams, with scope, priorities, and decision boundaries agreed with the HR project owner.
  • Maintain milestones, track dependencies, resolve issues within authority, and escalate risks with recommendations.
  • Support change-impact and readiness assessments with HR partners.
  • Prepare communication materials, coordinate stakeholder input, and track adoption; recommend adjustments when implementation is not achieving the intended outcomes.
  • Map and improve HR workflows with process owners and relevant functional partners.
  • Clarify handoffs, document approved practices, and support implementation and ongoing ownership of improvements.

Organizational Programs & Implementation Support

  • Prepare analysis and materials for discussions on role clarity, team collaboration, and ways of working.
  • Facilitate defined sessions with the relevant HR partner as appropriate, and track agreed actions and follow-up.
  • Work with HR colleagues to implement and improve organizational programs. Translate engagement findings and employee feedback into proposed actions for HR review. Where a capability gap is confirmed, support targeted development and evaluate application on the job rather than attendance alone.
  • Handle sensitive organizational information with discretion. Recognize employee-relations or compliance concerns and involve the appropriate HR or legal specialists within established decision boundaries.

Workforce Analytics & Effectiveness Measurement

  • Independently clean, reconcile, and analyze workforce, organization, engagement, and process data.
  • Validate definitions and calculations, identify trends, and distinguish evidence from assumptions.
  • Agree baselines and outcome measures with the HR project owner.
  • Track adoption, process cycle time, role clarity, stakeholder feedback, and other relevant indicators, acknowledging limitations in attributing results.
  • Present concise analysis and recommendations to HR stakeholders, explaining evidence, assumptions, alternatives, and proposed actions.
  • Incorporate business input gathered through project work and follow through on agreed improvements.

Minimum Qualifications

Preferred Experience
Experience in semiconductor, technology, engineering, manufacturing, or other complex matrix organizations. Exposure to organizational design, workforce planning, employee engagement, or change implementation across functions. Familiarity with Workday, Power BI, or comparable HR and reporting tools is an advantage.

Core Capabilities & Working Approach

  • Bring independent problem-solving, data literacy, HR stakeholder collaboration, and disciplined execution. Develop business understanding by investigating how work is performed and connecting operational needs to HR recommendations. Challenge assumptions respectfully and explain conclusions in one's own words. Own work quality and follow-through; organizational decisions remain with the designated HR and business owners.
  • Use AI and automation as supporting tools, not substitutes for personal analysis or judgment. Independently verify generated facts, calculations, and recommendations, identify limitations or bias, and protect confidential information through approved tools and practices.

Success Measures

  • Reliable delivery of assigned projects and workstreams against agreed scope, milestones, and outcome targets, with timely risk escalation.
  • Documented improvements in HR process efficiency, role clarity, or handoffs within the assigned scope, measured against agreed baselines.
  • Effective collaboration with HR stakeholders and sustained adoption of approved changes, with clear action ownership and follow-up.
  • Accurate, traceable analysis that informs HR decisions, and demonstrated understanding of business operations through relevant project recommendations.

description:

The Opportunity

We are seeking a skilled Electrical Instrumentation & Controls (EIC) Measurement Technician to join our Canada Gas Operations team, supporting the Big Sky Area in Medicine Hat, AB, who is proficient in repairing, installing, troubleshooting, and performing planned maintenance and corrective tasks on assigned electronic, pneumatic, and/or mechanical control systems, devices, and ancillary equipment.

The successful candidate will also operate and maintain natural gas measurement and instrumentation equipment in a manner that meets operational needs, ensuring compliance with company and regulatory requirements. This individual must be a self-starter, capable of working with minimal supervision, who possesses excellent troubleshooting, problem solving, and communication skills.


The regular work schedule for this position will be:

Week 1 - Monday to Thursday 9 hours per day

Week 2 - Monday to Thursday 9 hours per day; 8 hours on Friday


What you’ll do

  • Support natural gas measurement equipment (flow/pressure control systems, RTU’s, orifice meters, Coriolis meters, ultrasonic meters, hydrocarbon dewpoint analyzers, H2S analyzers)

  • Other systems and equipment relevant to the pipeline system

  • Perform valve maintenance

  • Perform emergency repairs to meet customer and client needs

  • Interpret technical reference documents, drawings, and vendor manuals

  • Lead/manage the safe and efficient completion of low/medium complexity projects including the coordination and monitoring of contractor work activities or third-party active control

  • Ensure facilities, personnel, and contractors comply with TC Energy's safety, health, environment, and risk standards

  • High School Diploma

  • 2 years of related Industry experience

  • Journeyman Electrician certification and/or Journeyman Instrumentation certification

  • 3-5 years of years of related industry experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills

  • Instrumentation and/or valve maintenance experience

This position requires candidates to:

title: Growth BD Associate
description:

We are seeking a high-energy, detail-oriented Business Development Associate to join our Growth team, who will be willing to work in a dynamic multi-cultural local and regional environment with a global company
In this role, you will work directly with the Growth BD Director to bridge the gap between initial lead generation and the delivery of the right CX solutions. You will be instrumental in nurturing prospects who are looking to innovate their experience build, design, and data strategies.

Job Description:

Responsibilities

1. CX Lead Generation & Pipeline Support

  • Outreach & Prospecting: Run multi-channel outreach to identify and qualify prospect brands, pinpoint key decision makers in each account, and send targeted messages and emails to secure first-meeting opportunities.
  • Pre-Research & Opportunity Mapping: Research prospects from the outreach target list, summarize the key points that signal selling opportunities, and support ongoing client meetings as needed.
  • MQL Nurturing: Own the follow-up process for Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) generated from Merkle's global events and CX insight reports (e.g., CX Imperatives).

2. Client Engagement & Solution Pitching

  • CX Solution Support: Support the BD Director in showing how our data-driven approach builds better customer experiences.
  • Consultative Presentation: Present MarTech and CX solutions to clients in both English and Thai, focusing on how we design and build seamless end-to-end customer journeys.
  • Market Insight: Stay current on global and local CX trends to act as a knowledgeable advisor during early client interactions.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Schedule and coordinate meetings between prospects and senior team members, write meeting minutes, summarize key points, and share follow-up notes with both clients and the internal team.

3. Sales Operations & Legal Coordination

  • Documentation Management: Handle the end-to-end process for sales-related legal documents (NDAs, SOWs, Service Agreements) across CX pitching.
  • Contract Oversight: Manage the internal approval process to keep the legal foundation of our client partnerships secure and efficient.
  • CRM Hygiene: Keep accurate records of the CX sales funnel to provide clear data for growth forecasting.
  • Reporting: Compile weekly and monthly pipeline summaries and lead status reports.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Communications, or related field
  • 1-3 years experience in Client Success, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting
  • Experience in Customer Experience (CX), MarTech, CRM, or a data-driven agency environment is highly preferred.

  • A proactive "hustler" mentality combined with an understanding of how to build long-term customer relationships.

description:

Position Summary:

The Patient Services Specialist (PSS) provides high-quality front-end patient support by managing patient intake, scheduling, medical records, and financial transactions while ensuring accurate documentation and exceptional customer service. Responsibilities may vary by office size, layout, and staffing model, with cross-coverage across functional stations as needed.

Key Performance Areas:

KPA 1 – Patient Intake, Registration & Customer Experience

  • Greet patients and caregivers professionally to create a welcoming, supportive environment.

  • Accurately check in patients according to clinic policy, verify identity per AON Patient I.D. standards, and document arrival status and location in the EMR.

  • Verify, update, and maintain patient demographic information at required intervals.

  • Collect, document, and post patient payments and co-pays; issue receipts and notify Financial Counselor when payment cannot be made.

  • Ensure completion of required patient forms and medical history documentation.

  • Respond promptly and courteously to inbound calls; route calls or document messages accurately within the EMR.

KPA 2 – Scheduling, Physician Support & Communication

  • Schedule and manage patient appointments, including new patients, follow-ups, treatments, referrals, outside testing, and hospital admissions per physician orders.

  • Maintain physician schedules in alignment with preferences, capacity limits, and clinic policies; proactively resolve scheduling conflicts.

  • Coordinate physician requests related to schedule changes, meetings, vacations, conferences, and drug representative visits.

  • Assign new patients to appropriate clinicians per office guidelines and maintain accurate assignment records.

  • Contact patients regarding missed appointments, document outreach efforts, and reschedule as appropriate.

  • Accurately document and relay hospital consults, messages, and urgent information to physicians and designated care team members.

  • Manage answering service activation/deactivation and retrieve messages in accordance with clinic hours and emergency call policies.

KPA 3 – Medical Records & Documentation Management

  • Create, maintain, and update patient charts in the EMR and billing systems for new, follow-up, and hospital consult patients.

  • Assemble and verify new patient and hospital follow-up records; obtain missing documentation from referring providers, facilities, or labs.

  • Process, file, and distribute faxes, mail, courier deliveries, and electronic documents accurately and timely.

  • Respond to medical record requests from patients, providers, and authorized third parties in accordance with policy and HIPAA requirements.

  • Support legal and subpoena-related chart requests by coordinating with corporate and external vendors as required.

  • Maintain EMR, fax servers, and document management systems with attention to accuracy, completeness, and proper categorization.

  • Verify patient identifiers prior to filing records and resolve misfiled documentation promptly.

KPA 4 – Financial Transactions & Daily Reconciliation

  • Collect and post all forms of patient payments accurately; log transactions in required systems and reports.

  • Prepare daily close documentation, deposits, and trial closes in accordance with AON and clinic protocols.

  • Balance cash drawers and handle funds according to established procedures.

  • Notify Financial Counselors of insurance changes, STAT scheduling needs, or hospital admissions impacting billing or collections.

  • Distribute reports, schedules, and documentation to appropriate departments, including EDI and Business Office, per protocol.

KPA 5 – Compliance, Team Support & Operational Flexibility

  • Comply with all federal, state, and local regulations related to patient care, privacy, billing, safety, and records retention.

  • Adhere to all AON policies, procedures, IT standards, and disaster recovery requirements.

  • Perform duties across Patient Services stations (Check-In, Check-Out, Medical Records, Fax Server) as trained and assigned.

  • Provide coverage for absences, lunches, vacations, and staffing needs across locations.

  • Assist with training and onboarding of new Patient Services staff.

  • Maintain organized workspaces, safeguard equipment, and ensure confidentiality of patient and employee information.

  • Support multi-site operations and work at alternate AON locations as business needs require.

Required Qualifications:

Education: High School Diploma; Associates degree preferred

Experience:

  • Minimum of one (1) year experience in a healthcare setting; physician office experience preferred

  • Demonstrated customer service focus with strong attention to detail and multitasking ability

Skills and Competencies:

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with diverse populations

  • Critical thinking, problem-solving, and organizational skills

  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, multi-site environment

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

Travel: 0%

POSITION SUMMARY
This position designs, develops, configures, implements, tunes, maintains solutions, resolve technical and business issues related to cybersecurity threat & vulnerability management, identity management, security operations center, forensics, and data protection. Cybersecurity Engineers work with Cybersecurity Architects to execute strategic cyber initiatives, evaluate security components of the network, applications and end-user devices, and provides guidance to ensure new systems meet regulatory and technical standards. Cybersecurity Engineers participate in root-cause analysis efforts to determine improvement opportunities when failures occur. Manage Cyber systems, ensures they are tuned, on the current release and manages appropriate change management across the IT organization and the business.

CORE FUNCTIONS
1. Participates in the design and implementation of cybersecurity solutions.

2. Participates in providing technical expertise and support for cybersecurity solutions, including operational aspects of the software.

3. Participates in the design, implementation, and compliance of secure baseline configurations for applications and infrastructure components.

4. Performs technical assessments of systems and applications to ensure compliance with policy, standards and regulations.

5. Participates in the ongoing evaluation and development of security policies and procedures. Leads the revision of policies and procedures, as needed.

6. Update, sustain, and administer a high level of security for in-house security infrastructures and services.

7. Participates in cybersecurity projects, including the development of project scope requirements, budgeting, work breakdown.

8. Under general direction, this position is responsible for cybersecurity across multiple departments system-wide and requires interaction at all levels of staff and management.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Must possess strong knowledge of business, information security and/or computer science as normally obtained through the completion of a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Systems, or a related field.

0-3 years of experience of enterprise-scale information security engineering, preferably in healthcare. Experience with IT operations and or Security operations is also highly desirable. Experience with automation of security processes, coding and scripting languages. Ability to perform acquisition process, including vendor selection, define requirements, contractual documentation development. Ability to document security processes as well as Use case development. Proficient understanding of regulatory and compliance mandates, including but not limited to HIPAA, HITECH, PCI, Sarbanes-Oxley. Experienced assessing and reaching out to vendors for needed features via enhancement requests. Experienced in planning, designing and implementing cybersecurity solutions. Experienced in operating, maintaining and the lifecycle of cybersecurity solutions. Knowledge of Security Engineering Principles, including risk management, resilience, vulnerability management, Information Security, and security operations. Requires independent judgment, critical decision making, excellent analytical skills, with excellent verbal and written communications. Ability to think quickly under difficult or complex conditions and clearly communicate to appropriate staff; ability to balance project workloads with customer support and on-call demands. Must demonstrate general knowledge of information technology and information security principles and practices. Requires communication and presentation skills to engage technical and non-technical audiences. Requires ability to communicate and interact across facilities and at various levels. As is typical in this industry, variable shifts and hours and responding to after-hours notifications may be required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


Certification in one(1)of the following areas Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP), HealthCare Information Security & Privacy Practitioner, (HCISPP), CompTIA Security+, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) – Engineering (ISSEP), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), SANS GIAC, or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA). Two years as a System Administrator, Security operations or in IT Operations. Or two years risk management or GRC experience in the healthcare/medical environment.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

NVIDIA's Switch ASIC group is seeking a top-tier ASIC technical manager to lead the development of our next-generation ASICs. Join us in shaping the future of technology!   • BS or MS in Computer or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Description -

The Opportunity


Join HP’s high-impact, high-visibility HP Solutions Strategy team and help shape the future of HP Solutions across video collaboration, headsets and emerging growth areas. This team partners closely with senior HPS leaders to define long-term direction, medium-term strategic priorities, and near-term business choices that influence portfolio strategy, planning, investment priorities, and growth opportunities.

This is an exciting opportunity for a highly analytical, results-oriented strategy leader who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys solving complex business problems, and wants to make a visible impact at scale. In this role, you will help translate market, customer, technology, and financial insights into clear strategic choices—especially across collaboration, headsets, and integrated business planning.

You will work across executive leaders, GBU teams, finance, category, and cross-functional partners to develop insight-driven recommendations grounded in rigorous analysis and compelling strategic narratives. The role

AI is redefining personal computing, and it is happening fastest at the edge — as inference, agents, and models move onto the device. This role owns HP Personal Systems' understanding of that shift: who is building it, who is winning, and what it means for our strategy.

You will lead a small, high-caliber team that keeps a live pulse on the entire PC Competitor portfolio and AI ecosystem across software and hardware, turns raw signal into sharp strategic insight, and briefs to several senior management levels from division strategy teams to division presidents and the PS president.

What you'll do

  • Run deep, continuous competitor analysis. Build and maintain living intelligence on the core competitive set — Lenovo, Dell, Apple, Asus, Acer — and the emerging challengers, including Honor, Huawei, Xiaomi, and innovative smaller and regional players. Cover product roadmaps, AI positioning, go-to-market, partnerships, and overall pricing changes.
  • Benchmark business and financial performance. Lead quarterly earnings analysis and business-performance comparison across the competitive set.
  • Maintain POV on the AI ecosystem and edge-AI picture. Maintain a living map of the AI landscape across the full stack — models and software, devices, and the companies enabling AI at the edge. Develop and defend a point of view on which workloads are moving on-device, how fast, and who is driving the transition.
  • Synthesize and influence at the executive level. The heart of the role. Convert findings into concise, decision-ready insight that connects each signal to a specific business risk or strategic implication. Package and communicate it, verbally and in writing to division strategy teams, division presidents, your SVP, and the PS president on a regular cadence.
  • Anticipate, don't just report. Run scenario and war-gaming exercises to model likely competitor and ecosystem responses, and recommend HP's pre-emptive posture — moving the function from "what happened" to "what is about to happen and what we should do first."
  • Maintain an emerging-threat radar. Provide early warning on the players that don't show up in a standard benchmark — startups, new form factors, agentic devices, and regional entrants — before they become obvious.
  • Build the intelligence engine. Stand up AI-augmented tooling, data pipelines, and a shared knowledge base so the team delivers at a scale and speed a manual approach never could.
  • Lead and develop the team. Manage, coach, and grow a team of four analysts. Set the research agenda, the quality bar, and the operating cadence, and develop your people into strong analysts and confident communicators. Team leadership is a central expectation of this role, not a side responsibility.
  • Drive strategic direction for HP. Support Strategy and multiple business leaders with research, analysis, testing, and presentations on specific topics to support PS Strategy Projects
  • Manage a team of 3-4 junior team members

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 8+ years in competitive intelligence, corporate or competitive strategy, equity research, management consulting, or product/market strategy — ideally touching technology hardware, semiconductors, or software
  • Strong working knowledge of the AI landscape across software and hardware models, on-device/edge AI, NPUs and accelerators, and the AI PC ecosystem with the curiosity and speed to close gaps quickly
  • Financial and analytical fluency: you can read an earnings call and a 10-Q and pull out the story, and you are comfortable with unit economics, margins, and mix
  • Exceptional communication — verbal above all. You can distill complexity into a clear narrative and hold the room with senior executives up to president level
  • Strategic mindset: you connect disparate signals into insight and tie them to concrete business risk and strategic opportunity.
  • Demonstrated people leadership: you have managed and developed analysts or associates, set direction, and raised a team's bar
  • Executive presence and credibility with senior, cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Experience in the PC / client-device, semiconductor, or consumer-electronics industry.
  • Familiarity with AI-augmented research tooling and LLM-based research workflows.
  • A global market perspective, including China/APAC OEM dynamics and the export-control and regulatory landscape shaping the sector.
  • MBA or a relevant advanced degree.

The pay range for this role is $147,050 to $230,850 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
