title: Senior Software Engineer - Cluster Networking
description:
NVIDIA is a pioneer in accelerated computing, known for inventing the GPU and driving breakthroughs in gaming, computer graphics, high-performance computing, and artificial intelligence. Our technology powers everything from generative AI to autonomous systems, and we continue to shape the future of computing through innovation and collaboration. Within this mission, our team, Managed AI Research Superclusters (MARS), builds and scales the infrastructure, platforms, and tools that enable researchers and engineers to develop the next generation of AI/ML systems. By joining us, you'll help build solutions that power some of the most sophisticated computing workloads globally.

We are looking for a senior networking engineer to lead the network architecture of our GPU superclusters. Our platform runs frontier model training across tens of thousands of GPUs on multiple clouds, and we are scaling it toward clusters of ten thousand nodes and beyond. At that size, networking stops being a configuration exercise and becomes the hardest engineering problem on the platform — and it is currently one of the areas where we most need depth.

What you'll be doing:

You will be the technical owner of how our clusters communicate internally and externally. This includes the CNI data plane, the overlay mesh, and the nodes connecting clusters across regions and providers.

  • Own and evolve the Kubernetes networking architecture for GPU clusters running at multi-thousand-node scale

  • Design, operate and scale the overlay network - CNI, mesh and VPN topologies (Tailscale, WireGuard), and the gateways that connect control and data planes

  • Design, operate and scale the L7 gateways/load balancers/tunnels (Envoy, Cloudflare)

  • Find and eliminate scale ceilings: packet loss under load, control-plane saturation, IP address management exhaustion, and the failure modes that only appear above a few thousand nodes

  • Build the scale-test environments and validation suites that let us catch networking regressions before they reach production, rather than during a training run

  • Diagnose hard, ambiguous problems across the stack - where a symptom in Slurm or a training job traces back to a mark collision, a stale route, or a saturated tunnel

  • Partner with cloud and neocloud providers on network topology, requirements and capabilities as we bring up new clusters

  • Provide senior technical judgement to a distributed team, and depth in the Custer Networking domain.

What we need to see:

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • 6+ years of professional experience in systems, network or infrastructure software engineering

  • Deep command of Kubernetes networking architecture and CNI standards, with production experience operating Calico strongly preferred

  • Proficiency designing and maintaining modern mesh and VPN networking topologies - Tailscale, WireGuard or equivalent

  • Strong Linux networking fundamentals: routing, netfilter and iptables/nftables, packet marking, network namespaces, and how these interact with container runtimes

  • Demonstrated ability to debug distributed network problems at scale - packet capture, tracing, and correlating behaviour across many hosts to find a single root cause

  • Proficiency in Go, Python, C or a comparable systems language

  • Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work effectively with engineers across multiple time zones

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Direct experience architecting and operating massive-scale Kubernetes topologies across thousands of concurrent nodes

  • Experience with high-performance fabrics in AI or HPC environments - InfiniBand, RoCE, or RDMA over converged networks

  • Upstream contributions to Calico, Cilium, Tailscale, or Kubernetes networking SIGs

  • Experience operating networking across multiple public clouds and on-premises environments simultaneously

  • Familiarity with Slurm or other HPC schedulers running on Kubernetes

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Novartis has an exciting opportunity for a Director, Analytics Engineering. The Opportunity:


Responsible for the administration, operation, troubleshooting, and security of IT infrastructure supporting containerized applications. This includes container runtimes, orchestration platforms, cluster networking, persistent storage, and related security controls. Uses systems analysis techniques to diagnose and resolve issues affecting containerized workloads, nodes, storage, and connectivity, ensuring availability, performance, and integrity of the environment. Applies security patches, OS and Kubernetes upgrades, and container image updates. Supports new container-platform infrastructure projects and maintains accurate configuration documentation for assigned systems.

Responsibilities:


The Systems Administrator provides infrastructure and platform support for containerized applications. Responsibilities include identification of problems in the container environment, root-cause diagnosis (pod/node failures, resource constraints, CNI/overlay networking issues, persistent volume problems, control-plane issues), and development of corrective action plans.

  • Corrective maintenance: Isolate and restore failed containerized services, nodes, or cluster components.

  • Perfective maintenance: Optimize cluster performance, resource allocation, autoscaling, and observability.

  • Adaptive maintenance: Update configurations, perform version upgrades, adapt to new security or infrastructure requirements, and support platform changes while preserving workload functionality.

  • Manage container lifecycle operations (image management, deployments, rollouts, scaling) and the underlying container-runtime infrastructure.

  • Create and maintain as-is documentation, including high-level architecture diagrams of the containerized environment (clusters, namespaces, workloads, services, ingress, storage classes, networking, and integration points) and associated system requirements.

  • Support maintenance of active security authorizations (A&A) and Body of Evidence (BoE) artifacts (POAMs, control implementations, test plans). Implement applicable STIGs, CIS Kubernetes Benchmarks, vendor hardening guides for container platforms, and ensure timely patching of nodes, container images, and related components. Integrate with enterprise security services (ESS) and use required tools (XACTA 360, Service+, CPT, SWAP, etc.).

  • Support build, test, and deployment of container images, Helm charts manifests, and infrastructure configurations via enterprise, government-managed CI/CD pipelines (where applicable). Focus is on platform operations, image/registry management, and orchestration—not application code develop

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical/scientific discipline.

  • CompTIA Security+ or the ability to obtain within 90 days

  • Active/current TS/SCI clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain a Polygraph.

Desired:

  • Container security knowledge (image scanning, network policies, runtime protection, CIS benchmarks).

  • GitOps experience and CI/CD pipelines for container deployments.

title: Registered EEG Tech PRN
description:
Job Description:

Accountable for performing and monitoring a full spectrum of Electroencephalogram (EEG) procedures. The position provides care to patients in the hospital and EEG clinic using neurodiagnostic technologies, and through coordination of care with other health care professionals.

Find out what it means to be an EEG Tech here

Posting Specifics

  • Shift Details: PRN (Part Time), Variable Shifts, 1 night shift required every 6 weeks and PCH Lehi Call shifts 2-3x a month, minimum of 2 holiday shifts in a rolling year.

  • Location: EEG/Sleep Lab - Primary Children's both Lehi and SLC Campus

  • Required: Current Registered Electroencephalographic Technologist (R.EEG.T) credential

Essential Functions

  • Performs routine and continuous EEG procedure hookups using best-practice electrode placement.
  • Ability to recognize epileptiform brain wave patterns and follow established policies and protocols to provide best-practice care.
  • Performs EEG monitoring, including documentation, of continuous video EEG procedures.
  • Ability to use medical equipment and computers to perform neurodiagnostic procedures.
  • Performs advanced EEG procedures including WADA, PET Scan, SPECT scan with EEG, and Surgical EEG, etc.
  • Assists in the training of technicians under the direction of the EEG Supervisor.
  • Monitors and tracks equipment and supplies and coordinates troubleshoot efforts when appropriate.
  • Performs technical documentation and charting of neurodiagnostic patient procedures.
  • Demonstrated communication skills with patients, providers, and other caregivers.

Skills

  • Electroencephalogram (EEG)
  • Team Oriented
  • Patient Safety and Outcomes
  • Written Communication
  • Flexibility and Adaptability
  • Communication
  • Critical Thinking and Troubleshooting
  • Follow Protocols
  • Computer Literacy
  • Documentation

Required Qualifications

  • Current Registered Electroencephalographic Technologist (R.EEG.T) credential or equivalent
  • BLS Certification or RQI for Healthcare Providers
  • Licensed in the State of practice if applicable
  • Availability to work varying shifts which may include nights, weekends, and on-call.
  • Familiarity with technology including EEG acquisition systems and Microsoft Office

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ year of clinical EEG experience or direct patient care experience
  • Proven ability to provide technical oversight to junior technicians

  • Ongoing need for employee to see and read information, labels, assess patient needs, operate monitors, identify equipment and supplies.

  • Need to walk and assist with transporting/ambulating patients and obtaining and distributing supplies and equipment. This includes pushing/pulling gurneys and portable equipment, including heavy items. Often required to navigate crowded and busy rooms (full of equipment, power cords on the floor, etc.)
  • May be expected to stand in a stationary position for an extended period of time.

title: Päätoiminen tuntiopettaja, Uskonto ja terveystieto, Sotungin koulu
description:
Vantaan kaupunki, Kasvatus ja oppiminen, Perusopetus
Sotungin koulu

Sotungintie 19, 01200

Työsuhteen kesto: Määräaikainen 17.10.2026 - 22.12.2026

Hei sinä työstäsi innostunut opettaja! Tervetuloa loistoporukkaamme työskentelemään oppilaittemme hyväksi!

Koulumme sijaitsee Vantaalla Hakunilan urheilupuiston vehreässä ympäristössä. Koulussamme on noin 600 oppilasta 5.–9. luokilta. Teemme Sotungin koulussa työtä toisiamme auttaen ja osaamista jakaen. Koulumme on mukana pääkaupunkiseudun Urheiluakatemian toiminnassa.

Sotungin koulu sijaitsee Vantaalla osoitteessa Sotungintie 19. Liikenneyhteydet ovat koululta hyvät sekä muualle Vantaalle että Helsinkiin. Pyöräilyreitit ovat myös toimivia. Liikuntamahdollisuudet koulun alueella ovat erinomaiset. Koulussamme työskentelee noin 50 opettajaa sekä kuusi koulunkäyntiavustajaa. Samassa rakennuksessa toimii myös Sotungin lukio. Pääset tutustumaan kouluumme [tästä](https://sivistysvantaa.fi/sotunginkoulu/index.html) ja kouluarkeen pääsee perehtymään [Instagram-tilimme](https://www.instagram.com/sotungin_koulu/?hl=fi) kautta.

Millaista työtä?

Sotungin koulu etsii joukkoonsa osaavaa tekijää uskonnon ja terveystiedon päätoimista tuntiopettajaa määräaikaiseen virkasuhteeseen 17.10. - 22.12.2026. Tehtävään kuuluu myös tunne- ja vuorovaikutustuntien opetusta 7. ja 8. luokille sekä luokanvalvojuus 7. luokalle.

Uudelta työtoveriltamme odotamme hyvän aineenhallinnan lisäksi kykyä ja halua yhteisopettajuuteen sekä hyviä ryhmänhallintataitoja. Koulussamme toteutetaan yhteisopettajuutta eli suunnittelu, opetus ja arviointi tehdään yhdessä oman aineryhmän kesken.

Toivomme sinulta kykyä huomioida erilaiset oppijat ja oppimisympäristöt omassa opetustyössäsi sekä kiinnostusta kohdata nuori myös opetustilanteen ulkopuolella. Arvostamme lisäksi halua edistää yhteisöllisyyttä ja osallisuutta lasten ja talon eri toimijoiden kesken.

Lisäksi valittavalta odotetaan hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja ihmissuhdetaitoja, joustavuutta, hyvää ammatillista osaamista ja positiivista asennetta sekä kehitysmyönteisyyttä. Arvostamme aiempaa työkokemusta yläkoulussa, mutta annamme mahdollisuuden myös aloittaville uusille tähdille. Työssäsi saat opettaa pääsääntöisesti vuosiluokilla 7-9, mutta opetustunteja saattaa olla myös alakoulun puolella.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Yhteisöllinen työyhteisö
Meillä uskotaan, että kaveria auttamalla ja osaamista jakamalla olemme yhdessä enemmän. Työyhteisössämme panostetaan yhteisöllisyyteen ja työhyvinvointiin, ja kehitämme toimintakulttuuria positiiviseen suuntaan mm. ProKoulu-toiminnan kautta. Olemme tiivis ja toisiamme kannustava porukka, jossa jokaisen vahvuudet pääsevät käyttöön.

Johtaminen ja toimintakulttuuri
Koulullamme ja työllämme on selkeät tavoitteet. Käytössämme on jaetun johtajuuden malli, mikä tarkoittaa, että johtamisvastuuta jaetaan myös tavoitteellisesti työskenteleville tiimeille. Kehitämme arkea yhdessä – tavoitteena vahvat oppimista tukevat opetusjärjestelyt, hyvinvoivat oppilaat ja viihtyvä henkilöstö.

Perehdytys ja tuki
Et jää yksin! Koulussamme toimii vertaismentoreita, jotka perehdyttävät sinut koulun käytäntöihin ja tukevat opetustyön arjessa. Saat kollegoita tukevan työyhteisön, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus käyttää vahvuuksiaan niin omassa opetustyössään kuin kouluyhteisön kehittämisessä.

Osaaminen ja kehittyminen
Meillä arvostetaan osaamistasi ja kannustetaan sinua ylläpitämään ja kehittämään ammattitaitoasi. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia oppia uutta ja osallistua koulun kehittämiseen yhdessä kollegoiden kanssa.

Monimuotoisuus ja yhdenvertaisuus

Olemme sitoutuneet toteuttamaan työyhteisössämme yhdenvertaisuutta ja monimuotoisuutta. Haluamme, että meillä työskentelee eri-ikäisiä, eri sukupuolia sekä eri kieli-, kulttuuri- ja vähemmistöryhmiin kuuluvia ammattilaisia.

Lisätiedot ja rekrytointi

Saatamme käyttää rekrytointiprosessissa videohaastattelua. Haastatteluja voidaan suorittaa myös hakuajan aikana.

Miksi valita Vantaa?

Vantaa on maamme neljänneksi suurin kaupunki, jossa on rohkeutta tehdä asioita uudella tavalla ja taitoa toimia yhteistyössä erilaisissa verkostoissa. Kaupunki on turvallinen työnantaja, joka tarjoaa henkilöstölle laajat mahdollisuudet osaamisen kehittämiseen. Nykyaikaisissa oppilaitoksissamme arvostetaan laadukkaan kasvatuksen ja opetuksen lisäksi kansainvälisyyttä, monikulttuurisuutta ja yhteisöllisyyttä.

Tule opettajaksi Vantaalle! [Tutustu opettajan työhön Vantaa.fi:ssä.](https://www.vantaa.fi/fi/tyo-perusopetuksessa-ja-toisella-asteella)

Vantaan kaupunki tarjoaa työntekijöilleen monipuoliset henkilöstöedut, kuten liikunta-, hyvinvointi- ja kulttuuriedun, lounasedun ja työmatkaedun julkisen liikenteen käyttöön. Tuemme henkilöstön hyvinvointia mahdollistamalla ja tukemalla liikunnallista elämäntapaa. Kaupungin työntekijät voivat hyödyntää mm. uimahallien, kuntosalien ja ryhmäliikunnan sekä hierontayritysten etuhintaisia palveluja. Lisäksi työntekijöille on usein tarjolla alennushintaisia lippuja kaupungin kulttuuritapahtumiin.

Jos jäit vielä pohtimaan, mitä Vantaalla on sinulle tarjottavaa, [käy verkkosivuillamme lukemassa lisää syitä valita Vantaa.](https://www.vantaa.fi/fi/kaupunki-ja-paatoksenteko/avoimet-tyopaikat-vantaan-kaupungilla/johtaminen-tyohyvinvointi-ja-henkilostoedut)

Työsuhteen tietoja

Kelpoisuusvaatimus: Opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen 986/1998 mukainen kelpoisuus.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksen lisäksi edellytämme: Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena tehtävään on uskonnon ja terveystiedon opettajan kelpoisuus. Lisäksi edellytämme valmiutta opettaa elämänkatsomustietoa. Asetuksen 9 §:n mukaisesti perusopetusta antavalla opettajalla tulee olla suomen kielen erinomainen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito. Viran hoitamisen edellytykset täyttävien hakijoiden puuttuessa virka voidaan täyttää määräaikaisesti. Määräaikaisessa täyttämisessä voidaan huomioida myös tässä haussa tulleet hakemukset.

Luemme eduksi: Yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot sekä opetussuunnitelmatuntemuksen. Kokemus tunne- ja vuorovaikutustaitojen opettamisesta. Toivomme myös tehtävään valitulta valmiutta ja kykyä toimia luokanvalvojana.

Great careers are built at Banner Health. We understand that talented health care professionals appreciate having options. We are proud to offer our team members many career and lifestyle choices throughout our network of facilities. Apply today, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

As a Surgery Scheduler, he Surgery Scheduler is responsible for coordinating and managing patient procedure schedules while ensuring a high level of customer service and efficiency. This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively with patients, physicians, and team members. There are 3 providers and 4 Nurse Practitioner

Location: 14416 W Meeker Blvd Bldg C Ste 202, SCW, AZ
Shift 8:30am-5:00pm

At Banner Medical Group, you'll have the opportunity to perform a critical role in the community where you practice. Banner Medical Group provides both primary and specialty care throughout the communities in which Banner Health operates. We do this in a variety of settings - from smaller group practices like our Banner Health Clinics in Colorado and Wyoming, to large multi-specialty Banner Health Centers in the metropolitan Phoenix area. We currently have more than 1,000 physicians and more than 3,500 total employees in our group and are seeking others to enhance our ability to deliver our nonprofit mission of providing excellent patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY
This position is responsible for scheduling surgical, cardiovascular or obstetrical procedures using a computerized scheduling system. The position is also responsible for entering patient charges, orders, and other pertinent information into the system and compiling and reporting statistical information to management. The incumbent may act as an office liaison for department staff, physicians, and patient families.

CORE FUNCTIONS
1. Coordinates case times for elective, urgent or emergent surgeries, cardiovascular or obstetrical procedures in a computerized scheduling system. Verifies and reviews physician privilege status prior to scheduling. Interfaces with medical staff office to maintain log of current privilege status and maintains confidentially of all information. May acquire and maintain physician preference information and staff roster.

2. Acquires authorization numbers, History and Physicals, results of laboratory tests and verifies that they are current. Orders previous medical records for the day of the procedure, when necessary.

3. Types and prints physician orders for multiple physicians and departments. Schedules and maintains physician block time, and block time releases.

4. Enters physician’s orders for lab, blood bank, medical imaging, and cardiology. Enters results of diagnostic tests, patient registration information and patient charges. Compiles data and prepares statistical reports for management.

5. Conducts charge management audits for assigned area. Reconciles charge packet information with the audit. Identifies missed or incorrect charges and corrects when appropriate.

6. Acts as a receptionist to assigned unit; answers phones, relays message. Greets and directs patients, visitors, physicians, and families and answers questions about policies and procedures. Acts as a liaison among nursing units, physician and staff to relay patient data. Screens requests for patient information and refers to appropriate staff. Records and types minutes of staff meetings, when required. Prepares and distributes staff call roster each month.

7. Enters facility work orders and supply orders when required by assigned department. Requests repairs/maintenance for business machines in the department. Arranges for pickup and delivery of instruments and equipment and completes all necessary paperwork.

8. This position has responsibility for scheduling surgeries and procedures and maintaining a smooth workflow in the area. Must be able to work with minimal supervision, under stressful situations, set priorities and maintain highly confidential information.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

High school diploma/GED or equivalent working knowledge.

Requires skills and abilities typically attained with 2 years of medical clerical experience; preferably in a hospital central scheduling or physician office scheduling setting. Knowledge of medical terminology is required.

Also requires knowledge of payor contract terms and processes. Must possess excellent organizational skills, as well as effective human relations and communication skills. Requires effective teamworking skills and the ability to meet deadlines and productivity standards.

The position requires knowledge of word processing and spreadsheet software and the ability to use computerized scheduling systems. Must possess the ability to maintain accurate statistical records, gather data, and produce reports.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

Haluatko työskennellä kansainvälisessä ympäristössä teollisuuden huipputeknologian parissa ja varmistaa, että asiakkaiden tuotanto pysyy käynnissä? Vaski Group etsii Huoltoteknikkoa vahvistamaan after sales -tiimiään.

Vaski Group on nopeasti kasvava teollisten työstökoneiden valmistaja, joka on erikoistunut sähkönjakelussa käytettävien virtakiskomateriaalien (busbar) ja ohutlevyn työstöön sekä automaatioratkaisuihin. Yhdistämme kolmen vakiintuneen brändin – Vaskin, Pivaticin ja Ursvikenin – vahvuudet.

Mitä tulet tekemään?

Huoltoteknikkona vastaat Vaski Groupin asiakkaiden koneiden huolloista, korjauksista, modernisoinneista ja asennuksista kotimaassa sekä kansainvälisesti. Työ on vahvasti reissupainotteista ja vietät suurimman osan työajastasi asiakkaiden luona pääasiassa Euroopassa sekä Yhdysvalloissa. Yksittäinen huoltokeikka kestää tyypillisesti 1–2 viikkoa.

Arjessasi työskentelet teollisten työstökoneiden parissa tehden mekaanisia, sähköisiä ja automaatioon liittyviä huolto- ja vianetsintätöitä. Osallistut myös modernisointien toteutuksiin sekä uusien koneiden asennuksiin ja käyttöönottoihin asiakkaan tuotantoympäristössä. Huoltokeikkojen jälkeen huolehdit työn asianmukaisesta dokumentoinnista.

Työ edellyttää kykyä ratkaista teknisiä ongelmia paikan päällä tilanteissa, joissa tuotannon sujuvuus on asiakkaalle kriittistä. Saat työllesi tukea muulta tiimiltä, mutta kentällä vastaat työn etenemisestä usein itsenäisesti.

Millaista osaajaa etsimme?

Etsimme käytännönläheistä ja oma-aloitteista tekijää, joka viihtyy reissutyössä ja toimii rauhallisesti myös paineen alla. Huoltoteknikko toimii usein keskeisessä roolissa tilanteissa, joissa tuotannon sujuvuus on kriittistä, joten arvostamme vahvaa ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja tilannetajua.

Hakijalta odotetaan:

  • Soveltuvaa teknistä korkeakoulutusta (esim. sähkö- tai automaatioinsinööri)

  • Vähintään parin vuoden kokemusta huolto- ja/tai asennustehtävistä teollisuusympäristössä

  • Ymmärrystä sähkö- ja automaatiojärjestelmistä

  • Hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

  • Valmiutta matkustaa säännöllisesti kotimaassa ja ulkomailla

Lisäksi eduksi katsotaan:

  • Kokemus Siemensin automaatioympäristöistä tai taajuusmuuttajien ohjausohjelmistoista

  • Aiempi kokemus kansainvälisestä kenttätyöstä

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Vakaan, nopeasti kasvavan ja kansainvälisen työnantajan, joka toimii alansa edelläkävijänä ja tarjoaa mahdollisuuden työskennellä teknisesti vaativien huipputuotteiden parissa

  • Itsenäisen ja vastuullisen roolin, jossa työsi näkyy suoraan asiakkaiden tuotannon jatkuvuudessa

  • Asiantuntevan ja mukavan työyhteisön tuen työllesi sekä kattavan perehdytyksen kokeneemman kollegan tuella

  • Kattavan etupaketin, joka sisältää sairauskulu-, matka- sekä työ- ja vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutukset, hyvinvointi-, lounas- sekä puhelinedun

Käytännön asiat:

Tässä vakituisessa ja kokoaikaisessa tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan asiakasyrityksemme Vaski Groupin palvelukseen. Aloitus tehtävässä on sopimuksen mukaan maalis–huhtikuussa 2026. Asemapaikkasi on Hyvinkäällä, mutta työ on luonteeltaan vahvasti matkustuspainotteista (noin 80 % työajasta), ja koostuu kotimaan sekä kansainvälisistä huoltokeikoista.

Tule mukaan rakentamaan Vaski Groupin globaalia kasvutarinaa! Lähetä ansioluettelosi sekä motivaatiokirjeesi PDF-muodossa suomen kielellä viimeistään torstaina 1.10. aTalentin hakujärjestelmän kautta osoitteessa: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/383050/create/

The future is full of possibilities. At Banner Health, we’re excited about what the future holds for health care. That’s why we’re changing the industry to make the experience the best it can be. You will be joining Banner Thunderbird. This is a great team to be apart of! For a second year, Banner Health has ranked #2 in the Gartner Healthcare Supply Chain Top 25. Great people make a great supply chain.

This an ideal entry level position to gain experience in supply chain and health care with opportunity for growth! Our Supply Chain Services department manages various medical supplies, fills customers supply phone requests, code cart replenishments, incoming deliveries, tanks, and supports other Supply Chain functions. The Inventory Associate position is a critical link between department leadership and the SCS store room, ensuring PAR locations are adequately managed for patient care.

You will feel welcomed, appreciated and part of a family immediately your first day. As an Inventory Associate, your ability to provide customer service, work independently and as part of a team will be key to your success in your role. Bring your positive energy to our large and unique team! As an Inventory Associate, you may not help patients directly, but, your efforts ensure that the patients here get everything they need during their stay. You will have the opportunity to work with multiple departments, which allows for understanding of internal operations that many outside of this department do not have.

Location: Banner Thunderbird

Hours: 7am-330pm, Thursday-Monday

Banner Health’s premier West Valley Level I Trauma for adults and Tertiary Care destination for all ages. Banner Thunderbird Medical Center (BTMC) and Banner Children’s Hospital at Thunderbird provide a preferred destination for surgical, oncological, cardiovascular, neuroscience, orthopedic, pediatric, and women and infant services achieved through best-in-class 5-star CMS rating to provide patients with high quality, safe care for the best possible experience. Our campus is one of the largest campuses in the Banner network with over 3000 employees. BTMC was voted Best of the Best in 2023 by Banner Health out of 30 hospitals. This is the most prestigious award one of our largest hospitals can receive for consistently meeting our annual targets. If you would like to contribute to truly leading edge caring, we invite you to bring your experience and skills to Banner Thunderbird.

POSITION SUMMARY
This position provides supply receipt, delivery and inventory management services to an assigned area or department of the medical center or facility.

CORE FUNCTIONS
1. Takes a daily inventory of assigned supply storage area and/or clinical department supplies (Par Carts), requisitions and restocks supplies to par levels. Rotates stock and maintains a clean and orderly storage area in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

2. Monitors usage, creates utilization reports, consults with clinical supply liaison or appropriate department staff, recommends changes to inventory and par levels.

3. Assists with the procurement of special supply needs and may assist assigned department with the procurement of equipment.

4. Acts as a knowledge resource for clinical or other related staff in the area of supply methods and goods.

5. Works independently under regular supervision. Follows defined procedures and guidelines. Makes decisions about inventory levels. Represents the interests of the organization when interfacing with vendors.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

An understanding of inventory management tasks and the ability to work effectively with a computer based inventory management system.

Requires accurate data entry and keyboarding skills, the ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing, the ability to read and interpret supply requisitions and equipment directions. Must have demonstrated effective customer service skills. Positions in Food Service area must be able to learn food handling regulations and pass certification tests as required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

High school diploma/GED or equivalent working knowledge.
Previous experience working with medical supplies or food supplies (as applicable) and/or hospital services is strongly preferred and may be required for some work assignments.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. If you like traveling across the world and meeting new people while working on challenging engineering projects, you will love this job.

Project Management: Knowledge of effective project management strategies and tactics; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve project objectives.

title: Tuotanto-operaattoreita Helmacabille Kaarinaan!
description:
Haemme nyt asiakkaallemme Helmacab Oy:lle tuotanto-operaattoreita pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Työssä pääset osaksi tuotantotiimiä, jonka tärkeänä tehtävänä on varmistaa laadukkaiden kaapelituotteiden valmistus ja sujuva tuotantoprosessi.

Työnkuva

Työtehtävät koostuvat kaapeleiden valmistuksesta tuotantolinjalla. Päivittäisiin työtehtäviin kuuluu tuotantolinjan ja koneiden valvonta, tuotannon laadun tarkkailu sekä koneiden asetusten muokkaaminen tuotannon tarpeiden mukaisesti. Lisäksi osallistut materiaalien käsittelyyn, kaapelikelojen vaihtamiseen sekä muihin tuotannon sujuvuutta tukeviin tehtäviin.

Työtä tehdään kolmivuorotyönä aamu-, ilta- ja yövuoroissa, ja työvuorojen pituus on 8 tuntia. Ruokatauko sisältyy työaikaan.

Työ edellyttää jatkuvaa tarkkaavaisuutta ja vastuullista työotetta, sillä tuotantolinjat toimivat keskeytyksettä. Laatu on keskeinen osa päivittäistä tekemistä, joten tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää huolellisuutta, tarkkuutta ja kykyä keskittyä työtehtäviin pitkäjänteisesti.

Vaikka työ sisältää toistuvia työvaiheita, se on aktiivista ja käytännönläheistä tekemistä, jossa työvuoro kuluu tuotannon eri tehtävien parissa. Tehtävä sopii henkilölle, joka viihtyy tuotantoympäristössä, pitää käsillä tekemisestä ja haluaa olla mukana varmistamassa laadukasta lopputulosta.

Toivomme sinulta

Odotamme hakijalta hyvää suomen kielen taitoa, tarkkaa ja huolellista työskentelyotetta sekä valmiutta kolmivuorotyöhön. Tehtävä edellyttää myös hyvää fyysistä kuntoa, sillä työ sisältää esimerkiksi kaapelikelojen vaihtamista ja muuta aktiivista työskentelyä tuotantoympäristössä.

Arvostamme joustavuutta, oppimishalukkuutta ja kiinnostusta kehittyä oman alansa ammattilaiseksi. Eduksi katsotaan valmius omaksua uusia työtehtäviä, työskennellä eri tuotantolinjoilla sekä osallistua tarvittaessa tuotannon muuttuvien tarpeiden tukemiseen. Teknisen alan koulutus ja aiempi kokemus tuotantotyöstä katsotaan eduksi.

Tarjoamme

Tarjoamme pitkäaikaisen työsuhteen vakaassa ja kansainvälisessä teollisuusyrityksessä sekä kattavan perehdytyksen työtehtäviin. Saat mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi tuotannon tehtävissä ja kasvaa osaksi ammattitaitoista tuotantotiimiä.

Palkkaus määräytyy teknologiateollisuuden työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti, minkä lisäksi työstä maksetaan tuotantopalkkiota.

Helmacabilla työskentelet siistissä ja savuttomassa tuotantoympäristössä. Työntekijöiden hyvinvointia tuetaan työaikaisilla ruokailumahdollisuuksilla: päivävuorossa käytössä on edullinen työpaikkaruokala, iltavuorolaisille tarjotaan lämmin ateria ja yövuorolaisille kevyt välipala.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi Baronan hakulomakkeen kautta mahdollisimman pian, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja paikat täytetään sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

title: National Key Account Off-Trade
description:
CURRENT EMPLOYEES, CONSULTANTS, AND AGENCY PARTNERS:

If you currently work for Brown-Forman, please apply by clicking the Careers icon on the Workday portal.

For best results, use Google Chrome to view this page.

Meaningful Work From Day One:

As the National Key Account your overall objective is to develop and implement the sales strategy per customer in alignment with Brown Forman Spain (BFS)’s strategic objectives, and to manage the customer relationship on an ongoing basis.

Based within the country sales structure the Key Account is responsible for a group of national off trade customers. The role has accountability for the full scope of BF´s commercial interaction with the customers, ranging from the development of sales strategy per customer to the management of promotional activities. The role requires close cross functional interaction with trade marketing, planning, marketing, logistics and finance.

What You Can Expect:

  • Commercial and Financial Performance: Responsible for achieving strategic objectives per customer including volume, turnover and gross profit.

  • Strategic Account Management: Build and maintain high-impact, long-term partnerships with national account buyers through consistent engagement, joint business planning (JBP), and routine on-site commercial reviews.

  • Promotional Strategy & Budget Execution: Design, deploy, and evaluate promotional strategies tailored to each customer. Allocate and optimize trade spend and continuous improvement in the management of the accounts by identifying opportunities for efficiency and profitability.

  • Negotiation & Commercial Term: Responsible for managing customer negotiations in relation to BFS´s commercial strategy and the customers trading terms

  • NPD Launch Strategy Responsible for developing customer new product launch plans and ensuring successful implementation.

  • Field Execution & Field Force Alignment: Together with Head of Off-Trade set goals for the outsourced off trade team, follow up their performance and ensure flawless execution at the point of purchase.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Proven track record in Key Account Management within Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), preferably in spirits, wine, or premium beverages.

  • Deep understanding of Off-Trade channel dynamics, trade margin structures, and promotional mechanics.

  • Strong financial acumen (P&L management, trade spend optimization, gross margin analysis) paired with strategic negotiation skills.

  • At least 6 years in key account management in the Spirits industry.

  • Strong presentation skills

  • Advanced English speaking and writing skills

  • Driving license

  • High availability to travel nationally (more than 50%)

What Makes You Unique:

  • Knowledge of Finance, Trade Marketing, Category Development and business processes.

  • Desirable multifunctional experience and /or geographic.

  • Spirits Industry experience.

Who We Are

We believe great people build great brands. And we know there is Nothing Better in the Market than a career at Brown-Forman. Being a part of Brown-Forman means you will grow both personally and professionally. You will have the opportunity to solve problems, seize opportunities, and generate bold ideas. You will belong to a place where teamwork matters and where you are encouraged to bring your best self to work.

What We Offer

Total Rewards at Brown-Forman is designed to engage our people to ensure sustainable and profitable growth for generations to come. As a premium spirits company, we offer equitable pay structures for individual and company performance alongside a premium employee experience. We offer a range of premium benefits that reflect our company values and meet the needs of our diverse workforce.

title: Systems Administrator II
description:
Job Title: Systems Administrator II

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Local

* * *

The Opportunity:

Provide frontline IT support and systems administration services, resolving hardware and software infrastructure issues to ensure appropriate function of end-user systems and network connectivity. As a Systems Administrator II (Help Desk), you will:

  • Respond to and resolve help desk tickets covering workstation, network, and system access issues in a timely and professional manner

  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve issues with IT infrastructure including user systems, servers, storage, and network connectivity

  • Provide day-to-day system administration support for assigned infrastructure and maintain user account security

  • Apply security patches and operating system upgrades to ensure the security and integrity of the technical environment

  • Support new infrastructure projects and system rollouts

  • Instruct and train end users on approved software applications and IT best practices

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as first point of contact for end-user technical support requests via phone, email, ticketing system, or in-person

  • Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network connectivity, and account access issues for desktop, laptop, and mobile devices

  • Perform account provisioning, password resets, and access management in Active Directory or equivalent directory services

  • Install, configure, and maintain workstation hardware, peripherals, and approved software applications

  • Escalate complex technical issues to senior systems administrators or specialized technical teams as needed

  • Maintain accurate documentation of help desk tickets, resolutions, and configuration changes in the ticketing system

  • Support imaging, deployment, and configuration of new workstations and equipment

  • Assist with maintaining network security by monitoring for and reporting suspicious activity or potential security incidents

  • Apply routine security patches, antivirus updates, and operating system upgrades to maintain a secure computing environment

  • Maintain configuration documentation for assigned infrastructure and user support activities

  • Provide basic training and guidance to end users on software applications, systems access, and IT security practices

  • Support VTC, printer, and peripheral device troubleshooting and maintenance

  • Work independently with general supervision while escalating difficult or complex problems appropriately

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Active Secret security clearance (required)

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or Information Systems (or equivalent experience)

  • 3+ years of professional experience in systems administration or IT help desk support

  • Experience troubleshooting Windows and/or Linux desktop operating systems

  • Familiarity with Active Directory user account management, password resets, and basic group policy concepts

  • Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP concepts

  • Experience using IT service management (ITSM) ticketing systems to track and resolve support requests

  • Strong customer service orientation with the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical end users

  • Ability to work independently with general supervision and prioritize multiple support requests

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

  • Compliance with Cyber WorkForce (CWF) directives, including any required certifications

Desired:

  • Active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility

  • Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, or ITIL Foundation

  • Experience supporting DoD or government IT environments

  • Familiarity with Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and secure configuration baselines

  • Experience with remote desktop support tools and remote troubleshooting techniques

  • Knowledge of mobile device management (MDM) platforms

  • Experience with imaging and deployment tools (e.g., SCCM, MDT, Ghost)

  • Familiarity with VOIP systems, VTC equipment, and basic AV troubleshooting

  • Experience supporting classified or secure network environments

  • Basic scripting knowledge (PowerShell, Batch) for automating routine tasks

  • Previous experience in a military, government, or defense contractor help desk environment

  • Familiarity with Risk Management Framework (RMF) basics as they relate to end-user systems

title: Spec-Prog & Proj Mgmt
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing...


We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Senior SAM Flexera Specialist with a strong track record in end-to-end Publisher Management. You will be responsible for executing the daily lifecycle management software publishers within the Flexera One platform. In this role, you will drive initial publisher onboarding, translate software contracts, continuously manage deployment data to maintain accurate Effective License Positions (ELPs), and identify continuous cost optimization opportunities across the software estate.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:


  • Executing the end-to-end lifecycle of software publishers within Flexera, from hands-on initial onboarding through ongoing compliance monitoring.
  • Interpreting EULAs, Master Services Agreements (MSAs), and purchase histories to accurately build and maintain license records and product use rights (PUR) in Flexera.
  • Producing and updating defensible, audit-ready ELP reports for managed publishers by reconciling entitlements against actual software installations and usage.
  • Actively identifying software optimization opportunities by flagging shelfware, over-licensed applications, and unmanaged installations to drive continuous cost savings.
  • Normalizing raw inventory, application catalog items, and software signatures utilizing Technopedia and Flexera's recognition engines.
  • Monitoring Flexera Beacon servers, inventory agent deployments, inventory alerts, and data processing jobs to ensure daily platform health.
  • Supporting ecosystem integrations between Flexera and external tools, including ServiceNow CMDB, SaaS APIs, and secondary discovery sources .
  • Developing and presenting executive-level reporting on software compliance risk, ELP status, and realized cost savings.



What we’re looking for...


You are a highly analytical thinker with a deep, hands-on understanding of software asset management tools and publisher licensing frameworks. You possess excellent technical and problem-solving skills, coupled with a proactive approach to maintaining data accuracy and uncovering cost savings. You thrive in a highly integrated data environment and are passionate about operational excellence.



You'll need to have:


  • 5 to 7 years of experience in Software Asset Management (SAM) or IT Asset Management (ITAM), with at least 3+ years of dedicated hands-on experience using Flexera.
  • Proven track record in executing end-to-end publisher management, successfully onboarding and continuously managing software publishers within Flexera.
  • Strong understanding of software licensing frameworks for major vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Adobe, VMware/Broadcom, Red Hat).
  • Solid operational knowledge of ecosystem integrations, including ServiceNow CMDB, SQL queries, and discovery agent data flows.
  • Advanced data analysis skills utilizing Excel and relational database logic to manage and synthesize complex software entitlement data sets.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:


  • Flexera Certified Professional / Administrator (Flexera One / FNMS) and/or CSAM (Certified Software Asset Manager) or IAITAM certification.
  • Understanding of how SAM intersects with Cybersecurity, specifically regarding the identification of End-of-Life (EOL) or End-of-Support (EOS) software.
  • Scripting and automation skills (such as Python or PowerShell) to streamline API integrations and automate repetitive data management tasks.



If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Maintenance Tech - 1st Shift - 6am-2pm $35.74/hr
description:
Maintenance Tech - 1st Shift - 6am-2pm $35.74/hr


What You’ll Do

As a Maintenance employee, you’ll be part of our Metals Plant team located in Chesterfield, MI. You’ll get to:

  • Disassembles, repairs, and reassembles machinery and equipment utilizing manual and power tools. In doing so climbs, kneels, stands, sits, or crouches while handling items of various sizes, shapes, and weights.
  • Troubleshoots problems from reading electrical and hydraulic schematics; uses electrical testing equipment.
  • Operates a variety of mechanical equipment such as forklift, hydraulic lift, scissor lift and hand cart in order to move equipment to appropriate locations.
  • Maintains departmental files of work orders, maintenance requisitions, preventative maintenance histories, and other related records.
  • Performs a variety of building, machinery, and equipment repairs, installation, or modification requiring hydraulic, pneumatic, plumbing and electrical skills and perform scheduled preventative maintenance items.
  • Obtain material and supplies from local distributors, warehouses, or merchants.
  • Place orders for repair parts or materials utilizing telephone, computer terminal, or written correspondence.
  • Regular exposure to oil, grease, and fumes from production equipment and extreme temperatures due to areas where repairs are required.
  • Regularly exposed to hazardous conditions associated with operation and repair of mechanical equipment, but hazards are limited when established safety procedures are followed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Who You Are

You always strive to do a good job…but wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? You care about quality – at every level. You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. In fact, you embrace it. You also have:

  • High school diploma or equivalent work experience.
  • Technical school certificate, training preferred but not required.
  • Read and write, to follow maintenance requests; understand and follow written and verbal instructions when receiving and processing requisitions, maintain simple records of items repaired, as well as other routine equipment history.
  • Approximately three to five years job related experience necessary in order to learn maintenance procedures and equipment operations.
  • Analytical skills necessary in order to evaluate machine/equipment functions.
  • Concentrate and pay close attention to detail when diagnosing, inspecting and checking accuracy of repairs.
  • Become authorized in Lockout/Tag out within probationary period.
  • Obtain a Hilo license within the probationary period.

title: Oncology Scheduling Specialist
location: Banner MD Anderson Cancer Center (2946 E Gateway Dr)
description:
Primary City/State:

Gilbert, Arizona

Department Name:

Central Scheduling-Gilbert

Work Shift:

Day

Job Category:

Administrative Services

Find your path in health care. Our team members make Banner Health a Great Place To Work®. Learn how you can join our dedicated team of professionals.

At Banner MD Anderson Cancer Center, patients experience customized, comprehensive and compassionate cancer care. We travel through the cancer journey with patients, supporting their unique medical and personal needs every step of the way. We believe patient care is most effective when it’s truly collaborative. Our evidence-based, multidisciplinary approach brings together physicians from all cancer specialties to provide highly coordinated and compassionate care.

As a Oncology Scheduling Specialist, you'll apply your excellent customer service skills to schedule initial and follow-up appointments for our cancer patients. Your role is fast-paced as we see a high volume of patients daily, so it will be important that you apply your critical thinking skills and ability to adapt to quickly. If you are ready to be part of providing patients a good experience throughout their cancer journey, apply now!

Schedule: Monday - Friday 8:30am-5pm

Experience innovative technology and exceptional opportunities for growth and development at Banner Health's state-of-the-art hospital Banner Gateway Medical Center. With comprehensive electronic medical records, physician order entry, digital radiography and proprietary advanced patient monitoring, Banner Gateway provides you with the innovative resources you need to provide your patients with the best care possible. Our commitment to nursing excellence has enabled us to achieve Magnet™ recognition by the American Nurses Credentialing Center. Located near Phoenix in Gilbert, Ariz., Banner Gateway Medical Center offers 286 private rooms, 13 operating suites, a 46-bed emergency department and shares a campus with the Banner MD Anderson Cancer Center. Our WIS and NICU services support an average of 4,000 deliveries per year. Key specialties include oncology, obstetrics, bariatric surgery, emergency and other services that focus on meeting the changing needs of the dynamic and growing community we serve.

Banner MD Anderson Cancer Center Located in Gilbert, Ariz. (the Phoenix Metro area) on the Banner Gateway Campus, the center provides world-class care for oncology patients - both inpatient and outpatient - and has also brought leading oncology programs to the Banner Gateway campus including designation as a Stem Cell Transplant Center of Excellence and comprehensive Head & Neck cancer care. Our capabilities include five linear accelerator vaults, a brachytherapy vault, an advanced diagnostic imaging suite with PET/CT scan, more than 70 infusion bays, a cryopreservation lab and much more. Our inpatient medical oncology unit also incorporates a program that utilizes the electronic surveillance partnership in caring for the patient, where remote nurses have the ability to interact with patients via two-way audio-video to assist the bedside nurse with patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for scheduling across the campus for physicians, medical facilities, and specialized medical practices by coordinating all aspects of scheduling including, but not limited to, appointments for physicians across the campus, surgical procedures, diagnostic tests, pain management, and other specialized tests and treatment as directed by physicians to ensure an exceptional customer experience at each point of service. Using a broad understanding of customer engagement strategies, clinical procedures, and company facilities, this position provides accurate and timely information to create an integrated, multidisciplinary schedule and an experience that is easy, empathetic, and differentiated in the oncology marketplace.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Schedules medical appointments through coordination of patients, providers, facility resources, ancillary staff, records, referrals, authorizations, and payers. Receives and initiates calls to/from patients, providers, provider offices and facilities, while following all established scheduling procedures and protocols to ensure patients receive the care they need, when and where they need it.

2. Receives physician’s orders and effectively schedules and reschedules appointments, tests, and/or procedures leveraging various electronic medical record/scheduling software systems according to protocols established by clinical staff and scheduling standards. Identifies alternative scheduled solutions in the event the patient’s preference is not available, while adhering to procedures and protocols and ensuring patient safety.

3. Provides patients with information, pre and post-test instruction, provides location of appointment and directions. The position answers questions as necessary within guidelines and protocols. Refers questions to clinical staff as appropriate.

4. Effectively communicates and builds impactful relationships through written, digital, and verbal channels with patients, facilities, providers, and clinical colleagues to ensure an easy, empathetic, solution-oriented patient experience, included but not limited to, phone, chat, email, electronic medical record messaging, and other digital channels. Anticipates patient and provider needs and responds accordingly.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

High school diploma/GED or equivalent working knowledge.

The position requires skills normally gained with two years of scheduling experience in a physician’s office or hospital. Medical terminology may be required for some assignments. Must possess excellent communication, organizational and problem-solving skills.

Must be proficient with commonly used office software and have the ability to use software typically used for medical practice management and scheduling.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Knowledge of ICD-9, CPT, and HCPCS coding is strongly preferred. Sound working knowledge of various types of insurance plans and/or worker’s compensation preferred. Bi-lingual in Spanish may be preferred for some assignments.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

About Cat Financial

Cat Financial is a subsidiary of Caterpillar Inc., the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For more than 40 years, Cat Financial has provided a wide range of financing solutions to customers and Cat® dealers for machines, engines, Solar® gas turbines, genuine Cat parts and services. Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, Cat Financial serves customers globally with offices and subsidiaries located throughout North and South America, Asia, Australia, Europe and Africa. Visit cat.com to learn more about Cat Financial.

Role Definition
Develop and maintain expertise in administration, risk management and structuring of receivable purchases from Caterpillar subsidiaries on a worldwide basis.

Responsibilities
• Manages the processing of receivable purchases in conjunction with Caterpillar Business Units; includes internal business partners such as accounting, treasury, tax, and legal.
• Leads all budgeting and forecasting efforts for purchased receivables volume expectations.
• Works with various internal business partners to grow potential purchased receivables opportunities.
• Works with internal business partners to ensure proper reporting of past due accounts and facilitates communication on past due purchased receivables.

Degree Requirement
Degree or equivalent experience desired

Skill Descriptors
Finance and Accounting: Knowledge of finance and accounting practices, financial analysis, and reporting; ability to apply finance knowledge appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Working Knowledge:
• Works with general ledger accounts.
• Differentiates between capital investments and expenses.
• Uses finance and accounting systems, procedures and practices.
• Interprets profit and loss statements, balance sheets and financial forecasts.
• Resolves questions about finance and accounting policies and practices.

Planning: Tactical, Strategic: Knowledge of effective planning techniques and ability to contribute to operational (short term), tactical (1-2 years) and strategic (3-5 years) planning in support of the overall business plan.

Level Extensive Experience:
• Develops, refines, and communicates tactical plans for own responsibilities.
• Provides the right level of detail as input for strategic plan development.
• Demonstrates the value and necessity of linking tactical plans to overall strategic plan.
• Ensures attention to the detail and dependencies of existing departmental-level plans.
• Plans for allocation of resources in line with unit goals, technical and business objectives.
• Ensures the planning process is integrated with the overall business plan.

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.

Level Extensive Experience:

The Opportunity:


This position supports a Department of War (DoW) organization, USAFRICOM, located OCONUS in Stuttgart, Germany, by providing security engineering and security architecture expertise to the Command. This position supports the USAFRICOM J6 and works with a robust staff of cybersecurity positions. The individual will interface directly with client managers, contract leadership, and system users.

Responsibilities:


• Multi-Enclave Design & Architecture: Designs secure enterprise architectures across multiple security classification enclaves (UNCLASSIFIED and SECRET). Implements Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), Software Defined Networking (SDN), and Comply-to-Connect (C2C) frameworks.

• Acquisition & Lifecycle Support: Document and integrate cybersecurity architecture and systems security engineering requirements throughout the DoD acquisition lifecycle. Evaluate security architectures proposed in response to acquisition documents.
• Risk Management & Continuous Monitoring: Perform security planning, assessment, risk analysis, and risk management. Perform Risk Assessments on findings identified through Continuous Monitoring Activities, recommending courses of action for all vulnerabilities or non-compliant areas.
• System Integration: Participate as the primary security engineering representative on engineering teams for the design, development, implementation, evaluation, and integration of IA architectures, systems, or system components.
• DCO Team Integration: Works directly alongside Defensive Cyber Operations (DCO) to feed system telemetry into incident response workflows and translate active threat hunt findings into system architecture hardening.
• Configuration & Maintenance: Evaluate and test software security patches and configuration changes for compatibility with the current baseline, employing secure configuration management processes. Evaluate new or trial equipment/software being brought into authorization boundaries.
• Security Engineering & Cloud Oversight: Drive "security by design" by reviewing technical change requests, evaluating new technologies, and providing security oversight for cloud-based platforms (primarily Azure).
• Emerging Technology: Apply knowledge of AI policy, procedures, and workforce structure to design, develop, and implement secure networking, computing, and enclave environments.

• Advanced Analytics & Dashboards: Implements and manages advanced cybersecurity dashboards that aggregate vulnerability management metrics and provide leadership with real-time risk-posture and project-tracking visualization.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Interact with the customer and project team members to translate operational requirements into protection needs (security controls) and identify overall security requirements for the proper handling of Government data. Ensure trusted relationships among external systems are enforced.

Qualifications:

Required:
• Clearance: Active TS/SCI required.
• DCWF / 8140 Security Architect (652) certification requirement (e.g., CISSP, CISSP-ISSAP, CISSP-ISSEP, CISM or CCSP) prior to start.

Experience & Education: 8+ years of cybersecurity, preferably ISSE/A experience (including recent access control, cloud, and architecture experience), and a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Assurance, or a related discipline.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Assurance, Information Security System Engineering, or related discipline from an accredited college or university.

title: Trauma and Operating Room Unit Aide
description:
Primary City/State:

Phoenix, Arizona

Department Name:

Surg-Hosp

Work Shift:

Varied

Job Category:

Clinical Care

The future is full of possibilities. At Banner Health, we’re excited about what the future holds for health care. That’s why we’re changing the industry to make the experience the best it can be. Our team has come together with the common goal: Make health care easier, so life can be better. The future of health care starts here. If you’re ready to change lives, we want to hear from you. Apply today.

As a Operating Room Unit Aide for the surgical team at Banner University Medical Center - Phoenix, you will help impact patient care directly by providing a clean and risk free surgical environment. You will clean the operating rooms after each surgery, stock the OR's with supplies, and other operational tasks as needed. You will have the opportunity to work in a level one trauma facility with varying types of surgical services in a positive team environment that promotes growth and learning.

Full Time position, schedule will vary. Normal hours are 3 12 hour shifts, Saturday, Sunday, and Monday from 6:30a-7p. Varied shifts position requires ability to work a varied schedule, with shifts as early as 6am.

University Medical Center Phoenix is a nationally recognized academic medical center. The world-class hospital is focused on coordinated clinical care, expanded research activities and nurturing future generations of highly trained medical professionals. Our commitment to nursing excellence has enabled us to achieve Magnet™ recognition by the American Nurses Credentialing Center. The Phoenix campus, long known for excellent patient care, has over 730 licensed beds, several unique specialty units and is the new home for medical discoveries, thanks to our collaboration with the University of Arizona College of Medicine - Phoenix. Additionally, the campus responsibilities include fully integrated multi-specialty and sub-specialty clinics.

POSITION SUMMARY
This position is responsible for collection, inventory, cleaning and distribution of medical supplies and patient care equipment for the unit. This position is also responsible for miscellaneous tasks such as transporting patients and supplies, and may include transporting health records, lab specimens and equipment to other areas. This position may provide basic, hands-on, patient care as requested by supervisor.

CORE FUNCTIONS
1. Inventories, orders, replenishes, and disperses supplies within the department, ensuring all areas and carts are appropriately stocked and the supplies are readily accessible to the clinical staff. Assists with transportation, delivery, and pick-up of supplies, health records, lab specimens, and/or equipment. Rotates and inventories stock to ensure sterile packaging integrity and current expiration dates. Monitors utilization and recommends changes as appropriate. Maintains quality records of various department equipment, supplies, storage areas, etc.

2. Maintains unit equipment, instruments and trays in accordance with department policy. Cleans, sorts, assembles equipment, instruments and/or trays according to standard set-up and replaces in designated areas, ensuring they are readily accessible. Responsible for finding and bringing equipment or instruments for procedures, under the direction of the clinical staff. May check instruments and equipment, as assigned, to see if they need repair and liaison with technology management.

3. Maintains clean and safe work environment and discards soiled linen and trash. Completes room set-up which may include comprehensive cleaning, bed turnover and preparation of special procedure carts. Remove debris from floors, walls, equipment and other surfaces using disinfectant, damp mops etc.

4. Provides basic, hands-on, patient care as requested by supervisor, including but not limited to patient transport and ambulation.

5. May provide general support to the department, including performing administrative tasks and greeting and assisting patients, visitors, physicians, and ancillary personnel. May provide back-up support for Monitor Techs in designated departments – this will require additional specialized training provided by the department.

6. This position works under local supervision and has responsibility for assigned unit only. Incumbents work in a fast-paced, sometimes stressful environment with a strong focus on customer service. Interacts with staff at all levels throughout the facility. Customers are patients, families, physicians, unit staff, case managers, patient service staff and medical records staff. Interacts with a wide variety of external customers.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Certification for BLS is required.

Requires skills and abilities typically attained with six months of healthcare experience. Must possess excellent organizational skills, as well as effective human relations and communication skills. Working knowledge of medical terminology is required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

High school diploma/GED or equivalent working knowledge.
Knowledge of patient related supplies, materials, equipment and aseptic techniques are preferred.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

EEO/Disabled/Veterans

title: Sr/ Engineer Supplier Quality
description:
Job Summary

Manages a bucket of suppliers and works as main point of contact window between suppliers and Corporate QA and Shanghai Office QA.

Supports/Drives the suppliers to build their own master process validation plan and monitor the execution progress.

Identifies and implements improvement opportunities to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of the supplier quality engineering and supplier quality management programs.

Work with QC/QA to optimize product inspection criteria with LEAN and effective quality inspection purpose.

Supports and coaches the junior members as necessary.

Complex project management to support internal and external quality improvement requests.

description:

A Patient Financial Advocate will provide general insurance education, provide price quotes to potential patients, and assist with payments and payment arrangements.

Oversight of the implementation of new applications and changes to existing computer systems and software packages. Ensure that current and potential resources and services stay current and competitive with respect to IT.

Apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills to customer and stakeholder problems. Oversight of purchasing, acquisition, inventory, and disposition of hardware and software for infrastructure. Oversee operations, support, and architecture for the computing and information technology functions; oversee, implement, and assess the feasibility of system enhancements. title: Analyst, Cyber Security
description:
