    • Talent development, retention, and internal mobility
    • Succession bench strengths (both internally & externally)
    • Medical capability uplift and training completion
    • Engagement and leadership index scores
  • Operational Excellence
    • Budget adherence, process efficiency, and operational improvements
    • Effectiveness of medical governance & compliance processes

Education:


· MD preferred; PhD/PharmD or comparable advanced scientific degree acceptable depending on country regulation

Languages:

· English

· Local country language required

Experience/Professional Requirement:

Experiences:

  • 10+ years of experience in Medical Affairs, preferably including 3–5 years in senior medical leadership roles (e.g. Medical TA Lead).
  • Demonstrated leadership associates in Medical or scientific roles, with a track record of building and developing high performing teams.
  • Deep knowledge of local healthcare systems, payer dynamics, policy frameworks, and therapeutic area science.
  • Proven success leading multiple pre‑launch and launches across therapeutic areas.
  • Experience shaping HTA, reimbursement, pricing and access, including integration of local evidence requirements.
  • Extensive engagement with KOLs, scientific societies, policymakers, payers, regulatory bodies and broader healthcare ecosystem partners.
  • Experience leading organizational transformation, including digital enablement and capability building within Medical Affairs

Functional & Leadership skills:

  • Navigating Complexity: ability to translate complex data into clear and relevant insights, executive presentation skills and ability to build compelling scientific narratives to support internal alignment and external advocacy; and strong knowledge of product LCM.

  • Delivering Impact: Demonstrating TA depth with ability to interpret and communicate clinical trial results, RWE and guidelines updates and strong knowledge of the regulatory and compliance frameworks such as GCP, PV, promotional vs non promotional standards; fully immersed in the business landscape demonstrating high business acumen, leverage data driven insights to inform decisions and cross-functional collaboration

  • Leading People: Demonstrated ability to lead transformations and changes while leading continued efforts on managing resources, performance and launch preparations; expertise of building and maintaining relationships with medical experts, medical societies, regulators, guideline boards, and policy makers


Skills Desired

Cross-Functional Collaboration, Data Analysis, Drug Development, Employee Development, Health Sciences, Influencing Skills, Innovation, Inspirational Leadership, Medical Affairs, Patient Care, People Management, Pharmaceutics, Product Launches, Real World Evidence (RWE), Regulatory Compliance, Research Methodologies, Results-Oriented, Stakeholder Engagement, Statistical Analysis

This role provides technical guidance to depot personnel, monitors production activities, supports troubleshooting efforts, and coordinates with engineering and operations teams to ensure quality, schedule, and performance objectives are achieved.   • Provides guidance to Depot personnel to ensure the Honeywell OEM standards are maintained during repair of assets
  • Monitors assets on test cell to ensure all performance specifications are met
  • Responsible for overseeing the repair/overhaul process of Honeywell secondary power assets including scheduling, planning and reporting consistent with program plans
  • Monitors preventative maintenance and calibration of equipment and systems
  • Reads blueprints, wiring diagrams, schematic drawings, and engineering instructions for assembling and disassembling assets

Basic Qualifications

  • Must be a U.S. citizen
  • Associate degree in a technical discipline and 6 years of relevant experience supporting maintenance, repair, overhaul, production, logistics, or related operational environments.

  • Working knowledge of technical publications, engineering documentation, blueprints, wiring diagrams, and schematics.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with operations, engineering, logistics, and customer stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Honeywell products or secondary power systems.
  • Knowledge of depot-level maintenance, repair, and overhaul operations.
  • Experience using IBM Maximo or other maintenance management systems.
  • Experience developing, tracking, and reporting production or performance metrics.
  • Prior experience working with U.S. Government depots or defense-related programs.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence and effectively coordinate cross-functional teams.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including reporting and data analysis capabilities.

The Research Institute Brain and Body Donation Program – Sun City serves all aspects of the Institute’s mission – to make a difference to patients with age-related disorders through cutting-edge research, clinical care, prevention, and education. The Neuropsychology team includes neuropsychologists, psychometrists, research assistants, post-doctoral fellows, and psychology graduate students. Our team is dedicated to precision and accuracy in administration of neuropsychological measures, compassionate care for our patients and research participants, and collaborative innovation of best practices.

The Psychometrist Coordinator helps run an extensive training program and ensures data integrity by on-going oversight throughout the academic year. Additionally, this position provides guidance and oversight to new psychometrists as they navigate complex training requirements.

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8am to 4:30pm

Location: Banner Research 10515 W Santa Fe Dr Sun City, AZ (may be asked to float to the Banner Alzheimer’s Institute at times for training purposes)

Banner Alzheimer's Institute (BAI) was established in 2006 as Banner Health's first Center of Excellence. Banner Sun Health Research Institute (BSHRI) was founded in 1986. Our team is uniquely, passionately, and strategically committed to ending Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative disorders without losing another generation, advancing oncology research to improve cancer prevention and treatment outcomes, and providing an unparalleled model of care for families facing these devastating diseases. Banner Research is committed to improving people's lives through comprehensive patient care and advances that capitalize on the best biomedical research. We intend to make a transformational difference in Alzheimer's disease, other neurodegenerative disorders, and oncology research and care.

POSITION SUMMARY
This position coordinates an extensive training program and ensures data integrity by on-going oversight throughout the academic year. Additionally, this position provides guidance and oversight to new psychometrists as they navigate complex training requirements.

CORE FUNCTIONS
1. Provides administrative oversight of psychometry department training needs to include facilitating the onboarding process of doctoral students and new psychometry staff, maintaining training records and assisting department neuropsychologist with maintenance of training schedule and meeting required benchmarks.

2. Maintains and updates department standard operating procedures to enhance operational efficiency of a complex department that supports multiple clinical and research activities.

3. Coordinates departmental schedules/room utilization to ensure optimal operational efficiency.

4. Administers global clinical assessments using semi-structured and unstructured interviews. This position attends training for specific clinical trial and/or research protocols and administers the interviews in according with protocols to ensure validity.

5. Scores evaluation and provides required observational summary as relevant. For certain evaluations, enters test data into computer database ensuring accuracy and entry in a timely manner.

6. Reviews allocation of patient visits and adjust as necessary to ensure all staff are maintaining relatively equal patient loads. This position will determine how best to utilize space and adjust rooms as appropriate to the type of clinical or research visit. This position will provide feedback and administrative supervision to student and psychometrists regarding scoring, norming, administration and other departmental procedures.

7. This position has freedom to determine how best to accomplish administrative functions within established procedures. Confers with supervisor for operational changes and/or unusual situations. This position will assist with flow of departmental workload. This position will interact with all departments within BSHRI as neuropsychology supports brain and body donation program, clinical trials and the outpatient clinic. Customers include patients/participants coming in for various types of visits and with varying levels of cognitive impairment. Additional customers include the academic institutions with whom we partner in our training program, as well as various sponsors for our clinical trials. This position is responsible to assess clinical severity of research participants. Confers with supervisor, site neuropsychologist, and/or study investigator for unusual or complex cases. This person will need to function independently and be able to provide a clinical assessment / judgment of severity without guidance from other team members and without access to medical records. This position serves the clinical trials department and pharma sponsors and their CROs.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Master’s Degree in psychology, behavioral health or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Certification for Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR) scale required upon hire or must be obtained within the first 90 days of employment.

Requires 2 years of clinical and cognitive assessment experience or related education experience. Requires excellent clinical judgment and communication skills (both verbal and written). Requires ability to establish rapport with clinical with varying degrees of impairment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

title: Technician Mammalian Downstream
description:
Manufacturing Technician, Downstream, Night Shift

Our purpose is to bring hope to life by enabling life-changing therapies for patients around the globe, creating a healthier and happier tomorrow. Our mission is to work side by side with our customers to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

At AGC Biologics in Søborg, this purpose becomes reality every day in our manufacturing facility, where biopharmaceutical production processes are transformed into products for clinical studies and the market.

As part of our Downstream Manufacturing team, you will play a hands-on role in the purification of biopharmaceutical proteins. Working in a GMP environment, you will operate purification equipment, execute production processes, and help ensure that every batch is produced and documented according to our quality standards.

If you enjoy working with technical equipment, structured processes, and colleagues who depend on each other to keep production moving, this could be the role for you.

Where purification expertise meets hands-on manufacturing

Downstream manufacturing is where the product is purified and prepared for the next stage of the production process.

As a technician, you will be responsible for planning and performing different steps in the protein purification process.

Your work will include setting up production equipment such as SUM systems, columns, filters, and Äkta Ready systems. You will execute processes including HETP, chromatography, Nano filtration, and UF/DF filtration, as well as perform swabbing and sampling.

Documentation is an important part of the role. You will complete and review MPRs and logbooks and help ensure high quality in the batch documentation in close collaboration with QA and QC.

You will also prepare production rooms and systems before and after production and participate in qualification, maintenance, control, and calibration of equipment.

Together with the team, you will be responsible for delivering the product to the filling team.

A team built around collaboration

You will become part of a production area consisting of five production lines producing preclinical, clinical, and commercial products for a wide variety of clients.

The team consists of dedicated technicians and academics who work closely together and collaborate with colleagues across functions including QC, QA, and Development.

Production can be dynamic and fast paced, and flexibility and teamwork are important parts of keeping the processes running and solving challenges together.

What will help you succeed

We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on production work and working in a structured GMP environment.

You will preferably bring:

  • An education as Process Operator, Process Technologist, or similar
  • More than 2 years of experience from the biopharmaceutical industry and experience working in a cGMP environment is an advantage.
  • Experience with protein purification using chromatography and Äkta Ready or Äkta Process
  • A positive attitude, team spirit, and willingness to learn new skills
  • The ability to collaborate and communicate in a constructive manner
  • The ability to speak, read, and understand English

As a person, you are positive and flexible and comfortable taking on new assignments and responsibility. You thrive in a dynamic work environment and can handle unpredictability.

Working nights in Downstream Manufacturing

This position operates on a night shift from 20:00 to 07:00.

You should also be prepared to take on overtime during peak production periods.

A global biotech environment with real impact

AGC Biologics is a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) within the biotech industry. We work with the development of biopharmaceutical production processes and GMP production of biopharmaceutical proteins for both clinical studies and the market.

At AGC, you will have opportunities to work with a wide range of tasks and challenges and gain experience across our different departments. As projects and tasks are planned together within the team, you will also have the opportunity to influence your daily work.

We work in an informal environment where energy, enthusiasm, respect for individual differences, flexibility, and helping each other reach deadlines are important parts of everyday work.

Join the Downstream Manufacturing team

If you have experience with protein purification and want to work hands-on with technologies such as Äkta Ready, chromatography, and filtration in a GMP manufacturing environment, we would be excited to hear from you.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application through our recruitment system.

Who We Are
AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

title: Integrated Solutions Well Engineer
description:
Job Description

Integrated Solutions Well Engineer

Do you enjoy motivating others to deliver successful solutions for business and customers?

Are you passionate in scientific and engineering methodologies?

Partner with the best

Baker Hughes stands as a leading global energy‑technology company, delivering innovative solutions that make energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient across the entire value chain. Operating in more than 120 countries, the company blends deep industrial expertise with advanced engineering and digital technologies to support energy production, transformation, and decarbonization. With over a century of heritage, Baker Hughes partners with customers in oil and gas, industrial sectors, and emerging energy markets to accelerate progress toward a more sustainable energy future

Fuel your passion

The Integrated Solutions Well Engineer performs all the well engineering activities within a project or Center of Excellence according to guidelines and processes set out in the Integrated Solutions Management System, international and/or local standards and regulations and customer requirements. The Integrated Solutions Well Engineer provides technical input to the well construction, completions, well intervention and abandonment phases, from the concept and tendering stage through project commencement, execution and project close out. During tendering phases, in addition to engineering work, the engineer will be supporting the commercial and procurement teams. During planning and execution stages, the engineer interfaces with stakeholders to ensure safety, well integrity and cost effective job execution. The Well Engineer ensures the well design and well program is prepared and detailed procedures are provided to the execution team; the Well Engineer is a key contributor during project execution providing follow up, technical input, and operational support.

As a Integrated Solutions Well Engineer, you will be responsible for:

  • Ensuring all engineering activities are in line with HSE policies and procedures, and drive HSE culture by setting example through safe work practices.

  • Conducting business according to Baker Hughes values

  • Participating in tender bid preparation process for well engineering input.

  • Participating in customer presentations & meetings (may include travel to other locations).

  • Preparing of well design, well plan and operational procedures for construction, completion, intervention and/or abandonment of wells in area of responsibility.

  • Defining technical services and third party requirements.

  • Preparing operational time and cost estimates.

  • Collaborating with internal and external parties, prepare risk register and contingency plans.

  • Preparing and participating in peer reviews, peer assists and other quality assurance activities related to the project.

  • Monitoring daily progress of job(s) or project(s) and monitor operations expenditure.

  • Evaluating the application and implementation of best practices and technological advancements to Integrated Solutions operations.

  • Communicating effectively with well site/project stakeholders as needed and make recommendations to drive flawless service delivery and operational excellence as per approved plans.

  • Monitoring technical and operations KPIs and benchmark against offset well data and pre-defined well objectives.

  • Participating in Root Cause Analysis investigation.

  • Preparing all technical reports related to the project including End of Well Report, after action reviews, lessons learned summary.

  • Complying with data management according to Integrated Solutions procedures.
    Keeping abreast of technological and engineering process advancements through affiliation with professional societies and participation in networks, workshops, seminars and training courses

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a Bachelor's degree preferably in Petroleum Engineering or Mechanical/Chemical Engineering with MS in Petroleum/Oil & Gas or Well Engineering.

  • Have at least 5 years of relevant work experience in well construction, completions, intervention and/or optimization: the experience could include drill bits, BHA design, engineering simulations, field operations, preparation of programs/designs, or similar.

  • Have basic knowledge/exposure to specific applications: conventional rotary drilling, horizontal and/or multilateral wells, pad drilling, unconventional.
    Knowledgeable in Geo-mechanics and well control

  • Interpersonal skills to work well with colleagues across all businesses/cultures, achieve objectives through effective influencing, and establish credibility with senior leaders.

  • Excellent analytics and problem-solving, including ability to form hypotheses and move forward in the absence of complete information.

  • Excellent English oral and written communication skills, including ability to synthesize complex topics into clear and simple messages.

  • Experience in the use of MS office suite, power BI or other analytical tools, well engineering and design software (for example: hydraulics, torque and drag, basic casing design)

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.


Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

  • Comprehensive private medical care options

  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs

  • Tailored financial programs

  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Engineering Senior Specialist - Integrated Solutions/ Well Engineering

Job Description

Join us as a Scientist I

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. As a Scientist I your role will be to execute endotoxin and microbiology methods for laboratory testing ensure the accuracy and reliability of results, and uphold the highest standards of quality and compliance in all laboratory practices.

• Perform lab work in accordance with client protocols, methods and requirements

• Excellent manual dexterity skills

• Good written and oral communication skills

• Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.

• Personal protective equipment required such as protective eyewear, garments and gloves.

• Exposure to fluctuating and/or extreme temperatures on rare occasions.

Physical Requirements:

• Ability to work in an upright and /or stationary position for 6-8 hours per day.

• Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists to operate lab equipment.

• Occasional mobility needed.

• Occasional crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck.

• Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.

• Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in-house and off-the-shelf.

• Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand; with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.

• Frequently interacts with others to obtain or relate information to diverse groups.

• Works independently with little guidance or reliance on oral or written instructions and plans work schedules to meet goals. Requires multiple periods of intense concentration.

• Performs a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions with little predictability as to the occurrence. Ability to perform under stress. Ability to multi-task.

• Regular and consistent attendance.

Why Join Us?

When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience – and where your contributions truly make a difference.

Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthrough.

title: Platform Architect, SFMC
description:
Job Description:

About Us

Merkle, a dentsu company, is a leading customer experience management (CXM) company that combines data, technology, and creativity to help the world's best brands build lasting customer relationships. Our Salesforce practice partners with global enterprise clients to design, implement, and optimize customer engagement solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

Role Summary

If you're passionate about Salesforce Marketing Cloud and enjoy building solutions that reach millions of customers, this is an opportunity to do your best work at scale. At Merkle, you'll support enterprise brands across a variety of industries, solving complex marketing technology challenges and delivering personalized customer experiences across email, mobile, and emerging channels. You'll be part of a collaborative team that values technical excellence, continuous learning, and innovation in customer experience.

As a Platform Architect, you will use hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement experience to build, support, and optimize digital messaging solutions across email, SMS, mobile, and related channels. You will translate business requirements into technical configurations, develop automations and integrations, troubleshoot platform issues, and support SFMC best practices.

This is a hands-on engineering and delivery role contributing to solution designs and reusable platform patterns while partnering with senior technical leaders on complex integrations and broader architecture decisions.

What You Will Do

SFMC Development and Implementation

  • Build and maintain scalable Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement solutions.

  • Translate business and campaign requirements into technical configurations.

  • Develop journeys, automations, segmentation logic, and campaign workflows.

  • Create platform solutions using AMPscript, SSJS, SQL, and GTL.

  • Configure Data Extensions, Contact Builder, Journey Builder, and Automation Studio.

  • Support REST and SOAP API integrations with senior technical team members.

  • Assist with platform audits, health checks, testing, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.

  • Follow development, testing, deployment, and documentation standards.

Client and Team Support

  • Serve as a hands-on technical resource for assigned clients and delivery teams.

  • Participate in requirements gathering and technical discovery sessions.

  • Explain technical requirements, recommendations, and platform limitations to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Support SFMC capability, configuration, and best-practice recommendations.

  • Collaborate with developers, project managers, strategists, analytics teams, and technical specialists.

  • Escalate complex architecture, integration, and platform decisions when appropriate.

Platform Optimization

  • Review SFMC configurations to improve performance, scalability, and maintainability.

  • Optimize journeys, automations, data structures, and campaign workflows.

  • Stay current on SFMC releases, platform changes, and new capabilities.

  • Support implementation of relevant platform updates and messaging best practices.

Documentation and Knowledge Sharing

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including workflow diagrams, configuration details, and specifications.

  • Document platform solutions, development decisions, and troubleshooting outcomes.

  • Contribute to reusable assets, coding standards, internal best practices, and team knowledge sharing.

What You Bring

Technical Experience

  • 4 or more years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement development or implementation experience.

  • Experience with AMPscript, SSJS, SQL, and familiarity with GTL.

  • Experience with Data Extensions, Contact Builder, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, and audience segmentation.

  • Experience supporting REST or SOAP API integrations.

  • Experience with Marketing Cloud Connect, SFMC Connector, or similar integration methods.

  • Background in software development, technical implementation, platform configuration, and SFMC troubleshooting.

  • Understanding of development, testing, and deployment practices.

Consulting and Communication Skills

  • Client-facing, agency, or consulting experience preferred.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.

  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort working through changing requirements and technical ambiguity.

  • Ability to manage assigned work and deliver high-quality solutions on schedule.

Domain Knowledge

  • Understanding of digital messaging across email, SMS, mobile, or push channels.

  • Familiarity with data quality, consent, campaign execution, CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and other relevant privacy or messaging requirements.

  • One or more Salesforce certifications preferred, such as Marketing Cloud Email Specialist, Administrator, Consultant, or Developer.

title: Food & Beverage Assistant
description:
Food & Beverage Assistant
Hours: Up to 37.5, dependent on the needs of the business
Work pattern: Including weekends, bank holidays and evenings
Duration: Permanent Zero Hour Contract

This exciting role involves working in our catering environments such as kiosks, restaurants, kitchens and stores. The role is varied, and no two days are the same.
You could be serving refreshments from one of our kiosks or helping the stores team to deliver stock to the outlets or you could be working as a team in one of the restaurants serving food to tables, helping to prepare and cook our delicious food and getting stuck in with keeping the unit clean and tidy. You may even need to jump into a fun costume at times to be part of our exciting themes and events!

About You

The ideal candidate will need to be highly motivated, have a bubbly personality, have a strong customer focus, be approachable and friendly and have confidence to serve food, handle cash and card transactions in a very face passed environment. Experience in this kind of environment is advantageous but not essential as we offer fantastic on the job training to help you grow and develop your skill set.

You will need to be flexible in your approach to work outside of standard business hours, including weekends, bank holidays and evening. All applicants will need to have completed their GCSE’s.

Benefits
As well as benefiting from working in a unique and beautiful setting, you’ll also receive a range of additional perks to employment including:

WMSP Annual Pass which gives you and your family and friends free admission and theme park wristbands, and free entry to our sister site Drayton Manor Park also Water World Stoke On Trent
20% Discount in our retail and catering outlets and off park special events.
24 Hour access to an online doctor and access to online prescriptions.
Counselling access.
Online retailer discount portal.

What we are
West Midlands Safari Park is an award-winning visitor attraction, located in Worcestershire in the heart of England. It is home to some of the world’s most beautiful and critically endangered species, with a four-mile safari drive-through, walk-through Discovery Trail, African Village and Lemur Woods, as well beautiful walking trails, allowing guests to experience up close encounters with hundreds of exotic animals. Guests can also choose from a wide range of catering and retail outlets, as well as enjoying a large amusement area with over 25 rides and attractions providing the ideal venue for family days out.
In 2021, the Park introduced Safari Lodges – luxury accommodation allowing guests to stay overnight for the first time. Guests can wake up to incredible sights of elephants, giraffe, rhino and red panda, or sleep just a ‘whisker’ away from lions, tigers and cheetahs.
In addition, the park is home to three incredible venues – Spring Grove House, Treetops Pavillion and Cellarz, which play host to weddings, corporate events and social celebrations.

What we do
Our mission is to bring people together to create unique wildlife experiences that exhilarate, educate and leave memories to last a lifetime.
Our 200-acre site allows us to do just that, whether you’re a day guest, wedding guest or overnight guest! We create experiences unlike no other, attracting visitors from across the Midlands and beyond.
Our brand and our team members live by our core values. We’re passionate and work with a sense of togetherness, always striving to be progressive, with preservation at the heart of everything we do, all while creating unforgettable experiences.
Through these principles we aspire to achieve our vision: to be the number one UK wildlife attraction through the creation of immersive animal habitats and unique visitor experiences.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Quantum Computing Applied Research
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s motivated by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Join our team and discover how you can develop a lasting impact on the world.

Quantum computing is accelerating from lab to utility, and NVIDIA sits at the center of that shift. We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead high-impact strategic R&D initiatives within quantum computing. You will lead across our applied research R&D roadmap to craft clarity and success. We are innovating groundbreaking techniques for quantum in AI and accelerated computing, so that useful fault-tolerant quantum computing arrives sooner. Partner across engineering, applied research, and product teams inside NVIDIA, and with external collaborators, you will build and operationalize innovation roadmaps that pioneer ahead. Success in this role includes outstanding program leadership, communication, and problem solving. If you're passionate about bringing quantum computing into the fault-tolerant era with accelerated computing, we would love to hear from you!

What you'll be doing:

  • Initiate and lead multiple concurrent technical programs across our quantum computing portfolio, with emphasis on bringing the full power of accelerated computing to the field.

  • Define clear execution plans and measurable outcomes from our R&D and technology roadmaps, then lown the work to success across teams.

  • Identify & prioritize the most critical activities required for the research's success, and ensure that they are completed.

  • Develop a strong technical understanding of our R&D priorities, to enable successful collaborations, and proactively identify new opportunities.

  • Creatively solve and mitigate technical challenges, while establishing early risk identification and mitigations.

  • Serve as a link between research and engineering, moving new technologies from incubation to scalable solutions.

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.

  • 10+ years of technical program management experience leading large-scale, cross-functional technology initiatives, including multiple sophisticated programs at once and execution alongside research, engineering, and technical leadership.

  • Validated understanding of the quantum computing ecosystem and technologies, including hardware and software.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate sophisticated technical concepts for a range of audiences.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Advanced degree (MS or PhD or equivalent) in quantum information science, physics, or a closely related field, or hands-on research or engineering experience inside a quantum program.

  • Background in translating research output to developed technology.

  • Familiarity with GPU-accelerated computing, HPC environments, or hybrid quantum-classical workflows and the tooling around them.

  • Experience running joint technical programs with national laboratories, companies, universities, or research institutions.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 258,750 USD for Level 4, and 200,000 USD - 322,000 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

title: Engineer II, Customer Quality Engineering
description:
Job Title:

Engineer II, Customer Quality Engineering

Job Description:

Job Description

Customer Quality Engineer (Engineer II, L2)

Product: Semiconductor Cleaner

Position Summary

We are seeking a motivated and customer-focused Customer Quality Engineer (CQE) to support and enhance customer quality performance for Semiconductor Cleaner products. The successful candidate will serve as the primary quality interface between customers and internal teams, driving issue resolution, product quality improvement, and customer satisfaction.

This role requires a strong understanding of semiconductor materials and manufacturing processes, excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams. Candidates with CMP-related experience, including Slurry, Pad, or PCMP Cleaner products, are highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary customer quality representative for Semiconductor Cleaner products supporting customers in Korea.

  • Lead customer issue investigation and resolution activities utilizing structured problem-solving methodologies (8D, RCA, CAPA, etc.).

  • Analyze quality and process data to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.

  • Collaborate with Manufacturing, R&D, Product Management, Sales, Supply Chain, and Global Quality teams to resolve customer concerns.

  • Support customer qualifications, product changes, PCN activities, and new product introductions (NPI).

  • Conduct technical reviews and communicate investigation results to customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance customer satisfaction and product performance.

  • Support customer audits, quality reviews, and technical meetings.

  • Monitor customer quality KPIs and develop corrective actions to improve quality performance.

  • Ensure compliance with internal quality systems, customer requirements, and industry standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, Semiconductor Engineering, or related disciplines.

  • Minimum 4-5 years of experience in Semiconductor Materials, Customer Quality, Process Engineering, Product Engineering, or related technical roles.

  • Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes and quality systems.

  • Experience handling customer quality issues and driving corrective actions.

  • Knowledge of quality methodologies including:

  • 8D

  • CAPA

  • SPC

  • FMEA

  • Root Cause Analysis

  • Statistical Data Analysis

  • Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and global teams.

  • Business-level English communication skills (written and verbal).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with CMP-related products:

  • CMP Slurry

  • CMP Pad

  • PCMP Cleaner

  • Post-CMP Cleaning Process

  • Experience supporting Samsung Electronics, SK hynix, or other semiconductor manufacturers.

  • Experience with semiconductor wet chemistry or cleaning processes.

  • Hands-on experience using Minitab, JMP, or similar statistical software.

  • Six Sigma Green Belt or above.

  • Experience supporting customer audits and qualification activities.

  • Experience collaborating with overseas manufacturing sites and global teams.

Key Competencies

  • Customer Focus

  • Data-Driven Decision Making

  • Technical Problem Solving

  • Quality Mindset

  • Effective Communication

  • Stakeholder Management

  • Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Initiative & Accountability

  • Continuous Improvement Mindset

Location

Suwon, South Korea

Job Level

Engineer II (L2)

Function

Customer Quality Engineering (CQE)

Success in this Role

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Effective and timely resolution of customer quality issues.

  • Improvement of customer satisfaction and quality KPIs.

  • Successful execution of qualification, PCN, and change management activities.

  • Strong collaboration with customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Contribution to continuous quality improvement and operational excellence.

title: Koneistaja, Bluefors Oy
description:
Bluefors Oy on Helsingissä toimiva suomalainen korkean teknologian yritys, joka työskentelee kvanttiteknologian ehdottomassa kärjessä. Yritys suunnittelee ja valmistaa maailman tarkimpiin kuuluvia kryogeenisiä mittausjärjestelmiä, eli laitteistoja, jotka vievät tieteen mahdollisuuksien rajoja eteenpäin. - Kuparin, AISI 316 -ruostumattoman teräksen, messingin, alumiinin ja POM-muovin koneistus
- Halkaisijaltaan 5-360 mm olevien kappaleiden valmistus
- Pienten sarjojen (yleensä alle 10 kappaletta) valmistus tarkasti ja tasalaatuisesti
- Yleistoleranssien ja korkeiden pintalaatuvalmistusten saavuttaminen
- Teknisten piirustusten ja koneistusohjelmien lukeminen ja tulkinta
- Laadunvalvonnan suorittaminen sekä valmiiden osien vaatimustenmukaisuuden varmistaminen
- Siistin, järjestelmällisen ja turvallisen työympäristön ylläpitämiseen osallistuminen

- Vankka kokemus CNC-jyrsinkoneiden asetusten tekemisestä ja käytöstä
- Käytännön kokemusta 5-akselisesta koneistuksesta
- Heidenhain-ohjauksen tuntemus
- Kyky lukea teknisiä piirustuksia ja soveltaa toleransseja tarkasti
- Tarkka ote pintalaatuun ja yksityiskohtiin

Eduksi myös katsotaan

- Aikaisempi kokemus kuparin, messingin tai muiden ei-rautametallien koneistuksesta
- Kokemus pienten tarkkuussarjojen valmistuksesta

title: CMG Team Lead
description:
Job Title: CMG Team Lead

Job Category: Intelligence

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 25%

Type of Travel: Continental US

* * *

The Opportunity

CACI is hiring a China Mission Group (CMG) regional analysis Team Lead to drive high‑quality, China‑focused assessments, analytic leadership, and mission‑aligned expertise across priority CMG tasks. As the CMG Team Lead, you will serve as the senior manager and technical lead for contract personnel delivering finished intelligence on the People’s Republic of China (PRC) and related cross‑regional issues, aligned to DIA standards and program objectives.

Our teams provide insight into political‑military dynamics, PLA force development and modernization, foreign influence activities, economic and technological statecraft, cyber and advanced technology threats, gray‑zone behavior, and other emerging challenges with Indo‑Pacific and global relevance.

In this role, you will lead, coordinate, and oversee focused analytic and operational efforts that inform senior stakeholders across the defense and national security community, ensuring timely, accurate, and high‑quality CMG production that meets DIA tradecraft standards.


Responsibilities

  • Lead, manage, and mentor contractor personnel assigned to your region, ensuring quality, accuracy, and timeliness across all analytic tasks

  • Provide senior‑level regional and functional expertise related to strategic competitors, military and security trends, foreign influence operations, regional alliances, and geopolitical developments

  • Direct the assignment and execution of complex analytic tasks while overseeing quality control for team‑produced products.

  • Oversee multidisciplinary teams performing all‑source research, regional expertise development, open‑source exploitation, knowledge management, technical editing, and product dissemination

  • Serve as the primary contractor interface with government program leads to clarify requirements, resolve issues, and ensure production aligns with regional priorities

  • Support crisis operations, surge requirements, and time‑sensitive analytic needs related to emerging regional developments

  • Ensure team compliance with program‑specific analytic standards, sourcing guidelines, classification protocols, and production requirements

  • Oversee onboarding, readiness, training, and performance management of assigned personnel

  • Support modernization initiatives, database maintenance, and integration of new analytic tools or methodologies as required


Qualification
Required

  • Active TS/SCI security clearance

  • 10+ years of experience in intelligence analysis, regional security issues, strategic competitor analysis, or related mission areas

  • Prior experience serving in a senior analytic, management, or technical lead role within the DoD or national‑security enterprise

  • Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage multidisciplinary analytic teams supporting all‑source production, regional analysis, foreign influence research, OSINT, or similar disciplines

  • Strong understanding of regional dynamics, including military modernization trends, regional alliances, strategic competition, and political‑military issues

  • Ability to coordinate directly with government stakeholders, manage tasking requirements, and ensure timely and accurate analytic production

  • Familiarity with analytic tradecraft standards, sourcing requirements, classification protocols, and production workflows

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience producing or reviewing high‑visibility analytic products

title: Product Owner - Underwriting
description:
MSIG USA continues to grow!

Company Overview:

MSIG USA is the US-based subsidiary of MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings, Inc., one of the world’s top P&C carriers and a global Class 15 insurer, with A+ ratings and a reach that spans 40+ countries and regions. Leveraging our 350-year heritage, MSIG USA brings the financial strength, expertise, and global footprint to offer commercial insurance solutions that address your business’s unique risks.

Summary

The Product Owner serves as the key bridge between Underwriting business teams and Technology, ensuring that underwriting solutions effectively support risk evaluation, submission intake, referral workflows, pricing support, quote/bind processes, and operational efficiency in the Commercial P&C insurance space. This role owns the product vision and roadmap for underwriting capabilities that support multiple underwriting product lines while also driving shared solutions and process improvements across the broader underwriting organization.

This role is expected to be hands-on in solution shaping and delivery, working side by side with cross-functional teams to define workflows, prototype capabilities, refine requirements, and improve how underwriting work gets done. The ideal candidate brings strong product acumen, systems thinking, and first-principles problem solving, with the ability to translate underwriting needs into scalable workflow, platform, data, and integration solutions.

This role also requires comfort applying modern product management principles, including clear prioritization and roadmap sequencing using approaches such as Now / Next / Later, while using modern productivity and AI-enabled tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and similar technologies to accelerate analysis, story writing, process design, and execution.

Essential Functions

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Partner with Product Manager and business leaders in Underwriting, Product Development, Actuarial, Operations, and Technology to define and communicate the underwriting vision, strategy, and roadmap in alignment with business goals and operational priorities.
  • Own underwriting capabilities that support multiple product lines, while identifying opportunities for shared workflows, reusable solutions, and consistent processes across the underwriting organization.
  • Develop and maintain a roadmap covering underwriting capabilities such as submission intake, triage, clearance, referral workflows, appetite and rules support, quote/bind workflow, and integration with core policy, data, and document platforms.
  • Apply systems thinking to understand upstream and downstream impacts across Underwriting, Product, Actuarial, Operations, and Technology when shaping priorities and solution direction.
  • Use underwriting, workflow, and operational analytics to inform decisions, prioritize enhancements, and improve business outcomes.
  • Monitor key product KPIs such as adoption, workflow efficiency, turnaround time, referral cycle time, and user feedback to evaluate product success and guide continuous improvement.
  • Use modern product management principles, like Now / Next / Later planning, to communicate roadmap sequencing, align stakeholders, and focus delivery on the highest-value outcomes.

Backlog Management

  • Own, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog to ensure alignment with underwriting, operational, and organizational priorities.
  • Translate business requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, and solution requirements for underwriting tools and related platforms.
  • Partner closely with architects, engineering, data, and business stakeholders to break down complex underwriting needs into scalable, deliverable increments.
  • Balance quick-win enhancements with foundational improvements such as workflow consistency, data quality, governance, usability, platform performance, and reuse across product lines.
  • Continuously refine backlog priorities based on stakeholder feedback, business outcomes, product usage, dependencies, team capacity, and evolving underwriting needs.
  • Use modern tools and AI-enabled technologies such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and similar technologies to accelerate backlog refinement, requirements drafting, and solution exploration while applying sound judgment and governance

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for underwriting solution needs across multiple product lines and shared underwriting functions.
  • Facilitate workshops and discovery sessions to understand underwriting workflows, pain points, decision-support needs, and opportunities for scalable process improvements.
  • Partner with underwriting leaders, SMEs, operations, analytics, and technology teams to translate business needs into practical, scalable, and effective solutions.
  • Drive shared understanding of business process, technical constraints, dependencies, and implementation tradeoffs across stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with training and change management teams to support adoption, readiness, and rollout of new capabilities.
  • Foster an underwriter-centric mindset, ensuring that enhancements improve usability, consistency, efficiency, and ease of doing business for internal teams and distribution partners.
  • Collaborate across product lines to identify opportunities for shared capabilities, reusable workflows, and enterprise-aligned underwriting solutions.

Sprint Planning and Execution

  • Lead sprint planning and backlog refinement for the underwriting product team, articulating sprint goals, priorities, and expected business value.
  • Ensure user stories are well-defined, refined, and ready for development, with clear acceptance criteria, business context, workflow logic, and test scenarios.
  • Collaborate closely with delivery leads, engineers, analysts, designers, QA, and data teams to deliver high-quality releases.
  • Participate actively in daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to monitor progress, remove blockers, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Validate completed work against acceptance criteria and coordinate user acceptance testing with business stakeholders to ensure solutions meet underwriting needs and quality standards.
  • Work hands-on with the team to shape workflows, refine requirements, prototype ideas, and guide solution decisions using modern collaboration and AI-assisted tools where appropriate.

Qualifications/Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Technical Product Owner, Senior Business Analyst, Product Manager, or similar role.
  • Minimum of 2–3 years of hands-on experience with insurance platforms such as Solartis, Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco, or similar platforms.
  • 2–3 years of experience within E&S insurance, with a focus on underwriting strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience working closely with engineering, architecture, data, and business teams to deliver technology solutions in Agile environments.
  • Experience working within Agile frameworks required.
  • Experience supporting workflow-driven, platform-based, or operational business solutions preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong understanding of commercial P&C insurance and underwriting workflows, including submissions, quoting, binding, renewals, endorsements, referrals, and related operational processes.
  • Strong product acumen, systems thinking, and solution mindset, with the ability to translate underwriting needs into scalable solutions across multiple product lines and shared underwriting functions.
  • Ability to apply first-principles thinking to analyze complex business problems, simplify fragmented processes, and define practical solution paths.
  • Familiarity with modern product management principles and prioritization approaches, including Now / Next / Later planning for roadmap communication and sequencing.
  • Ability to translate business needs into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, workflow requirements, and scalable solution designs.
  • Strong knowledge of Agile product ownership, backlog management, and cross-functional delivery practices.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work directly with delivery teams to shape and implement practical business solutions.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with tools such as Power BI, Power Platform, Copilot, Azure DevOps, and Teams preferred.

40

title: Tarjoilijoita ravintola Fridaan ja viinibaari Finoon
description:
Etsimme ravintola Fridaan ja viinibaari Finoon tarjoilijaa toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen. Työn aloitus sopimuksen mukaan, kuitenkin viimeistään 19.10.2026.

Ravintola Fridan makupaletissa on pohjoismaista vetovoimaa ja moderni ote. Keittiön ytimessä ovat kotimaiset, lähituotetut raaka-aineet. Fridaan voi piipahtaa kahville, lounaalle tai istahtaa kaikessa rauhassa nauttimaan à la carte -illallista Suomen kauneimmassa jokirannassa.

Fuugan katolla sijaitsevassa viinibaari Finossa voi nauttia lasillisen viiniä upeaa maisemaa ihastellen, tai poiketa kahville ihailemaan Aurajoki-näkymää. Finon laaja viinivalikoima on huolella suunniteltu kokonaisuus, jonka rytmi tempaa mukaansa. Laatuviinien lisäksi tarjolla on esimerkiksi erikoiskahveja. Tarjolla tulee olemaan myös pientä suolaista ja makeaa syötävää. Kesällä Fino laajenee kattoterassille ja tulee olemaan Turun upein paikka, jossa viettää vaikka koko päivän!

Tarjoilijana olet tärkeä osa asiakkaidemme elämyksiä. Varmistat omalta osaltasi sujuvan asiakaskokemuksen huolehtimalla tilausten vastaanotosta ja tarjoilusta.

Työ on osa-aikatyötä ja tunteja on keskimäärin 90 tuntia kolmiviikkoisjaksolla. Tehtävässä noudatetaan Matkailu-, ravintola- ja vapaa-ajan palveluita koskevaa työehtosopimusta.

Kulttuurirannan arvot – uudistuva, rohkea, avoin ja yhteisöllinen – ohjaavat toimintaamme arjen vilskeessä ja näiden pohjalta luomme jatkuvasti uusia elämyksiä myös asiakkaillemme niin Turun Kaupunginteatterissa kuin musiikkitalo Fuugassakin. Siksi odotammekin sinulta palveluhenkistä, oma-aloitteista, ystävällistä ja iloista asennetta. Tehtävään valitulla henkilöllä tulee olla voimassa oleva hygieniapassi. Anniskelupassi katsotaan eduksi. Lisäksi edellytämme vähintään kolmen vuoden työkokemusta à la carte -ravintolasta sekä salityöskentelystä, ja hyvää juomatuotteiden, erityisesti viinien, perustuntemusta.

Työsuhde-etuina tarjoamme mm. lakisääteistä laajemman työterveyshuollon, Epassin virkistys- ja työmatkaetuja, henkilökuntahintaisia lippuja omiin tapahtumiimme sekä Auntie-palvelun työntekijöidemme käyttöön. Uskomme, että osaava ja motivoitunut henkilökunta on menestyksemme kivijalka, siksi teemme esimerkiksi henkilökohtaisen kehittymissuunnitelman jokaisen kanssa vuosittain.

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi oheisen hakupainikkeen kautta viimeistään 27.9.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja kutsumme sopivia hakijoita haastatteluihin.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa liiketoimintajohtaja Jutta Elo, jutta.elo@kulttuuriranta.fi [jutta.elo@kulttuuriranta.fi].



Kulttuuri asuu rannassa

Kulttuuriranta on uniikki, kansainvälisesti kiinnostava kulttuurikohde, jonka elämykset toteutamme yhdessä työyhteisönä. Kulttuurirannan toimintaa ohjaavat arvot ovat uudistuva, rohkea, avoin ja yhteisöllinen.

Turun Kaupunginteatteri tuottaa vuosittain 5–10 ensi-iltaa sekä useita vierailunäytäntöjä. Esityksiä on noin 400 vuodessa, musikaaleista stand upiiin ja draamasta komediaan. Teatterin ravintola on paitsi suosittu lounas- ja illallispaikka, myös show and dinner -elämysten näyttämö.

Tutustu teatteriin: https://tkteatteri.fi/tietoa-teatterista/turun-kaupunginteatteri/ [https://tkteatteri.fi/tietoa-teatterista/turun-kaupunginteatteri/]

Turun musiikkitalo Fuuga on koti konserteille ja keikoille, sekä vierailukohde kaikille elämyksennälkäisille. Musiikkitarjonnan lisäksi Fuugan ravintolat palvelevat niin tapahtumakävijöitä kuin jokirannan turisteja.

Tutustu Fuugaan: https://www.musiikkitalofuuga.fi/tutustu-fuugaan/ [https://www.musiikkitalofuuga.fi/tutustu-fuugaan/]

Tervetuloa ottamaan oma paikkasi Kulttuurirannassa.

description:

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. Pekerjaan Anda Membangun Dunia di Caterpillar.

Ketika Anda bergabung dengan Caterpillar, Anda bergabung dengan tim global yang peduli tidak hanya tentang pekerjaan yang kami lakukan – tetapi juga tentang satu sama lain. Kami adalah pembuat, pemecah masalah, dan pembangun dunia masa depan yang menciptakan komunitas yang lebih kuat dan berkelanjutan. Kami tidak hanya berbicara tentang kemajuan dan inovasi di sini – kami mewujudkannya, bersama dengan pelanggan kami, di tempat kami bekerja dan tinggal. Bersama-sama, kami membangun dunia yang lebih baik, sehingga kita semua dapat menikmati hidup di dalamnya.

Saat ini, kami sedang mencari Manufacturing System Operator (Fabrication) untuk bergabung dengan tim Manufacturing Engineering kami di Caterpillar Indonesia Batam.

Sebagai Manufacturing System Operator (Fabrication), Anda bertanggung jawab atas pengelolaan lini produksi, termasuk melakukan analisis terhadap setiap permasalahan yang muncul dan memberikan rekomendasi tindakan korektif, baik sementara maupun permanen. Selain itu, Anda juga bertanggung jawab untuk memastikan seluruh standar keselamatan, kualitas, dan produktivitas terpenuhi di area produksi.

Informasi Tambahan:
Shift: Rotasi
Lokasi Kerja: Batam, Kepulauan Riau
Jenis Pekerjaan: Kontrak 12 bulan
Anda akan bekerja di lingkungan kantor maupun di area produksi. Relokasi domestik tidak tersedia untuk posisi ini.

Sebagai seorang Manufacturing System Operator (Fabrication) Anda akan:

  • Mengelola dan memperbarui semua dokumen proses fabrikasi, seperti SWS (Standard Work Sheet) dan APQP.

  • Menganalisis proses produksi serta produk Caterpillar menggunakan perangkat lunak CAD.

  • Memberikan rekomendasi teknis terkait produksi.

  • Menindaklanjuti hasil dan tindakan dari eCI (Electronic Continuous Improvement) dan AQE (All Quality Event) yang berhubungan langsung dengan lini produksi.

  • Mengelola data Quality Gate terkait produksi untuk mendukung analisis SPC (Statistical Process Control).

  • Kandidat yang berhasil harus memiliki:

  • Minimal memiliki pendidikan Diploma 3 atau setara.

  • Pernah bekerja di lingkungan dengan sistem produksi.

  • Memiliki pengetahuan serta dapat menerapkan prinsip Lean Manufacturing.

  • Mampu menggunakan perangkat lunak CAD seperti CREO, Inventor, atau Solidwork.

  • Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan hubungan interpersonal yang sangat baik.

  • Siap menjalani jam kerja yang fleksibel.


Persyaratan Fisik (Dengan atau Tanpa Akomodasi yang Wajar):
Pekerjaan ini mungkin memerlukan banyak gerakan aktif di seluruh pabrik termasuk naik turun tangga dan anak tangga, mengangkat peralatan, serta mendorong dan menarik peralatan.

Silakan periksa email yang terkait dengan aplikasi Anda secara berkala, termasuk folder sampah/spam, karena ini adalah metode korespondensi utama. Jika Anda ingin mengetahui status aplikasi Anda, silakan gunakan log-in kandidat di situs karir kami untuk mengetahui pembaruan status Anda.

title: GLOBAL RECONCILIATION CONTROLLER - SPECIALIST
description:

Job Purpose\:

To perform all the operational functions related to the Global Reconciliation functions related to branches and Central Operations Departments while ensuring compliance with the established standard operating procedures and Bank’s regulations.

Job Description\:

Transaction Management

1.Match the daily entries for the bank accounts and ensure settlement for the unclear transaction to avoid any potential risks.

2.Provide all accounts owner with accounts proofs as of end of each month to maintain effective control.

3.Ensure obtaining account owner confirmation on the outstanding items and balances within 1 Week from the proof date to maintain effective control through the normal branch channels.

4.Perform manual matching of accounts efficiently to maintain accuracy of data uploaded on the system.

5.Handle the against nature accounts with the concerned party within 1 Week according to finance daily follow up with (justification and related documents).

6.Keep track of any unclear outstanding amount as per each account nature with the relevant Branch / Department to avoid errors.

7.Issue weekly report with the pending unsettled items and received feedback from the concerned party to maintain effective controls.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About Mimecast

The work people build is worth protecting, and it's harder to protect than it used to be. AI agents now move at machine speed with human-level access, and a small slip-up can become a very public one. We disrupt cybercriminal activity before that happens. We think fast, go big, and always demand more of ourselves. We work hard, deliver, and repeat. We grow with real determination and put success well within reach. We push each other to be better and expect to be pushed back, in a community built on respect, where everyone is counted. Work Protected.

The Opportunity

Incydr Product Development is looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to help make sure customers get the full value of Incydr, from initial rollout throughout the entire time they run the product. As Incydr scales globally across more customers and more complex environments, we're investing in a technical role that sits close to the customer: partnering with our proof-of-value engineers, Professional Services team, and customer account teams to help accounts reach full operational health quickly and stay there as their needs evolve. It's a chance to shape a new role at the intersection of engineering and customer success.

This is a hands-on, engineering role that also interacts with customers. You'll be embedded in Incydr Engineering and brought in directly by the teams closest to an account to work on something specific: a technical health check, custom integration work, digging deep into customer problems to find and resolve issues quickly, and even fine-tuning after deployment to make Incydr fit well inside a customer's environment. You'll be part of the engineering team with access to source code, advanced logging, and telemetry to solve problems directly or partner with other SMEs in engineering as needed. Expect some travel to customer sites, though most engagement happens remotely; day to day, you'll follow the hybrid working model for your local Mimecast office.

Mimecast is an AI-First engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI-powered development tools across all facets of engineering, and we're looking for someone genuinely curious about working this way, including using AI to build fast, narrow solutions for individual customer problems rather than defaulting to a big, shared toolkit.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with customer-facing teams, customers, and fellow engineers to quickly diagnose and resolve technical pain points, from deployment hiccups to performance tuning, so customers get the most out of Incydr.

  • Take full ownership of each engagement, from first diagnosis to resolution, working directly with customers along the way, while account teams continue to own the broader relationship.

  • Get full access to the Incydr codebase and deployment tooling, so you can dig into how something actually works yourself and ship a fix through our normal review process when you're the right person to do it.

  • Build and troubleshoot custom scripts and integrations tailored to each customer's environment, using AI tools to move fast rather than reaching for a one-size-fits-all script library.

  • Partner with Incydr Engineering on issues that need deeper product involvement, arriving with enough detail, like repro steps and a root-cause hypothesis, that they can act on it immediately.

  • Spot early signals, like an account building up untriaged alert volume, and flag them proactively so customer-facing teams can get ahead of a problem before it grows.

  • Coach and enable a customer's own team, through training, documentation, and hands-on pairing, so they can confidently run and maintain Incydr themselves.

  • Bring what you learn back to the rest of product and engineering, so patterns you spot across customers directly shape the roadmap instead of being solved once and forgotten.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years building software, including practical experience troubleshooting or supporting that software directly with customers or in live production environments.

  • Enough depth across a broad codebase to work independently: comfortable reading and navigating code you didn't write, diagnosing an issue, and contributing a fix through normal review when needed, without waiting on someone else to do the digging.

  • Practical scripting and integration experience: building narrow, purpose-built solutions to a specific technical problem quickly, including using AI coding tools to move faster than writing everything by hand.

  • Genuine comfort owning a technical conversation directly with a customer: running a working session on a live issue, walking a customer through troubleshooting together over a video call. This is a role that will directly interact with customers and with a variety of internal stakeholders.

  • Comfort troubleshooting with incomplete information: you're the person who figures out why something is broken in someone else's environment, even when the information is incomplete and a customer's waiting on an answer.

  • Strong written and verbal communication: translating a technical root cause into something a non-engineer can act on, and a customer's vague description of a problem into something engineering can act on.

  • Comfort working daily with AI coding assistants and agents, and interest in building the kind of lightweight AI-driven tools and playbooks that let customers and internal teams solve problems themselves.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with endpoint agent technology, device management (MDM), or the operational realities of deploying software across large, varied fleets.

  • Experience with identity/directory sync (for example, SCIM) or enterprise single sign-on integrations.

  • Experience building internal tools, playbooks, or automations that non-engineering teams can run themselves.

  • Background in a customer-facing technical role: professional services, solutions engineering, technical account management, support or similar.

  • Exposure to data security, data loss prevention, or insider risk concepts.

The base salary range for this position is $140k−$170k plus benefits. This range represents the minimum and maximum new hire compensation for this role. The position may also be eligible for incentive plans and additional benefits, in accordance with company policy and local regulations. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location with individual compensation also dependent on factors such as qualifications, experience, and skills. Final offers will reflect these considerations and may vary accordingly.

Belonging at Mimecast

Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.

We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application.

Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.

description:
Job Title: C-UAS Planner

Job Category: Intelligence

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 25%

Type of Travel: Local

* * *


The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking a C-UAS (Counter-Unmanned Aerial Systems) Planner within the United States Central Command (USCENTCOM) J38 (Operations Directorate, CCJ38 Integrated Air and Missile Defense & C-UAS Division) that focuses on developing and coordinating strategies and conducting operations to counter threats posed by unmanned aerial systems in the USCENTCOM AOR.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and refine planning materials at the Combatant Command level to support ongoing operations within the CCJ38 C-UAS Branch.
  • Rapidly develop CONOPS for complex C-UAS tasks, ensuring operational utility and alignment with USCENTCOM objectives.
  • Prepare concise talking points for senior-level meetings to articulate C-UAS strategies and priorities.
  • Coordinate with partner nations, joint forces, and interagency stakeholders to synchronize C-UAS efforts across the enterprise.
  • Respond to complex requests for information from general officers with polished, analytical, and actionable narrative insights.
  • Attend meetings with the Joint Staff, Components, and Program Offices to ensure C-UAS tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) are effective in theater, contributing in alignment with CCJ38 and USCENTCOM intent.
  • Provide real-time, analytics-driven planning recommendations to commanders during operations to counter UAS threats to bases, dismounted forces, or critical infrastructure.
  • Analyze after-action reports from C-UAS incidents and engagements to enhance effectiveness and adapt to evolving threats.
  • Maintain an updated Partner Nation Laydown (PowerPoint & Maven), advising leaders on integration challenges, opportunities, and joint posture enhancements.
  • If requested, advise Services on acquisition and R&D strategies to ensure USCENTCOM maintains technological superiority against UAS threats.
  • Support Crisis Action Team (CAT) shifts in the Joint Operations Center (JOC) and Focus Point Operations Center (FPOC) as required.
  • Contribute to emergency action OPTs, working groups, planning meetings, and GO/FO-level briefings.
  • Participate in select C-UAS demonstrations, training programs, and joint exercises (1-4 annually) to bolster enterprise awareness and readiness of USCENTCOM forces and partner nations.


Qualifications:

Required:

  • Active TS/SCI clearance
  • BA/BS or AA degree with 6 years of relevant experience, or HS/GED with 10+ years of relevant experience
  • Prior Combatant Command experience in military planning, C-UAS operations, or force protection, preferably in a joint or combatant command environment.
  • Familiarity with USCENTCOM’s AOR, including its cultural, geopolitical, and operational dynamics.
  • Practical knowledge of C-UAS technologies and operational staff tools (e.g., Microsoft Suite, Maven, C2IE).
  • Demonstrated experience in joint operations or interagency coordination.
  • Strong written, analytical, and problem-solving skills to concentrate complex situations into actionable and easily understood plans.
  • Excellent communication skills for briefing senior leaders and collaborating with diverse stakeholders across the C-UAS enterprise.
  • Proficiency in operational planning frameworks, such as the Joint Planning Process (JPP) or Military Decision-Making Process (MDMP).
  • Ability to perform effectively in high-pressure, dynamic environments.

-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.


Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

$78,000 - $163,800
