title: Cybersecurity Engineer II
location: Banner Health Corp Phoenix (2901 N Central Ave)
description:
Primary City/State:

Phoenix, Arizona

Department Name:

IT Data Protection-Corp

Work Shift:

Day

Job Category:

Information Technology

Health care is constantly changing, and at Banner Health, we are at the front of that change. We are leading health care to make the experience the best it can be. We want to change the lives of those in our care – and the people who choose to take on this challenge. If changing health care for the better sounds like something you want to be part of, we want to hear from you.

The ideal candidate will have familiarity and/or experience as a cybersecurity engineer that includes but is not limited to technology research, testing, & implementation, development of enterprise communications, patching, runbook documentation, scripting & automation, and metrics development. We have a solid engineering team, and a collaborative and efficient team culture. We’re looking for a candidate with a high technical ceiling who can be an immediate team fit. Candidates should be capable of quickly learning and making a difference with one or more of the following technologies: Endpoint Protection, Email Protection, Cloud Protection and Data Protection.

This is a 100% remote opportunity with Banner Health’s Data Protection Engineering team. Standard hours are 8am – 5pm (1 hour for lunch) Monday through Friday AZ time. In this role you would work Monday through Friday normal business hours 8am - 5pm AZ time zone and can be a remote position if you live in the following states only: AL, AK, AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, ND, NE, NH, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV & WY. NO other states will be considered.

Your pay and benefits (Total Rewards) are important components of your Journey at Banner Health. Banner Health offers a variety of benefit plans to help you and your family. We provide health and financial security options, so you can focus on being the best at what you do and enjoying your life.

Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY
This position designs, develops, configures, implements, tunes, maintains solutions, resolve technical and business issues related to cybersecurity threat & vulnerability management, identity management, security operations center, forensics, and data protection. Cybersecurity Engineers work with Cybersecurity Architects to execute strategic cyber initiatives, evaluate security components of the network, applications and end-user devices, and provides guidance to ensure new systems meet regulatory and technical standards. Cybersecurity Engineers participate in root-cause analysis efforts to determine improvement opportunities when failures occur. Manage Cyber systems, ensures they are tuned, on the current release and manages appropriate change management across the IT organization and the business.

CORE FUNCTIONS
1. Leads in the design and implementation of cybersecurity solutions.

2. Leads in providing technical expertise and support for cybersecurity solutions, including operational aspects of the software, hardware, network/firewall.

3. Leads in the design, implementation, and compliance of secure configurations for applications and infrastructure components.

4. Leads in technical assessments of systems and applications to ensure compliance with policy, standards and regulations.

5. Leads in the ongoing evaluation and development of security policies and procedures. Leads the revision of policies and procedures, as needed.

6. Serves as technical lead of cybersecurity projects, including the development of project scope requirements, cybersecurity product implementation, tuning, operational support model creation.

7. Under general direction, this position is responsible for cybersecurity across multiple departments system-wide and requires interaction at all levels of staff and management. Work closely on cross functional IT Teams.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Must possess strong knowledge of business, information security and/or computer science as normally obtained through the completion of a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Systems, or related field.

Four to six years of experience of enterprise-scale information security engineering, preferably in healthcare. Must also possess one to three years’ experience in a healthcare environment or an equivalent combination of relevant education, technical, business and healthcare experience. Experience, IT operations, automation of cybersecurity processes, coding and scripting languages, ability to document cybersecurity processes as well as use case development. Experience with the assessing cyber products, including vendor selection, define requirements, contractual documentation development. Experienced in planning, designing and implementing cybersecurity solutions. Experienced in operating, maintaining and implementing, upgrading and lifecycle of cybersecurity solutions. Proficient understanding of regulatory and compliance mandates, including but not limited to HIPAA, HITECH, PCI, Sarbanes-Oxley. Advanced knowledge of Security Engineering Principles, including risk management, resilience, vulnerability management, Information Security, NIST, MITRE ATT@CK, etc. Expertise in Cyber products supporting Data Loss Prevention, EDR, AntiVirus, Perimeter services, Threat systems, cyber platform analytics, SIEM, CASB, CLOUD Security, ETC. Requires independent judgment, critical decision making, excellent analytical skills, with excellent verbal and written communications. Ability to think quickly under difficult or complex conditions and clearly communicate to appropriate staff; ability to balance project workloads with customer support and on-call demands. Must demonstrate knowledge of information technology and information security principles and practices. Requires communication and presentation skills to engage technical and non-technical audiences. Requires ability to communicate and interact across facilities and at various levels. Incumbent will have skills to mentor less experienced team members. As is typical in this industry, variable shifts and hours and responding to after-hours notifications may be required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


Certification in two or more of the following areas: Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP), HealthCare Information Security & Privacy Practitioner, (HCISPP), CompTIA Security+, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) – Engineering (ISSEP), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), SANS GIAC, or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA). Three plus years as a System Administrator, Security Operations or in IT Operations. Or three plus years in risk management or GRC experience in the healthcare/medical environment. Must also possess three plus years’ experience in a healthcare environment or an equivalent combination of relevant education, technical, business and healthcare experience.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

title: Järjestelmäasiantuntija, tietoturva
description:
Työsopimuksen tyyppi: vakituinen

Sijainti: Malminkaari 21, 00701 Helsinki

Hakuaika päättyy: 1.10.2026

Haluatko kehittää tietoturvaa käytännönläheisesti ja päästä vaikuttamaan siihen, miten Granlundin IT-ympäristöä rakennetaan entistäkin turvallisemmaksi?

Mitä tulet tekemään?

Tietoturva-asiantuntijana liityt osaksi Granlundin pientä IT-tiimiä, jonka vastuulla ovat tietoturva, tietoliikenne ja konesalipalvelut. Roolisi painottuu tietoturvan tekniseen ylläpitoon ja jatkuvaan kehittämiseen: seuraat ympäristön turvallisuutta, hallitset haavoittuvuuksia ja viet tunnistettuja kehityskohteita käytäntöön.

Keskeinen osa työtäsi on haavoittuvuuksien hallinnan ja korjaamisen kehittäminen nykyistä järjestelmällisemmäksi ja ennakoivammaksi. Osallistut myös tietoturvapoikkeamien käsittelyyn ulkoisen 24/7-valvontapalvelun havaintojen pohjalta sekä kehität prosesseja, dokumentaatiota ja toimintatapoja muun muassa ISO 27001 -vaatimukset huomioiden.

Tietoturvan lisäksi työskentelet hands-on myös Granlundin Windows-palvelinympäristön parissa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu esimerkiksi palvelinten ja SQL Server -ympäristön ylläpitoa sekä yrityskauppoihin liittyvien datamigraatioiden tietoturvan varmistamista. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä muun muassa konesali-, verkko- ja palomuuripalveluita tarjoavien ulkoisten kumppaneiden kanssa.

Millaista osaajaa etsimme?

Saatat olla etsimämme osaaja, jos olet työskennellyt esimerkiksi järjestelmä-, infrastruktuuri- tai tietoturva-asiantuntijana ja tietoturvasta on muodostunut vahva osa osaamistasi. Muutaman vuoden relevantti työkokemus voi antaa tehtävään hyvän pohjan, jos sinulla on jo käytännön kokemusta Windows-palvelinympäristöistä ja teknisestä tietoturvasta.

Viihdyt tehtävässä, jos haluat tehdä asioita käytännössä, mutta myös kehittää niitä pidemmällä tähtäimellä. Pienessä tiimissä vastuualueesi on laaja, joten arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta, paineensietokykyä ja kykyä tehdä yhteistyötä niin teknisten kumppaneiden kuin loppukäyttäjienkin kanssa.

Hakijalta odotamme:

  • Aiempaa relevanttia kokemusta esimerkiksi järjestelmä-, infrastruktuuri- tai tietoturva-asiantuntijan tehtävistä, ideaalitilanteessa jo ainakin muutaman vuoden ajalta

  • Vahvaa käytännön osaamista Windows-palvelinympäristöistä sekä kokemusta Azuresta, Microsoft 365:stä, Active Directorysta ja Entra ID:stä

  • Kokemusta Microsoftin tietoturvaratkaisuista, erityisesti Defenderistä, Purviewista ja intunesta sekä haavoittuvuuksien hallinnasta

  • Ymmärrystä ISO 27001 -viitekehyksestä ja tietoturvaan liittyvästä dokumentoinnista

  • Hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja englanniksi ja suomeksi

Lisäksi katsomme eduksi:

  • Kokemuksen esimerkiksi Tenablesta, Group Policysta, Config Managerista, tai Windows Firewallista

  • Katakrin sekä NIST-, Julkri- tai Pitukri-viitekehysten tuntemuksen

  • Ymmärryksen palomuureista ja verkkotietoturvasta

  • Ymmärryksen turvallisesta ohjelmistokehityksestä, CI/CD-pipelineista tai integraatioiden tietoturvasta

Mitä Granlund tarjoaa sinulle?

  • Laajan vastuualueen, jossa pääset sekä tekemään teknistä tietoturvatyötä että kehittämään Granlundin toimintatapoja pitkäjänteisesti.

  • Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa aidosti, sillä pienessä tiimissä pääset viemään omia kehitysideoitasi käytäntöön ja sinulla on mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan rooliisi.

  • Hyvät kasvu- ja kehitysmahdollisuudet: Granlundilla jokaisen työntekijän ammatilliseen kasvuun ja kehitykseen panostetaan ja pääsetkin laajentamaan osaamistasi mm. monipuolisen koulutustarjonnan, monipuolisten työtehtävien ja kollegoidesi asiantuntemuksen avulla.

  • Hyvähenkisen työyhteisön, jossa henkilöstö viihtyy pitkään ja työkavereita autetaan.

  • Kilpailukykyiset henkilöstöedut, kuten liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun, henkilöstön virkistysmatkoja sekä kattavan työterveyshuollon. Voit tutustua Granlundin kattaviin etuihin tarkemmin täällä.

  • Kokemukseesi ja osaamiseesi pohjautuvan kuukausipalkan sekä tulospalkkiojärjestelmän.

Käytännön asiat:

Tehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen ja työllistyt suoraan Granlundin palvelukseen. Työpisteesi sijaitsee Helsingin Malmilla. Granlundilla töitä tehdään joustavasti toimistolla ja etänä, ja toivomme, että pääset työskentelemään Malmin toimistolla silloin tällöin tehtävien ja yhteistyön tarpeiden mukaan. Aloitusajankohta sovitaan joustavasti valittavan henkilön tilanteen mukaan.

Rekrytointiprosessi:

  • Etähaastattelut aTalentin kanssa

  • Haastattelut paikan päällä Granlundin kanssa

Kiinnostuitko? Hienoa!

Lähetä ansioluettelosi sekä motivaatiokirjeesi PDF-muodossa viimeistään 1.10. aTalentin hakujärjestelmän kautta osoitteessa: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/383112/create/.

Huomioithan, että käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuajalla niiden tulojärjestyksessä. Emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse, vaan käsittelemme ainoastaan hakujärjestelmän kautta saapuneet hakemukset. Haluamme varmistaa, että kaikki hakijat voivat osallistua prosessiin tasavertaisesti ja huomioimme tarvittaessa yksilölliset esteettömyystarpeet.

Granlundista voit lukea lisää osoitteessa: https://www.granlund.fi/. Tehtävää ja hakuprosessia koskeviin kysymyksiin vastaa aTalentin Managing Recruitment Consultant Sofia Latva-Koivisto (+358 50 321 4473, sofia.latva-koivisto(at)atalent.fi). Jos en pääse heti vastaamaan puhelimeen, jätäthän perään tekstiviestin niin soitan sinulle takaisin.

title: Dotnet Full stack developer (Angular JS)
description:
Job Summary

Serve as a senior software engineer in a hybrid work model designing and delivering scalable web applications using net technologies Azure cloud services Angular TypeScript and modern JavaScript frameworks. Apply agile and scrum practices to build secure high quality solutions that support consumer lending and other enterprise business functions while improving customer experience and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop complex net based web applications using c sharp entity framework and rest api principles to deliver secure and scalable solutions for enterprise business needs.
  • Implement rich client side functionality using angular ten plus typescript javascript html css three point zero and bootstrap to create accessible and responsive user interfaces that comply with w three c web standards.
  • Collaborate with product owners business analysts and cross functional engineering teams in an agile and scrum environment to refine user stories estimate effort and plan iterative deliveries that align with business priorities.
  • Optimize application performance and reliability by profiling code tuning t sql queries and improving entity framework data access patterns to ensure efficient use of database and cloud resources.
  • Integrate azure services such as app services storage and monitoring tools into net applications to enhance scalability observability and maintainability across hybrid deployment environments.
  • Apply secure coding practices and web standards compliance in all front end and back end components to reduce defects improve accessibility and support inclusive digital experiences for diverse customer groups.
  • Conduct thorough code reviews and unit testing using industry standard frameworks to validate functionality maintain coding best practices and support continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines.
  • Work closely with quality engineering and operations teams to troubleshoot production issues analyze root causes and implement robust fixes that strengthen system stability and user trust.
  • Document technical designs api contracts and implementation details in a clear and structured manner so that other engineers can easily understand maintain and extend the solution.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of agile processes by suggesting enhancements to sprint planning backlog grooming and review activities that increase delivery predictability and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Participate in feature grooming sessions for consumer lending and related domains by translating functional needs into clear technical approaches that improve decision accuracy and customer transparency.
  • Align daily engineering activities with the organization purpose of delivering responsible and efficient financial services by building software that supports fair lending practices and simplifies digital interactions.
  • Provide technical guidance to peers on angular patterns net framework usage and azure integration options so that the broader team can adopt consistent approaches and reduce rework across projects.

title: Manager, Software Embedded Engineering
description:
NVIDIA is looking for a creative SW engineer manager to join the team. The incredible growth of AI factories represents the greatest change the world of networking has seen. Spectrum-X is NVIDIA's end-to-end Ethernet Networking solution designed to meet this new challenge with customers including the biggest and fastest-moving organizations in the world. We need a software engineering manager with strong people, customer-facing, and technical skills to join our Spectrum-X engineering team and help make this technology a success.

What you'll be doing:

  • Building and managing a team of US-based software engineers developing NVIDIA's networking products.

  • Debugging and diagnosing complex networking problems, and crafting the tools/processes to do it better.

  • Engaging directly with NVIDIA customers to ensure we are aligned on their networking requirements and solve their problems.

  • Working with a worldwide team of engineers, architects, product managers, and field personnel.

What we need to see:

  • B.A./B.Sc. in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

  • 8+ overall years of experience developing embedded networking software (e.g. switches, routers, NICs)

  • 3+ years of experience as a personnel manager leading software teams.

  • Strong programming skills in C and Python on Linux.

  • Leadership in AI-native software development.

  • Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail, particularly in identifying and resolving networking issues.

  • Good English communication and interpersonal skills.

  • A track-record of autonomous and successful delivery under challenging conditions.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience of data center network engineering spanning servers, NICs, cabling and switches.

  • Strong understanding of ethernet networking, from switch pipelines (e.g. ACLs, forwarding rules) through networking protocols (like TCP/IP and BGP/EVPN-VxLAN) to network operating systems and their automation.

  • Experience of NVIDIA networking technology such as Bluefield/ConnectX NICs, Spectrum switches, and the Cumulus Linux and SONiC operating systems.

  • Experience recruiting teams of software engineers.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking individuals in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 3, and 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Metsähallituksen asianhallintatiimi kartoittaa ja järjestää aineistoa keskusarkistossaan sekä vastaanottaa aineistoja muuttavista maakuntatoimistoista ja luontokeskuksista. Tässä tehtävässä pääset avustamaan Metsähallituksen asianhallintatiimiä arkistointiprojektissa loka-joulukuun ajan.

Työn kuvaus

Työskentelet Metsähallituksen keskusarkistolla Tikkurilan Neilikkatiellä. Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa:

- arkistoaineiston kotelointia

- aineiston hyllyttämistä ja järjestelyä annettujen ohjeiden mukaan

- kuormien purkua

- materiaalien siirtelyä ja kuljettamista arkiston tiloissa

- muita mahdollisia arkistointiprojektiin liittyviä avustavia tehtäviä

Aiempi kokemus arkistotyöstä tai vastaavasta katsotaan eduksi, mutta ei ole välttämätöntä.

title: Manufacturing Technician III - Sterile Filling
description:
A career at Resilience is more than just a job – it’s an opportunity to change the future.

Resilience is a technology-focused biomanufacturing company that’s changing the way medicine is made. We’re building a sustainable network of high-tech, end-to-end manufacturing solutions to better withstand disruptive events, serve scientific discovery, and reach those in need.

For more information, please visit

The Manufacturing Technician III reports to a Supervisor/Manager on the Manufacturing floor, supporting Filling (Sterile) operations. This position requires working in Controlled/Non-Classified and Classified areas. The Technician independently operates filling equipment, demonstrates advanced aseptic technique, performs in-process monitoring, and mentors Tech II team members.

Job Responsibilities

Operations

  • Independently perform the duties of operating all assigned machinery: servicing filling machines with materials, removing finished materials from machine tables, and assuring smooth product flow.

  • Assemble, disassemble, operate, and sanitize various Filling equipment.

  • Perform and execute filter integrity testing as needed per SOP.

  • Start-up equipment and make minor adjustments as needed.

  • Enter data online as required, including SCADA and HMI entries.

  • Work with various printing devices, including printing mats.

  • Perform cleaning and housekeeping activities for assigned areas as required to maintain a cGMP environment.

  • Perform visual and physical checks of in-process and finished materials as requested.

  • Demonstrate advanced aseptic technique; lead and participate in media fills, including line interventions; apply working knowledge of viable and non-viable environmental monitoring.

  • Assist mechanical staff with preventive maintenance procedures, as required.

  • Assist with executing Validation/Engineering protocols for processes and equipment.

  • Support lean activities and process improvement work, such as performing 5S and participating in problem-solving.

  • Perform SAP transactions as required at an intermediate level of knowledge.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Complete batch record and GMP documentation entries; independently review own documentation for accuracy before submission.

  • Identify and provide suggestions for process improvement while maintaining quality and cGMP compliance.

Training & Development

  • Act as a certified OJT trainer on assigned equipment and process tasks; train and evaluate Tech II team members.

  • Maintain all required certifications and qualifications for the assigned work area.

  • Cross-train and support other work areas as needed.

  • Attend and actively participate in daily tier meetings.

Experience & Education

Minimum Qualifications

  • Progressive experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or cGMP-regulated manufacturing environment, including independent execution of filling procedures.

  • Strong working knowledge of cGMP regulations, including deviation reporting, change control, and data integrity principles.

  • Proven ability to independently execute complex procedures and troubleshoot routine process or equipment issues.

  • Ability to effectively read, write, speak, and understand English to interpret technical documents and clearly communicate cross-functionally.

  • High level of attention to detail with demonstrated accuracy in completing and reviewing batch records and controlled documentation.

  • Proficient mathematical and analytical skills, including performing calculations related to manufacturing processes and verifying results.

  • Experience mentoring or training technicians and supporting onboarding of new team members.

  • Ability to identify process improvements and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize tasks while maintaining compliance and production timelines.

  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team in a fast-paced production environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • High school graduate, vocational school graduate, or equivalent.

  • 2+ years of experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or cGMP-regulated manufacturing environment.

  • Prior aseptic manufacturing experience.

  • Experience working in a lean manufacturing environment.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft applications, SAP and/or Veeva Vault.

Physical & Work Environment

  • Work is performed in Controlled/Non-Classified and Classified (cleanroom) production areas requiring aseptic gowning. This is primarily a non-Sedentary role that can include climbing, kneeling, standing, repetitive motion, temperature changes, exerting up to 100 pounds of force to move objects, and potential exposure to area chemicals requiring handling precautions per SOP.

  • Visual acuity such as working with data & figures, viewing computer terminal, extensive reading, operating machinery, operating motor vehicles, general observations of facilities, etc.

  • Participation in an occupational health program, which can include medical assessment, surveillance, vaccination, and testing.

  • Use of personal protective equipment, which can include respirators, Personal Air Purifying Respirators [PAPR], gowns, gloves, face protection, other barrier equipment, etc.

  • All employees are expected to adhere to the Quality Management System established in the Quality Manual, Quality Policy, Standard Operating Procedures, Current Good Manufacturing Practices, and any other applicable regulations and standards to the duties within their role. ​

  • Ability to pass eye exam during onboarding.

Work Schedule

The Company reserves the right to modify work schedules at any time, including a request to work overtime, with or without notice, based on business needs, operational requirements, or other considerations. Nothing in this description creates a guarantee of specific hours, days, or shift assignments.

title: VP, Investment Allocations
description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at . Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

Job Summary and Business Unit Overview

Blackstone Credit & Insurance (BXCI) was created in September 2023 by combining Blackstone's Credit and Insurance businesses. BXCI offers a broad range of solutions across corporate and asset-based credit, including investment-grade and non-investment-grade private credit. BXCI invests across the credit markets and manages strategies focused on sectors with strong fundamentals.

We are seeking a highly motivated Vice President to lead the Investment Allocations team within BXCI. The role will oversee the Bengaluru Center of Excellence (CoE) team and partner closely with global Investment Allocations stakeholders. The Vice President will be responsible for allocation governance, operational execution, controls, data quality, team leadership, and strategic transformation. The role requires sound judgment, strong execution discipline, and the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders across Investments, Capital Formation, Insurance, Finance, Operations, Technology, Legal and Compliance, and Data teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the Bengaluru Investment Allocations CoE and establish clear objectives, service standards, capacity plans, and accountability across the team.

  • Partner with global colleagues to run hypothetical allocation scenarios (hypos), evaluate allocation outcomes, and support the timely and accurate finalization of allocations across asset classes, funds, and client mandates.

  • Oversee the end-to-end allocation process, including data intake, eligibility validation, constraint monitoring, exception management, approvals, booking support, and post-allocation review.

  • Ensure allocations are executed in accordance with approved policies, investment guidelines, client and fund restrictions, conflicts protocols, and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Establish and maintain robust governance, including maker-checker controls, documented approvals, audit trails, escalation protocols, and periodic control attestations.

  • Define, monitor, and report key risk indicators (KRIs), key performance indicators (KPIs), service-level metrics, and operational trends; drive timely remediation of identified issues.

  • Perform and oversee periodic allocation surveillance, portfolio reviews, and management reporting for relevant business and client stakeholders.

  • Drive consistent data quality and reconcile allocation inputs and outputs across source systems, models, and downstream records; ensure exceptions are investigated and resolved promptly.

  • Act as the senior point of contact across business, Technology, Finance, Operations, Data, Legal and Compliance, Capital Formation, and Insurance teams globally.

  • Lead strategic initiatives focused on modernization, workflow digitization, automation, standardization, and operational scalability.

  • Assess change impacts, define business requirements, coordinate user acceptance testing, and ensure effective implementation and post-go-live stabilization of new processes and systems.

  • Create effective handover and follow-the-sun operating models between regional teams, supported by clear procedures, business continuity plans, and cross-training.

  • Build, coach, and retain a high-performing team through structured development plans, timely feedback, succession planning, and an inclusive culture of ownership and continuous improvement.

  • Prepare concise, executive-level updates on performance, capacity, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and strategic outcomes.

  • Respond to ad hoc requests from Investment, Capital Formation, Insurance, and other stakeholders, providing accurate and timely analysis.

  • Support internal and external audits, regulatory inquiries, and risk or compliance reviews by maintaining complete and readily retrievable evidence.

Required Skills and Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of investment allocation processes, portfolio management operations, private credit, fund structures, and investment guideline monitoring.

  • Demonstrated people leadership experience, including managing managers or senior individual contributors in a global or CoE operating model.

  • Strong control mindset with experience in operational risk, governance, issue management, root-cause analysis, and remediation.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data, identify patterns, and make sound decisions under time pressure.

  • Ability to understand the broader business context while maintaining close attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders and communicate complex matters succinctly.

  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities, multiple projects, and demanding deadlines with limited guidance.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work seamlessly across functions and geographical locations.

  • Experience driving process optimization, automation, technology implementation, and data-driven decision-making.

  • High standards of integrity, accountability, professional judgment, and commitment to excellence.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly advanced Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with data visualization, workflow, or analytics tools is preferred.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline. A Chartered Accountant qualification, CFA, CPA, or MBA in Finance is preferred.

  • 10 + years of relevant experience in investment management, private credit, asset management operations, a Big Four firm, or a global financial services organization.

  • Prior experience in investment allocations, portfolio operations, guideline monitoring, or a related investment control function is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of direct lending, private credit, insurance mandates, and multi-fund allocation frameworks is advantageous.

  • Experience leading a distributed team and partnering with stakeholders in North America or other global locations is preferred.

title: Child Life Services Coordinator- Child Life
description:
A Brief Overview
The Child Life Services Coordinator serves as a key member of the Child Life Services leadership team, functioning at an advanced level of professional practice, with leadership competencies that extend beyond direct clinical care to include programmatic oversight, strategic initiative leadership, and systems‑level influence in accordance with ACLP Administration and Professional Responsibility standards. The Child Life Services Coordinator supports department operations and initiatives while advancing the mission, vision, and values of Tampa General Hospital.



What you will do

  • Provides advanced leadership in child life practice through expert consultation, clinical reasoning, and systems‑level application of child life theory to support consistent, high‑quality psychosocial care across service areas. Applies expert clinical judgment to complex clinical scenarios, including adult, bereavement, and cross‑continuum consults, ensuring care delivery aligns with ACLP standards and institutional clinical practice guidelines.
  • Leads the development, evaluation, and refinement of child life programs, services, and practice guidelines to advance the scope, effectiveness, and sustainability of psychosocial care. Partners with interdisciplinary stakeholders to identify service gaps, guide program expansion, and align child life initiatives with hospital strategic goals and evidence‑based standards.
  • Leads departmental committees, workgroups, and strategic initiatives with responsibility for translating organizational priorities into actionable and measurable improvements in child life practice, operations, and outcomes. Ensures initiatives are informed by data, aligned with professional standards, and evaluated for impact at the department level.
  • Provides ongoing professional mentorship and leadership to Child Life team members by supporting professional development, clinical growth, project leadership, and emerging leadership skills. Serves as a role model for advanced practice, professionalism, and values‑based leadership, promoting a culture of learning, engagement, and continuous improvement.
  • Applies systems thinking and data‑informed leadership to support quality improvement initiatives, patient and family experience efforts, and evaluation of psychosocial care outcomes, using metrics and performance trends to inform improvement and regulatory readiness.
  • Provides advanced operational leadership for Child Life Services by coordinating daily service coverage, prioritization of referrals, and workflow across units to ensure equitable, efficient, and high‑quality psychosocial care delivery. Integrates operational decision‑making with strategic priorities, practice standards, and quality outcomes while supporting staff effectiveness without direct managerial authority.
  • Represents child life services at the departmental and organizational level, modeling professional responsibility, ethical practice, and alignment with ACLP standards, hospital policies, and the mission, vision, and values of Tampa General Hospital. Contributes subject‑matter expertise to interdisciplinary discussions, committees, and planning efforts impacting pediatric and family‑centered care.
  • Provides advanced clinical supervision for Child Life team members by supporting complex clinical decision‑making, ethical deliberation, conflict resolution, and problem‑solving. Ensures practice accountability, consistency with ACLP standards, and adherence to departmental expectations while fostering reflective practice and psychological safety.
  • Supports long‑term sustainability of Child Life Services by strengthening professional development pathways, mentoring emerging leaders, and contributing to succession readiness for critical roles and program functions.
  • Provides leadership and oversight of specialized programs (e.g., Pediatric Facility Dog Program), ensuring appropriate clinical use, staff training and support, program evaluation, and responsible resource utilization. Ensures program alignment with organizational priorities, safety standards, donor intent, and evidence‑informed practice.
  • Leads and oversees workforce pipeline initiatives including student internships, volunteer programs, visiting learners, new staff orientation, and hiring support processes, ensuring compliance with ACLP standards and readiness for safe clinical practice.
  • Leads the implementation of new or revised child life practices, workflows, and standards, guiding change management efforts to ensure consistent adoption, staff readiness, and sustained practice transformation across the department.
  • Partners with hospital foundation, marketing, and communications teams to coordinate donor engagement, tours, media opportunities, and external representation of Child Life Services. Serves as a trusted liaison ensuring alignment between clinical programs, donor intent, and organizational messaging.
  • Demonstrates the ability to identify clinical, operational, and reputational risks related to child life practice and program delivery and proactively supports mitigation strategies in alignment with institutional policy and ACLP ethical standards.
  • Serves as a liaison between Child Life staff, leadership, and interdisciplinary teams, and represents Child Life Services in shared governance, hospital committees, best‑practice forums, and external engagement efforts.
  • Models integrity, accountability, and emotional intelligence while fostering psychological safety, trust, and respect across the Child Life team and interdisciplinary partners.
  • Performs all duties in alignment with Tampa General Hospital’s mission, vision, and Core Values, and embodies AKTiVe leadership principles (Authentic, Kind, Transparent, Vulnerable) in all professional interactions, decision‑making, and leadership behaviors.

The Opportunity:

CACI’s EITaaS Program is a Department of the Air Force (DAF) initiative, which includes the Air Force and Space Force. EITaaS will transform the Dept. of the Air Force IT services from an in-house, base-centric delivery model to an advanced enterprise service delivery model. CACI will provide an enhanced IT management system, IT storefront, enterprise help desk, local field services, and life cycle support for end-user devices.

CACI’s innovative approach to enterprise technology infuses contemporary technologies with industry best practices to deliver commercial-style services that will improve customer experience and productivity for the Dept. of the Air Force’s global workforce. CACI and its partners will equip Airmen and Guardians with state-of-the-art services and automated capabilities that enable access to the tools they need to perform their mission efficiently and effectively when they need it, where they need it.

Responsibilities:

The Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) and Mobility Administrator will serve on the Mobility and Remote Access Services (MRAS) team to support the DAF in operating, sustaining, and improving enterprise Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) and mobility capabilities. The administrator will support the delivery of secure remote access and virtual desktop services, including Azure Virtual Desktop and Microsoft Intune, for the EITaaS program, and users across 187 bases.

Working with the Team Lead and engineering teams, the AVD and Mobility Administrator will also support the transition of new capabilities from engineering into operations, including operational hand-off and post-deployment monitoring.

  • Ability to execute documented detailed technical processes.
  • Good Windows Operating System problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Experience with Azure compute and storage resources.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and clients.
  • Exhibits strong customer service skills and can effectively communicate with end-users to understand and address their technical concerns.
  • Displays a willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.

Desired:

  • Experience supporting Windows computers and users in an enterprise environment.

  • Experience with STIG Windows security controls.
  • Experience creating technical documentation.
  • Experience creating and executing PowerShell scripts.
  • Experience with managing Active Directory domain or Entra ID user and computer objects.
  • DoD background, primarily USAF, preferred, especially when related to IT professional services for the Air Force.

-

title: Enterprise Director, Strategic Account Management
description:

We help complex organizations drive measurable business outcomes by building smarter customer experiences and delivering highly integrated solutions across digital, media, and technology. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced analytics and artificial intelligence, we enable our clients to make better decisions, move faster, and compete more effectively in dynamic markets.


Role Summary

As the Enterprise Director, Strategic Account Management, you'll lead a portfolio of enterprise client relationships that represent significant strategic and commercial value to OneMagnify. You'll serve as the senior business partner for executive stakeholders, helping clients connect investments in data, technology, marketing, and customer experience to measurable business outcomes. Working closely with leaders across strategy, analytics, technology, activation, and delivery, you'll shape long-term account growth while ensuring clients view OneMagnify as a trusted extension of their business. This role combines executive relationship leadership, commercial ownership, and cross-functional influence to drive client success and business growth.


The Impact You'll Have

You'll help shape the future of some of OneMagnify's most important enterprise partnerships. Success in this role comes from understanding a client's business well enough to anticipate challenges, identify new opportunities, and connect OneMagnify's capabilities to their long-term priorities. The relationships you build and the decisions you influence will directly impact client retention, revenue growth, and strategic account expansion.

You'll lead conversations with executive stakeholders responsible for customer experience, marketing, technology, and business transformation initiatives. By aligning business goals with integrated solutions across analytics, digital platforms, activation, and technology services, you'll help clients accelerate results while positioning OneMagnify as a strategic partner rather than a service provider.

This role requires strong cross-functional leadership. You'll bring together teams across delivery, analytics, technology, strategy, and activation to create unified account plans, navigate complex enterprise environments, and ensure business priorities remain connected to successful execution.


What You'll Do

Executive Relationship Leadership

  • Serve as the senior strategic partner and executive sponsor for key enterprise clients.
  • Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, business leaders, and procurement partners across complex organizations.
  • Guide executive-level conversations that connect business priorities to measurable outcomes and long-term partnership opportunities.

Enterprise Account Strategy & Growth

  • Develop and lead account strategies that strengthen client value, expand partnerships, and drive sustainable growth.
  • Create long-term account roadmaps aligned to client business objectives and evolving market needs.
  • Identify opportunities to expand OneMagnify's impact across data, technology, digital, and customer experience capabilities.
  • Translate client goals into growth plans that create value for both the client and the business.

Commercial Performance & Forecasting

  • Own revenue growth, retention, and renewal outcomes across a portfolio of enterprise accounts.
  • Lead expansion planning, commercial strategy, and opportunity development efforts.
  • Provide accurate forecasting and pipeline visibility to support business planning and investment decisions.
  • Partner with leadership on pricing strategy, contract negotiations, and renewal discussions.

Business Reviews & Executive Alignment

  • Lead Quarterly Business Reviews that clearly demonstrate business outcomes, value realization, and future opportunities.
  • Develop compelling business cases and strategic narratives for executive audiences.
  • Align stakeholders around priorities, success measures, and long-term partnership objectives.
  • Help clients evaluate future investments by connecting performance insights to business goals.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Delivery Governance

  • Partner with leaders across analytics, technology, activation, strategy, and delivery to ensure cohesive account planning and execution.
  • Align internal resources, priorities, and investments around client objectives and growth opportunities.
  • Balance client expectations, delivery quality, profitability, and business outcomes when evaluating opportunities.
  • Identify and mitigate relationship, scope, delivery, or commercial risks while maintaining client confidence and trust.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • 8+ years of experience leading enterprise client relationships within consulting, digital, marketing, data, technology, or professional services environments.
  • Proven success managing a portfolio of enterprise accounts with responsibility for revenue growth, client retention, and executive stakeholder engagement.
  • Strong experience developing strategic account plans and driving long-term business growth.
  • Demonstrated success leading expansion planning, renewal strategy, and revenue forecasting for large or complex accounts.
  • Experience presenting business outcomes, strategic recommendations, and value realization narratives to executive audiences.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including pricing strategy, contract negotiations, and partnership planning.
  • Ability to influence decision-making across client organizations and build consensus among diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Strong collaboration skills and experience working across delivery, program, analytics, technology, and business leadership teams.
  • Exceptional executive communication, presentation, storytelling, and relationship management capabilities.
  • Experience navigating large organizations with multiple business units, stakeholders, and decision-makers.

Future-Ready Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Familiarity with marketing technology ecosystems, customer data platforms (CDPs), CRM platforms, or digital experience platforms.
  • Experience supporting digital transformation, customer experience, or data-driven business initiatives.

title: Director of Front Office
description:
About Dream Downtown

Dream Downtown pays homage to its storied past as the former National Maritime Union headquarters while embodying the vibrant energy of modern New York City. From the moment guests enter the hotel, they are immersed in an atmosphere unlike any other. A glass-bottom pool suspended above the lobby, dynamic social spaces, buzzing nightlife, innovative dining concepts, and 314 loft-style guest rooms and suites create an experience that is both unexpected and unforgettable.

As much a place to play as it is to stay, Dream Downtown attracts travelers seeking the best of New York City. Our guests expect exceptional service, authentic experiences, and genuine connections. Our colleagues deliver all of that while having fun, embracing creativity, and bringing energy to every interaction.

If you are a high-performing hospitality leader who thrives in a fast-paced luxury lifestyle environment, enjoys developing talent, driving revenue, and creating unforgettable guest experiences, this is the opportunity for you.

Position Overview

The Director of Front Office is responsible for leading all aspects of Front Office operations, including Front Desk, Guest Services, Uniformed Services, Concierge, Reservations, and Pool Attendant operations. Reporting directly to the Director of Operations, this role serves as the strategic leader of the hotel's arrival, stay, and departure experience while driving operational excellence, financial performance, and colleague engagement.

This role is responsible for elevating the guest experience to the highest level by ensuring every leader and colleague within the department consistently performs to established service standards and expectations. The Director of Front Office develops a culture where hospitality is personalized, authentic, memorable, and distinctly New York.

Beyond traditional guest service leadership, this position is responsible for training and empowering teams to curate personalized micro-local experiences that connect travelers to the culture, neighborhoods, dining, entertainment, arts, wellness, and hidden gems that make New York City one of the world's most sought-after destinations.

The Director of Front Office is also a key business leader responsible for revenue optimization, room inventory management, upselling performance, forecasting, labor management, and operational collaboration. Through partnership with Revenue Management, Housekeeping, Engineering, Security, Food & Beverage, Sales, and Accounting, this role ensures the hotel achieves a perfect sell strategy while maximizing room revenue opportunities and enhancing the overall guest journey.

Key Responsibilities

Guest Experience Leadership

  • Lead all Front Office operations to ensure exceptional guest service standards, and consistent execution of the Dream Downtown guest experience.
  • Drive guest satisfaction, reputation management, audit performance, and service recovery initiatives.
  • Personally oversee VIP arrivals, special requests, celebrity guests, group arrivals, and elevated guest experiences.
  • Respond to guest concerns, complaints, accidents, and service opportunities in a timely, professional, and empathetic manner.
  • Establish a culture where every guest interaction is personalized, meaningful, and memorable.
  • Ensure seamless communication and coordination between all operational departments throughout the guest journey.
  • Champion the hotel's philosophy of service and ensure consistent execution across all Front Office functions.

Local Experience & Destination Programming

  • Develop and implement strategies that position Front Office colleagues as ambassadors of New York City.
  • Train and coach Front Office leaders and colleagues to curate personalized micro-local experiences tailored to individual guest interests.
  • Ensure team members confidently recommend dining, culture, arts, nightlife, wellness, shopping, entertainment, and neighborhood experiences.
  • Create partnerships and destination knowledge programs that enable colleagues to provide authentic local recommendations.
  • Inspire teams to transform routine guest interactions into memorable experiences that drive guest loyalty and return visits.
  • Establish destination expertise as a core competency within the Front Office team.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, coach, and develop Assistant Front Office Managers, Front Office Managers, Guest Service Managers and hourly colleagues.
  • Build a culture of accountability, engagement, empowerment, and high performance.
  • Conduct interviews, hiring, onboarding, and succession planning activities.
  • Provide ongoing coaching, performance management, and career development opportunities.
  • Hold leaders accountable for achieving operational goals, service standards, and financial objectives.
  • Conduct regular leadership meetings and departmental communication sessions.
  • Foster an environment where colleagues can have fun, be themselves, and perform at their highest potential.

Revenue Optimization & Financial Performance

  • Maximize room revenue, ADR, occupancy, and upsell performance through strategic inventory management.
  • Partner closely with Revenue Management to execute effective sell strategies and maximize hotel profitability.
  • Drive room upgrade conversion and premium room category sales.
  • Participate in daily selling strategy meetings and revenue discussions.
  • Ensure no-show, cancellation, and billing revenues are accurately captured.
  • Monitor labor costs, scheduling efficiency, and departmental productivity.
  • Assist in preparing budgets, forecasts, payroll controls, and financial reporting.

Operations Management

  • Oversee Front Desk, Concierge, Guest Services, Uniformed Services and Pool Operations.
  • Ensure proper execution of all Dream Downtown policies, procedures, and operating standards.
  • Develop, update, and implement departmental Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Review Front Office logs, Night Audit reports, guest requests, and operational reports daily.
  • Monitor package handling, key control, lost and found, cash handling, inventory controls, and departmental supplies.
  • Maintain operational readiness and ensure all systems and technology function effectively.
  • Ensure completion of daily MOD responsibilities and operational checklists.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Maintain strong working relationships with Housekeeping, Revenue Management, Engineering, Security, Sales, Food & Beverage, Accounting, and Human Resources.
  • Collaborate across departments to identify opportunities to improve efficiency, guest satisfaction, and revenue performance.
  • Participate in Rooms Division and operational leadership meetings.
  • Serve as a key contributor to overall hotel strategy and performance initiatives.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure adherence to company policies, financial controls, and operational standards.
  • Oversee credit policy compliance and front office cash-handling procedures.
  • Manage incident reporting, guest investigations, and risk mitigation efforts.
  • Partner with Security and Human Resources on workplace safety and employee relations matters.
  • Maintain confidentiality of guest, colleague, and business information.

Success Factors

The ideal candidate is\:

  • An inspirational leader who develops future hospitality professionals.
  • Passionate about creating world-class guest experiences.
  • A strategic thinker who understands both luxury hospitality and commercial performance.
  • Obsessed with service excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Skilled at driving revenue while maintaining an exceptional guest experience.
  • Knowledgeable about New York City and passionate about sharing its unique character with visitors.
  • Highly collaborative and capable of building strong cross-functional partnerships.
  • Visible, approachable, and engaged with both guests and colleagues.
  • Someone who believes that hospitality should be fun, energetic, and unforgettable.

Why Join Dream Downtown?

At Dream Downtown, we believe exceptional guest experiences start with exceptional leaders. As Director of Front Office, you'll have the opportunity to shape the guest journey, develop top hospitality talent, drive revenue performance, and create a culture where service excellence and fun coexist. If you're ready to lead one of New York City's most exciting lifestyle hotel front office teams while delivering unforgettable experiences for travelers from around the world, we'd love to meet you.

Salary Range\: $81,500- $99,000

How We Care for Our People

Our purpose sets us apart\: to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it guides how we support one another as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the foundation of our success.

We're proud to have earned a place on Fortune's prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for ten consecutive years. This recognition reflects our commitment to creating an environment rooted in inclusivity, empathy, respect, and belonging, where every colleague feels valued and empowered to grow.

As a leader within our hotel, the Assistant Director of Sales plays an important role in fostering this culture by developing talent, building meaningful relationships, promoting collaboration across departments, and helping create an environment where colleagues can thrive both personally and professionally.

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of Hyatt's Culture of Care and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Well-being.

You are a collaborative, relationship-focused leader who thrives in a fast-paced hospitality environment. You are energized by developing people, building partnerships, carrying a meaningful Major Market group quota, and driving results through teamwork and accountability. You understand that success comes from fostering strong relationships across departments, maintaining a visible and engaged presence, and creating a culture that supports both colleague growth and business performance.

You are someone who\:

  • Leads with integrity, professionalism, and accountability.

  • Builds trust and strong partnerships with colleagues, clients, and hotel leadership.

  • Enjoys mentoring and developing high-performing teams.

  • Embraces cross-functional collaboration and a “One Hotel, One Team” mindset.

  • Balances strategic thinking with hands-on leadership and active selling.

  • Demonstrates strong business acumen and a consistent, quota-driven approach to sales.

  • Thrives in an onsite leadership role, engaging daily with colleagues, guests, and operational partners.

  • Is committed to continuous learning, innovation, and professional growth.

Benefits Include\:

description:
Etsimme joukkoomme itsenäistä ja järjestelmällistä toimisto- ja hallintohenkilöä huolehtimaan veneliikkeemme päivittäisen toiminnan sujuvuudesta. Boatmart Oy on osa suurempaa Riverco Group -konsernia, jonka erittäin vahva taloudellinen asema ja vakavaraisuus tarjoavat henkilöstölle vakaan työympäristön sekä hyvät mahdollisuudet pitkäjänteiseen työuraan ja toiminnan kehittämiseen.

Veneliiketoimintaamme kuuluvat uusien ja käytettyjen veneiden myynti, välitys- ja vaihtovenekauppa, huolto- ja korjauspalvelut sekä talvisäilytys. Tarjoamme monipuolisen tehtävänkuvan, jossa pääset osallistumaan laajasti venealan eri osa-alueisiin.

Tehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.

  • ostolaskujen käsittely ja myyntilaskutus

  • asiakas- ja toimittajatietojen ylläpito

  • sopimusten ja muiden dokumenttien hallinta

  • venekauppaan liittyvien tilausten, luovutusten ja rekisteröintien koordinointi

  • veneilmoitusten ja tuotetietojen ylläpito

  • varastonhallinta

  • huollon ja talvisäilytyksen hallinnolliset tehtävät

Pääpaino tehtävässä on nimenomaan toimisto- ja hallintotyössä, mutta oman kiinnostuksesi ja osaamisesi mukaan voit osallistua myös veneiden myyntiin. Roolissa et siis ole pelkästään asioita käsittelevä toimistotyöntekijä, vaan tärkeä osa yrityksen päivittäisen toiminnan hallintaa ja järjestystä. Odotamme, että pidät huolen siitä, että sovitut asiat tulevat hoidetuiksi, laskut lähtevät ajallaan, ostolaskut ja muut dokumentit ovat kunnossa ja tarvittavat tiedot löytyvät silloin, kun niitä tarvitaan.

Toimit käytännössä johdon tukena ja päivittäisen toiminnan vastuuhenkilönä. Tehtävässä tarvitaan siis sopivasti napakkuutta, järjestelmällisyyttä ja uskallusta tarttua asioihin. Sinun ei odoteta johtavan yritystä tai tekevän taloudellisia päätöksiä, mutta odotamme, että otat oman vastuualueesi aidosti haltuun ja pidät huolen siitä, että arjen tekeminen pysyy järjestyksessä. Kokonaisuuksien ymmärtäminen ja kyky nähdä, mitä ympärillä tapahtuu, ovat tärkeitä ominaisuuksia roolissa.

Odotamme sinulta

  • kokemusta toimisto-, myynti- tai asiakaspalvelutehtävistä

  • oma-aloitteisuutta ja vastuullista työotetta

  • hyviä tietoteknisiä valmiuksia

  • tarkkuutta ja järjestelmällisyyttä

  • hyvää suomen kielen taitoa

  • kiinnostusta veneilyyn tai venealaan

Tarjoamme vakituisen ja vastuullisen työuran osana vakavaraista Riverco Group -konsernia sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi ja edetä urallasi.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si osoitteeseen rekry@riverco.fi viimeistään 15.10.2026. Hakemuksia käsitellään jo hakuaikana.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Tuomas Kankare puh. 0443652317.

title: Dynamics 365 Technical Architect (Auckland, New Zealand)
description:
This role is based in Auckland, New Zealand

Summary

Leading organisations – corporations, non-profits, government departments, look to Avanade to help them make the most of their investment in Microsoft and to push the boundaries of digital innovation. The result? Interesting work that is well supported, always evolving and sure to keep you engaged and interested. Together we go beyond.

Come join us

As a CRM Technical Architect (Manager level) at Avanade, you will lead the technical design and architecture of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE solutions for enterprise clients in New Zealand. Based in Auckland, you will provide deep technical leadership across presales, design and delivery phases, ensuring solutions are robust, scalable and aligned to client requirements and Microsoft best practices.

What you'll do

  • Lead technical architecture and solution design for complex Dynamics 365 CE / CRM implementations

  • Design end-to-end technical solutions including data model, integrations, customisations and security architecture

  • Architect Power Platform solutions including Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse and Power Pages

  • Provide technical governance across delivery teams, reviewing code, configurations and integration designs

  • Lead technical workshops with client stakeholders to validate architecture decisions

  • Collaborate with functional architects, security architects and infrastructure teams

  • Lead and contribute to pre-sales engagements including technical scoping, effort estimation and proposal development

  • Mentor and guide senior developers and technical consultants on the programme

  • Stay current with Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform developments and advise on emerging capabilities

.

Skills & Experience

About you

  • You are a highly experienced CRM technical architect with deep expertise in Dynamics 365 CE and Power Platform

  • You have a track record of designing and delivering complex, high-quality solutions in a consulting environment

  • You are confident leading technical discussions with client stakeholders and executives

  • You bring strong communication skills and can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences

  • You enjoy mentoring and developing more junior technical team members

  • You likely have 8+ years of professional experience in Dynamics 365 CE technical delivery

Technical skills & experience

  • Deep technical expertise in Dynamics 365 CE: plugins, JavaScript, PCF controls, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Web API

  • Strong experience with Power Platform: Power Apps (Canvas, Model-Driven), Power Automate, Dataverse, Power Pages

  • Experience designing integration architectures using Azure Integration Services, Service Bus, Logic Apps and REST APIs

  • DevOps with Dynamics 365 CE including ALM, solution management and CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps

  • Knowledge of Azure services supporting D365 CE solutions: Azure AD, Azure API Management, Key Vault, Storage

  • Experience with both Agile and Waterfall delivery models

Preferred certifications

  • PL-400: Microsoft Power Platform Developer

  • MB-600: Microsoft Dynamics 365 + Power Platform Solution Architect

  • AZ-204: Developing Solutions for Microsoft Azure (desirable)

Preferred years of experience

You likely have 8–14 years of professional experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE technical delivery, with at least 4 years in an architecture role.

.

Operations, ITIL Service Operations Analysis, CCNP, CCNA, AWS Associate or better, VMWare vSpere, or MCSA

title: Senior Engineer, Systems Infrastructure
description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Job Description

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Systems Infrastructure Engineer to manage and optimize enterprise infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments. The role focuses on operational stability, VMware and Windows infrastructure, capacity management, automation, patching, compliance, monitoring, and technical leadership.

The engineer will work closely with architects, operations, security, and other technology teams while providing technical guidance and mentorship to team members.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure Operations

  • Manage Incidents, Tasks, Problems, and Change Requests in alignment with ITIL processes.
  • Lead technical activities during Major Incident Management (MIM) calls and support timely service recovery.
  • Ensure SLA adherence and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
  • Provide technical troubleshooting, escalation support, and mentorship to team members.

VMware & Windows Infrastructure

  • Manage and support VMware ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, and VxRail environments.
  • Perform virtualization administration, upgrades, patching, troubleshooting, and optimization.
  • Plan and execute P2V and V2V migrations.
  • Administer and troubleshoot Windows Server 2012/2016/2019/2022 environments.
  • Support server provisioning, lifecycle management, performance optimization, and decommissioning.

Capacity & Performance Management

  • Monitor infrastructure utilization across compute, memory, storage, virtualization, and cloud resources.
  • Identify capacity constraints and performance bottlenecks and recommend improvements.
  • Forecast capacity requirements and work with architects on scaling and infrastructure planning.
  • Maintain capacity dashboards, performance metrics, and leadership reports.

Cloud Infrastructure

  • Support infrastructure across Microsoft Azure and/or AWS environments.
  • Work with architects on cloud implementation, migration, optimization, governance, security, and reliability.
  • Support hybrid cloud and on-premises infrastructure environments.

Automation & Optimization

  • Automate repetitive operational activities using PowerShell, Python, or similar scripting technologies.
  • Automate provisioning, health checks, monitoring, patching, compliance validation, and reporting.
  • Apply Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices where appropriate.
  • Drive continuous service improvement and reduce manual operational effort.

Patch Management & Compliance

  • Plan and execute Windows Server patching across enterprise environments.
  • Maintain patch compliance, vulnerability, exception, and remediation dashboards.
  • Automate patch deployment, validation, and compliance reporting.
  • Ensure infrastructure meets security, compliance, vulnerability management, and audit requirements.

Monitoring, Backup & Recovery

  • Support enterprise monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability platforms.
  • Maintain dashboards for infrastructure availability, health, performance, and capacity.
  • Support backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and high-availability solutions.
  • Participate in disaster recovery testing and remediation activities.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead or contribute to infrastructure migrations, upgrades, technology refreshes, and transformation initiatives.
  • Work with architects and technical teams on infrastructure standards and operational improvements.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and act as a technical escalation point.
  • Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions and maintain strong technical documentation.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 12+ years of relevant hands-on experience in enterprise infrastructure engineering or systems infrastructure.
  • Strong hands-on experience with VMware ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, and VxRail.
  • Advanced administration experience with Windows Server 2012/2016/2019/2022.
  • Experience supporting Microsoft Azure and/or AWS environments.
  • Strong understanding of capacity planning, performance monitoring, forecasting, and infrastructure optimization.
  • Strong automation and scripting skills using PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation practices.
  • Strong experience with ITIL-based Incident, Major Incident, Change, and Problem Management.
  • Experience with P2V and V2V migrations.
  • Strong knowledge of patch management, compliance reporting, monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and high availability.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience leading complex infrastructure activities and mentoring technical team members.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively with distributed global teams.

Work Conditions

  • Ability to work early IST shifts starting from 6:00 AM onwards to provide coverage for APAC business hours as per business requirements.
  • Flexibility to support critical maintenance windows, Major Incidents, and infrastructure changes outside regular working hours.
  • Ability to participate in an on-call rotation supporting 24x7 enterprise operations.

title: Postdoctoral Fellow - Computational Biology
description:
Join the forefront of groundbreaking research at City of Hope where we're changing lives and making a real difference in the fight against cancer, diabetes, and other life-threatening illnesses. Our dedicated and compassionate faculty and staff are driven by a common mission\: Contribute to innovative approaches in predicting, preventing, and curing diseases, shaping the future of medicine through cutting-edge research.

The Department of Diabetes and Cancer Metabolism at City of Hope is seeking a highly motivated Postdoctoral Fellow in Computational Biology/Bioinformatics to join an NIH R01-funded research program focused on decoding cardiomyocyte subtype dynamics and molecular mechanisms underlying heart failure progression.

Led by Didi Ren, Ph.D., Principal Investigator, the lab integrates single-cell and single-nucleus multi-omics, machine learning/AI, computational biology, and experimental validation to understand cardiovascular disease progression and identify novel therapeutic targets. The successful candidate will primarily lead computational and bioinformatics studies within the lab and will have opportunities to develop new analytical approaches, publish high-impact research, collaborate with multidisciplinary investigators, and establish an independent research direction.

As a successful candidate you will\:

  • Lead computational analysis of single-cell/single-nucleus RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, and multiome datasets related to heart failure and cardiovascular biology.
  • Develop and apply machine-learning and deep-learning approaches to identify disease-associated cardiomyocyte subtypes, cellular trajectories, and molecular drivers.
  • Develop AI agents and LLM-based computational workflows for biomedical research, including automated dataset discovery, quality assessment, multi-omics analysis, biological interpretation, and hypothesis generation.
  • Integrate transcriptomic, epigenomic, spatial transcriptomic, and other multi-omics datasets.
  • Perform gene regulatory network, transcription factor, pathway, and cell-state analyses.
  • Develop reproducible bioinformatics pipelines and computational tools using Python and/or R.
  • Work closely with Dr. Ren and experimental and computational collaborators to translate computational discoveries into experimentally testable hypotheses.
  • Contribute to manuscripts, conference presentations, grant-related research, and development of new research directions.

As one of the largest and most comprehensive facilities in Arizona, Banner Children's at Desert serves as a tertiary referral center for the East Valley of metropolitan Phoenix and treats the highest levels of acuity in the East Valley.

As an Speech Pathologist for the NICU, PICU and Pediatrics units, you will bring your experience and passion for health care to our rehab team! You will be an active and engaged change agent; dedicated to the needs of our patients and families. Steadfast to safe, kind, effective, efficient, evidenced-based and high quality clinical care, outcome focused and solution oriented. You will participate in the interdisciplinary team including therapists, nurses, physicians, and case managers to provide direct patient care and recommend appropriate discharge plans.

The Speech Pathologist is for pediatric and NICU spaces, working with NICU and pediatric patients through age 18 in the acute care settings. One year of pediatric experience is preferred. This is a part-time, 20 hours per week benefited position. The shift is Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Previous Speech Pathology experience in NICU and PICU is preferred.

Your pay and benefits (Total Rewards) are important components of your Journey at Banner Health. Banner Health offers a variety of benefit plans to help you and your family. We provide health and financial security options so you can focus on being the best at what you do and enjoying your life.

Located on an 80-acre campus in Mesa, Arizona, Banner Desert Medical Center is one of Arizona's largest and most comprehensive hospitals and was recognized by U.S. News and World Report as one of Phoenix's Best Hospitals. We provide an abundance of exceptional opportunities with more than 700 licensed beds, including over 100 dedicated to children and 76 dedicated to our NICU. Areas of excellence include high-risk pregnancy and neonatal care, obstetrics and gynecology, pediatrics, cardiology, oncology and emergency medicine. With 33 operating rooms, we offer a full range of surgical specialties and advanced technology that includes the da Vinci Surgical System. Becker’s Hospital Review named Banner Desert Medical Center as one of the top 50 busiest Emergency departments in the country.

If you aim to deliver top-tier care to the most vulnerable patients, consider joining Banner Children's Hospital at Desert in Mesa, Arizona. Within our over 200 bed, state-of-the-art facility, specially trained nurses, physicians and other clinical professionals utilize the most advanced technology - including iCare ICU monitoring and robotic surgery - to provide high quality, child-friendly, family-centered care. Our facilities feature a 76-bed NICU, a 24-bed PICU, six pediatric ORs and a 22-bed ED. We also offer dedicated pediatric rehab, radiology, oncology and hematology capabilities. With clinical diversity, exceptional training programs and a supportive culture, this is a place where you can grow in your career as you help our very special patients.

POSITION SUMMARY
This position provides screening, evaluation, and rehabilitation services for patients with speech and language disorders related to speech, language, cognitive-communication, voice, swallowing, and fluency. This position plans and carries out specialized treatment programs, documents treatment, and maintains data regarding patient care. This position demonstrates the clinical competence and knowledge necessary to provide treatment appropriate to the age of the patients served.

CORE FUNCTIONS
1. Evaluates patients’ functional abilities and limitations to determine appropriate intervention. Develops a plan of care and treatment goals, as ordered by physician or other referral source.

2. Implements individualized treatment plans that consider patients’ physical, social, spiritual, cultural, educational, and age-specific needs. Ensures that treatment plans are supported by standard practices and/or current literature. Re-evaluates treatment plans, as needed, to ensure maximum patient benefit.

3. Educates patients, family, and other care providers to promote patient participation and attainment of therapeutic program goals. Provides individualized home programs with clear instructions.

4. Documents patient treatment according to professional and regulatory standards.

5. Participates in the provision of training to other staff and students.

6. Follows plan of care to accomplish functions within established procedures and scope of practice. Makes independent judgments based on specialized knowledge. Confers with supervisor on any unusual situations. Internal customers: All levels of nursing management and staff, medical staff, and all other members of the interdisciplinary health care team. External Customers: Physician offices, patient families, third party payers, and medical supply companies.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Masters degree in Speech Language Pathology from an accredited university program.

Current licensure in the state of practice. Certificate of Clinical Competence or documented acceptance in Clinical Fellowship Year. BLS certification required.

Requires the ability to work collaboratively with physicians and other healthcare providers. Must have strong interpersonal communications and human relation skills.

Must have the ability to become proficient with computer software applications commonly used in an automated patient care environment. Additional related education and/or experience preferred.
