title: Engineer
description:
ABOUT WIND RIVER

Wind River is a global leader in delivering software for mission-critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, the company has been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that require the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability.

Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. The company’s software powers generation after generation of the safest, most secure systems in the world. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers. We’ve achieved recent 5G milestones including the world’s first successful 5G data session with Verizon and building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone.

The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a “Top Workplace” for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where the lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer-focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging, come join us and help advance the future software defined world.


YOUR ROLE

As an Engineer on the Wind River Linux team, you develop and maintain BSP and Linux kernel components for embedded platforms across ARM and x86. You own well-scoped hardware-enablement and kernel work end to end, bring-up, drivers, device trees, and defect fixes, CVE fixes, working independently on your assignments while learning from senior engineers on the harder cross-layer problems. You write clean, maintainable code, debug real hardware/kernel issues, and grow toward technical ownership of a platform or subsystem.

In your daily job you will:

What You'll Do

Development & Implementation

  • Develop and maintain BSP components, device trees, and machine configurations for supported platforms.
  • Work on Linux kernel bring-up, driver enablement, and defect fixes; backport patches and CVE fixes into LTS kernels under guidance.
  • Support hardware bring-up and validation — bootloader config, kernel boot, peripheral enablement.
  • Write high-quality, maintainable code and recipes following team and Yocto/OpenEmbedded conventions.
  • Debug and resolve BSP and kernel issues across boot, drivers, and system init.

Technical Growth & Collaboration

  • Participate in code reviews and design discussions; take on progressively larger, less-bounded work as you grow.
  • Mentor P1 (Associate) engineers on tasks you've mastered.
  • Collaborate across a distributed team (US / India); share what you learn through clear documentation.
  • Participate in sprint planning, estimation, and retrospectives, and contribute to team process improvements.

BSP / Kernel Specific

  • Enable new hardware platforms and processors; configure device trees and hardware abstraction layers.
  • Work with hardware vendors' BSPs and reference designs to integrate into the WRLinux Yocto layers.
  • Maintain compatibility across hardware platforms and kernel versions; keep recipes and configs current with the release cadence.
  • Contribute to platform performance, boot-time, and reliability improvements.

Required Skills

Education & Experience

description:
Job Description:

The Registered Dietitian Advanced Practice Specialist leads and directs the nutrition care process in highly complex specialty care areas using in-depth experience-based knowledge, diagnostic reasoning skills, and technical expertise. This role develops personalized medical nutrition therapy care plans for individuals across the continuum of care and/or in settings where frequent monitoring and evaluation is required due to the dynamic nature of the health condition.

Posting Specifics

Pay Rate: Based on Experience

Shift Details: Full-Time (40hrs/wk). M-F 8 am – 5 pm. Some Weekends, Holidays and Evenings shifts may be required.

Additional Details: This dietitian will support Utah Valley University Athletics and will be located directly on the campus.

Sign On Bonus: $2500

Essential Functions

  • Provides Medical Nutrition Therapy to individuals with multifactorial and highly dynamic complex disease states requiring frequent evaluation, monitoring, and adjustment in interventions.
  • Uses considerable depth of specialized knowledge to autonomously design highly personalized nutrition treatment plans relative to one or more complex conditions over time.
  • Conducts comprehensive data analysis to identify trends and inform interventions.
  • Identifies factors beyond nutrition that interfere with interventions and makes referrals.
  • Leads and directs the interprofessional team in planning and implementing nutrition interventions.
  • Drives nutrition care management across the continuum of care.
  • Applies expertise in medical equipment in the provision of nutrition care (e.g. insulin pumps, continuous glucose monitors, placing feeding tubes and/or bridles, etc.)
  • Mentors and trains dietitians and other health professionals in specialty area of practice and acts as an expert resource for consultation.
  • Develops strategic partnerships both internally and externally to advance nutrition care for given specialty area locally and enterprise-wide.
  • Acts as a subject matter expert in research, enterprise practice standards, enterprise committees, etc.

Skills

  • Specialty Medical Nutrition Therapy
  • Highly Complex Problem Solving
  • Nutrition Focused Physical Exam
  • Advanced Counseling Techniques
  • Medical Equipment Expertise
  • Research and Analytics
  • Coaching and Developing Others
  • Leadership
  • Adaptability

Qualifications (Registered Dietitian Advanced Practice Specialist)

  • Registered Dietitian with the Commission on Dietetic Registration.
  • For graduates after Jan 1, 2024, completion of a minimum of a master’s degree by an accredited university. Education is verified.
  • Completion of an ACEND accredited Didactic Program in Dietetics, Dietetic Internship, Coordinated Program, or graduate-level competency-based dietitian nutritionist program.
  • State licensure or certification in accordance with the primary state of practice requirement for Registered Dietitians. If the primary state of practice requires licensure or certification, this must be obtained within 6 months of hire.

Qualifications (Registered Dietitian Clinical Specialist):

Registered Dietitian Specialist Pay Range: 32.34 - 49.94 Hourly

title: Electronics Design / Sustaining Engineer
description:
Company Overview

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

Group/Division

The KLA Services team headquartered in Milpitas, CA is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The KLA Services organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts.

Job Description/Preferred Qualifications

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with external vendors to support engineering validation and turn‑key manufacturing solutions
  • Design, sustain, and troubleshoot printed circuit boards (PCBs), power supplies, and electronic test fixtures
  • Interpret and apply engineering requirements and specifications at the board and sub‑system levels
  • Perform failure analysis and root‑cause investigations for analog, digital, and mixed‑signal electronics
  • Conduct hands‑on PCBA debugging using laboratory equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, DMMs, etc.)
  • Independently troubleshoot board‑level and sub‑system issues with moderate technical ownership
  • Contribute to sustaining engineering activities, including corrective actions, ECO execution, and manufacturability improvements
  • Collaborate with global cross‑functional teams (systems, software, manufacturing, service, supply chain) to resolve technical issues
  • Create and maintain engineering documentation, including schematics, ECOs, test procedures, and sustaining updates
  • Communicate technical findings, risks, and project status to stakeholders and management

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline
  • 2+ years of experience in electronics design, sustaining engineering, or board‑level support roles
  • Demonstrated hands‑on experience debugging PCBAs and electronic sub‑systems
  • Solid foundation in analog and digital circuit design principles
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills; ability to work in a global, cross‑functional environment

We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.

This position will help support exploitation missions both CONUS (Continental United States) and OCONUS (Outside Continental United States) via deployment.

  • Experience must include the following: Identification of bodily fluids such as blood, ability to extract DNA using automated platforms, generation of STR and Y-STR DNA profiles via standard and direct amplification, experience with mixture interpretation using probabilistic genotyping software, experience with submission of DNA profiles to databases, and experience in technical and administrative case file reviews.
  • Able to obtain a DoD Secret security clearance. (Please note: US citizenship is required to obtain a US Secret security clearance).

title: Oncology Field Medical, Director Thoracic (non-MD)
description:
Role Summary

Lung cancer treatment is evolving rapidly, and the space between emerging evidence and every day clinical practice is where our medical expertise matters most.

As a field-based scientific expert supporting Pfizer’s Thoracic oncology portfolio across the California/ Nevada/ Hawaii territory, you will engage a broad range of medical customer segments. You will deliver approved medical and scientific education to healthcare professionals, surface insights that inform medical strategy, support the identification of potential clinical trial sites and clinical trial support, and help address the field’s most important unanswered scientific questions in service of improving patient outcomes.

Field Medical: Core Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute Medical strategy and engagement for appropriate assigned customers within a territory, compliantly coordinating with other Pfizer colleagues as needed to achieve Medical objectives.
  • Maintain required level of knowledge of relevant TA/disease states and Pfizer medicines, providing therapeutic area/product information to both internal and external stakeholders as needed.
  • Serve as a conduit and resource for Medical Information and customer insights, providing requested information to HCPs as allowed by Pfizer guidance and sharing customer viewpoints with Pfizer as appropriate.
  • Understand the priorities of Pfizer Medical Affairs in order to contribute to Medical content strategy development and execute aligned Field Medical tactics
  • Maintain effective and appropriate communication and collaboration among headquarters Medical colleagues, Medical Information, and other Pfizer Field Medical colleagues.
  • Demonstrate expertise in communication across multiple channels, including, but not limited to, live and virtual presentations in small or large settings, written communication, and telephone or virtual conversations.
  • Optimize patient centricity of Medical communications and deliverables, incorporating Health Literacy and cultural awareness principles to ensure that patients remain the ultimate focus.

Field Medical: Additional Responsibilities

  • Deliver approved medical content about Pfizer medicines and relevant topics in the designated therapeutic area.
  • Identify and seek medical engagement from priority customer segments in assigned Therapeutic Area.
  • Provide truthful, accurate, and scientifically supported information in response to direct unsolicited medical requests from HCPs in a manner that complies with all applicable Pfizer guidelines, policies, and procedures.
  • Leads advisory boards, working with vendors if necessary, with manager oversight.
  • Field relevant inbound queries from HCPs via established triage process.
  • In collaboration with Global Medical Affairs colleagues, partner with Oncology Research & Development and Global Product Development (GPD) in the identification of potential sites for Pfizer-sponsored clinical trials, including identification of sites serving under-represented patient populations in trials.
  • Appropriately provide Medical support throughout the Investigator Sponsored Research (ISR) process.
  • Cultivate research and therapeutic area expertise, including familiarity with latest congress data and disease state literature.
  • Provides Asset leadership.
  • Understand the principles of study design, methodology, data analysis, and interpretation and communicate these concepts with customers.
  • Lead your territory with an ownership mindset: strategic planning, disciplined prioritization, and full accountability for medical impact in your geography.
  • Reactively and proactively communicate with local Patient Advocacy Group(s), as appropriate, in close collaboration with Corporate Affairs and HQ Medical Affairs.
  • Deliver actionable field insights — local patient organization structure, capabilities, patient population needs, real-world treatment patterns, evolving standards of care, and unmet data needs — to inform medical strategy and evidence generation.
  • Serve on Medical and/or TA and asset cross-functional committees, as appropriate.
  • Represent Pfizer Medical Affairs leadership with clinical/professional associations and/or societies, consistently demonstrating medical professionalism in all interactions.
  • Mentorship – Onboarding partner, ad board and study lead mentor.
  • Participate in special projects as needed.

title: Senior Scientist, Analytics & Metrology
description:
Job Title:

Senior Scientist, Analytics & Metrology

Job Description:

The Role:

Entegris is currently seeking a talented and innovative Senior Scientist to join its Analytical & Metrology team in Billerica, MA.

This role will focus on the implementation and deployment of ultratrace elemental analysis using ICP-MS to support membrane R&D and new liquid filtration and purification products development in the Micro-contamination Control Division (MC) of Entegris. The Scientist serves as a subject matter expert related to the characterization of metallic contaminates for semiconductor applications. In line with our values, which is fostering an environment of teamwork, you will have an opportunity to collaborate with a talented global team of engineers and scientists to solve challenge tasks.

The ideal candidate will be results oriented and an excellent team player, with solid knowledge of analytical chemistry and instruments, and familiarity with semiconductor device materials, structures, and metrology.

What You'll Do:

  • Perform metallic impurity analysis using ICP-MS instrument;

  • Develop analytical methods drive for continuous improvement of existing testing methods;

  • Use product and testing expertise to collaborate with internal and external customers to determine root causes in product development and quality problems;

  • Collaborate with application team to solve customer quality complaints and provide solutions to their technical issues;

  • Promote Entegris’ image by participating in industrial conferences and seminars;

  • Continuous training on the various analytical techniques and methods;

  • Document work in internal reporting systems, and external publications.

What We Seek:

  • Ph.D. in chemistry, environmental science, materials science or related field with 2 years of industry experience strongly preferred; Master's Degree with 3+ years of experience can be considered.

  • Practical knowledge and experience working with ICP-MS instrument, microwave digestion and shing sample preparation.

  • Experience on other analytical techniques (GCMS, GC-QToF, LC-QToF, Py-GCMS, HPLC, FT-IR, and wet chemistry techniques) will be a plus;

  • Experience working in the chemical, semiconductor or related industry is preferred;

  • Strong communication skills demonstrated by both oral presentations and written technical publications;

  • Demonstrated problem solving skills with a passion for learning and teaching;

  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced dynamic and collaborative working environment;

  • A role model to maintaining a safe work environment and championing safe work practices;

Your success will be measured by:

  • Tests and analyzes R&D samples, new products, and in-process samples when needed and in timely manner;

  • Develops and validates new methods for new sample matrices;

  • Instrument maintenance and trouble-shooting

  • Confers with process engineers, development scientists, and manufacturing personnel regarding results and research, prepares technical reports and presentations to promote learning;

  • Good communication and coordination abilities and presentation skills;

  • Teaching and mentoring junior chemists and technicians;

  • Ability to conduct project independently and navigate ambiguity;

  • Demonstrated ability to work on multiple projects in parallel;

  • Strong independent operation skills and ability to complete lab work safely;

  • Ability to learn and become proficient at several analytical techniques.

Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future.
Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. Every employee throughout the company is encouraged to share input on projects and initiatives. title: Architecture Energy Modeling Engineering Intern - 2027
description:
At NVIDIA, we pride ourselves in having energy efficient products. We believe that continuing to maintain our products' energy efficiency compared to the competition is key to our continued success. Our team is responsible for researching, developing, and deploying methodologies to help NVIDIA's products become more energy efficient; and is responsible for building energy models that integrate into architectural simulators, RTL simulation, and emulation platforms. Key responsibilities include developing techniques to model, analyze, and reduce the power consumption of NVIDIA GPUs.

As a member of the Power Modeling, Methodology, and Analysis Team, you will collaborate with Architects, Performance Engineers, Software Engineers, ASIC Design Engineers, and Physical Design teams to study and implement energy modeling techniques for NVIDIA's next-generation GPUs and Tegra SOCs. Your contributions will help us gain early insight into the energy consumption of graphics and artificial intelligence workloads, and will allow us to influence architectural, design, and power management improvements.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Work with architects and performance architects to develop an energy-efficient GPU.

  • Develop methodologies and workflows to select and run a wide variety of workloads to train models using ML and/or statistical techniques.

  • Develop methodologies to improve the accuracy of energy models under various constraints, such as, process, timing, floorplan and layout.

  • Correlate the predicted energy from models created at different stages of the design cycle, with the goal of bridging early estimates to silicon.

  • Develop tools to debug energy inefficiencies observed in various workloads run on silicon, RTL and architectural simulators. Work with architects to fix the identified energy inefficiencies.

  • Work with performance, verification and emulation methodology and infrastructure development teams to integrate energy models into their platforms.

  • Prototype new architectural features, create an energy model, and analyze the system impact.

What we need to see:

  • Pursuing MS degree

  • Strong coding skills, preferably in Python, C++.

  • Background in machine learning, AI, and/or statistical modeling.

  • Interest in computer architecture and energy-efficient GPU designs.

  • Familiarity with Verilog and ASIC design principles is a plus.

  • Ability to formulate and analyze algorithms, and comment on their runtime and memory complexities.

  • Desire to bring quantitative decision-making and analytics to improve the energy efficiency of our products.

  • Good verbal/written English and interpersonal skills.

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you! NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

description:

Job Description

Thermo Fisher Scientific offers the scale, reach, and mission-driven work to make a meaningful impact.


The Role:


We are seeking an R&D Scientist to develop and apply analytical methods for the characterization of materials and surfaces, and to understand how their physical and chemical properties influence performance in customer applications.


The role will bridge analytical science, materials and surface chemistry, and application performance, with a particular focus on functionalized beads used in immunoassays, proteomics, biomolecule capture, and related applications.


Key Responsibilities:


• Develop, optimize, and apply analytical methods to characterize materials, particles, and surfaces.
• Design experiments that connect physical and chemical properties with functional and application performance.
• Translate application challenges into analytical and materials-science questions.
• Integrate data from multiple analytical techniques and functional assays to identify the material attributes that drive performance.
• Apply statistical and data-driven approaches to understand complex relationships and support predictive models.
• Provide analytical expertise to new product development, product improvement, and technical investigations.
• Identify, evaluate, and introduce new analytical technologies and capabilities.
• Communicate scientific findings and translate data into clear recommendations for multidisciplinary teams.


Qualifications and Experience:


• MSc or PhD in analytical chemistry, physical chemistry, materials science, colloid/interface science, biochemistry, bioengineering, or a related discipline.
• Strong experience in analytical method development and characterization of materials and/or surfaces.
• Strong experimental design, scientific problem-solving, and data-analysis skills.
• Ability to connect analytical measurements with material, product, or functional performance.
• Ability to work independently and effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
Experience in one or more of the following would be an advantage:
• Surface chemistry, colloid/interface science, or functionalized particles.
• Protein–surface or biomolecule–surface interactions.
• Immunoassays, proteomics, affinity-based assays, or biomolecule capture.
• Statistical, multivariate, computational, or machine-learning analysis of experimental data.
• Evaluation and implementation of new analytical technologies.

description:

More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world.   • Experience in influencing decisions and leading teams in a matrix environment

title: Engr III Spec-AI/ML Engring
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you'll be doing:

The AI Science team is seeking a Senior AI Scientist/Engineer to bridge the gap between cutting-edge Machine Learning research and high-scale production systems. In this role, you will collaborate closely with Data Engineers and Platform Engineers to design, train, optimize, and deploy advanced ML models and AI infrastructure. You will take ownership of turning complex algorithmic innovations into robust, scalable, and low-latency production applications.
Key Responsibilities

  • Model Productionization & Scaling: Architect, implement, and maintain scalable infrastructure to train, fine-tune, and deploy state-of-the-art AI models (e.g., Large Language Models, Multimodal Models, Deep Learning architectures).

  • Research & Development Collaboration: Work alongside Research Scientists to translate novel theoretical concepts and prototypes into clean, modular, and performant codebases.

  • Inference & Training Optimization: Optimize model inference and training workflows for memory, speed, and cost efficiency using techniques like quantization, pruning, distillation, and distributed execution.

  • ML Pipelines & Data Architecture: Design resilient data pipelines, dataset curation workflows, and automated evaluation suites to ensure continuous model improvement and regression testing.

  • System Design & MLOps: Build robust monitoring, logging, and continuous deployment (CI/CD for ML) systems to track model performance, drift, and system health in production.

  • Technical Leadership: Code-review team contributions, mentor junior engineers, and drive technical best practices for engineering rigor within the AI Science organization.t

What we’re looking for...

You'll need to have

  • Bachelor’s or degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related quantitative field or four or more years of work experience.

  • Three or more years focused on building, deploying, and maintaining ML/AI models in production.

  • Expert-level programming proficiency in Python and deep understanding of modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX).

  • Strong background in system design, object-oriented programming, data structures, and software engineering best practices.

  • Experience with distributed model training and inference systems (e.g., Ray, DeepSpeed, vLLM, Megatron-LM).

  • Experience with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and modern MLOps tool chains.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

title: Senior Territory Executive
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Territory Executive is responsible for attaining revenue and EBITDA targets through growing share within existing and new customer accounts in an expanded territory. The Senior TE will develop and implement strategic plans to expand the use of products and services within assigned territory and accounts. This role involves managing sales accounts by prioritizing high-impact goals, requirements, and sales opportunities to achieve revenue and EBITDA growth. Additionally, the Senior TE will mentor and lead training for peers, leveraging their extensive experience with healthcare systems and Group Purchasing Organizations (GPOs).

PRIMARY OBJECTIVES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

An effective Senior TE is proficient in the “4 Pillars of Sales Excellence” which are outlined below.

Time and Territory Management:

  • Understands strategic position in industry and territory.
  • Establishes long-term goals in territory and develops annual and quarterly goals that create a clear pathway to achieving the long-term goals.
  • Manages time and resources to ensure that work is completed efficiently and on schedule.
  • Embraces Customer Relationship Management tools to effectively manage sales territory and execute sales objectives.
  • Demonstrates a comprehensive knowledge of the specific markets (Including Acute Care, Long-term Care, etc.).
  • Effectively leverages Sales Specialists and cross-functional subject area experts to execute on growth strategies within the expanded territory.

Customer Aligned Sales Process:

  • Adapts to customer needs and buying processes; adjusts messaging and sales processes accordingly.
  • Conveys information to customers in a clear, compelling way that will positively affect their thoughts and actions.
  • Identifies, qualifies, and closes business opportunities in the expanded territory and demonstrates an ability to strategically assess and approach a territory to optimize and execute a sales plan.
  • Keeps customer commitments, resolves customer problems, and exceeds customer expectations.
  • Effectively manages internal sales processes by leveraging appropriate resources (Sales Specialists, Operations Counterparts, and Corporate Resources).
  • Conducts business reviews with customers.
  • Manages external customer relationships through regularly visiting client locations.

Insight Selling Methodology:

  • Translates the benefits of solutions, products, and services to customers involved in the decision-making process based on understanding of their individual needs and/or business problems to solve.
  • Possesses an in-depth understanding of customer needs and challenges to effectively deliver insights during each customer interaction.

Equipment Value Management:

  • Articulates how the EVM framework drives meaningful improvements to equipment workflows within hospitals while simultaneously improving quality, reducing costs, and elevating patient experiences.
  • Stays current on all Agiliti’s service offerings and sales trainings.

Mentorship and Leadership:

  • Mentors and leads training for peers, sharing best practices and strategies for success.
  • Provides guidance and support to less experienced Territory Executives, fostering a collaborative and high-performing sales team.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • BS/BA degree in business, sales, or marketing.
  • 7+ years of healthcare sales or related experience required.
  • Experience working with healthcare systems and Group Purchasing Organizations (GPOs) is essential.
  • Proven track record of success in a team-based selling environment.
  • Previous experience selling services is preferred.
  • Must be available to travel up to 50%.
  • Must hold a current, valid, and unrestricted driver’s license. Must have a safe driving record based on Agiliti policies.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Has the focus, persistence, positive outlook, and discipline to meet the personal demands of a sales role.
  • Anticipates problems or opportunities and takes immediate action to address them.
  • Follows through on commitments and agreements.
  • Sets challenging personal and business goals and demonstrates tenacity toward achieving those goals.
  • Communicates effectively, both written and verbally, to internal and external partners.
  • Sets high standards of performance, quality, and accountability for self and others. Guides by example.
  • Professionally presents and conveys our services using the Challenger Sales methodology, utilizing available tools such as whiteboarding and virtual meetings when applicable.
  • Builds strong cross-functional internal relationships.
  • Comprehends and understands Sales Incentive Plan, budget, and District Profits & Losses.
  • Ability to speak competently about all clinical equipment found in hospital environments as well as solid comprehension of hospital finance, reimbursement, regulatory, and safety practices.

title: Field Medical Outcomes, Director, non-MD
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

The Field Medical Outcomes is a field medical colleague responsible for informing customer decision-making and improving population health through real-world data analytics, pharmacoeconomic analyses, outcomes evaluations and medical presentations. The role is responsible for educating customers on the clinical and economic impact of Pfizer medicines and products. The colleague may also be responsible for providing disease area/therapeutic area/product-based expertise for designated TA areas with a primary focus on integrated health care organizations, including but not limited to Integrated Delivery Systems, Payer customers and Specialty Pharmacy Providers (SPPs).

The responsibilities of the role are to contribute to Pfizer’s ability to (a) Plan and execute the independent Medical strategy and engagement for appropriate assigned customers within a territory, compliantly coordinating with other Pfizer colleagues as needed to achieve Medical objectives (b) Understand the priorities of Pfizer Medical Affairs in order to contribute to Medical educational content strategy development and execute aligned Field Medical tactics (c) Maintain effective and appropriate communication and collaboration among headquarters Medical colleagues, Medical Information, and other Pfizer Field Medical colleagues (d) Demonstrate expertise in scientific communication across multiple channels, including, but not limited to, live and virtual presentations in small or large settings, written communication, and telephone or virtual conversations (e) Compliantly integrate understanding of clinical, Health Information Technology (HIT), market, and account considerations to develop and execute mutually beneficial customer-specific projects, collaborations, strategic medical partnerships, and non-interventional studies with the goal of advancing quality of care and improving patient outcomes (f) Optimize patient care improvements in centricity of Medical communications and deliverables, incorporating Health Literacy and cultural awareness principles to ensure that patients remain the ultimate focus.

The role may interact with accounts in the region including Healthcare Decision Makers (HCDM) affiliated with organized customers. The colleague will respond to medical questions regarding Pfizer products for the designated therapeutic area and other Pfizer medicines as appropriate. The individual may be involved in presentations to payers, managed care organizations, formulary decision makers and regional medical advisory boards in accordance with the designated therapeutic area medical strategy. The Medical Outcomes colleague will also facilitate communication between regional and national HCOs and headquarters Medical Affairs colleagues and provide customer insights that contribute to the development of brand medical strategies as appropriate. The role may facilitate Pfizer sponsored research projects/studies which could include collaborative projects, quality improvement research and non-interventional studies.

The colleague will maintain required level of knowledge of relevant TA/disease states and Pfizer medicines, providing therapeutic area/product information to both internal and external stakeholders as needed, and serve as a conduit and resource for Medical Information and customer insights, providing requested information to medical stakeholders as allowed by Pfizer guidance and sharing customer viewpoints with Pfizer as appropriate.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure compliance with all internal/external SOPs/Rules/Regulations.

  • Provide objective and scientifically sound medical information regarding Pfizer’s medicines and the disease states they treat through use of pharmacoeconomic models, outcomes tools, educational programs, Health Outcomes Projects and Evaluations (HOPEs), non-interventional studies, and collaborations

  • Appropriately prioritize the needs of the customer and of Pfizer to develop and implement objective and scientifically sound Real-World Evidence-based outcomes tools (such as HOPEs and educational programs) which identify the greatest opportunities for improving patient care, closing quality gaps, and addressing population health management

  • Serve as the Field Medical Outcomes lead for assigned customers, developing and executing a medical account plan while representing Medical Affairs, sharing insights from the customer, and identifying opportunities for collaboration to improve patient care

  • Understand the principles of study design, methodology, data analysis, and interpretation and communicate these concepts with customers

  • Appropriately engage with key stakeholders within the market, such as Quality Improvement Organizations, Advocacy Groups, Coalitions, and other medical/healthcare associations, to understand their population health priorities and identify opportunities that align with the strategic Medical objectives of Pfizer

  • Provide Medical support and guidance for HIT initiatives including initial assessment, triaging opportunities for review, assessing organizational capabilities and feasibility, and providing clinical relevance to proposed HIT methodologies

  • Analyze workflows in the context of clinical healthcare information systems to facilitate care processes to reduce care gaps, improve care efficiencies, and maximize quality and population health

  • Facilitate development of clinical content that embodies the clinical perspective while effectively using information technology to develop strategy and build innovative tools and resources

  • Provide expertise on e-data collection and planning for Field Medical colleagues

  • Work cross-functionally within Pfizer guidance to identify, design, and deploy HIT solutions aligned with Pfizer Medical goals for Field Medical use

  • Support development of HIT/clinical informatics specific resources for new product and new indication launches

  • Maintain, continually develop, and utilize Clinical Informatics capabilities to enable effective collaborations with external customers

  • Serve as members of internal teams to further the impact of Field Medical Outcomes by creating tools, resources, and educational materials for use both internally and externally

  • Represent Pfizer Medical Affairs leadership with clinical/professional associations and/or societies, consistently demonstrating medical professionalism in all interactions

  • Enhance customer recognition of Pfizer Medical through collaborative projects, publications and healthcare awards

  • Providing approved medical content on Pfizer’s products in the designated therapeutic area, with a primary focus on organized customers, including but not limited to National Payers, Regional Payers, and Specialty Pharmacy Providers (SPPs)

  • Demonstrate Pfizer Scientific Leadership by keeping abreast of medical and scientific developments in the designated therapeutic area by continuously reviewing literature in the field, evolving competitive landscape, networking with experts and attending assigned conferences

  • Respond to unsolicited requests from customers regarding scientific interpretation of clinical information and pharmacoeconomic impact of product selection to further advance formulary decision-making or patient outcomes through appropriate pharmaceutical care

  • Compliantly collaborate with internal Pfizer colleagues (including Key Account Managers, Account Directors, PHI, Field Medical, Headquarters Medical, CI, AME, and HEOR) to understand the outcomes of interest and data analysis needs of assigned customers

  • Maintain significant market and customer knowledge in an increasingly complex and dynamic marketplace

  • Manage a significant volume of projects developed in a field-based environment, while exhibiting the ability to prioritize, successfully implement, and demonstrate excellent judgment skills and work in a continuous improvement environment

  • Maintain an up-to-date status for internal training requirements

  • Conduct all activities in accordance with all relevant policies, procedures and compliance guidance

  • Educating HCOs based on patient care gaps and aligned to medical strategy with the goal of enhancing understanding of disease state and guideline-based care

  • Achieve leadership-defined expectations regarding the number of medical stakeholders engaged

  • Understand the priorities of PFE Medical Affairs in order to contribute to medical content strategy development and aligned field medical tactics

  • Provides strong territory/customer leadership

  • Serve on Medical, TA or cross-functional committees as appropriate

  • Mentorship and Onboarding partner

  • Maintain professional licensure and continually learn and grow in profession

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact

  • Bachelor’s degree in health science required

  • PharmD, PhD, or equivalent terminal doctoral degree preferred

  • Relevant experience required: 8+ years with bachelor’s degree; 7+ years with master’s degree; 5+ years with terminal doctorate degree (PharmD, PhD)

  • Experience should be in any of the following:

    • Clinical, formulary, and/or other management experience

    • Managed Care, pharmaceutical industry, and/or Quality Improvement

    • Data Analytics and/or HEOR activities, with demonstrated strong methodological skills (study design, data analysis, and interpretation) in health services research

  • Significant experience in interacting with payers and other organized customers is required

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills required

  • Excellent and demonstrated interpersonal skills: ability to understand and respond to multiple external and internal customers’ demands, manage and handle conflict constructively required

  • Breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including the ability to influence and collaborate with peers and create business impact

  • Strong analytic skills including creativity and effectiveness in proactively identifying and addressing challenges

  • Strong comprehension and communication skills, including ability to communicate large amounts of scientific information in a manner that is clear and concise

  • Well-organized with the ability to be flexible, prioritize multiple demands, and employ strong situational leadership skills

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Previous experience in field-based medical/outcomes role

  • Experience analyzing health care data (claims, electronic health records, other health care data)

  • Expertise in Clinical Informatics or Health Information Technology (HIT), including working with claims data sets or Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems

  • Residency or Fellowship experience

  • Microsoft Access, statistics software, and/or data programming experience

  • Experience in the clinical, functional, and technical application of health information technology used in the U.S

  • Experience with optimization/customization of EHR platforms, including developing EHR clinical solutions

  • Leadership in innovative project start-up and management

  • Understanding of the complex business environment within the US healthcare system as well as emerging healthcare trends

NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

  • Valid US driver’s license and driving record in compliance with company standards. Any DUI/DWI or other impaired driving citation within the past 7 years will disqualify you from being hired

  • Flexibility to travel 40-50% of time

  • Reasonable proximity to airline ‘hub’ city; must be within a 2-hour drive of a major airport

  • Ability to work on weekends occasionally (e.g. attend advisory boards and congress meetings)

  • Ability to regularly fly on airplanes (i.e. attend medical stakeholder meetings; attend HQ meetings, regional and national scientific meetings, etc.) required

  • Ability to travel, including overnight travel for internal and external meetings (customer, industry, and professional society meetings)

Other Job Details:

Territories covered and must reside in Washington, Oregon, California, Idaho, Colorado, Wyoming

title: Travel and Expense Analyst-2
description:
Position Overview

The Global Travel and Expense Analyst will play a critical role in ensuring compliance with company policies, evaluating employee travel data, and resolving travel and expense-related issues. This role focuses on data accuracy, policy compliance, ticket resolution, and providing actionable insights to drive strategic decisions. The candidate will identify trends, opportunities for policy improvements, and cost savings while collaborating with global teams to enhance processes and systems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Compliance and Policy Management

  • Ensure adherence to company policies related to reimbursable expenses, travel policies, and receipt documentation.
  • Review and analyze expense reports to confirm compliance with established guidelines and approve/reject submissions based on company policy.
  • Clearly communicate expense policies and guidelines to employees, providing support and guidance to ensure understanding and compliance.
  • Identify and track opportunities for policy enhancements based on data analysis to optimize travel costs and improve employee experience.
  • Research best practices and develop recommendations for policy updates.

2. Data Analysis and Reporting

  • Analyze travel and expense data using tools like Navan and Excel or similar databases to identify trends, anomalies, areas for improvement, and potential savings.
  • Generate reports on expense trends and compliance metrics from Navan.
  • Provide insights and recommendations to management to improve efficiency and adherence to policies.

3. Audit and Resolution

  • Conduct regular audits of expenses to detect discrepancies and ensure accuracy in reporting.
  • Investigate anomalies or issues during the audit process and develop recommendations for improvement.
  • Resolve Travel and Expense support tickets, including troubleshooting system integration errors (e.g., Navan, Workday), fixing travel booking errors, and educating end users.
  • Manage tickets end-to-end in a time-sensitive manner using tools like Zendesk.

4. Visualization and Presentation

  • Create dashboards, charts, and graphs to effectively communicate findings and tell a story about travel and expense patterns, compliance metrics, and system issues.

5. Collaboration and Implementation

  • Work closely with the Global Travel Manager and Data Analytics Team to develop accurate, data-driven dashboards that provide ongoing insights into travel and expense metrics.
  • Collaborate with the Travel team to improve system messaging and reduce ticket creation numbers.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent work experience in travel and expense auditing and support.

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in travel and expense auditing, preferably in a corporate or technology environment.

Skills and Technical Proficiency

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret multi-system data (e.g., Navan, Zendesk) and resolve issues clearly and concisely.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, including pivot tables.
  • Familiarity with travel and expense management software (e.g., Navan) and Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Strong customer service skills and the ability to take ownership of tickets and other work products in a fast-paced environment.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in a global team environment.

Personal Attributes

  • A proactive approach to work, with a strong commitment to maintaining confidentiality and compliance.

Work Environment

This role requires the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment typical of the technology sector.

Why Join Us?

Join a leading cybersecurity company that values innovation and employee development. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for professional growth.

The base salary range for this position is 384 000,00 −576 000, 00 ZAR plus benefits. This range represents the minimum and maximum new hire compensation for this role. title: Head of Global Customer Engineering - Internal EDA Infrastructure
description:

We’re hiring a hands-on engineering leader to develop our Global Customer Engineering for Internal EDA Infrastructure - the organization sitting directly between our chip designers and the platforms they run on. The Kubernetes platform team that delivers one of our customer services end to end.

You will design software solutions, and automation pipelines to eliminate operational overhead. When encountering recurring toil for customer engineering, your immediate impulse is to engineer permanent automated remedies. Staying directly connected to live production environments is essential hence the end-to-end Kubernetes platform responsibility.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Build the leaders. Grow and develop the leaders running a globally distributed team of customer-facing engineers who own the reactive support queue for EDA infrastructure - escalating into service engineering with clean, high-quality signal.

  • Develop the Kubernetes platform. Run the K8s platform team as a first-class customer engineering service: availability, roadmap, developer experience, and the operational excellence behind it.

  • Ship the L0 AI support layer. Own the evolution of our AI support agent from FAQ bot to a system that safely resolves real issues against real internal systems - and measurably removes volume from human queues.

What We Need To See:

  • 12+ overall years building and leading engineering support organizations, spanning reactive and proactive customer engineering.

  • 5+ years of experience leading a globally distributed organization, including developing managers and leaders.

  • Proven ability to influence technical roadmaps by turning support trends into engineering requirements that actually ship.

  • Deep technical familiarity with Kubernetes, EDA workloads, job schedulers, and AI/LLM infrastructure foundations.

  • Track record of leveraging automation and AI/ML to improve support efficiency and drive ticket volume down.

  • Exceptional communication skills - credible with individual engineers and executive leadership in the same day.

  • A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant engineering field or equivalent experience.

title: Recon Owner, Cash and Open Exposure within Markets
description:
Saxo Bank is seeking a dedicated, analytical, and process-oriented Recon Owner for Cash and Open Exposure within Markets to join the Recon Risk Management team.

About the Role

We are seeking a Recon Owner for Cash and Open Exposure, a newly established role designed to strengthen ownership, governance, and reporting across reconciliations covering cash balances and open exposures. The position provides independent oversight and control of operational reconciliations while ensuring strong governance standards are maintained.

You will collaborate closely with Product Owners, Network Management, the Reconciliation team, Group Finance, Operations, Markets, and IT. Together, you will ensure reconciliations are complete, accurately governed, and supported by appropriate reporting and evidence for financial and regulatory purposes.

As Recon Owner, you will be responsible for ensuring reconciliations covering cash and open exposure are implemented, monitored, and maintained across all relevant contracts, excluding client and partner reconciliations. While reconciliations are performed by the Reconciliation team in IntelliMatch, you will define requirements, monitor completeness and quality, and ensure results are reported in line with governance and business requirements.

The role requires a strong understanding of the Bank’s systems and reporting landscape to establish scalable, digital reconciliation processes aligned with contractual obligations and reporting requirements. A key objective is to enhance automation, improve control frameworks, and support internal and external financial reporting.

We have recently launched a new reconciliation completeness tool, Broker Recon, developed with AI support. Cash reconciliation is expected to be fully implemented by the end of Q3 2026, while exposure reconciliation is expected to be completed by the end of Q4 2026.

This is an excellent opportunity for a professional with 3-5 years of reconciliation experience who is looking to broaden their expertise and contribute to a forward-looking, technology-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

The Recon Owner will establish ownership, reporting, and documentation standards for cash and open exposure reconciliations while driving improvements in completeness, transparency, and auditability.

Broker Recon will become the primary platform for reconciliation controls and reporting. Until full implementation, existing tools and manual processes will remain in use.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Perform monthly reviews of reconciliation completeness, ensuring balances and exposures recorded in the general ledger can be matched to internal contracts and external reporting.
  • Prepare and distribute regular reporting on findings, exceptions, and remediation activities to stakeholders.
  • Conduct daily and weekly follow-up on aged reconciliation breaks in accordance with established procedures, including communication with custodians, counterparties, and internal stakeholders.
  • Assess and monitor the impact of reconciliation breaks on trading conditions and obtain stakeholder sign-off where required.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to ensure new products, initiatives, and agreements are correctly incorporated into the reconciliation framework.
  • Collaborate closely with IT and AI development teams to continuously improve reconciliation processes, controls, and automation capabilities.

Your Profile

We are looking for a candidate with a bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent experience gained within financial services. You have a solid understanding of financial products, reconciliations, accounting principles, and project delivery.

  • Strong written communication skills in English are essential.
  • You are comfortable working independently and collaboratively, with a structured, detail-oriented, and analytical approach to problem-solving.
  • Experience within financial services is an advantage.
  • Exposure to SQL, data analysis, technical documentation, process automation, or AI-driven solutions will be considered a strong asset.
  • Experience working with large datasets and investigating cash and exposure breaks will support success in the role.

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

title: C-UAS Operations & Training Advisor
description:
Job Title: C-UAS Operations & Training Advisor

Job Category: Intelligence

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Top Secret

Employee Type: Regular-Long Term Assignment

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 25%

Type of Travel: Continental US

* * *


The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking a resident C-UAS Operations & Training Advisor to support AFRICOM by providing theater-level Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems (C-UAS), Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD), intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR), and C5ISR operational expertise in support of U.S. Department of War and joint force requirements.

The successful candidate will serve as a senior operational advisor capable of engaging General Officers, senior military leaders, higher headquarters, and interagency partners while translating complex C-UAS and C5ISR requirements into executable operational plans, training programs, exercises, and theater-level solutions.

This position requires a combination of tactical C-UAS expertise, operational planning experience, UAS technical knowledge, instructional capability, and demonstrated understanding of military command-and-control processes. The candidate will independently develop operational documentation, advise theater organizations, lead joint forums, oversee Mobile Training Teams (MTTs), and evaluate the effectiveness of C-UAS training and operational procedures.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and facilitate joint and interagency forums, brief General Officers and senior leaders, and provide recommendations that support theater-level operational and strategic decision-making.
  • Apply comprehensive knowledge of the Military Decision-Making Process (MDMP) to develop and review operational products, including Task Orders, Concepts of Operations (CONOPs), Requests for Forces (RFFs), Requests for Support (RFSs), Execute Orders (EXORDs), and supporting planning documentation.
  • Independently analyze operational requirements and translate commander and staff guidance into executable plans, training objectives, operational assessments, and recommendations.
  • Apply a detailed understanding of the Department of War operational and organizational environment to respond to C-UAS and IAMD Requests for Information (RFIs), identify capability gaps, and develop practical solutions.
  • Advise, assess, and improve Base Defense Operations Cell (BDOC) procedures for UAS detection, identification, tracking, reporting, command and control, and centralized situational awareness.
  • Provide technical and operational instruction on the integration, establishment, employment, and sustainment of ISR collection platforms and C5ISR capabilities.
  • Develop and deliver instruction concerning adversary UAS flight profiles, including ISR, loitering, reconnaissance, one-way attack, and other emerging threat employment techniques.
  • Develop technically oriented training and exercise programs integrating UAS collection platforms, C-UAS capabilities, intelligence production, sensor employment, and reporting procedures.
  • Coordinate training and exercise activities with higher headquarters, supported commands, government organizations, external agencies, and partner organizations to ensure operational alignment and interoperability.
  • Lead, mentor, and provide operational guidance to Mobile Training Teams (MTTs) operating throughout the African Area of Responsibility.
  • Oversee MTT execution of C-UAS training, BDOC operations, Live Fire Exercises (LFX), operational assessments, and Red Air threat replication.
  • Ensure training scenarios, adversary flight profiles, and Red Air employment accurately reflect current and emerging UAS threat profiles and Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs).
  • Evaluate theater training programs and operational procedures to identify capability gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Leverage extensive tactical experience and advanced C-UAS expertise to implement continuous process and operational improvements across theater training and exercise programs.
  • Provide senior-level mentorship to trainers, planners, operators, and supporting personnel to improve technical proficiency and operational effectiveness.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging UAS technologies, adversary capabilities, C-UAS systems, ISR technologies, and changes to operational doctrine and TTPs.


Qualifications:

Required:

  • Active Top Secret security clearance.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting U.S. military operations, joint forces, or Department of War organizations.
  • Advanced understanding of C-UAS operations, UAS employment, threat profiles, and adversary TTPs.
  • Demonstrated understanding and practical application of the Military Decision-Making Process (MDMP).
  • Experience developing operational documents, including CONOPs, Task Orders, RFFs, RFSs, EXORDs, operational assessments, and briefing materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to brief and communicate effectively with senior military leadership and General Officer-level audiences.
  • Technical understanding of Group 1–3 UAS platforms, sensors, payloads, mission planning, flight operations, and supporting systems.
  • Hands-on experience instructing personnel on UAS and/or C-UAS systems and operational procedures.
  • Advanced knowledge of UAS threat device profiles, flight characteristics, employment techniques, and TTPs.
  • Experience developing and executing military training and exercises, preferably involving UAS, C-UAS, ISR, BDOC, or C5ISR capabilities.
  • Ability to independently analyze complex operational requirements and develop effective solutions with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to travel extensively throughout the African AOR and other CONUS/OCONUS locations as mission requirements dictate.
  • Active FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate for Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems.

Desired:

  • Special Operations Forces (SOF) experience.
  • Senior military leadership, staff, or operational planning experience.
  • Experience supporting Combatant Commands, Theater Army, Joint Task Forces, or Service Component Commands.
  • Experience working within air defense, IAMD, C-UAS, ISR, C5ISR, or force protection organizations.
  • Experience operating or instructing on commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) UAS platforms.
  • Experience conducting or supporting Red Air threat replication and UAS adversary emulation.
  • Experience planning and executing Live Fire Exercises (LFX), collective training events, and operational assessments.
  • Experience advising or evaluating BDOC, command-and-control, sensor integration, or centralized reporting processes.
  • Experience coordinating military training and exercises with higher headquarters, interagency organizations, coalition partners, and external agencies.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in deployed, austere, and high-tempo environments.
  • Continuous Process Improvement

-

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

title: BI Analyst
description:
OneMagnify is an AI native, platform-enabled B2B digital agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity. We help complex organizations drive measurable business outcomes by building smarter customer experiences and delivering highly integrated solutions across digital, media, and technology. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced analytics and artificial intelligence, we enable our clients to make better decisions, move faster, and compete more effectively in dynamic markets.

The Impact You’ll Have:

We are hiring a BI Analyst to own the design, build and support of Power BI reporting for business teams across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Credit, Mobility, Connected Vehicle and Warranty. The majority of the work is hands-on Power BI development on top of data in Google Cloud (BigQuery). You will work directly with business users to understand what they need, model the data properly, and deliver dashboards people actually use.

What you’ll do:

  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports and datasets end to end — requirement gathering, data model, DAX measures, visuals, publishing and support.
  • Write and tune SQL in BigQuery to prepare clean, reliable datasets for reporting.
  • Design star-schema data models and reusable, certified datasets so business teams can self-serve instead of asking for one-off reports.
  • Set up refresh schedules, gateways, workspaces, row-level security and deployment pipelines; keep report performance and query cost under control.
  • Build transformation pipelines in Dataform (or dbt-style SQL models) and schedule them; use Cloud Run / Cloud Functions for lightweight automation where needed.
  • Investigate data issues, trace them back to the source, and put basic data quality checks in place.
  • Sit with business stakeholders, translate their questions into metric definitions and specs, and document what you build.
  • Replace manual and Excel-based reporting with automated solutions.
  • Support Gen AI / Vertex AI use cases where useful — natural-language Q&A on datasets, automated summaries, Copilot features in Power BI.
  • Review work from junior analysts and help them level up.

What you’ll need:

  • 3–7 years of hands-on BI / reporting experience, with the bulk of it in Power BI (Power Query, DAX, data modelling, Power BI Service administration)/ similar tools.
  • Strong SQL — joins, aggregations, window functions, and the ability to debug a slow query.
  • Practical experience with a cloud data warehouse. GCP BigQuery preferred; Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse / Fabric or Redshift equally considered.
  • Working knowledge of ETL/ELT concepts and at least one transformation or workflow tool — Dataform, dbt, Alteryx, SAS, Dataflow or similar.
  • Understanding of dimensional modelling and how to structure data for reporting rather than just extracting it.
  • Ability to talk to non-technical stakeholders, push back sensibly, and explain numbers clearly.
  • A degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Statistics, Business Analytics or any quantitative field.

Future-Ready Skills (Nice to Have):

  • Python (pandas) for data prep or automation.
  • Vertex AI, Gen AI / LLM-assisted analytics, or Power BI Copilot exposure.
  • Tableau, Qlik Sense or Looker experience alongside Power BI.
  • Git / DevOps, CI-CD for BI artefacts, Agile ways of working.
  • Power Automate / Power Apps for workflow automation.
  • Microsoft PL-300 or Google Professional Data Engineer certification.
  • Experience in integrated marketing, digital agency, marketing services, or consulting environments preferred.

As a Unit Aide, you play an important role in supporting patient care by maintaining a clean, safe, and well-stocked environment for patients and staff. You help ensure supplies and equipment are readily available, assist with patient transport, and support the daily operations of the unit. Success in this role requires dependability, teamwork, attention to detail, and a commitment to following safety and infection prevention standards. Whether you have previous hospital experience or are eager to learn, your contributions help create a positive experience for both patients and caregivers.

Banner Baywood Medical Center is a 342 bed hospital serving the health care needs of the dynamic and growing East Valley communities of metropolitan Phoenix, Arizona. We provide complete acute care services and outpatient services to include but not limited to cancer, stroke, women's health, rehabilitation, emergency medicine and surgery. Our Emergency Department treats a variety of ailments and offers advanced treatment areas, with 68 beds, seeing over 50,000 patients per year. We are certified as pediatric prepared as well as designated as a Trauma level 3 emergency room. In addition, our comprehensive orthopedic unit is one of the nation’s premier orthopedic programs. The unit's commitment to excellent patient care has earned a 4 STAR rating by CMS and repeated recognition as having one of the Top 100 Orthopedic Programs in the U.S. by The Health Network and HCIA, Inc. Because we are also a leader in neurological medicine, people throughout Arizona come to us when they need treatment for conditions of the brain, spine and nervous system.

POSITION SUMMARY
This position is responsible for collection, inventory, cleaning and distribution of medical supplies and patient care equipment for the unit. This position is also responsible for miscellaneous tasks such as transporting patients and supplies, and may include transporting health records, lab specimens and equipment to other areas. This position may provide basic, hands-on, patient care as requested by supervisor.

CORE FUNCTIONS
1. Inventories, orders, replenishes, and disperses supplies within the department, ensuring all areas and carts are appropriately stocked and the supplies are readily accessible to the clinical staff. Assists with transportation, delivery, and pick-up of supplies, health records, lab specimens, and/or equipment. Rotates and inventories stock to ensure sterile packaging integrity and current expiration dates. Monitors utilization and recommends changes as appropriate. Maintains quality records of various department equipment, supplies, storage areas, etc.

2. Maintains unit equipment, instruments and trays in accordance with department policy. Cleans, sorts, assembles equipment, instruments and/or trays according to standard set-up and replaces in designated areas, ensuring they are readily accessible. Responsible for finding and bringing equipment or instruments for procedures, under the direction of the clinical staff. May check instruments and equipment, as assigned, to see if they need repair and liaison with technology management.

3. Maintains clean and safe work environment and discards soiled linen and trash. Completes room set-up which may include comprehensive cleaning, bed turnover and preparation of special procedure carts. Remove debris from floors, walls, equipment and other surfaces using disinfectant, damp mops etc.

4. Provides basic, hands-on, patient care as requested by supervisor, including but not limited to patient transport and ambulation.

5. May provide general support to the department, including performing administrative tasks and greeting and assisting patients, visitors, physicians, and ancillary personnel. May provide back-up support for Monitor Techs in designated departments – this will require additional specialized training provided by the department.

6. This position works under local supervision and has responsibility for assigned unit only. Incumbents work in a fast-paced, sometimes stressful environment with a strong focus on customer service. Interacts with staff at all levels throughout the facility. Customers are patients, families, physicians, unit staff, case managers, patient service staff and medical records staff. Interacts with a wide variety of external customers.

Certification for BLS is required.

Requires skills and abilities typically attained with six months of healthcare experience. Must possess excellent organizational skills, as well as effective human relations and communication skills. Working knowledge of medical terminology is required. Banner Registry and Travel positions require a minimum of one year experience in an acute care hospital setting. Experience must include working in an acute care setting within the past twelve months as a Unit Aide in the specialty area.
