title: Vice-President, Capital Markets Resource Optimization
description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit

The Vice-President, Capital Markets Resource Optimization is responsible for setting the strategic direction for the allocation, optimization, and deployment of financial and human resources across Capital Markets. The role is focused on designing and leading the quantitative analytics, optimization models, governance frameworks, and strategic decision processes that support a unified client coverage model across lines of business, industry segments, and regions.

This executive provides enterprise-level leadership in developing the analytical models, scenarios, and strategic resource allocation methodologies that enable disciplined growth, capital efficiency, and informed investment decisions. This leader oversees the frameworks used to optimize liquidity, funding, capital deployment, and workforce allocation, with the objective of maximizing return on equity (ROE), return on investment (ROI), and overall business performance. The role acts as a key strategic advisor to senior leadership, influencing business growth, client strategy, capital markets priorities, and long-term resource planning.

CIBC employee experience principles:

  • Always professional… so our team members can excel and be their best professional self.

  • Radically simple… so our team members can focus on what they need to do and make an impact.

  • Genuinely caring… so our team members can feel valued for who they are and what they contribute.

CIBC leadership capabilities:

  • Envisions the future…to innovate purposefully to create new value and harness new capabilities in order to meet the evolving needs of our diverse stakeholders.

  • Inspires hearts and minds…to build an inclusive culture where we make bold choices, collaborate, and empower others to take chances and do what’s right for our stakeholders.

  • Drives action and impact, together…to align with urgency around what matters, making decisions with speed and always making a real difference.

What You’ll be Doing

Resource Allocation, Forecasting & Decision Support:

  • Lead the development of quantitative analytics, optimization models, and strategic frameworks for allocating financial and human resources across Capital Markets.

  • Design and evolve resource allocation methodologies that support a unified and highly connected client coverage strategy across lines of business, industry segments, and regions.

  • Define and assess capital allocation trade-offs across growth investments, technology and transformation initiatives, and workforce expansion or contraction using robust analytical and optimization frameworks.

  • Monitor competitor activity, market conditions, and regulatory developments, and translate those insights into strategic implications, modeling assumptions, and resource allocation recommendations for senior stakeholders.

  • Drive the creation of decision-support capabilities that enable the business to evaluate alternatives, test scenarios, and prioritize actions with greater speed, rigor, and transparency.

  • Establish and oversee analytical tools, forecasting approaches, and scenario models to support business growth, capital markets activities, and strategic resource planning.

  • Build and enhance optimization frameworks that improve resource utilization, productivity, effectiveness, and overall business performance.

  • Develop and govern performance measurement frameworks, KPIs, and analytics dashboards to assess resource effectiveness, business outcomes, and strategic trade-offs.

  • Identify and implement enhanced quantitative allocation and optimization methodologies to improve ROE, ROI, capital efficiency, and decision quality.

Strategic Advisory, Direction & Oversight:

  • Provide strategic leadership on liquidity, funding, and balance sheet optimization frameworks, ensuring alignment with enterprise objectives and business strategy.

  • Lead the design of capital recycling strategies and portfolio optimization approaches to improve capital deployment and enhance returns.

  • Deliver strategic insights, modeling outputs, and executive recommendations to senior leadership on investment priorities, resource trade-offs, and growth opportunities.

  • Support the development of strategic direction through advanced analytics on capacity, profitability, client segmentation, investment decisions, and business performance.

  • Lead strategic discussions related to the client coverage model, resource allocation frameworks, and prioritization methodologies at the Global Deals Committee, Capital Markets Resource Allocation Committee, and SCR/Focus client determination forums.

  • Lead the development of the 5-year strategic financial, client, and workforce roadmap for Capital Markets, supported by quantitative modeling, scenario analysis, and long-range planning assumptions.

Stakeholder Management:

  • Partner with business leaders to translate growth priorities, market opportunities, and enterprise constraints into data-driven allocation strategies and decision models.

  • Collaborate with Finance, Treasury, Business Management, Risk, and Front Office stakeholders to create integrated planning models and governance processes that support coordinated decision-making.

  • Act as the key liaison with Credit Risk, Liquidity Risk, and Treasury to shape limits frameworks, balance sheet allocation approaches, and fund transfer pricing methodologies across assets and liabilities to incentivize balanced growth and alignment with strategic objectives.

Leadership & Development:

  • Provide leadership in moving the function from transactional support toward a strategic center of excellence in quantitative resource management, optimization, and portfolio decision-making.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant leadership experience in financial resource management, capital markets, finance, treasury, business management, or strategic planning.

  • In-depth understanding of the various financial resources required by Capital Markets along with an in-depth understanding of the regulatory framework.

  • Strong understanding of capital markets businesses, client coverage models, and resource deployment across complex organizations.

  • Experience in capital allocation, liquidity management, funding strategy, and performance measurement.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across business lines, segments, and geographies.

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to connect resource planning decisions to business growth and profitability.

  • Proven experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving strategic decisions in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong analytical and financial modeling capabilities, with the ability to translate complex information into actionable business recommendations.

  • University degree required with a minimum of fifteen years’ experience in a trading and resource optimization including: experience managing multiple teams, working in multiple jurisdictions (North American, Asian and European markets) with an in-depth understanding of global tax, legal and regulatory environments and familiarity with various finance structures, including but not limited to repurchase agreements, total return swaps, bond forwards, warehouse lending and structured credit loan facilities, structuring, syndication and securitization of relevant debt products.

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

  • We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

  • Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.

  • We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

*Subject to plan and program terms and conditions

What you need to know

  • CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com

  • CIBC is committed to clarity in our hiring process. All roles posted are opportunities we’re actively recruiting for, unless stated otherwise.

  • You need to be legally eligible to work at the location(s) specified above and, where applicable, must have a valid work or study permit.

  • We may ask you to complete an attribute-based assessment and other skills test (such as simulation, coding, French proficiency).

  • We use artificial intelligence tools during the recruitment process. Our goal for the application process is to get to know more about you, all that you have to offer, and give you the opportunity to learn more about us.

description:

The Opportunity:

As a CACI Sensitive Activities Advisor, you bring the full spectrum of Sensitive Activities from planning to execution, Special Programs, STO, ACCM, Information Operations, as well as friendly and adversary military and technology capabilities in direct support to the Department of War and its efforts to identify, neutralize, and/or eliminate current and emerging threats and enemy threat networks that possess and can employ Weapons of Mass Destruction.

Responsibilities:

You will embed with, advise, and provide the subject matter expertise (SME) to Combatant / Theater Commands, and special operations commands, at all echelons on effectively leveraging specially compartmented material, non-material capabilities, and information related capabilities (IRC) to eliminate or neutralize current and emerging threats and the networks that employ those threats. The advisor should have a knowledge base (or awareness of): irregular warfare, implementation of SAP/STO capabilities, Information Operations (IO), Psychological Operations, Military Deception (MILDEC), Electronic Warfare (EW), as well as Cyberspace Operations.

The advisor will be expected to be adept at comprehensive mission analysis, assessment skills, and in-depth analytic problem solving. The advisor should be innovative when employing and integrating full spectrum IRCs and information systems into PE/UW/SA; capable of integrating with the intelligence community (IC) and interagency; able to create innovative concepts in order to counter adversaries malign use of influence activities within the Information Environment (IE), while at the same time being considerate of relevant cultural aspects that could affect planning, security, required risk assessments, and the mission (including the ability to effectively integrate partner-force activities into mission analysis and execution; by, with, and through). The advisor is required to be effective in the application of technical skill sets as it applies to planning, execution, and tracking measures of performance (MOPs) through attaining measure of effectiveness (MOEs) and subsequently providing advice on the application of capabilities to address the threats.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Current Top Secret/Specialized Compartmented Information Security Clearance, willingness to submit to a Poly.
  • More than three years of specialized experience in military or IC compartmented or sensitive activities (IJSTO, SAP, ACCM, etc.).
  • Be deployable to the required theater of operations, usually conducting periodic travel within CONUS and six-month deployments to OCONUS locations.
  • You must possess the ability to effectively communicate both orally and in writing.
  • You will be able to provide daily feedback to the team lead and supported unit on product development.

  • Associates degree and five years of experience or seven years of relevant work experience.

  • Experience and in-depth knowledge of the Military Decision Making Process (MDMP), to include mission analysis, COA development and CONOP approval briefings, D3A execution matrices, CONOP documents and FRAGOs.
  • Must be able to work independently with some government oversight and function effectively as part of a team in a joint working environment.
  • Previous assignment in a G/J-3 X

  • Information Operations Planners Course

title: Power Analysis and Optimization Intern - 2027
description:
NVIDIA is committed not only to delivering outstanding chip performance, but also to improving power efficiency across every product. Performance per watt is critical to our success. The Power Analysis and Optimization team helps IP teams define power targets for architectural changes and new features, identify power-saving opportunities throughout the ASIC design process—from architecture definition through place and route—and resolve power issues that could affect functionality or performance.

As an intern, you will gain hands-on experience in ASIC power analysis, modeling, optimization, and automation while contributing to more energy-efficient NVIDIA products.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Support the development of IP-level power models for early power estimation of architectural changes and new features.

  • Assist IP teams in analyzing power consumption across different workloads and application scenarios.

  • Use internally developed flows and industry-standard tools to perform power analysis and identify optimization opportunities.

  • Work with design teams to evaluate proposed power optimizations.

  • Develop scripts and automation flow to improve the work efficiency.

What we need to see:

  • Currently pursuing a BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Basic understanding of digital circuit design, computer architecture, or ASIC design methodology.

  • Familiarity with power consumption concepts and common low-power design techniques.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative engineering environment.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Coursework or project experience in RTL design, synthesis, physical design, or computer architecture.

  • Familiarity with power-analysis tools such as PrimeTime PX or PowerArtist.

  • Experience with power modeling, workload analysis, or low-power design.

  • Experience building or integrating AI agents/skills.

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology industry’s most desirable employers, bringing together some of the world’s most talented and innovative people. Are you creative, analytical, and eager to improve the power efficiency of cutting-edge GPU and SoC designs? Do you enjoy understanding complex architectures, analyzing power behavior, and finding opportunities to improve performance per watt? If so, we want to hear from you.

Join Cleveland Clinic Weston Hospital’s team of caregivers that remain on the leading edge of technology and education all while consistently providing patient-centered healthcare. As part of Cleveland Clinic’s Florida region, Weston Hospital is recognized as one of the top hospitals in the Miami-Fort Lauderdale metro area and Florida. Here, you will work alongside passionate and dedicated caregivers, receive endless support and appreciation, and build a rewarding career with one of the most respected healthcare organizations in the world.

Our goal of delivering exceptional services and care goes far beyond the clinical setting. We also have a responsibility to keep our patients, visitors, caregivers, and staff safe and secure. As a Communication Services Telecommunication Operator, you’ll play an essential role in this mission by providing quick and accurate processing of all telecommunications needs. You will answer all incoming phone calls on a multi-function phone system, responding to general inquiries and calls for emergency requests, suspicious persons, medical emergencies, suicides, bomb threats, and other crisis calls. In this role, you will be able to enhance your customer service and communication skills while being a part of a growing healthcare organization.

A caregiver in this position works 7:00AM - 4:00PM. The Call Center operates Monday-Friday, 24/7, and 5:30AM – 9:00PM on weekends. Availability to work 1-2 weekend days and potentially one weekday is required.

title: AI Researcher - Skin Bioscience Discovery Accelerator
description:
Job Location

SINGAPORE TC-BIOPOLIS

Job Description

Overview of role

Skin and scalp science lies at the heart of P&G's mission to improve lives through superior everyday experiences. Few areas of biology influence human health, wellbeing, confidence, and self-expression as profoundly or as continuously across the lifespan. From protecting the delicate skin barrier of infants, to helping adolescents navigate the biological transitions of puberty, to supporting the grooming, shaving, body and personal care needs of adults, P&G technologies touch billions of consumers every day.

Throughout life, consumers face evolving skin and scalp challenges, including dandruff and scalp irritation, hair thinning and loss, menopause-related changes, skin aging, and the pursuit of healthy longevity. Emerging consumer trends and transformative interventions, including GLP-1 therapies, hair transplantation, and other rapidly evolving health and aesthetic solutions, are creating entirely new scientific questions and unmet needs that demand deeper biological understanding and breakthrough innovation.

The launch of the Skin Bioscience Discovery Accelerator (SBDA) at the P&G Singapore Innovation Center (SgIC) represents a bold commitment to shape the future of skin and scalp science. By integrating advanced human biology, multimodal data generation, next-generation experimental platforms, and AI-powered discovery, the Accelerator will create a new model for scientific innovation where biological performance becomes measurable, predictable, and actionable. We are seeking exceptional researchers who are driven to push the boundaries of discovery and transform breakthrough science into meaningful consumer impact.

This is a unique opportunity to tackle some of the most important unanswered questions in skin and scalp biology, work at the convergence of biology and artificial intelligence, and help pioneer the next generation of technologies that improve health, wellness, confidence, and quality of life for billions of consumers worldwide. Join us in building the future of skin and scalp science and redefining what is possible across the human healthspan.

Your team

Located at the P&G Singapore Innovation Center at Biopolis, you will report to a R&D Director or Senior Scientist Manager and will be part of growing team of functional and technical experts in leading projects in the region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and apply AI-driven approaches to accelerate biological discovery, integrating multimodal datasets to generate predictive scientific insights.

  • Develop and improve Design-Build-Test-Learn (DBTL) workflows that connect biological understanding, data generation, modeling, and experimental validation.

  • Analyze large-scale biological datasets including imaging, omics, phenotypic, screening, and experimental data to identify patterns, generate hypotheses, and guide decision-making.

  • Collaborate closely with experimental scientists and technology teams to translate biological questions into computational frameworks and model-driven discovery experiments.

  • Contribute to the development of the Skin Bioscience Discovery Accelerator's AI-enabled discovery platform, helping create next-generation capabilities for autonomous and predictive scientific research.

Job Qualifications

  • Diploma in Applied AI or related field with experience in Applied AI

  • 3-5 years relevant experience in AI for (Life) Science and modeling of biological systems

  • Experience in skin and hair follicle biology preferred

  • Passion for experimentation, invention, and solving difficult technical problems

  • Strong scientific method and technical rigor, with the ability to design, execute, and interpret experiments independently

  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and the ability to connect observations to technical insights and next steps

About us

We produce globally recognized brands and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head & Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.

Visit http://www.pg.com to know more.

Our consumers are diverse and our talents - internally - mirror this diversity to best serve it. That is why we’re committed to building a winning culture based on Inclusion and our ideal candidate is passionate about the same principle: you will join our daily effort of being “in touch” so we craft brands and products to improve the lives of the world’s consumers now and in the future. We want you to inspire us with your unrivaled ideas.

title: Director, Enterprise Quality Programs
description:
Title:

Director, Enterprise Quality Programs

The Enterprise Director of Quality Programs is a strategic enterprise leader responsible for developing, implementing, governing, and continuously improving the organization's global quality management framework across domestic and international operations. This role supports a diverse portfolio of government, defense, aerospace, engineering, technology, and mission support contracts by ensuring quality programs align with business objectives, customer expectations, contractual obligations, and regulatory requirements.

The Director provides leadership to assigned and matrixed quality professionals while partnering with business unit leaders, program managers, functional organizations, and executive leadership to foster a culture of quality, operational excellence, accountability, customer focus, risk-based decision making, and continuous improvement. The successful candidate will establish enterprise quality strategies, policies, governance processes, standards, and performance measures that support compliance with ISO 9001, AS9100, CMMI, customer-specific requirements, and other applicable regulatory frameworks.

This role requires exceptional strategic thinking, executive presence, organizational agility, and cross-functional leadership to influence stakeholders across multiple business units and geographic regions while balancing corporate governance with operational effectiveness.

Trinzic is being established as an independent public company through the planned separation of KBR's Mission Technology Solutions business, which is expected to be completed on January 4, 2027. This role offers a rare opportunity to join the organization during a pivotal period of growth and transformation, helping build and advance enterprise quality, compliance, and continuous improvement capabilities that will position the company for long-term success while serving critical government and commercial missions around the world.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Quality Leadership

  • Develop and execute the enterprise quality vision, strategy, roadmap, and operating model in alignment with corporate objectives and growth initiatives.
  • Establish enterprise-wide quality goals, governance mechanisms, and performance expectations that support business results and customer success.
  • Lead the design, implementation, and continual improvement of the corporate Quality Management System (QMS).
  • Serve as the senior advisor to executive leadership on quality performance, compliance risks, process maturity, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Promote a culture of quality excellence, accountability, customer-focused decision making, and continuous improvement across the enterprise.

Governance, Compliance & Regulatory Excellence

  • Establish and maintain enterprise quality policies, standards, procedures, controls, and governance frameworks.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable quality and regulatory requirements, including ISO 9001, AS9100, CMMI, customer-specific standards, government contracting requirements, and applicable international frameworks.
  • Lead enterprise readiness activities for certification audits, surveillance audits, recertifications, customer assessments, and regulatory reviews.
  • Direct corrective and preventive action programs arising from audits, assessments, customer findings, or internal evaluations.
  • Monitor emerging industry standards and regulatory developments and ensure timely integration into enterprise processes and governance structures.

Business Partnership & Operational Integration

  • Partner with business unit leadership, program management offices, and functional organizations to deploy enterprise quality initiatives and standards.
  • Provide strategic quality leadership and consultation across government and commercial programs.
  • Balance enterprise standardization with operational flexibility to support diverse customer and business requirements.
  • Build strong stakeholder relationships and influence decision-making across matrixed and geographically dispersed organizations.

Performance Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and oversee enterprise quality metrics, dashboards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and leading performance indicators.
  • Analyze enterprise quality trends and provide actionable insights to executive leadership.
  • Drive data-informed improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance, strengthen compliance, and reduce business risk.
  • Champion Lean, Six Sigma, process optimization, and operational excellence methodologies across the organization.
  • Advance process maturity, corrective action effectiveness, and enterprise performance improvement initiatives.

Risk Management & Customer Satisfaction

  • Integrate quality and compliance principles into enterprise risk management processes.
  • Evaluate quality-related risks associated with programs, operations, suppliers, and strategic business initiatives.
  • Partner with business leaders to improve customer outcomes, contract performance, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Ensure timely resolution of quality concerns and strengthen customer confidence through proactive engagement and governance.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop assigned quality professionals and matrixed teams.
  • Build organizational capability through training, coaching, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing work environment.
  • Strengthen enterprise quality capability by promoting professional development, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.

Basic Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Business Administration, Industrial Management, Operations Management, or a related field.
  • 12-15+ years of progressive experience in quality management, compliance, operational excellence, process improvement, or related disciplines.
  • 7+ years of leadership experience managing quality programs, teams, and enterprise initiatives within complex, multi-site organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting government, defense, aerospace, engineering, technology, or mission-focused organizations.
  • Experience managing enterprise quality systems across multiple business units, functions, and geographic regions.
  • Proven success leading quality transformation initiatives, compliance programs, audit readiness efforts, and enterprise process improvement initiatives.

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep expertise in ISO 9001, AS9100, CMMI, and enterprise quality management systems.
  • Strong knowledge of government contracting environments and customer quality requirements.
  • Advanced understanding of quality auditing methodologies, root cause analysis, corrective action management, and process governance.
  • Expertise in risk management, performance measurement, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence methodologies.

title: GRC Engineer (Special Programs)
description:
Get to know the Special Programs Team

The Special Programs team delivers high-impact, fast-paced services that help organizations accelerate their compliance journey. Unlike our standard offerings, Special Programs are purpose-built engagements designed to solve specific customer challenges, from establishing a compliance foundation in 30 days to migrating organizations onto new GRC platforms, supporting audits, and delivering other specialized compliance services.

Workstreet is seeking a highly motivated, client-focused GRC Engineer to join our fast-growing team. Built around client relationship excellence, this role focuses on delivering exceptional client experiences, cultivating trust, and driving program outcomes while managing accounts and overseeing a pod of analysts across frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF.

The successful candidate will integrate quickly into the organization and manage active client accounts within their first 15 days. Who you are

  • Direct client engagement operator - proven ability to communicate directly with U.S. clients, maintaining professionalism and executive care across all touchpoints.
  • Multi-project GRC operator - bring strong organizational discipline to manage multiple cybersecurity compliance engagements simultaneously without losing velocity.
  • Technical compliance practitioner - hands-on execution experience across SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST CSF frameworks within tech-focused cybersecurity environments.

title: Value Chain Designer
description:
Career Area:

Engineering

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

As a Value Chain Designer, you'll help shape how products move from concept to customer across a global enterprise. You'll work closely with stakeholders across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Engineering, Purchasing, Operations, and Quality to tackle complex challenges, optimize processes, and drive meaningful improvements in cost, quality, delivery, and customer outcomes.

In this highly visible role, you'll develop value-stream models, uncover opportunities for improvement, and lead initiatives that improve cost, quality, delivery, and customer outcomes. Many of the challenges you'll tackle span multiple functions, requiring someone who can connect people, processes, and data to solve complex business problems. If you enjoy influencing change, driving continuous improvement, and seeing the measurable impact of your work, this role offers exceptional exposure and opportunity.

What makes this role exciting:

Few roles offer the breadth of exposure and business impact of a Value Chain Designer. Acting as a strategic connector across the organization, you'll solve complex challenges that often exist between functions, bringing structure, process discipline, and analytical rigor to drive meaningful results.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding how the entire business operates, not just a single function. You'll move between technical and commercial discussions, uncover root causes, and influence decisions that improve end-to-end performance. With a constant variety of projects and opportunities to learn, you'll build broad business knowledge while helping shape the future of the value chain.

What you will do:

Business Process Design & Value Chain Optimization

  • Design and implement new business processes and enhancements to existing processes to improve end-to-end value chain performance.

  • Develop current-state and future-state network value-stream models.

  • Evaluate value chain workflows and identify opportunities to improve operational effectiveness.

  • Document process flows, dependencies, decision points, and organizational handoffs.

  • Develop sustainable solutions that improve process performance across multiple business functions.

Root Cause Analysis & Problem Resolution

  • Investigate complex operational, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, and process-related challenges.

  • Apply structured problem-solving methodologies to identify underlying causes of performance gaps.

  • Conduct root cause investigations and recommend corrective actions.

  • Analyze operational data to uncover patterns, risks, constraints, and improvement opportunities.

  • Support implementation of sustainable solutions that prevent recurrence of issues.

title: Partner Activation & Aquisition Officer

As an organization built on diversity, our team members are representative of the students we support.


Partner Acquisition & Activation Officer

We’re seeking an energetic and determined Partner Acquisition & Activation Officer to accelerate ApplyBoard’s growth through strategic partnerships and seamless onboarding. As a pivotal member of our team, you’ll identify and recruit high-potential recruitment agents (RPs) and shepherd them into the ApplyBoard network, turning potential into measurable impact every day.

ApplyBoard empowers students around the world to access international education. title: Senior Software Engineer, GNN
description:
NVIDIA is seeking a highly experienced and passionate Senior Software Engineer to join a team building large-scale machine learning solutions, including Graph Neural Networks, Tabular Foundation Models, and ensemble models. This role is critical to accelerating PyTorch-based frameworks and supporting user-facing tools that power NVIDIA’s cutting-edge data science solutions. The team works at the intersection of high-performance computing, GPU acceleration, machine learning infrastructure, and customer-facing software. This is an opportunity to shape efficient training and inference workflows for advanced machine learning models running on NVIDIA GPU infrastructure. If you are passionate about building high-performance software and enabling customers to solve complex data science problems at scale, we would love to hear from you. NVIDIA teams work on some of the world’s most ambitious computing problems, helping organizations adopt AI technologies that enable faster, smarter decisions.

What you’ll be doing

  • Develop accelerated, PyTorch-based solutions for large-scale machine learning models, including GNNs, TFMs, and ensemble models, with a focus on efficient training and inference on GPU infrastructure

  • Support CUDA-X Libraries and integrations used in PyTorch-based, large-scale machine learning workflows

  • Partner with developers, product managers, and scientists to develop innovative GNN models and GPU-accelerated implementations for model development and prediction phases

  • Develop solutions that help customers adopt NVIDIA hardware and software, and gather technical requirements directly from customers and Solutions Architects to guide product and engineering priorities

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers across the team

  • Identify opportunities to improve the codebase and reduce code-maintenance overhead through re-architecture

  • Apply agentic coding tools to identify and fix bugs, implement new features, and refactor code

  • Solve complex technical issues, explain solutions clearly, exercise technical leadership, and coordinate across multiple teams to achieve shared objectives

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) plus 5 or more years of relevant experience in large-scale machine learning, deep learning, and general data science; or a Master’s degree or PhD plus 3 or more years of relevant experience

  • 3 or more years of experience with PyTorch

  • 2 or more years of experience training enterprise-scale machine learning models across distributed infrastructure

  • 2 or more years of experience designing and operating efficient training and inference workflows on GPU infrastructure, including profiling, scaling, orchestration, and resource utilization

  • Excellent C++ programming and software design skills

  • Proven experience developing, debugging, and optimizing high-performance applications, preferably with GPU acceleration using CUDA

  • Strong collaboration, communication, and documentation habits

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience developing or deploying Graph Neural Network solutions using PyTorch Geometric, or a similar framework

  • Experience working with data warehouse and lakehouse platforms, such as Snowflake or Databricks

  • Experience in two or more of the following domains: finance, cybersecurity, government or national laboratories, and retail

  • Strong understanding of system architecture, CPU, GPU, memory, and storage systems, as well as performance optimization

  • Experience with customer engagement and technical support, particularly for data science workflows and with vector search and storage solutions, such as FAISS or Milvus

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us. If you are creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you.

As a Senior Supervisor, Compensation Administration, you will provide specialized operational knowledge and guidance to Volumes & Commission department staff consisting of ten administrative staff performing a range of clerical and accounting adjustments each month. You will ensure the ongoing operation of the department is performing effectively and efficiently, meeting all month-end deadlines. General responsibilities include reviewing work of administrative staff, coordinating work-flow processes, providing knowledge and guidance for commission related issues and projects (for Clients, Finance and Technology). Investigation is typically required to complete the work and an in-depth knowledge of CIBC World Markets policy is preferred.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You’ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 1-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote. Details on your work arrangement (proportion of on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

The expected annualized base salary range for this role is $66,090 to $85,550.

The base salary is determined by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s skills, experience, and job-related knowledge, as well as geographic location and specific business needs. Our compensation philosophy supports ongoing growth and development, enabling progression within the salary range as team members advance in their roles.

In addition to base pay, compensation for this role includes participation in an annual discretionary incentive or bonus program.

We are committed to providing fair, equitable, and competitive compensation opportunities for all employees and we encourage open conversations about compensation throughout the recruitment process.

How you’ll succeed

  • Provide operational leadership and coaching – Act as the team’s senior point of contact by providing day-to-day guidance, coaching, and specialized knowledge on commission-related processes, accounting adjustments, and issue resolution. Support colleagues in resolving complex matters while helping ensure work is completed accurately and on time.
  • Strengthen processes, controls, and reporting – Support the effective execution of procedures and controls related to commission processing, reconciliations, financial journals, reporting, and attestations. Help identify gaps, investigate variances, and promote compliance with audit, SOX, and business continuity requirements.
  • Lead complex issue resolution and stakeholder support – Investigate/solve commission-related inquiries, General Ledger impacts, and technical issues, and provide guidance on escalations, projects, and business initiatives involving partners across Finance, Technology, and the business.
  • Drive continuous improvement – Identify opportunities to improve workflows, enhance efficiency, and support implementation of process or system changes. Contribute to projects, testing, and issue analysis to help improve operational effectiveness.

Who you are

  • You are driven by operational excellence. You are highly organized, adaptable, and resourceful in managing competing priorities, changing demands, and tight timelines while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and service.
  • You lead through expertise and influence. You provide coaching, guidance, and support to others through strong knowledge, sound judgment, and collaboration.
  • You are technically capable. You have strong Access and Excel skills, experience working with data, reporting, and the ability to communicate detailed information clearly and effectively.
  • You bring strong operational experience in commission processing, payroll specialization, accounting operations, and complex reconciliations, supported by knowledge of Broadridge (ADP/PostEdge), General Ledger accounts (SAP), accounting practices, financial controls, and the brokerage and regulatory environment, with a strong focus on compliance, governance, and risk management.

  • Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work, and you live our values - trust, teamwork, and accountability.

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

title: Kiertävä siivooja Turun alueelle
description:
Sijainti: Turku

Työsuhde: Vakituinen, osa-aikainen 32 h/ viikko

Palkka: Kiinteistöpalvelualan TES pl 2(12,59€/h) + mahdolliset lisät

Aloitus: Sopimuksen mukaan

Työskentelyaika/ työvuorot: Vaihtelevasti ma-su klo 5.30-22.30 välisenä aikana



Kurkistus tulevaan työpäivääsi/ työrooliisi


Liity joukkoomme siivoojaksi – yhdessä rakennamme toimivampaa huomista!

Tykkäätkö siitä, että jälkesi näkyy heti? Haluatko tehdä työtä, jossa ei tarvitse istua paikallaan, vaan saa liikkua ja pitää paikat kunnossa? Hyvä, me etsimme juuri sinua!

Siivoojana pääset huolehtimaan asiakaskohteidemme siisteydestä vaihtelevissa kohteissa Turun alueella. Kohteinasi voivat olla niin toimistot, rappukäytävät kuin hoivakohteetkin, joten toivomme sinun olevan reippaalla ja joustavalla asenteella varustettu tekijä!

Aikaisempi kokemus ja koulutus katsotaan eduksi joidenkin asiakaskohteiden luonteen vuoksi. Homma on vaihtelevaa ja liikkuvaa, joten B-ajokortti, oman auton käyttömahdollisuus sekä hyvä fyysinen kunto ovat tässä tehtävässä hyödyksi.

Työsuhde solmitaan osa-aikaisena ja vakituisena, jossa työtunteja kertyy 32 h viikossa. Työvuorot sovitaan erikseen, ja työvuorot vaihtelee ma-su välillä aamu sekä iltavuoroissa.


Hae nyt ja tule mukaan tekemään pintaa syvempi vaikutus!



Mitä työssämenestyminen edellyttää?

Positiivista työotetta ja asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä


Aiempaa kokemusta siivoustyöstä tai alan koulutus eduksi


Sujuvaasuomenkielentaitoa(Fluency in Finnish is a requirement for this position)
* Ajokortti ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuus
* Valmiutta työskennellä viikonloppuisin ja iltaisin




MiksiLuotealletöihin?

MeLuoteallapidämme aidosti huolta työntekijöistämme ja haluamme, että viihdyt ja voit hyvin joka päivä. Saat meistä rinnallesi luotettavan ja luotsaavan suomalaisen työnantajan, joka toimii vastuullisesti, pitää lupauksensa sekä huolen siitä, että palkanmaksusi on ajallaan.Perehdytämme sinut huolella työsuhteen käytäntöihin ja työtehtäviisi, sekä erikseen jokaiseen kohteeseen, jossa työskentelet. Käyttöösi saat asianmukaiset ja modernit työvarusteet. Meillä et jää yksin, vaan sinulla on aina saatavilla esihenkilösi tuki.


Osaavat työntekijät ovat meille tärkeä voimavara ja kannustamme henkilöstöämme osaamisen kehittämiseen ja kouluttautumiseen. Meillä työskentelevillä on mahdollisuus kehittää omaa ammattitaitoaan esimerkiksi suorittamalla ammattitutkinto tai sen osia. Meillä saat myös työterveyshuollon tuen, joka tuo turvaa arkeen. Päätoimisille (20 h/vko tai enemmän) tarjoamme laajemmat palvelut ja osa-aikaisille (alle 20 h/vko) tarjoamme hoitajan sairausvastaanoton. Yli 20 tuntia viikossa työskentelevillä on lisäksi kattava sairaskassa lääkkeisiin, silmälaseihin ja lääkärikäynteihin.



Miten haet meille?

Hakemukset kulkevat meillä vain hakulomakkeen kautta: näin varmistamme reilun pelin ja tietosuojan. Klikkaa itsesi hae -painikkeen kautta hakulomakkeelle ja kerro meille, mikä tekisi sinusta meille sopivan työntekijän.



Miten rekrytointi etenee?

Hakuaika tehtävään päättyy 30.9.2026., mutta käsittelemme hakemuksia ja etenemme rekrytointiprosessissa jo hakuajan aikana, joten kannattaa toimia nopeasti.Kun rekrytointi etenee seuraaviin vaiheisiin, otamme sinuun yhteyttä joko puhelimitse tai sähköpostitse. Varmuuden vuoksi kannattaa tarkistaa ajoittain myös roskaposti.

Jos jokin mietityttää, laita viestiärekry@luotea.com.Psst! Muista liittää viestiisi haun viisinumeroinen pyynnön tunnus (löytyy ilmoituksen yläreunasta).



Pintaa syvemmälle –Luotea



https://www.luotea.com/fi/

title: Custom SOC IP Verification Engineer
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Custom SOC/IP Verification Engineer to verify the next generation SoC and IP solutions! We are looking for special individuals with desire to deliver innovative products. Together, we will build the next generation of life changing custom SOCs! If you are a motivated individual that understands how complex SOC and IPs are built, has intimate knowledge of client requirements, and understand various development cycles, this is your place to be. This role specifically requires a skilled ASIC Verification Engineer with expertise in fabric and interconnect verification, spanning both IP and SoC integration. You will play a key role in verifying the correctness, performance, and compliance of on-chip fabrics and interconnect subsystems — from IP bring-up through full chip integration — ensuring robust and high-performance connectivity across complex SoC designs. This position demands a motivated individual who understands how complex SOCs and IPs are built, has intimate knowledge of client requirements, and comprehends various development cycles. It requires deep knowledge of SystemVerilog and UVM, along with a solid grasp of ASIC verification methodologies.

What you'll be doing:

  • Responsible for ASIC design verification of fabric and interconnect IP blocks as well as full chip integration, covering DMA, routing, arbitration, ordering, flow control, and protocol compliance.

  • Develop and implement test plans for fabric and interconnect verification of SoCs using UVM-based environments, targeting both IP-level and system-level scenarios.

  • Design and implement constrained-random and directed SystemVerilog testbenches targeting interconnect fabrics, network-on-chip (NoC) topologies, and multi-agent SoC integrations.

  • Collaborate extensively with Architecture, SW/FW, Design, Modeling, Emulation, and Post-Silicon Validation teams to ensure comprehensive first-time right verification plans and execution.

  • Drive the development of silicon and platform verification strategies and methodologies for fabric and interconnect subsystems.

What we need to see:

  • B.S. or M.S. degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 8+ years of experience in ASIC verification, with a strong focus on fabric, interconnect, or network-on-chip verification at both IP and full chip levels.

  • Strong knowledge of SystemVerilog and UVM methodology.

  • Hands-on experience with industry-standard interconnect and bus protocols (e.g., AMBA AXI, CHI, or equivalent), with solid understanding of ordering, coherency, and flow control semantics.

  • Familiarity with SoC architectures, NoC topologies, and multi-initiator/multi-target interconnect designs.

  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, Perl, TCL).

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Knowledge of performance verification and bandwidth/latency analysis for interconnect fabrics.

  • Exposure to verification IPs for bus protocols, or emulation platforms (e.g., Palladium, Veloce) for full chip fabric validation.

  • Experience in GPU or AI accelerator SoC interconnect verification is desirable.

  • Experience with formal verification or assertion-based verification (SVA) applied to fabric and protocol properties.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 264,500 USD for Level 4, and 196,000 USD - 310,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 19, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Business Account Specialist- SMB
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

As an Business Account Specialist- SMB , you will be part of the Business Markets Inside Base Management Team. Your responsibilities will include making proactive outbound calls to Verizon's small business customers. You will ensure their accounts are in good standing and provide them with the latest offers, plans, and services available.

What you’ll be doing...

You will operate in a technically advanced ecosystem where AI-driven insights prioritize your workflow, ensuring you spend your time on the interactions that matter most. Your day-to-day will be focused on delivering a world-class customer experience to delight our customers.

  • Welcome & Onboarding: verifying products, positioning value-added services, and ensuring a seamless new customer experience. Expertly guide customers through their first bill, confidently explaining complex charges like proration, one-time activation fees, and device promotion timelines to eliminate "bill shock." Actively prospect within existing customer accounts for new business needs, employee hires, and referrals during these interactions.

  • Base Management Outbound: Execute curated campaigns and the outbound base offer strategy—determined by Marketing—for strategic upgrades, plan migrations, and special product and service offers. Actively prospect and qualify existing customers for new business needs, employee hires, and referrals during these interactions.

  • Value Reinforcement & Right-Sizing: You must be well-versed in Verizon's product catalog (including FWA and OneTalk) to right-size accounts, add necessary features organically when requested by the customer, and explain the value of free resources like the Small Business Digital Ready program.

What we’re looking for...

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Prospecting & Opportunity Generation: Active Business Identification: The ability to move beyond the primary call objective (onboarding, offer execution) to actively identify and uncover secondary opportunities, such as new business needs, potential employee hires for the customer's business, and referral leads for new accounts. This requires a questioning and consultative mindset

  • Speaking Over the Phone & Value Reinforcement: Product & Solution Fluency: Must be well-versed in the entire Verizon product catalog, including FWA and OneTalk, to "right-size" accounts, organically add necessary features, and clearly explain the value of free resources like the Small Business Digital Ready program. This ensures every conversation is productive, not just transactional.

  • Winning the First 60 Seconds (Building Trust & Authority): Expert-Level Billing Acumen & Clarity: The confidence and knowledge to immediately analyze and articulate complex financial details. This is crucial for Welcome & Onboarding, where the representative must expertly guide customers through their first bill, confidently explaining complex charges like proration, one-time activation fees, and device promotion timelines to eliminate "bill shock proactively.

  • De-escalation & Empathy: Interpersonal De-escalation: The strength to handle immediate customer frustration—especially regarding billing—and to use strong interpersonal skills to transform a potentially negative interaction ("bill shock") into a "moment of delight," which immediately establishes a positive foundation for the business relationship.

  • System Navigation: The ability to smoothly "swivel-chair" and operate across multiple platforms simultaneously. While not a direct customer-facing skill, efficiency prevents friction, allowing the representative to focus entirely on the customer and maintain call momentum during the critical first minutes.

You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or one or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • Customer service experience

  • Business-to-business sales experience and business acumen

  • Experience handling inbound and outbound customer calls

  • Ability to work effectively as a team player and independently in a hybrid work environment

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits and Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. title: Continuous Improvement Coordinator - 1st shift, $22.81 hourly
description:
Continuous Improvement Coordinator - 1st shift, $22.81 hourly

Position Summary:

This position is responsible for supporting the transition to Lean/SPS Manufacturing at the facility level. Primary responsibility is to ensure there is an effective transformation from traditional batch manufacturing to Lean/SPS Manufacturing by removing waste from the value stream and improving throughput to develop the future state value stream map for the facility. The Continuous Improvement Coordinator will coordinate these activities with the Continuous Improvement Manager.

Essential Functions:

· Support initiatives that integrate Lean/SPS throughout the facility, using continuous improvement (CI) tools such as; kaizen events, 5S, Six-Sigma, “standard work”, OEE, mistake proofing, etc. to reduce waste, optimize capital assets and improving throughput.

· Contribute to the manufacturing facility to achieve productivity, inventory, quality, throughput, space and safety objectives established for the facility.

· Support the 5S process within the facility.

· Support the training and education plan facility wide to ensure associates possess the knowledge and skill required to implement and maintain Lean/SPS efforts

· Continuously perform all required tasks in a safe manner, adhering to all established safety rules and procedures. Must take immediate action to correct and/or report any unsafe conditions and hazards.

· Take an active role in caring for the equipment to prevent breakdowns and defects and help increase overall equipment efficiency through 5S, TPM (total productive maintenance), and other Lean Manufacturing initiatives directed by the Sedalia site.

· The CI Coordinator will be required to meet satisfactory performance requirements as determined by the Manager.

· Additional responsibilities include good housekeeping and other assignments as directed by the Manager.

· The employee shall be able to work overtime as requested and posted by management.

Specific Duties:

· Support kaizen event leaders

· Implement effective visual manufacturing boards throughout the facility.

· Perform 5S audits to ensure gains are made and to sustain improvements

· Sustain gains implemented through kaizen events.

· Function as a change agent.

· Ensure “standard work” is vigorously implemented using straightforward work instructions to sustain the improvements

· Support the follow-up efforts established from Kaizen events

· All other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

· Two years minimum experience in manufacturing environment

· Strong quantitative and analytical skills

· Excellent communication skills (oral and written)

· Basic skills in Microsoft Office programs.

· Ability to develop valuable process maps.

· Ability to manage assigned projects

· Willingness to take risks on solutions and decisions

· Strong interpersonal skills and ability to effectively facilitate and communicate at all levels of the organization.

· Must be results oriented, energetic, proactive, a team player, with the ability to think conceptually and strategically

· Ability to effectively present information to varying groups of associates.

Physical Requirements:

· Must have normal field of vision

· Must be capable of lifting 30 lbs.

· Must have vision corrected to 20/20

· Capable of effective written and oral communication

· Ability to distinguish color differences.

· Second and third shift support may be required.

· Ability to read instructions represented in manuals, drawings, schematics etc. and follow them with precision

· FT/ Walkie Certification

· Experience and ability in using hand tools

Dimensions:

· Communications

title: Overnight Supervisor, Rooms Division
description:
At Thompson Dallas, we believe hospitality is personal. Located within The National in the heart of Downtown Dallas, Thompson Dallas blends striking design, exceptional dining, and a vibrant social atmosphere to create experiences that are distinctly local and unmistakably Thompson.

Our hotel features 219 thoughtfully designed guestrooms, including 52 suites, signature dining experiences, more than 20,000 square feet of event space, a resort-style pool, spa, and curated experiences that connect guests to the energy and culture of Dallas.

We are seeking an Overnight Supervisor to support our Rooms Division by providing operational leadership and hands-on support across Front Office and Housekeeping. This role will also serve as a liaison and trusted partner to other hotel departments, including Engineering and Security, facilitating clear communication and coordinated follow-through to support seamless operations and exceptional guest experiences.

The Overnight Supervisor will oversee the Front Office and evening Housekeeping teams during assigned shifts, ensuring that service is timely, professional, and in compliance with hotel standards. This is an excellent development opportunity for a hospitality professional who is ready to expand their experience, take on greater responsibility, and grow into broader Rooms Division leadership. The position is both operational and hands-on, with the expectation that the Overnight Supervisor will provide coverage and direct support in Front Office and Housekeeping as needed.

Schedule

  • Shifts will generally be 8.5 hours in duration, starting anywhere between 7 pm until 11 pm typically from Tuesday through Saturday, based on operational needs.
  • Schedule requirements may vary and evolve based on hotel occupancy, events, weekends, holidays, and other business needs.

What You’ll Do

· Serve as the primary Rooms Division point of contact during assigned evening and overnight shifts, providing operational leadership and hands-on support across Front Office and Housekeeping.

· Supervise, train, coach, and support Front Office and Housekeeping colleagues, including directing daily work, resolving issues, and providing shift coverage as business needs require.

· Oversee PM Housekeeping operations, including turndown service, guest-request deliveries, room readiness, public area coverage, and the timely completion of evening assignments in accordance with hotel standards.

· Monitor Housekeeping workflow, coverage, and room status throughout the evening and overnight hours, adjusting priorities based on occupancy, VIP arrivals, late arrivals, guest requests, and operational needs.

· Follow up on incomplete or outstanding work and verify the completion of end-of-shift responsibilities for public area attendants, housepersons, and other PM Housekeeping colleagues.

· Welcome and assist arriving and departing guests by completing check-in and check-out procedures, responding to requests, providing hotel and local information, and ensuring a warm, professional experience.

· Manage guest complaints, compliments, billing requests, and other concerns with professionalism, empathy, and appropriate follow-through.

· Maintain current knowledge of hotel culture, amenities, services, events, points of interest, and local experiences, and promote hotel offerings when appropriate.

· Partner with Engineering, Security, and other hotel departments to coordinate guest needs, communicate operational priorities, and ensure maintenance and service issues are properly logged, addressed, and followed up on.

· Assist with or complete overnight audit responsibilities as assigned, including reviewing Front Office work, guest accounts, billing, cash transactions, reports, and daily financial activity. Overnight audit is an occasional responsibility and is not the primary focus of the role.

· Handle cash transactions in accordance with the property’s cash-handling policy, support the accuracy of hotel records, and maintain awareness of hotel activity and overnight safety and security procedures.

· Act as Manager on Duty in the absence of management, uphold Hyatt and Thompson service standards, and complete all other tasks and duties as assigned.

Benefits

At Hyatt, we care for people so they can be their best. Eligible colleagues may enjoy\:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
  • Complimentary Colleague Parking
  • Hyatt Colleague Travel Discounts Worldwide
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Tuition Reimbursement Opportunities
  • Career Growth and Development within Hyatt

Why Thompson Dallas? Thompson Dallas is more than a hotel. It is a gathering place for travelers, locals, and culture seekers alike. With thoughtfully layered design, distinctive dining, curated experiences, and an inviting social atmosphere, Thompson Dallas creates a dynamic home base for guests and colleagues. If you are passionate about lifestyle hospitality, enjoy creating memorable guest experiences, and are ready to grow your Rooms Division experience, we would love to welcome you to our team. Care Connects Us.

title: TAILOR IN STORE
description:
Profile:

The Tailor is responsible for managing all in-store tailoring activities within the Boutique, ensuring alterations are executed to the highest standards of quality, precision, and timing.

The role contributes directly to client satisfaction by supporting the sales team and ensuring product excellence in line with brand standards. In addition, the Tailor actively supports the Sartoria Solomeo Made-to-Measure (MTM) project, taking accurate measurements and overseeing the process with great attention to detail, while maintaining close collaboration with the Headquarters to ensure consistency, quality, and alignment with brand guidelines.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Identify and execute appropriate alterations while preserving garment structure and brand identity

  • Ensure timely and high-quality completion of all tailoring activities

  • Support the sales team during fittings and client appointments

  • Take accurate measurements for MTM (Sartoria Solomeo)

  • Oversee and coordinate external tailoring partners, ensuring quality compliance

  • Perform final garment inspection before delivery to the client

  • Maintain organization, tools, and workspace according to company standards

  • Uphold confidentiality and discretion when handling client garments

Qualifications:

The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in high-end tailoring, combining technical mastery with a strong attention to detail and a genuine passion for luxury craftsmanship. A natural collaborator, they demonstrate excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to operate effectively within a boutique environment, maintaining high standards of quality and flexibility.

Key requirements include:

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in high-end tailoring within luxury boutiques or ateliers

  • Strong expertise in formal menswear construction and garment alteration

  • Advanced use of sewing machines (lockstitch and overlock) and pressing techniques

  • Proven ability to evaluate and execute alterations on finished garments

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills

  • Team-oriented mindset with high flexibility and attention to detail

  • Availability to travel, if required

  • A good command of French and English is appreciated

Selection Process:

At Brunello Cucinelli, the person is placed at the centre of every process. For this reason, each application is reviewed with genuine care and respect by a member of our Human Resources Department, as we believe in the value of human insight, guided by careful consideration rather than automated processes.

Should a professional profile resonate with the role, the candidate will take part in a clear and structured selection process, beginning with an initial telephone conversation with a member of the People & Culture team, which may be followed by an interview with the line manager; any further steps will be progressively shared.

Brunello Cucinelli is committed to ensuring equal opportunities, nurturing a working environment that embraces inclusion and honours diversity, aligned with our corporate values.

The Opportunity:

CACI is looking to hire a Senior Cybersecurity Software Engineer to join our Spectral Cyber team supporting the production of high-quality software applications to support the U.S. Navy mission. The ideal candidate will support the U.S. Navy Spectral Program. Spectral is a seven-year $1.2B program to provide the U.S. Navy's next-generation signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and information operations software technologies. The Spectral system is critical to the ability for our forces to fight and win in the increasingly sophisticated and complex cyber and electronic threats of our adversaries.

We are seeking someone with technical experience who is highly skilled in cyber engineering to be responsible for toolset design, implementation, automation, and optimization of Spectral enterprise-wide security solutions. Desired cyber engineering skillsets will be responsible for continuous development of secure software solutions and hardened mission applications.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on cyber engineering experience with cyber analytics and reverse engineering tactics on Kubernetes infrastructure, who thrives in fast-paced, complex environments, and has a proven track record of technical advancements in cyber engineering, cybersecurity engineering, analysis, and modern software deliverables.

Responsibilities:

-- Automate cybersecurity architecture within the infrastructure as code (IaC) for on-prem and distributed platforms and mission applications with end-to-end integrated Zero Trust capability to deliver high quality software outcomes.

-- Engineer and integrate security controls into the IaC, platform as a service (PaaS), and mission applications to automate and streamline outputs for IAM, encryption, logging, and monitoring compliance validation.

-- Streamline hardening of IaC, PaaS, and mission applications leveraging STIG/SRGs, CIS benchmarks, and industry best practices.

-- Support secure software deployments, containerized platforms and mission applications.

-- Coordinate and engineer cybersecurity tools pipeline integration, enforcement, and automate tool outputs into dynamic decision-making dashboards.

-- Engineer and automate RMF security control implementation into the IaC, PaaS, and mission applications to modernize and rapidly produce body of evidence for continuous delivery, monitoring, updates, and improvements.

-- Modernize vulnerability remediation outcomes and engineer continuous system resiliency, adaptability, drift correction, and responsiveness to updates.

-- Write Ansible playbooks and scripts and perform peer review of cyber engineer as well as software developer code commits.

-- Ensure end-to-end system patch management enforcement, SBOM, RBOM, and artifact generation.

-- Capable of collaborating cross-functionally with software development, IT, DevOps, hardware/engineering teams, and customer to continuously integrate and improve security posture throughout the SDLC.

Qualifications:

Required:

-- Active TS/SCI and an ability to obtain the required Polygraph.

-- Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, cyber engineering, systems engineering, information technology, or a related field.

-- 7+ years’ experience in cyber engineering, with at least 5 years in moder software technologies.

-- Proven Kubernetes platform security and modular architectures, technical enterprise architecture, secure SDLC, and cloud-native security.

-- Deep technical understanding of cyber and security engineering toolsets and deployment methodologies, and SIEM, SAST, DAST, SCA, and vulnerability exposure technologies.

-- Hands-on experience with Zero Trust tools and implementation, micro-segmentation, and identity-centric security services.

-- Demonstrated IaC, PaaS, and mission application knowledge, to include ability to automate RMF, control engineering, metrics reporting, and telemetry pipelines.

-- Sec+ and/or CISSP certification, or an ability to obtain within 90 days of onboarding.

-- Experience in at least one or more scripting languages (e.g., bask, python, java, powershell, etc), and knowledge in Ansible playbooks and ArgoCD integration for automation.

-- Working knowledge in network protocols, TCP/IP stack, firewalls, and packet inspection tools on Linux, Windows, and Kubernetes system security.

Desired:

-- More than one industry certification (CISSP, GSEC, CEH, GCIH, CISSP Associate), or equivalent.

-- Familiarity in multiple programming / scripting languages to streamline automation.

-- Exposure to DevSecOps pipelines and tools (e.g., Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible, ArgoCD, etc).

-- Experience in performing engineering tasks, cross-enclave environments, classified systems, highly regulated environments, and compliance-as-code.
