title: Retail Credit Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
Job Title\: Retail Credit Quality Assurance Specialist

Closing Date\: 30 September 2026

About us

At Mercedes-Benz Financial Services, our employees are at the heart of our business. Our colleagues provide a range of financial solutions designed around the changing needs of our diverse customers. It doesn’t matter the colour of your skin, the beliefs you value, the people you love or the tattoos you wear, we support you for being you.

Through the doors of Mercedes-Benz Financial Services, you will find a passionate team working to support our customers and our colleagues. We ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to learn and develop.

We want to celebrate your individuality, embrace your personality and welcome you into our culture. It’s the differences of our colleagues that enable us to thrive. We believe our backgrounds, skills and cultures contribute to our shared culture and help us deliver outstanding Customer Experience. Inclusion is the driving force behind our ethos.

At MBFS, we are proud to be a Menopause Friendly Accredited Employer, reflecting our ongoing commitment to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace. We offer wellbeing support options and resources for colleagues experiencing menopause and to those who are supporting someone through it.

How you’ll play your part

In this role, you will independently review retail credit underwriting decisions to ensure that they are made in line with internal credit procedures, delegated authority frameworks and applicable regulatory requirements, including FCA CONC obligations, supporting the delivery of consistent, fair and compliant customer outcomes.

Main Accountabilities

  • Reporting into the Quality Assurance Manager, you will conduct daily, timely and structured reviews of retail credit underwriting decisions using a defined Quality Assurance (QA) framework and methodology. Assess whether decisions are consistent with internal credit policies and procedures, delegated authority limits and approval frameworks and FCA CONC requirements relating to creditworthiness, affordability and responsible lending. Ensure evidence supporting decisions is appropriate, complete and clearly documented.

  • Apply a risk-based sampling approach to select cases for review, ensuring appropriate coverage across underwriter mandates, decision types and risk segments. Perform reviews in line with established QA standards to ensure consistency, objectivity and auditability. Clearly document all QA outcomes, including scoring, rationale and findings in accordance with QA governance requirements.

  • Identify and analyse trends, control weaknesses and recurring issues arising from QA reviews. Conduct root cause analysis to determine underlying drivers of procedural breaches or gaps, inconsistent decision-making and control failures. This includes considering the adequacy of controls at all stages of a process to mitigate potential harm to customers and/or MBFS and highlighting change candidates for review and improvement.

  • Provide clear, constructive and evidence-based feedback to underwriting management with targeted recommendations to improve underwriting quality, consistency and compliance. Contribute to training programmes, process improvements and procedure refinement. Where required, support calibration sessions to ensure consistent interpretation of credit policy. Take ownership of your recommendations and actively monitor the progress of resulting changes, ensuring they are effectively embedded in future reviews and processes.

  • Produce regular QA reporting, including quality scores and key metrics, emerging risks, root cause insights and recommendations. Escalate material issues, breaches or systemic risks to underwriting management and appropriate governance channels as required. Support committee and governance reporting where underwriting quality or control effectiveness is discussed.

  • Competency assessments must be passed prior to commencing live reviews and levels maintained to ensure that the correct accreditation is in place for the reviews that are being performed.

  • Reviews must be completed in line with defined targets for volume and precision, providing clear, accurate, and constructive feedback on areas that would benefit from improvement.

  • Implementation of informal complaint reviews related to underwriting decisions to align with the wider Operations team.

To remain up to date on all regulatory change and to support with continuous improvement\:

  • Creation of new QA framework and QA scorecard that aligns with business and Compliance requirements. Responsible for regular periodic framework reviews with recommendations for any elements that need to be updated or new additions that need to be considered as our approach evolves to ensure consistent adherence to the agreed framework.

  • Maintain strong working knowledge of relevant regulatory frameworks, including FCA Consumer Credit Sourcebook (CONC), Internal Directives and Procedures.

  • Maintaining knowledge across all in-scope processes following any process or system updates, ensuring adherence to any changes that are introduced.

  • Support responses to internal audit, compliance monitoring, and regulatory reviews where required and actively participate in the implementation of any changes identified to improve the delivery and output of reviews.

  • Engage with Underwriting teams, Credit Risk leadership team, Compliance and Risk functions. Maintain independence while promoting a collaborative and improvement-focused culture.

Providing feedback\:

  • The ability to effectively communicate the outcome of any review and recommendations for improvement, either in writing or verbally, with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels is essential.

About you

  • Proven experience, 3+ years, in a Quality Assurance role preferably within a credit underwriting environment within the auto finance sector.

  • Strong understanding of FCA regulations, including Consumer Duty, Vulnerable Customers and CONC.

  • Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail.

  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex information clear and easy to understand.

  • Effective listening, coaching, reasoning and influencing skills.

  • Be self-motivated with a proactive, positive, and determined mindset, with a willingness to overcome challenges.

  • Ability to mark reviews fairly, consistently, objectively and compliantly within set guidelines and frameworks.

  • Strong organisational and time management skills to ensure adherence to timeframes and targets.

  • Proactive analytic skills with evidence of critical thinking and logical reasoning, including identifying root causes.

  • Ability to understand and interpret data to provide insight for others.

  • Commitment to professional development and continuous learning.

What’s in it for you?

We’ll offer you a competitive salary and discretionary bonus structure. We also hope you’ll love our products as much as we do, with access to our colleague car schemes. On top of that, you’ll be able to join our pension scheme and you’ll get a flexible benefit pot that can be used to find the benefits that are right for you.

We’re here to support you – we offer access to colleague wellbeing resources, including an Employee Assistance Programme, Mental Health First Aiders and the Inclusion Advocates as well as flexible opportunities to support work life balance. We’ll also encourage your development, with the training and knowledge you need to reach your potential.

Through the doors of Mercedes-Benz Financial Services, you’ll find a passionate team working to put our customers first. We know that to keep this team motivated, we need to ensure that everyone has equal opportunity to learn and develop. We celebrate a culture of appreciation and respect, where everyone is valued for who they are. We believe our backgrounds, experiences and cultures contribute to our shared experience and shape who we are and what we do. The diversity of our colleagues reflects the diversity of our customers. This diversity is the driving force behind our ideas.

What’s next?

When you apply, you’ll be asked to complete a short online application where we’ll ask that you include your current CV. You’ll also be asked some application questions, including your current salary information. The Mercedes-Benz recruitment process reflects our obligations under relevant UK legislation. Whilst all applications are carefully considered, we are only able to progress applications from candidates who have the right to work in the United Kingdom.

Please be assured that we’re here to support you throughout the recruitment process and beyond, and reasonable adjustments are available to any candidates who need them. We’re also open to working flexibly and are happy to discuss flexible working options.

Managing your data

We care about your personal data. The General Data Protection Regulation provides you with more control and by submitting an application to us; we consider this an agreement to process your personal data in support of our recruitment and selection process.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Lead SAM Flexera Expert to play a crucial "player-coach" role within our Software Asset Management (SAM) function. You will architect the end-to-end publisher management strategy while actively working as a hands-on implementor for our most complex, tier-1 software publishers within the Flexera One platform. In this role, you will drive enterprise-wide continuous cost optimization programs, manually design and configure complex licensing frameworks, serve as the lead technical defender during major vendor audits, and mentor a team of SAM professionals.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:


  • Defining the end-to-end lifecycle strategy for software publishers within Flexera, while rolling up your sleeves to directly execute the onboarding, configuration, and compliance monitoring for critical tier-1 vendors.
  • Acting as the primary authority and hands-on implementor for translating highly complex EULAs, MSAs, and amendments into accurate license records and product use rights (PUR) within the platform.
  • Directing and executing continuous cost optimization initiatives, actively diving into the data to identify strategic opportunities regarding shelfware, hybrid cloud licensing, and enterprise-wide application rationalization.
  • Leading the defense and data strategy during major software vendor audits, collaborating closely with IT Procurement, Legal, and Sourcing teams to mitigate financial risk.
  • Executing advanced data normalization, beacon management, and hands-on troubleshooting of the Flexera architecture to ensure optimal platform health.
  • Overseeing the strategic roadmap and technically supporting the implementation of Flexera integrations with enterprise systems like ServiceNow CMDB, cloud portals (AWS/Azure/GCP), and discovery tools.
  • Mentoring and guiding SAM analysts by leading by example, fostering a culture of continuous ITAM process improvement and technical excellence.
  • Developing and presenting executive-level reporting on software compliance risk, ELP status, and realized cost savings.
  • Collaborating with Sourcing and Legal teams to maintain continuously updated compliance workpapers, defend against vendor audits, and proactively support contract renewals.



What we’re looking for...


You are a strategic leader and hands-on technical expert with an authoritative understanding of software asset management and complex publisher licensing frameworks. You possess excellent problem-solving skills, a proven ability to execute complex platform configurations, and a passion for mentoring others. You thrive when balancing high-stakes compliance strategy with the technical implementation required to realize multi-million-dollar cost-saving opportunities.



You’ll need to have:


  • 9+ years of experience in Software Asset Management (SAM) or IT Asset Management (ITAM), with at least 5+ years of dedicated, hands-on implementation and architecture experience in Flexera.
  • Proven leadership experience blending end-to-end publisher lifecycle strategy with direct, hands-on platform execution.
  • Expert-level understanding of software licensing frameworks for major vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, Adobe, SAP, Red Hat, VMware/Broadcom).
  • Extensive technical experience managing ecosystem integrations and databases, including ServiceNow CMDB, SQL queries, REST APIs, and discovery agent operations.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex licensing data into actionable business strategies for leadership.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:


  • Flexera Certified Professional / Administrator (Flexera One / FNMS) and/or CSAM (Certified Software Asset Manager) or IAITAM certification.
  • Scripting and automation skills (such as Python or PowerShell) to streamline API integrations and automate data management tasks.
  • Understanding of how SAM intersects with Cybersecurity, specifically regarding the identification and management of End-of-Life (EOL) or End-of-Support (EOS) software to mitigate security risks.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

40

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About Mimecast

The work people build is worth protecting, and it's harder to protect than it used to be. AI agents now move at machine speed with human-level access, and a small slip-up can become a very public one. We disrupt cybercriminal activity before that happens. We think fast, go big, and always demand more of ourselves. We work hard, deliver, and repeat. We grow with real determination and put success well within reach. We push each other to be better and expect to be pushed back, in a community built on respect, where everyone is counted. Work Protected.

The Opportunity

Incydr Product Development is looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to help make sure customers get the full value of Incydr, from initial rollout throughout the entire time they run the product. As Incydr scales globally across more customers and more complex environments, we're investing in a technical role that sits close to the customer: partnering with our proof-of-value engineers, Professional Services team, and customer account teams to help accounts reach full operational health quickly and stay there as their needs evolve. It's a chance to shape a new role at the intersection of engineering and customer success.

This is a hands-on, engineering role that also interacts with customers. You'll be embedded in Incydr Engineering and brought in directly by the teams closest to an account to work on something specific: a technical health check, custom integration work, digging deep into customer problems to find and resolve issues quickly, and even fine-tuning after deployment to make Incydr fit well inside a customer's environment. You'll be part of the engineering team with access to source code, advanced logging, and telemetry to solve problems directly or partner with other SMEs in engineering as needed. Expect some travel to customer sites, though most engagement happens remotely; day to day, you'll follow the hybrid working model for your local Mimecast office.

Mimecast is an AI-First engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI-powered development tools across all facets of engineering, and we're looking for someone genuinely curious about working this way, including using AI to build fast, narrow solutions for individual customer problems rather than defaulting to a big, shared toolkit.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with customer-facing teams, customers, and fellow engineers to quickly diagnose and resolve technical pain points, from deployment hiccups to performance tuning, so customers get the most out of Incydr.

  • Take full ownership of each engagement, from first diagnosis to resolution, working directly with customers along the way, while account teams continue to own the broader relationship.

  • Get full access to the Incydr codebase and deployment tooling, so you can dig into how something actually works yourself and ship a fix through our normal review process when you're the right person to do it.

  • Build and troubleshoot custom scripts and integrations tailored to each customer's environment, using AI tools to move fast rather than reaching for a one-size-fits-all script library.

  • Partner with Incydr Engineering on issues that need deeper product involvement, arriving with enough detail, like repro steps and a root-cause hypothesis, that they can act on it immediately.

  • Spot early signals, like an account building up untriaged alert volume, and flag them proactively so customer-facing teams can get ahead of a problem before it grows.

  • Coach and enable a customer's own team, through training, documentation, and hands-on pairing, so they can confidently run and maintain Incydr themselves.

  • Bring what you learn back to the rest of product and engineering, so patterns you spot across customers directly shape the roadmap instead of being solved once and forgotten.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years building software, including practical experience troubleshooting or supporting that software directly with customers or in live production environments.

  • Enough depth across a broad codebase to work independently: comfortable reading and navigating code you didn't write, diagnosing an issue, and contributing a fix through normal review when needed, without waiting on someone else to do the digging.

  • Practical scripting and integration experience: building narrow, purpose-built solutions to a specific technical problem quickly, including using AI coding tools to move faster than writing everything by hand.

  • Genuine comfort owning a technical conversation directly with a customer: running a working session on a live issue, walking a customer through troubleshooting together over a video call. This is a role that will directly interact with customers and with a variety of internal stakeholders.

  • Comfort troubleshooting with incomplete information: you're the person who figures out why something is broken in someone else's environment, even when the information is incomplete and a customer's waiting on an answer.

  • Strong written and verbal communication: translating a technical root cause into something a non-engineer can act on, and a customer's vague description of a problem into something engineering can act on.

  • Comfort working daily with AI coding assistants and agents, and interest in building the kind of lightweight AI-driven tools and playbooks that let customers and internal teams solve problems themselves.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with endpoint agent technology, device management (MDM), or the operational realities of deploying software across large, varied fleets.

  • Experience with identity/directory sync (for example, SCIM) or enterprise single sign-on integrations.

  • Experience building internal tools, playbooks, or automations that non-engineering teams can run themselves.

  • Background in a customer-facing technical role: professional services, solutions engineering, technical account management, support or similar.

  • Exposure to data security, data loss prevention, or insider risk concepts.

The base salary range for this position is $140k−$180k plus benefits. This range represents the minimum and maximum new hire compensation for this role. The position may also be eligible for incentive plans and additional benefits, in accordance with company policy and local regulations. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location with individual compensation also dependent on factors such as qualifications, experience, and skills. Final offers will reflect these considerations and may vary accordingly.

Belonging at Mimecast

Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.

  • Document technical solutions data flows and batch dependencies for merchandising systems to support audit readiness knowledge sharing and onboarding of new team members.
  • Coordinate hybrid work model collaboration activities with distributed development testing and operations teams to ensure smooth deployment and steady day to day delivery.
  • Support production monitoring activities for key merchandising jobs during day shift windows to proactively identify issues and trigger timely remediation actions.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on automating repetitive support tasks on the mainframe stack to free capacity for high value merchandising enhancements.
  • Align technical solutions with enterprise sustainability and efficiency goals so mainframe merchandising capabilities contribute to reduced waste and better customer experiences.

Qualifications

  • Bring extensive experience in IBM mainframe utilities combined with strong proficiency in JCL Cobol VSAM DB2 and IMS DB to handle complex merchandising workloads effectively.
  • Demonstrate deep merchandising domain knowledge covering item setup pricing management allocation and inventory planning so technical decisions reflect real retail scenarios.
  • Apply strong skills in performance tuning problem solving and incident analysis across mainframe environments to stabilize mission critical merchandising processes.
  • Exhibit practical experience working in hybrid delivery models with global teams and day shift schedules ensuring predictable collaboration and reliable communication.
  • Use solid understanding of relational and hierarchical data concepts in DB2 and IMS DB to model and maintain merchandising data structures that support analytical needs.
  • Show capacity to write clear technical documentation for programs jobs and data mappings so complex merchandising solutions remain understandable and maintainable.
  • Display familiarity with standard software development practices including requirement analysis unit testing integration testing and change control in mainframe contexts.
  • Apply hands on experience in retail or merchandising technology transformations so enhancements support company objectives around customer satisfaction and market growth.


Certifications Required

Preferred certifications include IBM Certified Application Developer mainframe and industry recognized retail or merchandising technology credentials.

description:

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

DESCRIPTION:
As a Systems Administrator III at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll maintain and optimize our critical infrastructure and applications. You'll join a collaborative team dedicated to supporting our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. In this position, you'll manage complex enterprise systems, implement effective solutions, and ensure maximum system performance and reliability. Working with advanced technologies across cloud and on-premises environments, you'll have opportunities to drive automation, improve processes, and contribute to our digital transformation initiatives.

REQUIREMENTS:
•

Experienced Systems Operations and Virtualization professional with expertise in VMware vSphere, vCenter, vSAN, Hyper-V, Windows Server, infrastructure operations, and SysOps automation. Skilled in managing virtual environments, capacity and performance monitoring, server lifecycle activities, patching automation, service-account integrations, and operational support. Strong focus on improving reliability, reducing manual effort, and delivering standardized automation solutions across enterprise infrastructure.


System Administrator III – Key Responsibilities

  • Manage enterprise infrastructure across on-premises, VMware, Windows, and cloud environments.
  • Handle Incidents, Major Incidents, Problems, Tasks, and Changes following ITIL processes and SLA requirements.
  • Administer and troubleshoot VMware ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, and VxRail environments.
  • Manage Windows Server 2012/2016/2019/2022, including provisioning, patching, upgrades, optimization, and decommissioning.
  • Plan and execute P2V/V2V migrations, infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and technology refreshes.
  • Monitor CPU, memory, storage, virtualization, and cloud capacity, identify bottlenecks, and forecast future requirements.
  • Support Azure and/or AWS, including hybrid infrastructure, migrations, optimization, governance, security, and reliability.
  • Automate operational activities using PowerShell/Python, including provisioning, health checks, patching, compliance, monitoring, and reporting.
  • Apply Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation practices to reduce manual effort.
  • Manage Windows patching, vulnerability remediation, compliance tracking, exceptions, and reporting.
  • Support monitoring, logging, alerting, backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and high availability.
  • Maintain operational dashboards, documentation, runbooks, knowledge articles, and performance reports.
  • Act as a technical escalation point, lead complex infrastructure activities, and support Major Incident recovery.
  • Collaborate with architects, security, operations, and global technology teams on infrastructure improvements.
  • Mentor junior/mid-level engineers and conduct technical knowledge-sharing sessions.

Key Requirements

  • 8+ years of hands-on enterprise infrastructure/system engineering experience.
  • Strong expertise in VMware ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, and VxRail.
  • Advanced Windows Server administration experience.
  • Hands-on exposure to Azure and/or AWS.
  • Strong knowledge of capacity planning, performance management, and infrastructure optimization.
  • Strong PowerShell/Python scripting and automation skills.
  • Understanding of IaC and infrastructure automation.
  • Strong knowledge of ITIL Incident, Major Incident, Change, and Problem Management.
  • Experience with P2V/V2V migrations and enterprise patch management.
  • Knowledge of monitoring, compliance, backup, DR, and high availability.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Proven ability to lead technical activities, mentor engineers, and work with global teams.
  • Flexible to support APAC/EMEA hours, maintenance windows, Major Incidents, and 24x7 on-call rotation.

The Banner University Heart Institute cares for a high volume of heart disease patients throughout the state of Arizona and the southwest. Our physicians stand out as being active participants in national research and as providers of cardiac training to physicians from all over the United States and the world. Our goal is to offer patients excellent cardiac services by providing safe, compassionate care and the best advanced treatment options.

As a Practice Supervisor on this team, you will be an integral part of the patient's Banner experience looking to provide each person with the best customer service and patient care, and manage the day to day operations of a busy, high volume cardiology practice with a team of 100+. Management of various team members to include but not limited to: administrative staff, clinical staff and technical staff. Partners with physicians and APPs to improve overall clinical operations, enhance efficiency and be a champion for the patient and provider experience. Prefer previous healthcare management experience (1 – 2 years +). Prefer previous experience managing cardiology practices and programs. If you are seeking growth within the organization (Banner is the biggest health system in the state, lots of opportunities for advancement), world-class physicians, facilities and programs fueled by innovation and the opportunity to work with a collaborative group of leaders from both Banner Health and The University of Arizona, apply now!!

This is a full time (40 hours/week), day shift position: Monday - Friday 8:00A-5:00P

University Medical Center Phoenix is a nationally recognized academic medical center. The world-class hospital is focused on coordinated clinical care, expanded research activities and nurturing future generations of highly trained medical professionals. Our commitment to nursing excellence has enabled us to achieve Magnet™ recognition by the American Nurses Credentialing Center. The Phoenix campus, long known for excellent patient care, has over 730 licensed beds, several unique specialty units and is the new home for medical discoveries, thanks to our collaboration with the University of Arizona College of Medicine - Phoenix. Additionally, the campus responsibilities include fully integrated multi-specialty and sub-specialty clinics and has operations in multiple locations spanning across the Phoenix metropolitan city.

POSITION SUMMARY
This position works to ensure the efficient and effective operation of the assigned department, including day-to-day administration of non-physician staff and operations. Uses specialized knowledge, judgment and skills necessary to provide excellent patient care.

CORE FUNCTIONS
1. Supervises the day to day activities of non physician staff, ensuring a high level of productivity. Continuously monitors the functioning of the medical group and recommends changes to operational procedures as necessary.

2. Selects, trains, coaches, motivates, conducts performance evaluations, and directs the workflow of staff. Schedules non physician staff ensuring that staff is appropriately deployed among offices.

3. Oversee all functions of the medical group including reception and scheduling activities, patient service areas, accounting, medical records, transcription, business information systems, and appropriate clinical areas.

4. Functions as a liaison between non physician staff and physicians to ensure effective service for patients. Establishes and maintains effective working relationships with group physicians. Serves as a role model and resource person for providing quality patient care and patient information as needed.

5. Maintains office policies and procedures in accordance with physician requirements, facility and system policies and procedures, standard practices of the profession, and related regulatory requirements.

6. Determines physical maintenance and equipment needs and repairs and coordinates internal or external resources. Resolves problems relating to the facility on a day-to-day basis. Ensures all areas are appropriately stocked and supplies are readily accessible.

7. Covers front and/or back office functions. May also administer medications in accordance with established policies and procedures or as directed, and consistent with demonstrated competencies and state scope of practice.

8. This position has a strong understanding of the daily workflow of the practice and functions autonomously to provide guidance to ensure quality patient experiences and efficient practice operations. This position is required to have working knowledge of referral and authorization processes and must have the ability to navigate a variety of separate computer programs at any given time and handle multiple demands on time. Internal customers include all patients, staff and clinic providers. External customers include the community, vendors and non-clinic providers and facilities.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Requires a level of literacy, communication and math skills as normally demonstrated at the level of an Associate’s Degree.

Certain assignments may require current certification as a Medical Assistant, Nursing Assistant or current LPN license.

Requires a level of knowledge and ability normally demonstrated by at least two years experience in a physician's office or medical environment. Requires excellent communication and organizational skills.

Employees working at Banner Behavioral Health Hospital, BTMC Behavioral, and BUMG, BUMCT, or BUMCS in a Behavioral Health clinical setting that serves children must possess an Arizona Fingerprint Clearance Card at the time of hire and maintain the card for the duration of their employment. An Arizona Criminal History Affidavit must be signed upon hire.

Bachelor's degree preferred.

Experience in a leadership or coordinator capacity preferred.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

title: Global Mobility Specialist
description:
Career Area:

Human Resources

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

As a Global Mobility Specialist at Caterpillar, you will play a key role in supporting international assignments and employee relocations across the Europe, Africa, Middle East (EAME) region. Partnering closely with employees, leaders, HR colleagues, and external service providers, you will help deliver a seamless mobility experience while ensuring compliance with company policies and local regulations.

In this role, you will provide expert guidance on relocation and mobility programs, manage relationships with external vendors, support policy development and program administration, and use data and market insights to recommend improvements. You will thrive in a fast-paced, global environment where customer focus, attention to detail, stakeholder management, and problem-solving are essential to success.

Job Duties/Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

  • Administer international assignment and relocation programs across the EAME region, ensuring consistent application of mobility policies and processes.

  • Providing guidance on mobility programs and relocation support to employees, supervisors, and HR partners.

  • Manage relationships with relocation management companies and external vendors to deliver a high-quality relocation experience.

  • Coordinate mobility services including policy counseling, cost estimates, reporting, allowance payments, expense reimbursements, compensation data accumulation for tax equalization/filing, arrangements of immigration, household goods shipments, transportation, housing, dependent education, and language and cultural training.

  • Review mobility policy exception requests and provide recommendations based on policy intent, business impact, and precedent.

  • Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of global mobility policies, programs, and processes.

  • Conduct market research, benchmarking, and analysis of mobility benefits, allowances, and industry practices to support program effectiveness and competitiveness.

  • Monitor regulatory developments and market trends affecting employee mobility and recommend appropriate program adjustments.

  • Lead and support regional and global mobility projects, including process improvement and operational excellence initiatives.

  • Analyze mobility and Total Rewards data to provide insights and recommendations that support business and talent objectives.

Job Requirements

Skills, Abilities and Knowledge

  • Knowledge of global mobility, relocation, compensation and benefits principles.

  • Understanding of immigration, tax, and compliance considerations associated with international assignments across the EAME region.

  • Knowledge of data privacy requirements and the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.

  • Strong customer focus with a commitment to delivering an exceptional employee and stakeholder experience.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple levels of the organization.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information in a clear and concise manner.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy when managing employee data, policies, and relocation activities.

  • Strong organizational, planning, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate complex situations and make sound recommendations.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal and external partners.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and HR systems, including Workday.

Experience

  • Proven experience within Human Resources, preferably in Global Mobility, International Assignments, Relocation, Immigration, Compensation & Benefits, or a related Total Rewards function.

  • Experience administering employee programs and partnering with employees, managers, HR teams, and external vendors.

  • Experience interpreting policies and balancing employee needs with business requirements while ensuring policy compliance.

  • Experience managing multiple cases or projects concurrently within a global and matrixed environment.

  • Full professional proficiency in English. Additional European language skills would be advantageous.

Skill Descriptors

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Level: Working Knowledge

  • Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance.

  • Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions.

  • Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fishbone diagrams, and other tools to identify meaningful data patterns.

  • Identifies the major forces, events, and stakeholders impacting and impacted by the situation at hand.

  • Uses logic and intuition to draw conclusions and make informed recommendations.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools, and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication practices.

Level: Working Knowledge

  • Delivers constructive feedback that focuses on behaviors and outcomes.

  • Listens to feedback openly and uses it to improve communication effectiveness.

  • Prepares and delivers presentations, reports, and other work-related communications.

  • Communicates clearly and avoids unnecessary technical jargon when inappropriate.

  • Considers verbal and non-verbal cues when communicating with individuals and groups.

Benefits Programs: Knowledge of employee benefits programs, processes, issues, and considerations; ability to support the administration and implementation of benefits programs.

Level: Working Knowledge

  • Counsels and assists employees with benefits-related questions and issues.

  • Coordinates employee information and benefits-related data with external vendors and service providers.


What we offer:

From day one, you’re set up to thrive at Caterpillar: helpful training, relatable mentors, global experience, competitive salary package, work-life balance, and the growth opportunities you expect with a Fortune 100 company.

You power our success, and we are committed to empowering yours. After all, when your work can impact the entire world, it’s important to do work that matters.

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives.

For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

title: Commercial Model Transformation Lead
description:
1. Role Summary

The Transformation Lead leads ANZ’s AI-enabled commercial transformation. The role is part of the ANZ Commercial Leadership Team and reports directly to the Country President.

The role has two connected parts. First, it runs a disciplined programme of small, fast tests that use AI and data to better reach and serve patients and customers, then scales what works into everyday business practice. Second, it ensures ANZ has the AI skills, tools and ways of working needed to run this model well, rather than relying on isolated pockets of expertise.

This is one of ANZ’s most important build roles. ANZ is investing significantly in AI and new commercial approaches ahead of pipeline-driven growth, and this role is accountable for turning that investment into commercial and operational advantage. The Transformation Lead sets the standard for each test, decides what should scale, and keeps the programme moving at pace, while Therapy Area and functional leaders deliver their respective parts.

2. Role Responsibilities

Run the Test-and-Scale Programme

· Set clear criteria for each test before launch: a real commercial idea worth testing and enough data to judge whether it worked.

· Own the system for capturing what each test teaches the business, and ensure those lessons inform future decisions and action.

· Turn successful tests into repeatable approaches that other teams can adopt, separating the drivers of impact from the specific tool or format used, and share learnings with Pfizer’s international transformation network.

Build Internal Readiness — AI & Capability

· Lead ANZ’s internal AI enablement agenda by identifying where automation and AI can free up time, and how that time can be redirected to higher-value work.

· Act as ANZ’s practical authority on AI adoption, helping teams distinguish promising tests from changes ready for funded, operational scale.

· Build the change capability, skills and mindset needed for teams to work this way day to day, in partnership with People Experience and Communications.

Portfolio Coherence & Resourcing

· Give the Country President and Leadership Team a clear, current view of where change initiatives are drawing on the same teams, so trade-offs are made deliberately.

· Ensure lessons from pilots, automation tests and process improvements are applied wherever relevant, rather than rediscovered by each team separately.

International Representation

· Represent ANZ in Pfizer’s international network of Transformation Leads, bringing in what works elsewhere and sharing ANZ’s learnings.

People and Leadership

· Lead and inspire a high-performing team, creating clarity, accountability and psychological safety.

· Make talent a top priority: attract, develop and retain high-impact colleagues and create visible, meaningful development and succession opportunities.

· Coach colleagues through regular feedback, performance conversations and development planning; sponsor talent into broader Pfizer opportunities.

· Model scientific curiosity, patient focus, commercial discipline and inclusive collaboration across the matrix.

· Build future-ready capability in AI fluency, experimentation design, partnership leadership, analytics and complex portfolio decision-making.

· Support and continually build the Pfizer culture across the ANZ organization.

· Uphold and model Pfizer values and actionable attitudes through visible and inspirational leadership.

Operational Excellence and Compliance

· Ensure all activities comply with Pfizer policies, relevant medicines-industry codes, local laws and governance requirements across Australia and New Zealand.

· Maintain rigorous budget, forecast, risk and performance management in partnership with Finance and relevant governance forums.

· Promote a speak-up culture and ensure adverse events and product complaints are identified and reported in line with corporate procedures.

· Act as a catalyst for responsible AI adoption across the team to improve insight generation, productivity, decision quality and customer impact.

· Simplify end-to-end workflows, remove low-value activity and focus resources on the work that creates the greatest value for patients and the business.

3. Skills and Experience

· University degree in business, marketing, science, pharmacy, health sciences or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification desirable.

· Proven track record leading complex, multi-year transformation or capability-building programs — ideally spanning commercial model design, AI/data-enabled tools, and organisational change.

· Genuine fluency with AI-enabled commercial models (omnichannel engagement, predictive analytics, process automation) — able to shape and prioritise pilots, not just administer them.

· Demonstrated ability to bring structure and a clear roadmap to an evolving, not-yet-fully-defined mandate, and to make credible progress while the model is still being built.

· Proven success building and leading high-performing teams, and influencing outcomes across a complex matrix without always holding direct authority.

· Strong external and internal storytelling and communication capability — able to build organisational belief in a multi-year change agenda.

· Demonstrated ability to partner across functions and with regional/global teams within a matrix organization.

· Visible, inclusive and enterprise-minded leadership with a bias for action and a strong commitment to integrity.

4. Key Relationships

· Direct Reports: Lifecycle Lead, Experimentation & Evidence Project Manager

· Key internal partners: Therapy Area Commercial and Medical Leads; Commercial Excellence & Innovation Lead; Execution Leads of individual initiatives; the internal AI-enablement taskforce; Innovation Accelerator pod leads

· Key channel partners: ANZ transformation governance forums (monthly Steering Review); International CMI program office; peer country Transformation Leads

5. Why This Role

A rare opportunity to shape how ANZ competes over the next decade, with a seat on the Commercial Leadership Team, direct access to the Country President, and clear ownership for turning AI and commercial model innovation into results ahead of pipeline-driven growth.

title: Éditeur(trice) de Contenus Digitaux / Digital Content Editor
description:
Job Location

PARIS GO-ASNIERES-SUR-SEINE

Job Description

Éditeur(trice) de Contenus Digitaux

Alliez créativité, culture et contenu pour certaines des marques les plus appréciées au monde.

Nous recherchons un(e) Éditeur(trice) de Contenus Digitaux & Spécialiste de l’Adaptation talentueux(se), passionné(e) par les réseaux sociaux et le storytelling digital. Dans ce rôle, vous transformerez des assets créatifs existants en contenus engageants, conçus pour chaque plateforme, afin d’aider des marques emblématiques à créer des liens authentiques, pertinents et significatifs avec leurs consommateurs.

Au sein d’un portefeuille de marques P&G de premier plan, vous adapterez et optimiserez des contenus vidéo et visuels pour les canaux digitaux, en veillant à ce que chaque création réponde aux usages des plateformes, aux attentes des audiences et aux spécificités culturelles locales. Des campagnes de marque premium aux contenus inspirés des créateurs, vous contribuerez à donner vie à des stratégies mondiales grâce à des exécutions locales percutantes et de haute qualité.

En étroite collaboration avec les équipes Brand, Media, Influence et Relations Publiques, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la création de contenus qui génèrent de l’engagement, renforcent la confiance envers les marques et contribuent à des résultats business mesurables.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Créer des contenus adaptés à chaque plateforme : Transformer des vidéos existantes, des séquences brutes et des assets visuels en contenus performants conçus pour TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, le Retail Media et bien d’autres canaux. Cela comprend notamment :

  • Le montage, le découpage et la restructuration de contenus vidéo pour maximiser leur impact.

  • La création de sous-titres, légendes et incrustations textuelles.

  • L’adaptation des formats et résolutions aux spécificités de chaque plateforme.

  • L’optimisation audio et l’intégration de musiques ou d’effets sonores.

  • La correction et l’harmonisation colorimétrique des contenus.

  • Le recadrage, le redimensionnement et l’optimisation d’images fixes.

  • La création d’animations simples et d’éléments graphiques animés à partir des assets de marque existants.

  • Donner vie aux idées rapidement : Développer plusieurs variantes créatives, tester rapidement de nouvelles approches et optimiser les contenus en fonction des performances, des retours des parties prenantes et des tendances émergentes.

  • Développer une créativité pensée pour les plateformes : Mettre à profit votre connaissance des bonnes pratiques propres à chaque canal, des comportements des audiences et des tendances sociales afin de créer des contenus naturellement adaptés aux plateformes tout en préservant une identité de marque cohérente.

  • Collaborer avec différentes équipes et marques : Travailler en partenariat avec les équipes marketing, média, influence et communication, tant au niveau local que régional, pour donner vie aux campagnes. Vous gérerez plusieurs projets simultanément, apporterez votre expertise créative et accompagnerez les contenus tout au long des processus de validation.

  • Rester à l’avant-garde des tendances culturelles : Suivre de près les évolutions des réseaux sociaux, les contenus créateurs, les tendances culturelles et les nouvelles techniques de montage afin d’enrichir continuellement vos créations.

Bring creativity, culture, and content together for some of the world's most loved brands.

We're looking for a talented Digital Content Editor & Adaptation Specialist who thrives in the fast-paced world of social media and digital storytelling. In this role, you'll transform existing creative assets into engaging, platform-native content that helps iconic brands connect with consumers in relevant, authentic, and meaningful ways.

Working across a portfolio of leading P&G brands, you'll adapt and optimize video and image assets for digital channels, ensuring every piece of content is tailored to platform behaviours, audience expectations, and local cultural nuances. From polished brand campaigns to creator-inspired social content, you'll help bring global strategies to life through high-quality, locally relevant execution.

Partnering closely with Brand, Media, Influencer, and PR teams, you'll play a key role in delivering content that drives engagement, builds brand trust, and generates measurable business impact.

What you'll do:

  • Create content built for every platform: Transform existing videos, raw footage, and image assets into high-performing content tailored for channels such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, Retail Media, and more. This includes:

  • Editing, trimming, and restructuring video content for maximum impact.

  • Creating captions, subtitles, and text overlays.

  • Adapting aspect ratios and resolutions for different platforms.

  • Enhancing audio and incorporating music or sound effects.

  • Colour correction and grading for visual consistency.

  • Cropping, resizing, and optimising static imagery.

  • Creating simple motion graphics and animated elements using existing brand assets.

  • Bring ideas to life at speed: Develop multiple creative variations, rapidly test new approaches, and refine content based on performance insights, stakeholder feedback, and emerging platform trends.

  • Deliver platform-first creativity: Apply your understanding of channel-specific best practices, audience behaviours, and social trends to create content that feels native while maintaining a consistent brand identity.

  • Collaborate across teams and brands: Partner with local and regional marketing, media, influencer, and communications teams to bring campaigns to life. You'll manage multiple projects simultaneously, contribute creative thinking, and help guide assets through approval processes.

  • Stay ahead of culture: Keep your finger on the pulse of social media, creator content, youth culture, and editing trends, bringing fresh ideas and new techniques into your work every day.

Job Qualifications

Les compétences qui vous permettront de réussir :

  • Un niveau d’études Bac +3 minimum.

  • Expérience en montage vidéo et retouche d’images pour les réseaux sociaux, idéalement acquise en agence, en studio créatif ou au sein d’une équipe marketing intégrée.

  • Excellente maîtrise de la suite Adobe Creative Cloud, notamment : Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator

  • Expérience avec CapCut ou d’autres outils de montage mobile-first.

  • Solide compréhension des principales plateformes sociales et de leurs codes : TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, Reddit et plateformes émergentes.

  • Excellent sens esthétique et grande attention aux détails.

  • Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément.

  • Esprit proactif, curieux et orienté amélioration continue.

  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes.

  • Capacité à travailler de manière autonome tout en collaborant efficacement avec des équipes variées.

  • Une expérience dans la mise en place ou l’analyse de tests A/B sur des contenus créatifs constitue un atout.

  • Une connaissance des analyses marketing et de l’optimisation créative basée sur la performance est un plus.

  • Maîtrise courante du français et de l’anglais.

Ce que nous offrons

description:

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

As a Systems Engineer, you will work as the engineering interface between L8 Autonomous Hauling Application teams and L6 base machine systems teams. You will be responsible for autonomy hardware and software solution integration with base machine systems.


What You Will Do:

  • Work closely with Autonomy Systems integration engineers and architects to ensure the product architecture requirements are fulfilled.

  • Work with Technical program managers and Application Architects to ensure that program requirements are being met (time, cost, quality).

  • Ensure that Base machine software changes are delivered on time for command for hauling releases. These can be NPI and CPI solutions depending on the state of the program.

  • Support Field data collection kits activities. Including design support, procurement, coordinating shipping to site, and kit test support.

  • Documenting architecture specifications, software design description, verification plans, test cases, operating procedures, and safety procedures.

title: Windows Virtualization Operations Engineer
description:
Windows Virtualization Operations Engineer

Description -

Senior Windows Virtualization and Infrastructure Operations Engineer

Job Summary

We are seeking an expert-level Senior Windows, Virtualization and Infrastructure Operations Engineer to manage, optimize, secure, and continuously improve enterprise infrastructure platforms.
The role will provide deep technical ownership across Windows Server, VMware, Microsoft Hyper-V, HPE server and blade environments, HPE OneView, HPE SimpliVity, Windows clustering, patch management, vulnerability remediation, firmware updates, storage, backup, monitoring, and infrastructure automation. The successful candidate will lead complex technical troubleshooting, major incident response, Change and Problem Management, Root Cause Analysis, capacity planning, proactive maintenance, and continuous improvement initiatives. The role will work closely with Engineering teams and end users to deliver reliable and effective infrastructure services, while also overseeing Managed Service Providers to ensure consistent service quality, strong operational governance, effective automation, and compliance with technical and security standards.

Responsibilities

Windows and Virtualization

  • Administrate and support enterprise Windows Server environments across physical and virtual platforms,
  • Manage VMware vSphere environments, including ESXi, vCenter, clusters, HA, DRS, vMotion, templates, snapshots, and virtual networking.
  • Support Microsoft Hyper-V platforms, including Failover Clustering, Live Migration, CSV, virtual switches, and VM lifecycle management.
  • Troubleshoot complex operating system, virtualization, networking, storage, performance, application dependency, and availability issues.
  • Lead patching and vulnerability remediation for Windows servers, virtualization hosts, firmware, and infrastructure components in coordination with security teams and MSPs.
  • Support HPE OneView, SimpliVity, ProLiant DL/BL servers, and BladeSystem c7000 environments, including hardware replacements, upgrades, vendor escalations, and lifecycle activities.
  • Plan and execute firmware upgrades using validated compatibility matrices, implementation plans, maintenance windows, and rollback procedures.
  • Provide technical leadership during major incidents, high-severity outages, service restoration, recovery activities, and on-call support.
  • Drive Problem Management, root-cause analysis, permanent corrective actions, technical escalation, stakeholder communication, and accurate documentation.
  • Develop automation and strengthen AIOps monitoring across Windows, VMware, Hyper-V, HPE, storage, backup, and clustering platforms.
  • Monitor infrastructure utilization, performance, availability, capacity, growth trends, licensing, SAN/NAS, RAID, LUNs, datastores, multipathing, IOPS, latency, backup, restore, and disaster recovery.
  • Review and govern MSP performance across incidents, changes, problems, patching, vulnerability remediation, monitoring, automation, service improvement, and accountability for outcomes.
  • Support knowledge of DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, domain controllers, replication, authentication, certificates, and access controls.

Education & Experience Recommended
• Four-year or Graduate Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
• Typically has 12-15 years of work experience, preferably in computer programming languages, testing tools, or a related field.

Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator & Azure Administrator Associate or relevant Microsoft infrastructure certification.

  • HPE certifications covering ProLiant servers, HPE OneView, BladeSystem, or HPE SimpliVity.
  • ITIL Foundation certification

Technical Knowledge

  • Expert knowledge of Windows Server administration, troubleshooting, hardening, performance analysis, and lifecycle management.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Hyper-V, Failover Clustering, CSV, Live Migration, and virtual machine management.
  • Strong knowledge of Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Kerberos, LDAP, replication, certificates, and identity security.
  • Advanced knowledge of VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, HA, DRS, vMotion, clusters, snapshots, and virtual networking.
  • Hands-on knowledge of HPE ProLiant DL/BL servers, c7000, HPE OneView, and HPE SimpliVity.
  • Strong understanding of patch management, vulnerability remediation, firmware lifecycle management, and configuration compliance.
  • Practical understanding of storage, SAN/NAS, RAID, datastores, multipathing, backup, restore, replication, and disaster recovery.
  • Strong knowledge of monitoring, observability, event correlation, alert management, capacity management, and service health.
  • Advanced PowerShell scripting skills, including automation, reporting, error handling, logging, testing, and remediation.
  • Working knowledge of ITIL-based Incident, Major Incident, Change, Problem, and Configuration Management processes.
  • Public Cloud Knowledge AWS, Azure

Professional and Operational Skills

  • Expert-level analytical thinking and deep technical troubleshooting ability.
  • Ability to lead complex incidents calmly and make sound decisions under pressure.
  • Strong Root Cause Analysis, problem-solving, risk assessment, and permanent remediation skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and Managed Service Providers.

  • Strong ownership, accountability, collaboration, and service-management mindset.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Willingness to learn and develop hands-on technical expertise.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team and adapt to a fast-paced project environment.
  • Willingness to travel and work at customer/project sites when required.

Why Join INTECH Automation Intelligence?

At INTECH, you will have the opportunity to work with a globally renowned industrial automation and digitalization technology company. For nearly 30 years, INTECH has partnered with major oil and gas global giants to deliver innovative solutions. As we continue to lead in the Industry 4.0 era, you will be at the forefront of transformative technologies that solve real-world challenges.

Job Description

As adoption of centrally developed products and corporate-scale capabilities continues to grow across multiple business units, we are seeking Product Owners to lead adoption, onboarding, and value realization for these products. Title:

Metrology Logistic Coordinato

Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR!

Program Summary

The KBR Metrology team supports manufacturing, engineering & test, repair & overhaul, and aftermarket service centers globally in support of Aerospace & Defense, Automotive, Medical, Safety, Semiconductor and other industries. Our support includes services such as complete management of embedded metrology systems, calibration and repair, test & inspection, metrology engineering, preventive maintenance, NADCAP special process support, and AMS2750 Heat Treat pyrometry services and more. Our teams are located across the globe working in KBR and customer embedded laboratories as well as performing onsite visits with our field service operations and mobile laboratory platforms. Our teams work to ensure our customer systems are maintained to high standards through calibration, preventative maintenance, automation and programming, calibration recall system management, and audit support. We ensure great customer experience by tracking and providing performance and delivery metrics through digital dashboards, as well as routine customer service surveys and direct customer meetings.

Job Summary

The Metrology Logistic Coordinator manages the movement, tracking, and delivery of calibration equipment to ensure timely and compliant support of metrology operations. This role includes coordination of shipments, vendor communication, system updates, and required driving to perform equipment pickup and delivery while maintaining accurate records and operational readiness.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Perform calibration and certification of basic electronic and physical/dimensional measuring and test equipment according to technical specifications, ensuring traceability to the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST).

  • Coordinate the end-to-end logistics lifecycle for metrology equipment, including receipt, shipment, tracking, and return of calibration assets

  • Perform on-site pickup and delivery of measurement equipment between customer locations, laboratories, and vendors, ensuring safe handling and secure transport of sensitive assets.

  • Manage equipment intake processes, including verification, documentation, and system entry to ensure accurate tracking and status visibility

  • Package and prepare equipment for shipment in accordance with established procedures, ensuring all required documentation, labeling, and compliance requirements are met

  • Maintain accurate and real-time updates in enterprise tracking systems (e.g., IndySoft/MetTeam), ensuring visibility of asset status, location, and turnaround timelines.

  • Interface with customers, metrology technicians, and program management to communicate equipment status, priorities, and delivery timelines.

  • Follow established standard work instructions and continuously identify opportunities to improve logistics efficiency, turnaround time, and asset visibility.

Basic Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

  • 1 - 2+ years of logistics or coordination experience

  • Valid driver’s license with required driving duties

  • Experience with tracking systems (SAP, IndySoft, MetTeam or similar)

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office

  • Strong communication, organization, and attention to detail

  • Ability to lift and transport equipment and follow safety procedures

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of logistics experience in technical or metrology environments

Job Description

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with an annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving sophisticated analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our distributed team of more than 130,000 colleagues delivers an unrivalled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.

For more information, please visit .

As a Software Developer, you will actively engage in comprehending software requirements thoroughly, ensuring end-to-end understanding, and delivering high quality code to fulfill these requirements. Your focus extends to optimizing system performance while prioritizing the long-term maintainability of the codebase.

What will you do?

  • Perform scenario-based manual testing of software applications to identify defects and ensure adherence to quality standards.
  • Analyze requirements and develop comprehensive test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative, boundary, edge, exception, and end-to-end business scenarios.
  • Apply strong software testing techniques Decision Table Testing, State Transition Testing, Error Guessing, and Exploratory Testing.
  • Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on project requirements.
  • Conduct verification and validation activities to confirm that software meets specified requirements and user expectations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand system requirements, identify requirement gaps, and validate software functionality.
  • Perform functional, integration, regression, system, exploratory, and end-to-end testing.
  • Analyze test results, identify issues, and report defects in a clear and timely manner.
  • Work closely with developers to troubleshoot issues, verify fixes, and ensure the integrity of the software.
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright with Python, where applicable, to improve regression coverage and testing efficiency.
  • Execute and maintain automated test scripts as part of the overall testing process.
  • Perform mobile device testing across applicable devices, operating systems, screen sizes, and configurations, where required.
  • Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospective meetings to provide input on testing activities and contribute to process improvement initiatives.

Minimum Requirements or Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in software testing, verification, and validation.
  • Strong proficiency in scenario-based manual testing methodologies and techniques.
  • Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in test design techniques such as Boundary Value Analysis, Equivalence Partitioning, Decision Table Testing, State Transition Testing, Error Guessing, and Exploratory Testing.
  • Strong ability to derive comprehensive test scenarios from requirements, business workflows, and user behavior, including positive, negative, boundary, edge, and exception scenarios.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
  • Experience in functional, integration, regression, system, exploratory, and end-to-end testing.
  • Experience with Playwright automation using Python is an added advantage.
  • Experience with Python and pytest is an added advantage.
  • Experience in mobile device testing is an added advantage.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Proven ability to prioritize tasks, manage workload efficiently, and meet project deadlines.
  • Knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC), software testing lifecycle (STLC), and Agile methodologies.
  • Exposure to ISO 13485 and IEC 62304 standards for medical device development.
  • ISTQB or similar certification is a plus.

title: Kierownik/Kierowniczka Projektu
description:
Polska Agencja Żeglugi Powietrznej (PANSA) zarządza przestrzenią powietrzną w Polsce. Zapewniamy płynność ruchu lotniczego oraz niezawodność infrastruktury lotniczej. Kontrolerzy Ruchu Lotniczego czuwają nad lotami setek tysięcy pasażerów każdego dnia. ​

Zapraszamy do wspólnego kształtowania przyszłości lotnictwa!
