title: Warehouseman - USW 628
description:
Determined, imaginative, curious—if these are some of the ways you describe yourself, we want to learn more about you!

At TC Energy, we are proud to connect the world to the energy it needs. Guided by our values of safety in every step, personal accountability, one team and active learning, we deliver the critical energy that North America and the world rely on while balancing reliability, affordability and sustainability.

The Opportunity

Support the day-to-day warehouse operations. This role performs duties related to shipping & receiving both physically and transactionally (SAP), inspecting, storing, issuing, and delivering a variety of materials, equipment, and supplies including high-dollar, heavy items in support of the business. Engages in receiving, storing, issuing, and maintaining control of materials and supplies in a central warehouse and pipe yard.

This position is represented by the United Steelworkers Local 628, and the filling of the position is subject to the terms and conditions of the governing collective bargaining agreement.

What You’ll Do

  • Assure and maintain data integrity in all work.
  • Collaborate with other SC functions, Operations and Maintenance groups to effectively manage and optimize order fulfillment rate.
  • Comply with all company policies, procedures, and controls, including but not limited to safety, health, confidentiality, and environmental policies.
  • Conduct Cycle Counting and/or Physical Inventory Process per schedule and report discrepancies to Warehouse Foreman.
  • Count, weigh, or measure incoming or outgoing items to compare identifying information and variety against bills of lading, invoices, orders, or other records.
  • Determine method of shipment utilizing the company’s third-party logistics providers.
  • Examine incoming shipments for issues with quality, count, part number, etc., and complete paperwork required for documentation.
  • Fill orders and issue materials per requests and document transactions appropriately.
  • Inspect and care for small tools, slings, hoists, etc. as required.
  • Load and unload materials in warehouses and storage facilities.
  • May be required to drive a company vehicle and maintain any/all licenses in good standing.
  • Monitor and maintain physical condition of warehouse.
  • Operate material handling equipment, such as forklifts and pallet jacks, to reposition materials.
  • Perform transactions in the SAP inventory system to enter new quantities and remove inventory from stock to ensure accurate system and documentation updates.
  • Prepare materials for shipping by weighing, packaging, and preparing necessary shipping documents.
  • Promote and participate in continuous improvement activities such as team huddles.
  • Provide training and guidance to other Warehouse Specialists and support onboarding of new personnel.
  • Receive materials into the warehouse and verify materials against purchase order or receiving report to ensure the accuracy of the delivery.
  • Resolve issues of quality, count, part number, etc. with incoming shipments and elevate those not resolved.
  • Resolve issues with documentation and package marking with appropriate placards when moving hazardous materials and elevate those that are not resolved.
  • Resolve problems utilizing knowledge of shipping, receiving, and stock operations.
  • Responsible for receipt, storage, and issuance of a variety of critical inventory, including pre-tested pipe, equipment, and supplies.
  • Support warehouse operations, including inventory storage, space utilization, safety, and compliance.
  • Verify correctness of catalogue/inventory numbers, descriptions, quantities, units, and location and resolve and/or communicate differences.
  • Work with Logistics team and Logistics suppliers to schedule incoming and outgoing shipments. Engage in checking incoming orders against invoices; filling orders and requisitioning stock from warehouse or pipe yard; preparing material transfers for stock being moved; storing supplies in convenient removal locations; marking identifying codes, figures, or letters on articles received; requesting supplies when needed; cleaning and making minor repairs to material being returned; loading and unloading trucks; sweeping floors; neatly arranging materials and/or otherwise tidying up warehouse or pipe yard; operating forklift and overhead crane to move, load, and unload materials.

Periodic Duties

  • Monthly/weekly cycle counts of material.
  • Monthly/annual offsite visits to field sites to assist and perform cycle counts, site cleanup, inventory removal, and shipment back to central warehouse(s).
  • Weekly rotation of on-call phone to assist with after-hours material requests. This includes working requests via email and phone calls, determining material availability in SAP, and, if necessary, dispatching to the warehouse to physically confirm material and coordinate shipping if requested and required.

The above statement reflects the general details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job identified and shall not be construed as a detailed description of all of the work requirements that may be inherent in the job.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school graduate or equivalent required.
  • Familiarity and experience with SAP or equivalent MRP inventory system.
  • Up to two years previous experience required.
  • Up to one-year minimum additional knowledge required.
  • Forklift certification and experience operating larger equipment, up to 15,000 lbs.
  • Able to be located within 45 minutes of the facility to handle and address after-hours critical material requests.

Additional Information

General supervision. Spot-checked.

About our business

We are a leader in North American energy infrastructure, spanning Canada, the U.S. and Mexico. Every day, our dedicated team proudly connects the world to the energy it needs—moving over 30 per cent of the cleaner-burning natural gas used across the continent. Complemented by strategic ownership and low-risk investments in power generation, our infrastructure fuels industries and generates affordable, reliable and sustainable power across North America, while enabling LNG exports to global markets.

TC Energy is an equal opportunity employer and participates in the E-Verify program supervised by the US government. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, religion, age, sex, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or disability. We are also committed to providing accommodations throughout the recruitment process. Applicants requiring accommodations or accessible formats are encouraged to contact us at careers@tcenergy.com for support.

All applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where the position is based, without restrictions. Background screening is required for all positions, which may include criminal and/or credit checks. Offers may be extended at a different level or job title that best aligns with the successful candidate's qualifications.

Learn more

Visit us at TCEnergy.com and connect with us on our social medial channels for our latest news, employee stories, community activities, and other updates.

Thank you for considering TC Energy in your career journey.

title: Osa-aikainen aamusiivooja vaatemyymälään
description:
Haemme nyt SIIVOOJAA työsuhteeseen TURKUUN!
Tässä tehtävässä vastaat vaatemyymälän ylläpitosiivouksesta Turun keskustassa. Työskentelet maanantaista torstaihin kello 7.00 alkaen ja lauantaisin kello 8.30 alkaen 2h/pv ja 10h/vk. Tehtävä edellyttää aikaisempaa siivoustyökokemusta ja käytät työssäsi yhdistelmäkonetta. Tämä työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.
Tehtävästä maksetaan Kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimuksen palkkaryhmän 2 mukaista palkkaa (12,59 €/h) sekä mahdolliset lisät.
ISS on paikka juuri sinulle! Meillä saat
- paikan, jossa voit kasvaa: meillä voit rakentaa oman urapolkusi ja hyödyntää monipuolisia koulutusmahdollisuuksiamme.
- työyhteisön, jossa arvostamme monimuotoisuutta sen kaikissa merkityksissä, meidän tiimissämme voit olla oma itsesi.
- vakaan ja luotettavan työpaikan, jossa voit luottaa siihen, että palkkasi maksetaan oikein ja ajallaan. Erityisiä onnistumisia huomioimme ISS-palkitsemisohjelman mukaisesti.
- laadukkaat työterveyshuollon palvelut ja työhyvinvointiohjelmat.
- turvalliset työolosuhteet: suojavarusteet, työvaatteet, perehdytyksen työtehtäviin, ennakoivaan turvallisuuskulttuuriin ja säännölliset turvavartit.
- liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun vapaa-ajallesi.

Meillä viihdytään, koska täällä voi kasvaa, vaikuttaa ja onnistua. Tutustu taitaviin tekijöihimme: ISS töISSä

Sinulta me odotamme
- aikaisempaa työkokemusta puhdistuspalvelualalta. Alan koulutuksen luemme eduksesi.
- suomen tai englannin kielen osaamista.
- oman työn organisointitaitoa sekä tarkkaa ja avuliasta työotetta, tartut joustavasti erilaisiin työtehtäviin.
- itsenäistä työotetta sekä hyviä tiimityötaitoja, sillä työskentelet kohteessa toisen siivoojan kanssa.
- hyvää fyysistä peruskuntoa.


Tärkeissä paikoissa tarvitaan taitavimmat tekijät. Tule meille rakentamaan omaa ISS urapolkuasi ja tekemään kanssamme tiloja, joissa on hyvä olla!
Täytä hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta viimeistään 24.9.! Voit kertoa osaamisestasi ja kokemuksestasi joko liittämällä hakemukseesi cv:n tai kirjoittamalla tiedot hakulomakkeen tekstikenttään. Käsittelemme kaikki hakemukset ja kerromme jokaiselle hakijalle prosessin etenemisestä.

Me, ISS Suomi, olemme osa maailman johtavaa kiinteistö- ja toimitilapalveluyhtiötä, joka toimii yli 30 maassa. Suomessa meitä ISS:läisiä on yli 7 000 ja toimimme valtakunnallisesti. Toimintamme tarkoituksena on luoda tiloja, joissa on hyvä olla. Luomme näitä tiloja siivous-, kiinteistö-, ravintola- ja työpaikkapalveluillamme. Siivous on palvelualoistamme suurin. Olemme luoneet puhtaita ja siten turvallisia, viihtyisiä ja tuottavia tiloja yli 100 vuoden ajan. Nykyisin siivoamme yhä useammissa kohteissamme kemikaalivapaasti, moderneja siivouskoneita käyttäen. Työparinasi saattaa olla robotti!
Ilmastotavoitteenamme on olla hiilineutraali vuonna 2040 – ISS:läisenä pääsetkin vaikuttamaan merkittävästi tämän tavoitteen toteutumiseen ja yhteisen ympäristömme hyvinvointiin!

title: Postdoctoral Associate
description:
Required Qualifications\: (as evidenced by an attached resume)

● Ph.D. (or foreign equivalent) in geosciences, geophysics, physics, chemistry, materials science, chemical engineering, or a closely related field, in hand by the date of appointment.

● Research experience performing first-principles electronic structure or density functional theory calculations using an established code (for example VASP, Quantum ESPRESSO).

● Research experience performing molecular dynamics simulations.

● Experience training, fine-tuning, or validating machine-learning interatomic potentials or force fields (for example MACE, NequIP, DeePMD).

● Experience running scientific calculations on Linux-based high-performance computing clusters, including scripting or workflow automation (for example Python, bash, or an equivalent language).

● At least one peer-reviewed publication in a scientific journal.

Preferred Qualifications\:

● Experience with free-energy or phase-boundary calculations, such as two-phase coexistence simulations, thermodynamic integration, or the Z-method.

● Research experience with geological materials at high pressure and high temperature.

● Experience extracting transport properties from molecular dynamics trajectories.

● Experience with GPU-accelerated machine learning frameworks (for example CUDA, PyTorch, or GPU-enabled LAMMPS).

● Experience with an established molecular dynamics engine such as LAMMPS, ASE.

● Experience generating and curating training datasets, including active learning or uncertainty-driven sampling strategies.

● Experience presenting research at national or international scientific conferences.

● Experience preparing computing allocation requests to national facilities such as NSF ACCESS, DOE INCITE, or NERSC.

● Experience with version control and reproducible research practices, including Git and documented computational workflows.

Brief Description of Duties\:

The Postdoctoral Associate will collaborate with the Principal Investigator in the Department of Geosciences to carry out computational research on the melting behavior and physical properties of geological materials under conditions relevant to planetary interiors. This work will rely on large-scale atomistic simulations paired with machine-learning interatomic potentials.

Duties\:

● The postdoc will generate density functional theory reference data, use it to train and validate machine-learning force fields, run molecular dynamics simulations based on those potentials, analyze the data, interpret it geophysically.

● Write up the findings for peer-reviewed publication, and present them at conferences and group meetings.

● Participate in group activities, such as mentoring students.

● Other duties or projects as assigned as appropriate to rank and departmental mission.

Special Notes\:
This is a full-time appointment. FLSA Exempt position, not eligible for the overtime provisions of the FLSA. Minimum salary threshold must be met to maintain FLSA exemption.

title: Controller Centec Jrz
description:
Who We Are

Aptiv is a global technology leader, with more than 200,000 people across more than 140 manufacturing facilities and 15 major technical centers worldwide in 48 countries.

Today, our mission is to shape the world with safer, greener, and more connected solutions that enable the future of mobility.

Our Finance organization plays a critical role in supporting operational excellence across Aptiv's global manufacturing network by providing financial insights, governance, cost optimization, and strategic decision support that drive sustainable business growth.

Your Role

As a Controller, you will lead the financial planning, reporting, and control activities of the Centec Juárez operation. You will partner closely with plant leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure strong financial performance, effective cost management, compliance with internal controls, and informed business decision-making.

This role offers the opportunity to make a direct impact on operational and financial results while supporting key manufacturing initiatives and long-term business objectives.

How You Will Contribute

In your daily job you will:

  • Lead monthly financial reporting, forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis activities.

  • Ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial statements, including Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss, and Cash Flow reporting.

  • Drive manufacturing cost analysis and oversee the complete costing process.

  • Analyze monthly manufacturing expenses and identify cost drivers, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Monitor monthly sales performance and provide financial insights related to revenue trends and business performance.

  • Develop, monitor, and report key financial and operational performance indicators (KPIs).

  • Manage and strengthen financial and operational internal controls to ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.

  • Support investment planning and control processes for capital expenditures (CAPEX).

  • Partner with manufacturing, operations, supply chain, and leadership teams to identify opportunities for cost optimization and performance improvement.

  • Coordinate the annual physical inventory process and ensure compliance with financial and operational requirements.

  • Provide financial guidance and support across a wide range of plant initiatives and business activities.

  • Support strategic planning activities that drive profitability and operational excellence.

  • Lead, coach, and develop team members, supporting their technical and professional growth.

We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.

  • More than 5 years of experience in Controlling, Finance, Accounting, or Manufacturing Finance roles.

  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal).

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

  • Proven ability to influence decision-making through financial analysis and business insights.

  • A proactive mindset focused on continuous improvement and operational efficiency.

Skill Set Requirements

Essential

  • Strong knowledge of accounting and financial processes.

  • Experience preparing and analyzing:

    • Balance Sheet

    • Profit & Loss Statements

    • Cash Flow Statements

  • Cost accounting and manufacturing costing expertise.

  • Advanced Excel

  • Experience in SAP or Oracle (HFM)

  • Financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.

  • Financial and operational internal controls.

  • Manufacturing finance and cost analysis experience.

  • KPI development, monitoring, and reporting.

  • Advanced analytical and business-partnering capabilities.

Desirable

  • Experience supporting capital investment projects (CAPEX).

  • Experience leading or mentoring finance teams.

  • Knowledge of ERP systems and financial reporting tools.

  • Experience in a manufacturing or automotive environment.

  • Continuous improvement and process optimization experience.

What's In It For You

Why Join Us?

You can grow at Aptiv. Aptiv provides an inclusive work environment where all individuals can grow and develop regardless of gender, ethnicity, or beliefs.

You can have an impact. Safety is a core Aptiv value. We want a safer world for us and our children, one with:

  • Zero fatalities

  • Zero injuries

  • Zero accidents

You have support. We ensure you have the resources and support you need to succeed both professionally and personally.

Your Benefits at Aptiv

  • Major Medical Insurance with optional add-ons

  • Life and Accidental Death Insurance

  • Flexible Benefits Program

  • Savings Fund

  • Grocery Allowance

  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Vacation Premium, Holidays, and Christmas Bonus)

  • Learning and Development Opportunities

  • Employee Assistance and Wellness Programs

  • Recognition for Innovation and Excellence

  • Opportunities to Give Back to the Community

APPLY TODAY, AND TOGETHER LET'S CHANGE TOMORROW!

title: Solution Engineer
description:
As a Solutions Engineer, you will own the analytical portion of the sales process. You will help uncover customer analytical needs and pain points that relate to the Earnix platform and demonstrate how the Earnix suite of products aligns with the insurance carrier's vision.


What you’ll do:

Own the technical and analytical side of the sales process, end-to-end

Join the Scripps Health team and work alongside passionate caregivers and provide patient-centered healthcare. Receive endless appreciation while you build a rewarding career with one of the most respected healthcare organizations nationwide.

Why join Scripps Health?

At Scripps Health, your ambition is empowered and your abilities are appreciated\:

  • Nearly a quarter of our employees have been with Scripps Health for over 10 years.

  • Scripps Health has been consistently ranked as a top employer for women, millennials, diversity, and as an overall workplace by various national publications.

Why join this team?

In our supportive environment, our Pathology Lab Assistants are always learning and training in different sections of pathology, while maintaining accuracy with high volume of processing. You will be exposed to a wide variety of complex cases and procedures and will have the opportunity to work closely with the team of pathologists, radiologists and surgeons.

As a Pathology Lab Assistant Sr., you will be responsible for the handling and accessioning of surgical and outpatient tissues and cytologic specimens. Job duties include the following\:

  • Using the cryostat to cut frozen tissue sections for rapid specimen diagnosis by the pathologist and staining slides using H/E and DQ stains.
  • Using the Faxitron for breast specimens to identify biopsy clips and Magseeds in the pathology tissue room.
  • Attending various CT and Ultrasound radiologic and EUS and EBUS procedures to handle and triage collected tissue to prepare slides for rapid interpretation by the pathologist and place tissue in cassettes for cell block preparation in the acute care hospital.
  • Attending bone marrow procedures (bedside and in radiology) to handle and triage collected tissue to prepare slides and prepare the core.
  • Ensuring that the specimens are identified and labelled correctly and protects the pathologist, department and organization at large against critical patient care errors.

title: Lastensuojelun palveluvastaava, lastensuojeluyksikkö Nalle, Espoo
description:
Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen lastensuojelun laitoshoidon yksiköistä kolme sijaitsee samassa kiinteistössä Espoon Viherlaaksossa. Etsimme nyt motivoitunutta ja osaavaa lastensuojelun palveluvastaavaa vakituiseen virkaan 7- paikkaiseen perustason yksikköön Nalleen. Lastensuojelun palveluvastaavana pääset olemaan keskeisessä roolissa lasten hyvinvoinnin edistämisessä. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisessa ja kehittyvässä ympäristössä, jossa voit hyödyntää asiantuntemustasi ja johtamistaitojasi.

Lastensuojelun palveluvastaava toimii omassa yksikössään lastensuojelulaissa määriteltynä lastensuojelulaitoksen vastuuhenkilönä ja vastaa yksikköönsä sijoitettujen lasten hoito- ja kasvatustyöstä siihen kuuluvine elementteineen. Palveluvastaava vastaa yksikkönsä lastensuojelulain mukaisten rajoitustoimenpiteiden päättämisestä ja toteutuksesta sekä delegoinnista sekä vastaa yksikkönsä lääkehoidon toteutumisesta. Palveluvastaavan tehtäviin kuuluvat myös lasten hoito- ja kasvatustehtävät osana yksikön mitoitusta.

Lastensuojelun palveluvastaava on tiiminsä henkilöstön esihenkilö ja yksikön henkilöstön työhyvinvoinnin omavalvonta kuuluu oleellisena työnkuvaan. Lastensuojelun palveluvastaava suunnittelee itse omat työvuoronsa vastaamaan yksikön tarpeita. Työaikamuoto on jaksotyö, mikä mahdollistaa lastensuojelun laitoshoidon yksiköiden palveluvastaavien työn yhteistä suunnittelua niin, että myös viikonloppuisin mahdollisesti joku palveluvastaavista on töissä ja suunnitelmallisesti tavoitettavissa työntekijöiden tueksi.

Lastensuojelun palveluvastaava osallistuu oman palvelunsa johtoryhmätyöskentelyyn sekä hyvinvointialuetasoiseen työn kehittämiseen yhdessä muiden laitoshoidon yksiköiden palveluvastaavien sekä lastensuojelun palveluesihenkilön kanssa. Lastensuojelun palveluvastaavilla on myös oma yhteinen esihenkilöiden ryhmätyönohjaus. Tehtävässä onnistumiseen sinulla onkin tiivis kollegiaalinen ja esihenkilösi tuki.

Kelpoisuusvaatimukset: Sosiaalihuoltolain 46 a §:n 3 momentin mukainen tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto

Tehtävässä edellytetään käytännön työssä osoitettua johtamistaitoa eli kokemusta esihenkilötehtävistä sekä vähintään 3 vuoden työkokemusta lastensuojelun sijaishuollosta. Lisäksi edellytetään asiakasta kunnioittavaa työasennetta, verkostotyön osaamista, erinomaisia vuorovaikutustaitoja ja paineensietokykyä, hyvää suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa, dokumentointiosaamista sekä kehittämismyönteistä työotetta. Tehtävän hoitaminen edellyttää myös ajokorttia ja ajotaitoa.

Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6.2 §:n tarkoittama rikosrekisteriote.

Virkaan/työsuhteeseen valituilta pyydetään satunnaisesti Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen päihdeohjelman mukaista huumausainetodistusta.

Eduksi luetaan kokemus lastensuojeluyksikön vastuuhenkilönä toimimisesta, lääkehoitolupiin vaadittava koulutus sisältyen tutkintoon tai erikseen hankittuna sekä kokemus kehittämistehtävistä.

Haastattelut tehtäviin pidetään torstaina 1.10.2026 klo 8-12 sekä perjantaina 2.10.2026 klo 8-11.

Jäämme odottamaan hakemustasi!

Olemme muutoksen tekijöitä. Uudistamme rohkeasti sen, mikä kaipaa parannusta, ja säilytämme sen, mikä toimii. Panostamme jokaisen työntekijämme hyvinvointiin ja haluamme tarjota monipuolisia etuja henkilöstöllemme. Tarjoamme lounasedun ja saat käyttöösi vuodessa 300 €, jonka voit käyttää toiveidesi mukaan kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi-, liikunta- tai matkalippuetuuksiin. Lisäksi pääset kehittämään omaa osaamistasi Eduhousen ja Oppiportin laajojen verkkokoulutusten avulla.

title: Technical Lead
description:

Responsibilities

  • Lead end to end design and implementation of front end solutions using JavaScript and React Js to deliver responsive and accessible applications that meet business needs and user expectations.

  • Safety Inspections: Conducting inspections of walking surfaces, fire extinguishers, and overall facility safety to mitigate risks.
  • Parking Enforcement: Enforcing parking regulations to ensure safety and accessibility, focusing on enhancing the patient experience.
  • Investigations: Collaborating with HR and law enforcement to conduct investigations, following protocols for disclosing patient information, and ensuring facility safety.

description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

What you’ll be doing

As the Director, Data & Insights, Complaints Management, you will be accountable for all data, reporting, analytics, and insight generation requirements supporting the ongoing evolution of the Complaints Management Program (CMP). The CMP is a centre of excellence established to ensure compliance with complaint handling requirements mandated by the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada (FCAC). You will lead the development and delivery of enterprise complaints reporting and insights, oversee key regulatory and governance reporting obligations, and support the continuous enhancement of data processes, controls, and infrastructure. You will work closely with partners across Compliance, Technology, Business Controls, and the Lines of Business to ensure complaints data is complete, reliable, well-governed, and positioned to inform strategic decision-making.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You’ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 2–3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

How you’ll succeed

  • Leadership – Lead a small team of Consultants and Senior Consultants responsible for complaints data, reporting, analytics, and insight generation. Coach team members, set clear priorities, and ensure quality, timeliness, and consistency across recurring reporting cycles and ad hoc requests. Foster a strong control environment and a continuous improvement mindset across the team.

  • Enterprise Reporting & Insights – Lead the production and review of weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual complaints reporting. Identify notable trends, emerging issues, and key risk indicators across enterprise complaints data, and translate findings into clear, actionable insights for business and executive audiences.

  • Committee, Executive & Board Reporting – Oversee preparation of complaints reporting and insights for senior management and governance forums, including executive-level updates, quarterly Complaints Management Committee materials, and complaints-related contributions to Board reporting. Ensure reporting is accurate, decision-useful, and supported by clear metric definitions and documented methodologies.

  • Regulatory Reporting – Lead the delivery of regulatory complaints reporting obligations, including quarterly FCAC complaints reporting, and ensure compliance with evolving external requirements, schemas, guidance, and reporting expectations. Partner closely with Compliance to interpret changes and implement them effectively.

  • Metric Governance & Controls – Maintain strong governance over enterprise complaints metrics, including operational definitions, transformation logic, calculation methodologies, reporting procedures, and supporting controls. Lead annual metric refresh activities and support proposals, approvals, and updates for enterprise metrics and key risk indicators.

  • Data Infrastructure & Dashboards – Provide oversight of complaints dashboards, reporting data sets, and analytics tooling, including Databricks and related reporting environments. Support the enhancement of reporting assets and partner with Technology and data teams to resolve production issues, validate changes through testing, and improve reliability and scalability.

  • Advanced Analytics & Ad Hoc Requests – Lead and support complex ad hoc data requests from Lines of Business and enterprise partners related to investigations, audits, systemic issue reviews, business cases, and other management needs. Apply tools and techniques such as SQL, Alteryx, Python, and advanced analytics methods, including NLP where appropriate, to derive meaningful insights from complaints data.

  • Data Sourcing & Integration – Support the onboarding and integration of new complaints-related data sources and feeds to strengthen enterprise reporting and insight generation. Work with business and technology partners to improve data completeness, quality, and usability across platforms.

  • Relationship Management – Build strong partnerships across Compliance, Business Controls, Technology, and business stakeholders to align reporting requirements, resolve issues, and identify opportunities to improve complaint data use and governance. Act as a trusted advisor and escalation point for complaints data and reporting matters.

  • Oversight & Execution – Provide oversight of the complaints tracking ecosystem, including reporting processes connected to Salesforce and other platforms maintained by the Lines of Business. Ensure reporting obligations are executed effectively and that monitoring activities, procedures, and controls remain fit for purpose.

  • Strategic Communication – Support the development of presentations, overview materials, and management-ready narratives that communicate the CMP mandate, key trends, reporting outcomes, and strategic priorities to a range of stakeholders.

Who you are

  • You have a degree/diploma in engineering, mathematics, computer science, statistics, data analytics, or a related discipline leveraging advanced analytical and research methods.

  • You can demonstrate experience in leading data, analytics, and reporting teams in a complex enterprise environment, with accountability for recurring executive, Board, and regulatory reporting. Expertise in Databricks, SQL, MS Suite, Power BI, with working knowledge of Alteryx and Python for data transformation, automation, and analysis. Proficiency in data governance best practices, including metric design, operational definitions, transformation logic, calculation methodologies, reporting controls, and procedure documentation.

  • You are a caring and accountable leader. You are passionate about developing and growing team members’ abilities. You have experience providing coaching and hands-on support to meet team goals. You bring strong analytical, data, reporting, and problem-solving skills.

  • You act like an owner. You thrive when you're empowered to take initiative, go above and beyond, and deliver results. You have strong verbal, presentation, and written communication skills, including the ability to translate complex data into clear messages for executive and governance audiences.

  • You’re a subject matter expert. You have experience and knowledge of how data can be leveraged to drive strategic objectives. You have knowledge of complaints management processes, procedures, and guidelines. Experience with regulatory, risk, control, or governance reporting is an asset.

  • You can demonstrate experience in the delivery and execution of large and complex programs. You have experience operationalizing governance processes, procedures, and frameworks, including recurring reporting cycles, data controls, issue escalation, testing support, and implementation of new data sources or reporting requirements.

  • Your influence makes a difference. You know that relationships and networks are essential to success. You inspire outcomes by sharing your expertise, aligning stakeholders, and driving decisions through data-backed insight.

title: Sairaanhoitaja/myyntiedustaja liikkuvaan työhön
description:
MediPower hakee nyt sairaanhoitajaa / myyntiedustajaa Kir-Fix Oy:lle vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät terveydenhuollon osaaminen, ortopediset tuotteet ja asiakastyö. Työskentelyalueesi voi olla Tampereella tai pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta ensisijaisesti toivomme sinun pystyvän työskentelemään Tampereelta käsin.


Työnkuvaus:

Tehtävässä työskentelet liikkuvassa roolissa Pirkanmaan ja pääkaupunkiseudun alueella. Työhön kuuluu tekonivel- ja traumatuotteiden esittelyä ja myyntiä terveydenhuollon ammattilaisille sekä olemassa olevien asiakkuuksien hoitamista. Asiakkuuksia on valmiina, mutta tehtävässä on myös mahdollisuus aktiiviseen uusasiakashankintaan.

Toivomme sinulta kokemusta ortopedisista tuotteista ja tekonivelistä sekä mielellään aiempaa kokemusta leikkaussalityöskentelystä. Myyntihenkisyys ja kiinnostus kaupalliseen työhön ovat tehtävässä tärkeässä roolissa. Työ sisältää reissaamista Pirkanmaan ja pääkaupunkiseudun välillä, joten tehtävässä tarvitaan valmiutta liikkuvaan työhön.


Odotamme:

Edellytämme valmistunutta sairaanhoitajaa sekä aiempaa kokemusta ortopedisista tuotteista, erityisesti tekonivelistä. Leikkaussalikokemus katsotaan eduksi, samoin aiempi myyntikokemus. Arvostamme ulospäinsuuntautunutta, oma-aloitteista ja asiakaslähtöistä työotetta sekä hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja.

Tehtävässä tarvitaan B-ajokorttia ja matkustusvalmiutta. Voimassa olevat lääkeluvat katsotaan eduksi.


Tarjoamme:

Tarjoamme vakituisen työsuhteen suoraan Kir-Fix Oy:n palveluksessa sekä monipuolisen tehtävän terveysalan tuotteiden parissa. Tehtävässä pääset hyödyntämään sairaanhoitajan osaamistasi ja kehittämään samalla myynnillistä ammattitaitoasi.

Palkkaus on kokemuksesta riippuen 3 500–4 500 €/kk, minkä lisäksi maksetaan 500–1 500 €:n kuukausittaista provisiota. Tehtävään kuuluu myös autoetu.

Aloitus on mahdollisimman pian sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.


Hakuprosessi:

Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, jätä hakemuksesi meille mahdollisimman pian. Tämä haku toteutetaan MediPowerin kautta, joten jos tehtävä kiinnostaa, olethan meihin yhteydessä.

Hakemuksessa voit kertoa aiemmasta kokemuksestasi ortopedisten tuotteiden, leikkaussalityön ja myynnin parissa sekä siitä, milloin voisit aloittaa.

title: Production Systems Expert
description:
Job Description Summary

Are you passionate about transforming manufacturing through the integration of processes, equipment, and digital systems? As a Manufacturing Systems Expert, you will play a key role in supporting reliable, compliant, and efficient manufacturing operations in a GxP-regulated environment. Working collaboratively with manufacturing, quality, engineering, automation, and IT teams, you will contribute to the management and continuous improvement of manufacturing systems that enable operational excellence and digital transformation. This role offers a unique opportunity to develop expertise across multiple production systems while helping shape the future of digital manufacturing and delivering sustainable value to the business.


Job Description

The Manufacturing Systems Expert is responsible for coordinating, maintaining, and continuously improving manufacturing systems that support production and packaging operations. The role acts as a bridge between business users, production teams, quality functions, IT, and external partners to ensure reliable and compliant system performance.

The role is responsible for coordinating and continuously improving manufacturing systems in compliance with GMP requirements. Represent the assigned manufacturing area in MES and other Manufacturing Systems initiatives, ensuring that electronic batch records and related digital capabilities are implemented in line with business, operational, and compliance requirements. Collaborate with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to identify needs, define requirements, and deliver effective and value-added digital solutions.

Design, create, maintain, and continuously improve MBRs in line with operational, quality, and compliance requirements.


Major Accountabilities:

  • Coordinate end-to-end MES implementation activities for all products, including current and future MES releases, upgrades, and related digital initiatives.
  • Identify improvement opportunities by analyzing system performance, operational needs, and industry best practices.
  • Ensure inspection readiness by maintaining up-to-date manufacturing systems procedures, documentation, and compliance records, and by supporting internal and external audits/inspections.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for assigned manufacturing systems, providing technical and functional guidance while promoting knowledge sharing and cross-training within the Manufacturing Systems team.
  • Provide expertise for manufacturing and packaging processes during the design, testing, implementation, and continuous improvement of manufacturing system solutions and MBRs.
  • Coordinate, maintain, and continuously improve manufacturing systems, including MES, SAP, MACO, Seidenader Track & Trace, AGE, Historian, and GISC, ensuring their reliable and compliant operation.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to identify current and future business needs, drive process simplification, system optimization, automation and digitalization opportunities, and contribute to new projects, enhancements, and digital initiatives.
  • Support site digital transformation initiatives and contribute to the successful execution of the site's digital roadmap.
  • Contribute to end-to-end project implementation activities, including requirements gathering, solution design, testing, deployment, user training, go-live, and hypercare support.
  • Provide day-to-day operational support and troubleshooting for manufacturing systems, ensuring timely resolution of system-related issues and minimizing impact on production operations.
  • Investigate recurring or critical system issues, support root cause analysis, and drive sustainable corrective and preventive actions in collaboration with relevant functions.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in production operations, manufacturing systems, or related functions in a GMP/GxP-regulated environment. Experience with MES is considered an advantage.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English.
  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes and process-oriented ways of working.
  • Strong interpersonal, collaboration, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, IT/OT and other functions.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues and implement effective corrective actions.
  • Understand end-to-end manufacturing processes and system interfaces and effectively assess the potential operational and compliance impact of system changes or incidents.
  • Team-oriented and customer-focused mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and support project execution.
  • Business acumen with the ability to understand operational needs and translate them into effective solutions.
  • Continuous improvement and operational excellence mindset.
  • Strong digital mindset with the ability and willingness to quickly learn new manufacturing technologies, systems, and digital solutions.

Data Analytics

title: WDHB21987
company: Te Whatu Ora - Health New Zealand
description:
Waitemata District serves the largest population in New Zealand providing services to more than 640,000 people and employing more than 8,800 staff. We have a diverse population with complex, interesting, and challenging presentations.

Located in a world class harbour city, Waitemata District operates over two sites, North Shore Hospital on the shores of Takapuna’s Lake Pupuke and Waitakere Hospital within sight of West Auckland’s green belt.

Our promise and values statement “Best Care for Everyone” serves to inspire us to continuously improve and strive to provide the best care possible to every patient and their family.

The successful applicant will join our SMO team of friendly, enthusiastic and dedicated professionals in the General Surgery Department. The colorectal surgical service provides tertiary referral service for advanced pelvic malignancies. There is a colorectal fellow who is usually allocated by the training board in colorectal surgery. There is a strong working relationship with gastroenterology service managing endoscopy services and inflammatory bowel disease. There is regional robotic surgical service, and we are looking to develop our robotic colorectal program into the future.

Your responsibilities will include outpatient clinics, elective and acute theatre sessions, and endoscopy sessions. There would be approximately five half day acute general surgical theatre sessions per fortnight. You will be required to be on call on in accordance with the After Hours On Call Agreement. There may be other clinical commitments such as grading referrals, and supporting gynaecology services performing complex endometriosis surgical procedures.

The candidate should have FRACS in General Surgery. They should have completed at least two years of post-fellowship training in colorectal surgery prior to commencing the role. Membership of the CSSANZ (at least provisionally) is highly desirable. Post-fellowship training in advanced pelvic malignancy would be advantageous. The candidate must be able to be credentialled in colonoscopy (i.e. have recognition of training in colonoscopy by conjoint committee preferred). Some experience in robotic colorectal procedures may be advantageous. Salaries and conditions of employment will be in accordance with the NZ Association of Salaried Medical Specialists’ collective agreement.

title: Lead Engineer, Manufacturing Engineering
description:
Job Title:

Lead Engineer, Manufacturing Engineering

Job Description:

The Role: Lead Engineer, Manufacturing Engineering (NPI)

As a NPI Manufacturing/Assembly Engineer, you will support and lead New Product Introduction (NPI) initiatives within the Advanced Purity Solutions (APS) Division. This role is responsible for successfully transitioning new products and processes from engineering development into high-volume manufacturing through robust process development, validation, project leadership, and cross-functional collaboration. You will contribute to delivering high-quality, cost-effective, and scalable manufacturing solutions while driving continuous improvement and operational excellence.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop manufacturing process flows including planning, process development, validation strategies, product awareness, quality systems, and automation techniques.

  • Partner with R&D, Product Management, Operations, Engineering, and Project Management teams to define product success criteria and ensure successful product launches.

  • Lead new product and process transfers from engineering development through pilot production and high-volume manufacturing.

  • Develop and execute Validation and Qualification (V&Q) protocols for new products, processes, and product transfers.

  • Develop work instructions, SOPs, manufacturing process documentation, process records, and production controls to support manufacturing readiness.

  • Lead manufacturing readiness assessments and identify gaps to ensure successful scale-up and achievement of IRD/manufacturing targets.

  • Conduct PFMEAs, design reviews, manufacturing assessments, design freeze reviews, and risk mitigation activities to support robust product introductions.

  • Design, source, and implement custom fixtures, jigs, assembly tools, and manufacturing solutions to improve productivity and quality.

  • Support qualification builds, customer samples, and pilot production activities using standard manufacturing systems and work orders.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Manufacturing, DMAIC, Six Sigma, and statistical analysis methodologies to improve yield, capacity, cycle time, and process stability.

  • Participate in product, tooling, mold, and process design reviews while providing manufacturing-focused feedback and recommendations.

  • Analyze manufacturing performance and identify product and process improvement opportunities to optimize quality, cost, and efficiency.

  • Troubleshoot technical challenges related to products, tooling, equipment, and manufacturing processes using structured problem-solving methodologies.

  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in key manufacturing processes such as injection molding, ultrasonic welding, CNC machining, inspection systems, laser marking, data collection, and reporting systems.

  • Review engineering drawings, specifications, FAIR requirements, and critical dimensions to ensure product manufacturability and process capability.

  • Communicate effectively with multicultural and cross-functional teams to drive projects to completion on schedule and within objectives.

What We Seek:

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.

  • Minimum 5+ years of engineering or manufacturing experience, preferably within the semiconductor, high-tech, medical device, or plastics industries.

  • Strong knowledge of New Product Introduction (NPI), product transfers, validation, and high-volume manufacturing processes.

  • Experience with statistical analysis tools such as Minitab and data-driven decision-making methodologies.

  • Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis, and Continuous Improvement methodologies.

  • Experience with PFMEA, process validation, manufacturing assessments, and production readiness activities.

  • Knowledge of injection molding products, assembly processes, tooling, and manufacturing process development is preferred.

  • Ability to review and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and product requirements.

  • Experience using engineering simulation analysis tools such as FEA, CFD, and Moldflow software is an advantage.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Outstanding Candidates Will Have:

  • Strong interpersonal and cross-functional teamwork skills.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication capabilities.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Self-motivated and proactive approach to learning and continuous improvement.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

  • Hands-on engineering mindset with willingness to work closely with manufacturing operations.

  • Ability to become a technical subject matter expert across multiple manufacturing technologies.

  • Flexibility to travel internationally to support business, manufacturing, supplier, and customer needs.

What We Offer:

At Entegris, we invest in providing opportunities for our employees and promote from within. The new hire in this role will have the potential to grow and create relationships across the organization and be recognized for demonstrated success and adherence to company PACE values.

Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals.

  • Competitive Contractual and Profit-Sharing Bonuses: Rewarding your hard work and dedication.

  • Comprehensive Health Insurance: Tailored packages to meet your individual needs.

  • Generous Paid Public Holidays: Enjoy 17 days off to celebrate and relax.

  • Empowering PTO Policy: Take the time you need to recharge and come back refreshed.

  • Education Assistance: Support for your continuous learning and development.

  • Values-Driven Culture: Work with colleagues who embody People, Accountability, Creativity, and Excellence.

title: Research Scientist II, Immunology
description:

Job Description Summary

Location: Basel
Onsite
This role is not offering relocation. Please apply only if the location is accessible to you.
#LI-Onsite

We are working on innovative medicines to treat autoinflammatory and systemic autoimmune diseases, aiming to make a meaningful difference for patients. Here, you can apply your scientific skills and curiosity within a collaborative, interdisciplinary team, with your work helping generate important insights that lead to new, life-changing therapies.

The position in the Adaptive Immunity Lab is embedded within the Immunology Research Disease Area and will focus on translational aspects and project support for B cell-driven autoimmune diseases (e.g. systemic lupus erythematosus, rheumatoid arthritis). The role encompasses the design and execution of preclinical in vitro and in vivo studies, including complex flow cytometry-based analyses, to advance the mechanistic understanding of immune cell engager therapies. In addition, the position will contribute to the development of translational biomarker strategies to support clinical development. To lead research activities, we are seeking a scientist with a strong background in mechanistic translational research and immunology.

If you are passionate about human disease biology and compound mode of action at the interface of preclinical and clinical research, we want you on our team.


Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Actively contribute to drug discovery and exploratory projects aiming at discovering new ways to modulate the immune system for the treatment of inflammatory and autoimmune diseases.
  • Collaborate with quantitative scientists to design hypothesis-driven experiments and integrate experimental and biomarker data into models of autoimmune disease biology and therapeutic response.
  • Design and conduct mechanistic experiments hands-on, utilizing human biosamples (such as blood/serum, PBMC, tissue biopsies) to generate translational data that inform project decisions, validate innovative concepts, elucidate mechanisms of action, and develop biomarker strategies.
  • Plan and implement in vitro and ex vivo assays - including complex flow cytometry, cellular profiling, mechanistic cellular analyses, and examination of ex vivo samples derived from in vivo studies.
  • Perform thorough analysis and interpretation of experimental results, critically evaluating whether hypotheses have been adequately tested, resolving any technical challenges, and determining subsequent experimental steps.
  • Drive the development of novel hypotheses by integrating both internal and external scientific insights, proactively address research obstacles, and design strategic approaches to test these initial hypotheses.
  • Work collaboratively as an integral part of cross-functional project teams, provide organized experiment record tracking and data analysis and be an active member of lab and project teams.
  • Independently search for information in scientific and technical literature, establish new technologies in the lab and present your data within the team.
  • Drive a culture of collaboration, talent development and integrity.

Minimum Requirements

  • MSc degree in Immunology, Biology, Molecular Medicine or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of relevant research expertise in an interdisciplinary setting in academia or industry, bridging clinical and preclinical evidence
  • Hands-on mastery of routine immunological/ cell biology/ molecular biology assays and in vitro human models relevant to autoinflammatory and systemic autoimmune diseases (such as primary cells, cell lines, flow cytometry, qPCR etc.)
  • Experienced in collaboration with data scientists, ensuring high quality experimental design and reproducibility.
  • Proven track record of completing projects on schedule in view of narrow timelines
  • Strong interest in working in a creative environment where you demonstrate proactiveness, a flexible attitude and scientific curiosity

Additional Requirements

  • Experience contributing to drug discovery programs in biotech/pharma or translational academic/clinical setting (e.g. in vitro pharmacology, biomarker studies) is a plus.
  • Data Science literacy and confidence in interpreting multi‑omic outputs and statistical analyses is an additional asset.

Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and a minimum of 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Health care is constantly changing, and at Banner Health, we are at the front of that change. We are leading health care to make the experience the best it can be. We want to change the lives of those in our care – and the people who choose to take on this challenge. If changing health care for the better sounds like something you want to be part of, we want to hear from you.

As a Surgery Scheduler for our Cath Lab team, you will fulfill all tasks related to scheduling and confirming patients for upcoming procedures. To accomplish these takes, you will utilize strong decision making, communication and problem-solving skills aimed at maximizing customer satisfaction for patients, physicians, nursing staff, and administrative colleagues.

Shift: Mon-Fri 7:30am-4pm

Location: BUMC-T South (2800 E Ajo Way) but may float to Main Campus occasionally.

Ideal Candidate:

  • At least 2 years of experience in healthcare, preferably scheduling or Patient Access;

  • General understanding of Cardiac and/or Cath Lab daily workflow.

Banner - University Medical Center Tucson is nationally recognized for providing exceptional patient care, teaching future health-care professionals and conducting groundbreaking research. Also located on the campus is Diamond Children's - recognized for its specialized pediatric services including neonatal and intensive care, emergency medicine and cancer therapies. Banner - University Medical Center Tucson is a Level 1 Trauma Center, meaning we care for the most critically injured patients. The hospital is consistently listed among the nation's top hospitals in the prestigious Best Hospitals ranking by U.S. News & World Report. The academic medical center has earned Magnet Recognition becoming the only hospital in southern Arizona to meet the rigorous standards of the American Nurses Credentialing Center’s Magnet Recognition Program® for nursing excellence. The hospital's physicians are full-time faculty of the University of Arizona College of Medicine - Tucson. Our specialty services include comprehensive heart and cancer care, advanced neuroscience techniques and a multi-organ transplant program.

POSITION SUMMARY
This position is responsible for scheduling surgical, cardiovascular or obstetrical procedures using a computerized scheduling system. The position is also responsible for entering patient charges, orders, and other pertinent information into the system and compiling and reporting statistical information to management. The incumbent may act as an office liaison for department staff, physicians, and patient families.

CORE FUNCTIONS
1. Coordinates case times for elective, urgent or emergent surgeries, cardiovascular or obstetrical procedures in a computerized scheduling system. Verifies and reviews physician privilege status prior to scheduling. Interfaces with medical staff office to maintain log of current privilege status and maintains confidentially of all information. May acquire and maintain physician preference information and staff roster.

2. Acquires authorization numbers, History and Physicals, results of laboratory tests and verifies that they are current. Orders previous medical records for the day of the procedure, when necessary.

3. Types and prints physician orders for multiple physicians and departments. Schedules and maintains physician block time, and block time releases.

4. Enters physician’s orders for lab, blood bank, medical imaging, and cardiology. Enters results of diagnostic tests, patient registration information and patient charges. Compiles data and prepares statistical reports for management.

5. Conducts charge management audits for assigned area. Reconciles charge packet information with the audit. Identifies missed or incorrect charges and corrects when appropriate.

6. Acts as a receptionist to assigned unit; answers phones, relays message. Greets and directs patients, visitors, physicians, and families and answers questions about policies and procedures. Acts as a liaison among nursing units, physician and staff to relay patient data. Screens requests for patient information and refers to appropriate staff. Records and types minutes of staff meetings, when required. Prepares and distributes staff call roster each month.

7. Enters facility work orders and supply orders when required by assigned department. Requests repairs/maintenance for business machines in the department. Arranges for pickup and delivery of instruments and equipment and completes all necessary paperwork.

8. This position has responsibility for scheduling surgeries and procedures and maintaining a smooth workflow in the area. Must be able to work with minimal supervision, under stressful situations, set priorities and maintain highly confidential information.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

High school diploma/GED or equivalent working knowledge.

Requires skills and abilities typically attained with 2 years of medical clerical experience; preferably in a hospital central scheduling or physician office scheduling setting. Knowledge of medical terminology is required.

Also requires knowledge of payor contract terms and processes. Must possess excellent organizational skills, as well as effective human relations and communication skills. Requires effective teamworking skills and the ability to meet deadlines and productivity standards.

The position requires knowledge of word processing and spreadsheet software and the ability to use computerized scheduling systems. Must possess the ability to maintain accurate statistical records, gather data, and produce reports.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

Job Description Summary

We build and buy software that touches clinical trials, patient safety, manufacturing, quality systems and commercial operations. It now ships weekly rather than yearly, is increasingly AI-assisted, and increasingly contains AI. Our control framework was built for a slower world.

This role makes secure, compliant, audit-ready software delivery the fastest path for engineers — not a gate they route around. You will own the enterprise SDLC governance model and build much of it yourself: policy as code, automated evidence capture, pipeline controls and reference architectures.

This is a hands-on, individual-contributor leadership role. You will set enterprise direction, influence hundreds of engineers and lead through a federated community — but you will not have a large direct team, and you will spend meaningful time in repositories, pipelines and control code. Candidates seeking pure oversight or people management should not apply.


Job Description

#LI-Hybrid
Location: Barcelona, Spain

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the enterprise policy, standards and controls for software engineering, including source control, branching, peer review, testing, release management, environment segregation, change control, configuration and release documentation.
  • Rationalise overlapping GxP, SOX, privacy, security and IT-quality requirements into one coherent, risk-based framework, ensuring low-risk internal tools are not governed like regulated clinical systems.
  • Retire SDLC controls that do not reduce risk and ensure tooling is implemented to securely speed up software development at Novartis at the highest scale, leveraging and creating AI tooling for the enterprise.
  • Implement policy as code and controls as code, including branch protections, mandatory review, signed commits, segregation of duties, deployment approvals and immutable audit trails.
  • Build automated, continuous evidence pipelines and define control telemetry including coverage, exceptions, drift, mean time to remediate and control effectiveness, with a focus on agility, automation and speed.
  • Own secure-by-default guardrails in golden pipelines and paved-road platforms, aligning with recognized frameworks including NIST SSDF, ISO/IEC 27001 and IEC 62304 where applicable.
  • Define controls for AI-assisted engineering, including acceptable use of coding assistants, agentic tooling, IP and licence exposure, provenance, attribution and human accountability for review and approval.
  • Define controls for AI-containing products, including model lifecycle, dataset and model documentation, evaluation, drift monitoring, explainability, human oversight and readiness for evolving regulatory requirements.
  • Use AI to reduce compliance burden through automated risk assessment drafting, control mapping, test generation, deviation triage and documentation synthesis, while serving as technical authority for inspections, audits, certifications and SDLC remediation.
  • Lead a federated community of engineering, quality, security and compliance practitioners, publish practical guidance, advise senior leaders on risk and trade-offs, and partner with software developers across the enterprise to enable efficient delivery of compliant and secure products.

Essential Requirement:

  • You are a practitioner. You have substantial hands-on software engineering experience: you have written production code, owned CI/CD pipelines, and can read and modify pipeline configuration, IaC and policy code today, unaided. Expect a technical assessment.
  • 10+ years in software engineering, platform engineering, DevSecOps or engineering quality, including senior technical ownership of delivery pipelines at scale.
  • Experience designing and operating automated controls in regulated environments — with evidence of replacing manual compliance work with software.
  • Working fluency in regulated-software requirements relevant to pharma/life sciences: GxP, GAMP 5 (2nd Ed.), CSA, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11 and data integrity/ALCOA+.
  • Security engineering depth: application security, software supply chain security, secrets and identity management, vulnerability management.
  • Credible technical judgement on AI in the SDLC — both the tooling and its governance implications.
  • Ability to influence without authority across engineering, quality and business lines, and hold positions with senior stakeholders and auditors.
  • Excellent written English.

Desirable Requirement:

  • Experience in pharma, biotech, medical devices or another regulated industry (finance, aviation, nuclear), with real inspection or audit exposure.Experience with SOX ITGC in engineering contexts, IEC 62304 / SaMD, and privacy-by-design under GDPR.
  • Hands-on with modern stacks: Git-based platforms and policy/protection features, container orchestration, cloud, IaC, policy engines (e.g. OPA/Rego or equivalent), test automation frameworks, SBOM and signing tooling.

Responsible for the regulatory and scientific conduct of development, validation, stability projects, and/or other specialty technologies such as extractable/leachable studies. Performs troubleshooting on multiple analytical instrumentation and multiple detection techniques, calculates and interprets data, and records data in adherence with PPD SOPs and any additional requirements specific to the lab and / or client. Routinely acts as the technical project leader for multiple projects, interacts with clients on a weekly basis (or as needed) to provide updates, reviews and evaluates data, writes reports and protocols.

Overview:

This Statement of Work describes a dedicated on-site service offering that provides hands-on oligonucleotide LC–MS bioanalytical capacity to the customer’s DMPK (Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics) group, backed by analytical instrument field support. The service is designed to deliver the recurring oligonucleotide bioanalysis workload while keeping critical LC–MS platforms operational and analytically ready.

Individuals need strong instrument and computer-systems background, enabling user-level repairs, software and operating-system updates, and license administration to be handled in-house and bridging coverage until vendor service engineers can attend site. Individual will flex across bioanalysis and instrument support according to weekly demand, providing a consistent, approachable point of contact for the customer’s scientists and laboratory teams.

Objectives:

  • Deliver responsive, on-site oligonucleotide LC–MS bioanalytical support, scaled to the weekly study schedule.

  • Maximize uptime and analytical readiness of in-scope LC–MS and supporting laboratory instruments.

  • Resolve routine and minor instrument issues at the point of need, bridging coverage until vendor service attends site and reserving vendor engagements for repairs that exceed user-level scope.

  • Maintain instrument software, computer systems, operating-system updates, licensing, and version control.

  • Provide secondary small-molecule DMPK bioanalytical capacity when oligonucleotide and instrument demands allow.

  • Deliver a visible, collaborative presence that integrates with the customer’s scientific and laboratory support teams.

Scope of Service:

The primary focus of the service is hands-on oligonucleotide bioanalytical support to the DMPK group, scaled to the volume of work required each week. This capacity is intended to help deliver the recurring portfolio of in-vitro and in-vivo oligonucleotide studies on schedule.

  • Assay execution: Development and execution of oligonucleotide LC–MS bioanalytical workflows, including sample preparation, extraction, LC–MS analysis, and data review.

  • Method support: Support of method transfer, familiarization, and routine troubleshooting for oligonucleotide assays, including chromatographic and ion-pairing performance issues.

  • Workflow flexibility: Ability to ramp quickly across multiple established oligonucleotide assay types and adjust to fill the week’s study demand.

  • Data integrity: Review and handling of analytical data in line with the customer’s quality and compliance expectations.

Instrument Upkeep & Real-Time Support:

The service also maintains in-scope analytical equipment in an operational state and provides immediate, user-level response to minor issues, minimizing downtime and bridging coverage until vendor service can attend site.

  • Routine maintenance: Preventive maintenance, QC checks, and consumable management for in-scope LC–MS systems.

  • First-line triage: Real-time diagnosis and resolution of minor issues at the bench — for example, power cycling, basic troubleshooting, and user-level repairs such as addressing a crashed LC needle.

  • Hardware lifecycle: Coordination of hardware updates and component replacements as required.

  • Escalation: Defined troubleshooting and escalation paths, routing repairs that exceed user-level scope to the appropriate vendor service organization (e.g., SCIEX).

Software, License & Computer System Management:

The service maintains instrument software and the computer systems that control in-scope instruments, keeping acquisition workstations current, licensed, and aligned with the customer’s IT requirements.

  • Software maintenance: Management of instrument software updates, patching, and version control.

  • Computer & operating system updates: Deployment of workstation operating system updates, security patching, and configuration changes on instrument-controlling computers, coordinated with the customer’s IT function to avoid disruption to acquisition.

  • License administration: Tracking and administration of instrument software licenses to maintain continuity of operation.

Coordination & On-Site Presence:

  • Visible support: A consistent, approachable presence within the laboratory areas, supplemented by responsive communication via the customer’s collaboration tools.

  • Vendor escort & coordination: Escorting and hosting instrument vendors on-site, and coordinating with the customer’s analytical and laboratory support functions.

  • Instrument readiness: Preparing instruments for relocation, decommissioning, or related activities.

Small-Molecule Bioanalytical Support:

  • Assay execution: Support of established small-molecule DMPK bioanalytical workflows, including sample preparation, bioanalysis, and data review.

  • Workflow flexibility: Ability to ramp across multiple established small-molecule assay types and absorb overflow demand.

  • Prioritization: Small-molecule work is scheduled around oligonucleotide bioanalysis and instrument support commitments, and is agreed with the customer on a weekly basis.

Equipment in Scope:

The service covers analytical instrumentation across major and specialty LC–MS vendor platforms, with emphasis on the systems used for oligonucleotide bioanalysis, such as LC-MS platforms, Chromatography, Mass Spec, and supporting equipment.

Personnel & Hands-on experience with oligonucleotide LC–MS bioanalysis, including sample extraction, ion-pairing chromatography, and quantitation on SCIEX and Shimadzu platforms.

  • Familiarity with bioanalytical workflows — sample preparation, bioanalysis, and data review — with the ability to ramp quickly across multiple established assay types, including small-molecule DMPK assays.

  • For at least one of the two resources: demonstrable depth in LC–MS instrument hardware maintenance and user-level repair, together with management of instrument software and instrument-controlling computers — updates, patching, version control, operating system administration, and license administration — sufficient to resolve issues in-house and bridge coverage until vendor service engineers attend site.

  • Relevant education, or extensive directly relevant hands-on experience in lieu of formal education.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification

  • Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 6+ years).

  • In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Work Environment:
Thermo Fisher Scientific values the health and wellbeing of our employees. We support and encourage individuals to create a healthy and balanced environment where they can thrive. Below is listed the working environment/requirements for this role:

  • Able to communicate, receive, and understand information and ideas with diverse groups of people in a comprehensible and reasonable manner.

  • Able to work upright and stationary and/or standing for typical working hours.

  • Able to lift and move objects up to 25 pounds.

  • Able to work in non-traditional work environments.

  • Able to use and learn standard office equipment and technology with proficiency.

  • May have exposure to potentially hazardous elements, including infectious agents, typically found in healthcare or laboratory environments.

  • Able to perform successfully under pressure while prioritizing and handling multiple projects or activities.

description:
Title:

Senior Digital Network Exploitation Analyst (Sr. DNEA)

Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!

KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security.

· Collaborative Environment: Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace.

Senior Digital Network Exploitation Analyst (Sr. DNEA)

Position Summary

The Senior Digital Network Exploitation Analyst (Sr. DNEA) is responsible for analyzing, designing, specifying, and supporting complex communications and network infrastructures to enable intelligence collection, network characterization, and mission success. This role applies advanced technical expertise to evaluate communication systems, network architectures, data flows, transmission methods, and associated technologies including satellite communications, line-of-sight systems, fiber-optic networks, telephony systems, public address systems, and Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) data transmission environments.

Under general supervision, the Sr. DNEA performs highly complex analytical and engineering assignments requiring independent judgment, technical innovation, and the adaptation of established methodologies to address emerging challenges. The position supports mission operations through technical analysis, network exploitation assessments, intelligence reporting, and the development of innovative solutions to complex network-related problems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze and characterize complex digital networks, communication architectures, and data transmission systems.
  • Design, specify, and support communications infrastructure solutions across multiple technologies and environments.
  • Conduct network exploitation analysis to identify network structures, relationships, protocols, vulnerabilities, and operational characteristics.
  • Evaluate communication systems including satellite, line-of-sight, fiber-optic, telephony, and SCADA-related networks.
  • Plan, schedule, and execute technical projects requiring independent evaluation, selection, and adaptation of analytical and engineering techniques.
  • Develop innovative approaches to solve complex technical challenges involving unconventional requirements, conflicting design constraints, or integration issues.
  • Perform detailed analysis of network traffic, communication protocols, and data flows to produce actionable intelligence and technical assessments.
  • Author technical reports, assessments, and briefings for operational, engineering, and leadership audiences.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, intelligence partners, and mission stakeholders to support data sharing and operational objectives.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and subject matter expertise to junior analysts, engineers, and technical personnel.
  • Support mission planning, operational execution, and capability development through advanced technical analysis and recommendations.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 4 years of relevant experience; typically 6-10 years of progressively responsible experience in network analysis, communications engineering, cyber operations, intelligence analysis, or related fields.
  • Experience analyzing communication systems and network architectures.
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts, protocols, routing, switching, and telecommunications infrastructure.
  • Experience evaluating and interpreting complex technical data and developing analytical assessments.
  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision while managing multiple priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to brief both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Digital Network Exploitation (DNE), Signals Intelligence (SIGINT), Cyber Intelligence, or Intelligence Community missions.
  • Familiarity with SCADA, industrial control systems, and critical infrastructure communications.
  • Experience with network mapping, protocol analysis, and data flow characterization.
  • Knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, Network+, CySA+, CISSP, CEH, or equivalent.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Communications systems engineering and integration.

As the Med Imaging Assistant, you will play a vital part in supporting technologists by preparing exam rooms, calling back and changing patients before exams, and performing IVs. Medical imaging plays a pivotal role in the delivery of excellent patient care at Banner Health.
